links.title: Forgotten in Weights, Recovered by Tools: Agentic Tool Unlearning for LLM Agents

evidence: Motivation/Fig. 2: standard NPO unlearning reduces forget score 37.9→9.7 on MUSE (Books) and 57.7→44.6 on RWKU standalone, but scores rise to 29.8 and 68.6 under tool-augmented agent deployment.
Sec. 6.2, Table 3: NPO+Stage 2 reduces agent-deployment All from 68.6→47.5 (Δ −21.1) while retaining Neighbor 55.8, Factuality 37.5, Fluency 669.2 on RWKU with Qwen-3-4B.
Appendix D.4, Table 9: isolates framework effect (Δfw +1.2) from tool effect (Δtool +22.8) for Stage-1 NPO; after Stage 2 tool-induced recovery shrinks to +2.4.
Appendix D.6, Tables 11-12: Refusal SFT −8.7 and Trajectory DPO −10.5 vs ATU −21.1 on All; ATU costs 1.97h vs 1.10h (SFT) and 1.35h (DPO), with lower Neighbor utility than simpler baselines.

Appendix D.9, Table 15: human-validated judge comparison; Qwen2.5-7B judge reaches 83.3% sign agreement and 63.9% exact match, 4B/8B judges only 58.3%/61.1%, with downstream Forget All varying 47.5-60.0.
Appendix D.7, Table 13: forced-retrieval directives raise Stage-1 NPO All to 89.9 (+21.3); ATU limits uplift to +12.1 but exact-copy condition degrades to 57.7 (+10.2), showing incomplete robustness.
Table 4: cross-model MUSE results — Qwen-3-4B knowmem_f 29.8→15.8 (knowmem_r 56.7→55.1); Qwen-2.5-7B knowmem_f 32.9→22.4 (knowmem_r 44.1→40.5).
Appendix D.10, Table 16: 128-step GRPO audit (mean reward −0.44, mean KL ≈0.50, no ultra-short max-reward loophole), though the paper concedes LLM-judged reward dependence remains a limitation.

Limitations section: 'Incomplete closure of the agentic recovery gap' and 'Limited coverage of downstream tool environments' — Stage 2 does not fully restore standalone Stage-1 forgetting levels and training uses a finite simulated tool set.
Appendix C.4: implementation details provided (LLaMA-Factory LoRA Stage 1, OpenRLHF GRPO with vLLM rollouts, 4×RTX 4090 hardware); abstract footnote claims code availability.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper squarely matching top-weight preferences: tool-augmented LLM agents, unlearning/safety, GRPO/preference-optimization training, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and retrieval tooling. The identified failure mode (tool-mediated recovery of parametrically unlearned knowledge, e.g., NPO forget score rising 44.6→68.6 on RWKU under agent deployment) is a genuine and quantitatively demonstrated problem; the two-stage ATU fix (parametric unlearning + trajectory-level GRPO with judged rewards) is a sensible combination of existing components (NPO/DPO, GRPO, LLM judges, Qwen-Agent) rather than a fundamentally new technique. Rigor is above average: agent-framework-vs-tool decomposition (Appendix D.4), non-RL SFT/DPO baselines with cost accounting (D.6), tool-swap and held-out-query/tool generalization, adversarial forced-retrieval directives, human validation of the reward judge (83.3% sign agreement for the 7B judge, but only 58.3%/61.1% for 4B/8B), and a reward-hacking audit; limitations are candidly stated (residual gap not closed to standalone level; exact-copy directives remain vulnerable). Weaknesses: single-seed runs without variance, noisy LLM-judge rewards, ROUGE-L-based leakage metrics, Qwen-only backbones, a single-framework (Qwen-Agent) simulated environment, per-target RL training cost, and a very small held-out-query study (one target, 19 test queries). Code availability is claimed with detailed hyperparameters and judge prompts aiding reproduction, though web-tool dependence introduces nondeterminism.

primary_link.title: Forgotten in Weights, Recovered by Tools: Agentic Tool Unlearning for LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents, where responses can depend on tool calls and external observations rather than model parameters alone. This creates an evaluation mismatch for LLM unlearning: previous unlearning methods may suppress direct parametric recall, but an agent can still recover the same forget target through tools such as web search, retrieval, or database lookup. We identify this failure mode as tool-mediated recovery and study agentic
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出 LLM 機器遺忘（machine unlearning）的一大評估盲點：現有方法多半在單機推論下驗證模型是否已忘記目標知識，但一旦模型被部署為可呼叫工具的代理（agent），仍可透過網路搜尋、資料庫查詢或文件檢索等外部工具「復原」被遺忘的內容，作者稱此現象為 tool-mediated recovery。為此，論文提出兩階段框架 ATU：第一階段在參數層面執行知識遺忘（如 GA、RT、DPO、NPO），抑制直接回憶；第二階段在模擬的工具增強環境中，以軌跡層級的強化學習（GRPO）訓練模型，對遺忘查詢懲罰「找答案式」的工具呼叫與最終答案洩漏，同時以保留查詢與通用工具任務維持正常回應品質與良性工具使用能力。在 RWKU 與 MUSE（Books）基準、多個 Qwen 骨幹模型上的實驗顯示：以 NPO 為例，遺忘集分數在代理部署下從 44.6 回升至 68.6，加入第二階段後降至 47.5（下降 21.1 分）；MUSE 的 knowmem_f 也從 29.8 降到 15.8，且保留端效用與工具使用率大致維持。限制方面：遺忘分數未完全回到單機水準、訓練工具環境覆蓋有限、面對強制檢索等自適應指令攻擊仍會部分洩漏，且依賴 LLM 評審給予獎勵，可能存在 reward hacking 風險。此研究提醒：機器遺忘的評估必須納入代理式部署情境，未來基準應加入工具介導復原指標，使隱私與版權保護在真實部署下依然有效。

papers.title_zh: 權重中遺忘、工具中復原：LLM 代理的代理式工具遺忘（Agentic Tool Unlearning）

links.title: UpgradeBench: A Decision-Centric Benchmark for Upgrading Fine-Tuned LLM Specialists

evidence: §6 (Prospectively Specified Analyses): hypotheses were fixed before each wave (e.g., H2 predicted Copy R≥0.8 on shape-compatible hops); outcomes are reported against them, including refutations and a wave-5 correction overturning the wave-4 anneal/soup attribution.

§7.3 / Table 8: naive adapter copying collapses between independent pretraining runs (Banking77 Qwen2→2.5 R=−0.551, score .4286 vs floor .6071; OLMo-1→1.7 R=−0.32) but retains R=0.88/0.99 at a 46B-token OLMo continuation and falls to the floor (R=−0.02) at a 2.9T-token continuation, with anneal and soup edges adding no further damage.

§7.10 / Table 10: the pre-specified policy replayed over 33 episodes on held-out test-set halves attains 0.37pp mean regret with zero regression episodes at 15.6 GPU-h versus 47.7 for always-retrain; copy-if-shape baseline yields 17.11pp mean regret and 14 regressions.
§5 (Study inventory): 98 QLoRA trainings, 193 evaluation cells, 148.7 training GPU-hours with 47.8 kWh measured board energy, all on one RTX 4090 with pinned software versions.

§7.12 (Threats): authors state one lineage per family, one dataset per task class, QLoRA r=16 only with full fine-tuning unmeasured, and 1.8pp seed spread on the Spider/Qwen3 reference limiting single-hop retention arithmetic.

Reproducibility Statement: releases training/evaluation scripts, all 98 adapters, per-query records and bootstrap CIs for 193 cells, split manifests, relabeled Refresh-D corpora, memorization-probe outputs, and raw cost logs, 'to be released publicly upon publication'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A decision-centric longitudinal benchmark measuring the freeze/port/refresh/retrain choice for fine-tuned LLM specialists across real Qwen and OLMo release lineages. Strongly aligned with core LLM preferences (LLMs, PEFT/QLoRA fine-tuning, evaluation/benchmarks, function calling, text-to-SQL, cost-aware serving); no Japanese or reasoning content. Methodological hygiene is unusually high: prospectively specified hypotheses with wave boundaries, paired exact McNemar tests, multi-seed checks that overturned a single-seed decline (CLINC150), artifact controls (template swap, bf16 re-run, constrained decoding), and explicit self-corrections. The continuity/distance porting criterion is the standout novel finding, replicated in two families, though it rests on few cells and endpoint-only distance sampling. Generalizability is limited by English-only tasks, one lineage per family, a single QLoRA r=16 recipe (rank dependence shown), and the 8B cap; reproducibility claims are extensive but public release is deferred to publication.

primary_link.title: UpgradeBench: A Decision-Centric Benchmark for Upgrading Fine-Tuned LLM Specialists

papers.summary: Organizations maintain task-specific adapters for open-weight language models, and each new base-model release forces a migration decision: retain existing specialists, port adapters, refresh from preserved behavior, or retrain. Prior transfer work evaluates isolated model pairs, without studying these choices across real model release sequences. We present UpgradeBench, a decision-driven longitudinal benchmark covering four consecutive Qwen releases, one continuation checkpoint, six tasks, and
papers.summary_zh: 企業常在開源權重模型上微調出任務專用的 specialist，每當新基礎模型釋出，就面臨抉擇：凍結舊模型、移植 adapter、以舊模型為教師刷新，或全額重新訓練，但這個「升級稅」從未被系統性量測。作者提出 UpgradeBench，沿 Qwen1.5 到 Qwen3 四代、十四個月的完整釋出譜系，涵蓋六項任務與兩種規模（7–8B 與 1.5–1.8B），並以訓練譜系完全公開的 OLMo checkpoints 做前瞻式驗證；全部 98 次訓練在一張 RTX 4090 完成，並釋出逐題預測、成本與能源紀錄。核心發現：升級價值因任務而異——Banking77 凍結在九個 hop 保留 99–101% 效益，text-to-SQL 單次 hop 最多損失 59%；直接複製 adapter 的成敗不繫於架構相容，而繫於預訓練連續性：獨立預訓練的檢查點即使形狀相同也崩潰至低於不用 adapter 的水準，短程延續預訓練則保留 0.82–1.45，且可移植性隨延續距離衰減（46B tokens 保留 0.88–0.99，2.9T tokens 歸零）；以留存輸入做教師重新標註的 Refresh 達到與 gold-label 重訓相當的品質且零新增標註；預先指定的決策政策在 33 個升級情境上平均品質損失僅 0.37 個百分點、零行為退化，只花費三成的重訓運算與標註預算；CKA 探針可排序可移植性（Spearman 0.74）。限制包括僅測 QLoRA rank 16、模型規模上限 8B、任務皆為英文，且主要結論來自單一族系與固定資料集。此研究把升級決策變成可定價、可重播的問題，對企業維運 specialist 艦隊極具參考價值。

links.title: Measuring Activation Control in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: introduces Activation Controllability Benchmark quantifying modulation of residual stream via natural-language instruction; reports evasion of linear probes, natural language autoencoders, activation oracles, and the Jacobian lens
Section 3.1 / Table 1: controllability score S ranges 0.059 (GPT-OSS 120B) to 0.538 (Llama 3.1 8B) across 25 models from 4B to 744B, with 95% cluster-bootstrap CIs for most models
Figure 10 / Section 3.3: at 1% FPR, linear probes flag near-ceiling engagement but detect only 5-21% of suppression trials across nine models

Section 3.3: J-lens recovers concept in 76-99% of engagement trials in nine of 13 panel models but below 10% on suppression in 11 of 13; NLA mentions concept in 32% engagement vs 0 of 500 suppression trials
Appendix B: preregistered decision rule targeted CI half-width 0.025 d'; headline load slope -0.0255 with 95% CI [-0.0428, +0.0109], zero included, single model (Gemma 3 27B)
Section 4.1 Limitations: concepts are simple and not safety-relevant (e.g., deception), monitors are off-the-shelf and not hardened against evasive activations
Appendix C: code (github.com/mkobalski/activation-control) and dataset (hf.co/datasets/joshycodes/activation-control-battery) released; seeds, software versions, and GPU configurations specified

Appendix A: six measures are not independent (Engage-Coverage Spearman rho=0.81, participation ratio 3.82 of 6); Engage/Suppress scores use within-bootstrap peak-layer reselection acknowledged as mildly optimistic
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability/safety paper: introduces an Activation Controllability Benchmark quantifying instruction-following 'write access' to the residual stream across 25 open-weight models, with demonstrated evasion of four monitor families. Strongly matches LLM, AI Safety, Interpretability, and Red Teaming/Evaluation preferences; not a domain application. Novelty is solid though it builds directly on Lindsey (2026) transcription-based introspection and prior modulation work (Ji-An et al., Aoki et al.). Rigor is high: signal-detection d' measures, two-way cluster bootstraps (B=2000), preregistered precision targets for the task-load experiment, honest reporting of measure redundancy (Engage-Coverage rho=0.81, effective dimensionality 3.82) and peak-selection optimism. Evidence is quantitative but uneven: headline evasion results (probes detect 5-21% of suppression at 1% FPR; NLA 0/500 suppression mentions) are strong, yet the five largest models are point-estimate-only, the training-trajectory claim rests on point estimates, and the task-load result covers a single model with a CI straddling zero. Generalizability is tempered by acknowledged limitations: simple/safe concepts only, off-the-shelf unhardened monitors, and no fine-tuned adversaries. Reproducibility is excellent: code and dataset released, full stimuli lists, seeds, software versions, and GPU configs documented. Aggregate ~0.80 reflects a rigorous, relevant contribution with mildly self-limited evidence breadth.

primary_link.title: Measuring Activation Control in Large Language Models

papers.summary: Safe deployment of increasingly capable models will likely come to rely on latent-space monitoring as a complement to behavioral evaluations, especially when evaluation-aware models exhibit scheming or deception. However, if models can also control their own activations, deception could extend into the latent space itself. With this in mind, we introduce the Activation Controllability Benchmark to quantify the extent to which models can modulate their residual stream via natural-language instruc
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出「激活可控性基準」,量化大型語言模型能否透過自然語言指令調控自身殘差流的激活狀態。團隊設計六項指標(啟動、抑制、強度調節、時間控制、覆蓋率、層級定位)並合成單一可控性分數,測試二十五個開源模型(4B 至 744B)。結果顯示多數模型能在指令下啟動或壓低特定概念表示,甚至平滑調節其強度,但無法精確鎖定特定層級,時間控制亦不精準;可控性與參數量或能力指標無明顯相關,Llama 3.1 8B 反而整體最佳。在監控規避實驗中,僅憑指令的抑制即可躲過線性探針、Jacobian lens、激活預言機與自然語言自編碼器等四類監控方法。訓練檢查點分析顯示此能力在預訓練與後訓練中隱式累積,無需專門訓練。限制在於僅使用簡單安全的概念、未經強化的監控器,且估計值僅為能力引發的下限。此研究對安全部署意義重大:若模型能操控自身激活空間,潛在空間監控的有效性可能被侵蝕,作者建議將激活可控性納入各代模型的常規安全評估。

links.title: An Extensive Empirical Study on Code Translation Technique

evidence: Section III-A: selects 8 open-source methods (VIM-PT, StructCoder, TransCoder-ST, CodeT5+, InterTrans x2, UniTrans, ExeCoder) plus 3 LLMs (GPT-3.5-turbo-1106, GPT-4o-mini-2024-07-18, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) with explicit performance/recency/language-diversity criteria.

Section V-A (Finding 1, Tables IV-V): 'UniTrans achieves the best performance, with average CSR (CA) scores of 96.01% (94.36%) on G-TransEval and 96.59% (91.66%) on TransCoder-Uni', while best learning-based method TransCoder-ST reaches only 56.96% CA.
Section V-C (Table VIII): best class-level CA is 24.82% (UniTrans) versus 89.39% CSR, with Java→C++ CA ≤ 12.77% for all methods, supporting the class-level difficulty claim.

Section V-D: manual annotation of 570 method-level and 150 class-level failures; static semantic errors 49.37% (method-level) and 70.67% (class-level), function signature violations 70.18% of static semantic errors, 'Fleiss' kappa coefficient was 0.9446'.
Section VII (Threats to Validity, Table XI): data-leakage control via cleaned XLCoST overlap and a 50-problem post-cutoff Luogu dataset with gaps of -9.17 to +7.58 points, judged 'limited' impact.

Section IV-C: LLM decoding fixed at temperature=0.8, top_p=0.9, n=1 with three independent runs averaged; learning-based hyperparameters in Table III; Section IX provides open-source data/code via Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21973888.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed large-scale empirical study squarely within preferred topics: it benchmarks general-purpose LLMs (GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) and LLM-based code translation systems against learning-based baselines under unified settings, matching the LLM and Code/Programming preferences strongly. Rigor is high: 11 techniques across 3 test-suite-backed benchmarks (1,062 tasks, 5 languages), three independent runs for LLMs, documented hyperparameters, training-overlap cleaning, a post-cutoff data-leakage check (50 Luogu problems, Table XI), and a manual error taxonomy with 570+150 annotated failures and Fleiss' kappa 0.9446. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent (e.g., UniTrans 96.01%/94.36% CSR/CA on G-TransEval; class-level CA drops to 24.82% despite 89.39% CSR). Novelty is moderate: the paper claims the first cross-paradigm/cross-granularity comparison, but core findings (LLMs > learning-based methods; static-typed-to-dynamic-typed easier; class-level much harder; CodeBLEU unreliability) largely confirm prior expectations and prior single-paradigm studies. Generalizability is limited to function/class-level benchmarks derived from competitive-programming-style sources; no statistical significance testing is reported and error analysis relies on sampled cases. Reproducibility is supported by versioned model identifiers, hyperparameter tables, and an open Zenodo repository.

To address this gap, we conduct a large-scale empirical study comparing representative code translation techniques across methodological paradigms and translation granularities. We evaluate learning-based methods, LLM-based methods, and general-purpose LLMs on multilingual method
papers.summary_zh: 本文對十一種程式碼翻譯技術進行大規模跨典範實證研究,涵蓋四種學習式方法(VIM-PT、StructCoder、TransCoder-ST、CodeT5+)、四種 LLM 式方法(InterTrans 兩變體、UniTrans、ExeCoder)與三個通用 LLM(GPT-3.5、GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash),在方法級基準 G-TransEval、TransCoder-Uni 與類別級基準 ClassEval-T 上,以執行正確性(CA)、編譯成功率(CSR)與 CodeBLEU 相似度統一比較。主要發現:方法級翻譯中 LLM 式方法在正確性上明顯優於學習式方法,但相似度指標無法可靠反映功能正確性;翻譯方向影響顯著,從靜態型別語言翻至動態型別語言通常較佳,反向則需補推型別而表現較差;類別級翻譯遠難於方法級,最佳方法平均 CA 僅 24.82%,CSR 卻高達 89.39%,顯示編譯易而語義正確難;錯誤分析顯示靜態語義錯誤(49.37%)與邏輯錯誤(27.46%)為主要失敗來源,其中函式簽章違規最為常見。限制在於基準與方法選擇的代表性。作者據此呼籲發展型別感知、結構感知與上下文感知的翻譯技術,並兼顧正確性與相似度雙軌評估。

links.title: Graph Engineering in the Era of LLM Agents: From Individual Intelligence to System Intelligence

evidence: Abstract: introduces Graph Engineering for building agent systems and states all related resources are collected at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/Awesome-Graph-Engineering
Section 4.1: defines the three graph views (Task Organization, Agent Coordination, Runtime State Management) as the core of the proposed paradigm
Section 3.4: contains unrendered citation keys 'li2026loopsbench, macedo2026loop' in the Loop Engineering definition, indicating incomplete proofreading
References [202] and [221]: include editorial notes 'verify authors, venue, DOI, and publication status before submission', signaling placeholder citations
Section 5.2.1: cites LAMP with reference [7], which resolves to an Anthropic Claude product/documentation page, a citation mismatch
Section 7 / Table 1: organizes roughly sixty benchmarks, datasets, and environments across Model, Individual, and System Intelligence levels
Section 11.1 / Table 4: self-compares against related surveys, acknowledging overlap with the dynamic graph transformation survey [391] and multi-agent orchestration surveys [476]
Section 7.4: identifies open evaluation gaps including separating system-level gains from stronger models and structural credit assignment
llm_evaluation.rationale: A comprehensive survey squarely in-scope for LLM agent research: it proposes 'Graph Engineering' (Section 4) as a paradigm for multi-agent systems along three views (Task Organization, Agent Coordination, Runtime State Management) plus System Evolution and Ontology Engineering (Sections 5-6). Preference relevance is very high given dense coverage of agents, tool use, orchestration, memory, and prompting (Sections 3-4). Novelty is moderate: the unifying framing is new terminology, but the paper itself (Section 11.1, Table 4) acknowledges substantial overlap with recent surveys such as the dynamic-graph-transformation survey [391] and orchestration surveys [476], and much content is standard (GPTSwarm, AFlow, LangGraph). Rigor and evidence are middling for a survey: no systematic review methodology (search/inclusion criteria) is described; formal definitions in Section 2 are shallow; there are unfinished artifacts including raw citation keys ('li2026loopsbench, macedo2026loop') left in Section 3.4, placeholder notes 'verify authors, venue, DOI, and publication status before submission' attached to references [202] and [221], a likely citation mismatch (Section 5.2.1 attributes 'LAMP' to reference [7], which is an Anthropic Claude product page), and duplicate GPT-4 report entries ([256]/[327]). Evidence strength is largely borrowed from cited works, with descriptive application tables (Table 3) rather than original experiments. Generalizability is good given cross-domain coverage (Section 9: software engineering, science, healthcare, enterprise, simulation) and evaluation principles (Section 7.4). Reproducibility is aided by the stated public resource collection (Abstract: GitHub Awesome-Graph-Engineering link) and linked benchmark/library tables, but weakened by unmaintained references. Overall: a useful, well-organized position survey with notable editorial sloppiness.

papers.summary_zh: 本綜述提出「圖工程」(Graph Engineering)做為構建 LLM 代理系統的新興典範,論述從模型智慧到個體智慧、再到系統智慧的工程演進。文章先梳理前序典範:提示工程與上下文工程激發模型能力,Harness 工程串接工具、記憶與技能,迴路工程組織持續執行的回饋循環;然而單一代理仍難以排程平行且相互依賴的子任務、整合異質專業能力並維持持久狀態,因此需要系統智慧。圖工程以圖結構外化任務、代理與執行狀態之間的關係,涵蓋三大視角:任務組織(目標分解與工作流程最佳化)、代理協調(能力建模、團隊組織與多代理通訊)與執行期狀態管理(狀態記錄、故障定位與失敗復原),並以系統演化持續改進結構。全文系統性回顧代表性基準、開源函式庫,以及軟體工程、科學發現、醫療等應用,並指出本體工程與圖原生代理作業系統等未來方向。限制在於此領域仍屬新興,跨圖演化與結構化評估尚未成熟。本文為多代理系統從「圖結構化」走向「圖工程化」提供了完整的概念框架與研究議程。

papers.title_zh: LLM 代理時代的圖工程:從個體智慧到系統智慧

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-RL methodology: conditions the GAE/Bellman transport kernel on a detached statistic of the policy's own attention (CompPO) plus an actor-feature critic, evaluated with RL on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B for math reasoning. Experimental design is unusually careful (matched LR/KL screen, five seeds, 2x2 gate-by-critic factorial with seed-matched interaction CI, shuffle/position-only negative controls, PPO stress grid, stronger-group baseline, frozen second-backbone transfer), and the paper is candid about attention not being causal attribution and gate staleness. Novelty is a genuine but composed contribution given adjacent prior work on transition-dependent discounting and attention-based credit.

papers.summary_zh: 本文指出 LLM 強化學習的功勞分配長期存在「架構與功勞錯配」:固定折扣 GAE 沿時間軸套用靜態幾何核,GRPO 則將回應級統計量廣播至所有 token,兩者皆忽略 Transformer 政策自身已計算出的軌跡特定依賴結構。作者將功勞分配拆解為證據、傳輸算子與更新幾何三個物件,提出「計算條件化功勞傳輸」框架 CCT,並實作為 CompPO:以最終層注意力的 Herfindahl 集中度經有界映射產生保留閘門 κ_t,同時驅動單步 bootstrap、路徑相依的 Comp-GAE 軌跡,以及重用 actor 隱藏狀態、與傳輸機制對齊的價值評論器,而外部獎勵與 PPO 截斷目標維持不變。實驗上,Qwen3-4B 經五個種子驗證,CompPO 達 61.4% 最終保留驗證集準確率,遠高於調校後 GRPO 的 53.8%;2×2 因子實驗顯示動態閘門與對齊評論家具正向交互作用(+2.4 點),全域洗牌與僅位置控制亦證明軌跡特定對齊不可或缺;匹配壓力網格中 CompPO 於 12 次中 10 次穩定,優於 PPO 的 3/12;凍結評估在 Qwen3-4B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 分別領先 GRPO 4.3 與 3.9 點。限制包括僅驗證數學推理、注意力僅為結構代理訊號,以及閘門跨更新輪次存在滯後。此工作將政策內部計算提升為 RL 估計器的一等變數。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference work: a multi-session memory-hygiene benchmark for LLM software agents (Agents 2.5, Code 2.0, Evaluation 1.8, Memory 1.8), squarely in scope and not a domain application. Methodologically unusually rigorous: preregistered frozen protocols with SHA-256-hashed preregistrations (Appendix B/C), trap-clustered exact permutation tests with Holm correction over 60 trap clusters (Appendix E), power analysis (Table 23), pre-registered falsifiers honestly reported as failing (UsefulMemoryPrecision 0.264 vs B5 0.556; Table 20), CSPRNG secret injection, container-isolation canary proof (Section 5.6), and a null primary result (P1: 95/180 vs 89/180, permutation p=0.518, Holm p=1.0, Table 9) reported as the headline rather than spun. Evidence supports the bounded claims made: the successor v2.1 audit shows benchmark discrimination via three Family A rejections vs B0 after Holm correction (Table 13), but the headline system comparison is null, C9/C10 strata fail B0-headroom validity (Table 10), the mechanism family is wholly unavailable after conformance rejection, and the benchmark is heavily recall-verbatim (18/22 v1 traps, Appendix A), which partly explains the strong simple verbatim baseline. Novelty is real but narrow: adjacent multi-session memory benchmarks (MemoryArena, EvoMemBench, WorldMemArena, STATE-Bench, MemoryAgentBench) preclude generic priority, and the wake/sleep reference probe recombines known ideas (MemGPT, Letta, Sleep-time Compute, Reflexion) with careful claim boundaries. Generalizability is limited: single wake model gpt-5.5, GLM-5.2 transfer scoped out with no cross-backbone claim (Section 8), fixture repositories, one admitted hosted Mem0 configuration. Reproducibility is high for analysis replay (released v2.0.5/v2.1.0 artifacts with digests, exact replay commands, Appendix B/F) but bounded by hosted-model drift, which the paper itself discloses.

The successor run completed 360/360 work units and 720/720 S3 cells across four conditions. In the original fold, the primary DF
papers.summary_zh: 本文發表 DreamBench-SWE,一個針對多會話軟體代理「記憶衛生」的基準:後續會話的任務依賴早期會話中不可推斷的證據(如 CSPRNG 注入的隨機標記),並以可執行的隱藏預言機評分,藉此檢驗代理能否正確保留、檢索、更新與抑制記憶,而非僅累積記憶量。主要結果為縮放版 v2 確認性 fold:六十個陷阱、三個種子,每條件 180 個 S3 儲存格。原註冊的主比較(混合式探針 DF-hybrid 對抗強力逐字事件記憶 B5)統計不顯著(95/180 對 89/180,叢集 p=0.518,Holm 後 p=1),且僅為未拒絕而非等價;衛生指標 UsefulMemoryPrecision 亦未通過預註冊門檻。另含事前註冊的 v2.1 外部系統稽核:B0 僅 21/180,B5 82/180,DF-hybrid 83/180,唯一符合符合性檢查的託管 Mem0 逐字配置 B5-MEM0-LIT 達 97/180,三項對 B0 的比較經 Holm 校正後皆拒絕,確立基準之區辨力;但機制對比因配置於預評估被排除而不可評估。限制包括單一喚醒模型、僅檔案系統隔離而非網路隔離,以及 C9/C10 缺乏 B0 餘裕。此研究以透明方式發表負結果,為多會話記憶維護提供可重現的嚴格測量工具。

links.title: Uncovering and Understanding Hidden Dependencies in the LLM API Reseller Ecosystem via Prefix-Cache Side Channels

evidence: Section I (Contributions): claims first systematic study of hidden dependencies among LLM API resellers, formulating dependency visibility as an API-only measurement problem using prefix-cache reuse as a side channel.
Section IV-B1 & Table I: measurement of 39 endpoints, 636 pairs, ~1.1M requests over 7.2 hours; 236/636 (37.1%) pairs show shared cache reach, 147 (23.1%) inconclusive.
Section IV-B3 (Findings 2-3): containment order spans seven layers; one node's cache reach is contained in at least 31 of 33 clone-contracted nodes (stated as a conservative lower bound).
Section IV-C1 (Finding 6): telemetry validation finds 3 false hits among 5,059 usable cold-prompt observations (rate 5.9e-4, 95% CI [1.2e-4, 1.7e-3]).

Section IV-C2 (Finding 7): 14/21 A<B<C chains agree with the multiplicative hit-probability prediction within 0.10 (median deviation 0.084 vs 0.449 randomized), supporting the routing-consistency assumption.
Section IV-D (Finding 8): controlled evaluation with 8 configured topologies (T1-T8) is recovered exactly, including fan-in, chains, implication pruning, and overlapping latent witnesses.
Section IV-B5 (Finding 5): only 2 of 22 decisive reruns on gpt-5.1 reproduce the original containment relations, establishing model-specific topology.
Section III-C/III-D: statistical thresholds derived from binomial bounds at delta=alpha=0.05 (N_flood=59; N_prove=181 with M_contain=4; M_partial=15; M_nohit=59).
Ethics Considerations & Appendix B: endpoint identities withheld/redacted by standing policy and no code artifact is mentioned, limiting exact reproduction despite fully specified Algorithms 1-5.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM infrastructure research: measurement of the LLM API reseller ecosystem via prefix-cache (KV-cache) side channels, with direct ties to inference/serving, LLM supply-chain security, and agentic-workflow risk, not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid: prior work audits individual resellers or uses cache side channels for content leaks, while this paper repurposes authentic cache reuse as a relational infrastructure signal (cache reach/containment), acknowledged as a transfer of cloud co-residency and network tomography ideas. Rigor is strong: formal definitions, explicit assumptions (Assumptions 1-2), statistically derived thresholds (N_flood=59, N_prove=181, M_partial=15), empirical assumption validation, and a controlled 8/8 ground-truth recovery. Evidence is quantitative and appropriately hedged as an under-approximation, though limited to 39 endpoints in one 7.2-hour window, one primary model, and a modest decisive sample (22 reruns, 2 reproductions) for the model-dependence claim. Reproducibility is limited by redacted endpoint identities and no stated code release, despite fully specified algorithms and parameters.
topics: LLM API ecosystem / reseller supply-chain measurement
Prefix-cache & KV-cache side channels in LLM serving
AI safety: confidentiality/integrity of LLM APIs
Security implications for tool-using LLM agents

primary_link.title: Uncovering and Understanding Hidden Dependencies in the LLM API Reseller Ecosystem via Prefix-Cache Side Channels

papers.summary: LLM API resellers have become an important access layer to modern LLM services. However, multi-level resale creates an opaque supply chain: a user's request may traverse undisclosed upstream resellers, each of which can inspect or modify prompts and responses, inducing ecosystem-level confidentiality and integrity risks. Existing studies audit individual resellers, but provide little visibility into hidden dependencies across resellers. We present CacheTracer, the first API-only measurement of s
papers.summary_zh: LLM API 經銷商常經多層轉售形成不透明供應鏈,上游中介者可檢視或修改提示與回應,但使用者難以察覺這些隱藏依賴。本文提出 CacheTracer,首個僅透過 API 量測經銷商間依賴的方法:利用前綴快取重用做為側通道,以 Flood 原語透過端點 A 反覆灌入新提示,直到快取覆蓋其絕大多數路由流量,再以 Prove 的前綴階梯探測端點 B 能否重用該快取,並以雙向分類組裝全域快取可達結構。作者對 39 個真實經銷端點發送約 110 萬個請求、量測 636 個端點對,發現 37.1% 的對子存在共享快取可達;收縮為 34 個節點後,包含順序深達七層,且某一節點的快取可達被至少 31 個其他節點包含,顯示高度集中、潛在爆炸半徑大的生態結構;跨模型重測中,22 次決定性重測僅 2 次保留包含關係,證明拓撲具模型特異性。驗證方面,5059 次冷提示觀測僅 3 次誤報,受控實驗精確復原 8/8 已知拓撲。限制在於量測結果為保守下近似,快取包含亦不等於已證實的供應邊。此研究對供應鏈感知的安全評估與端到端內容協定設計具啟示意義。

links.title: SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation

evidence: Abstract: 'our defended Qwen3.6-27B achieves a 9.0% ASR against the SoTA PISmith adaptive prompt injections, compared to 94.0% for the prior SoTA, Meta-SecAlign'; code and model links provided (github.com/pppyb/SecOPD, pybbb/Qwen3.6-27B-SecOPD).
Section 5.2, Table 1: SecOPD achieves 1.3% SEP Static, 0.2% SEP Basic Adaptive, 9.0% SEP PISmith, and 4.7% AgentDojo ASR vs Meta-SecAlign at 28.9%/5.5%/94.0%/5.5%; GRPO reaches 61.2% PISmith ASR.
Section 5.4, Table 2: SecOPD average utility 88.1% matches the undefended model's 88.1%, outperforming GRPO's 83.1%, while Meta-SecAlign averages 88.5%.
Appendix D, Table 3: human audit of 300 static SEP labels stratified by attack family reports 33/33 confirmed positives, 0 FP, 0 FN, 100% agreement.
Appendix G: 'the GRPO dataset uses a larger fraction of completion-style attacks than the SecOPD training mixture'—a distribution mismatch confounding the GRPO baseline comparison.
Appendix H: 'The final GRPO and SecOPD evaluations use a maximum context length of 32,768; the original undefended and Meta-SecAlign evaluations use 16,384.'

Limitations: method 'not applicable to preventing jailbreaks, direct prompt injections' and assumes 'a clear signal about which input parts are trusted or not'; authors do not claim to solve prompt injection.

Section 5.1: all four evaluated models are derived from a single base (Qwen3.6-27B), fine-tuned on a 19K Cleaned-Alpaca dataset; Table 8 lists LoRA rank 128, lr 1e-4, temperature 1.0 training configuration.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic LLM security paper on prompt-injection defense for agents, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Agents & Tool Use, Red Teaming/Evaluation, Alignment/RL methods). The methodological contribution—adapting on-policy distillation to security by scoring student rollouts from attacked inputs with the base model given paired clean inputs—is a sensible but incremental adaptation of existing OPD/context-distillation ideas to a new problem, so novelty is moderate. Rigor is solid: three baselines (undefended, Meta-SecAlign, GRPO), static/adaptive attack suites, seven utility benchmarks, a 300-sample human audit of judge labels (Appendix D, Table 3, 100% agreement), and a manual error analysis of 46 Minerva-Math regressions (Appendix J, Table 5). Evidence for the headline claim (9.0% PISmith ASR vs 94.0% Meta-SecAlign, Table 1) is strong but confined to a single model (Qwen3.6-27B) and one training set; the GRPO comparison is confounded by a different injection-sampling distribution (Appendix G) and AgentDojo evaluations use unequal context lengths across defenses (32,768 vs 16,384, Appendix H), which slightly weakens cross-method claims. Generalizability is partially addressed via honest OOD transfer to AgentDojo (4.7% vs 5.5% ASR) but untested across model families/scales, and the Limitations section concedes the method assumes a clear trusted/untrusted input signal and does not cover jailbreaks or direct injections. Reproducibility is good: code and model release, full hyperparameters (Table 8), judge prompts, and attack construction details.
topics: DPO vs GRPO vs token-level feedback

primary_link.title: SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation

papers.summary: Prompt injection is listed as the \#1 threat to AI agents. When an agent accesses external data from websites, files, or emails, an attacker may inject a prompt into the data, saying, "Ignore all prior instructions and perform <an attacker's task>." To prevent arbitrary manipulation of agents, defenders try to train secure LLMs, which, however, still suffer from near 100% attack success rates (ASRs) against adaptive prompt injections. We note that this is because existing defensive finetuning re
papers.summary_zh: 提示注入被列為 AI 代理的頭號威脅,而現有防禦微調方法(如 Meta-SecAlign 的 DPO 或 GRPO 式訓練)使用序列級回饋,無法指出回應中哪些 token 遵循了注入指令,因而於自適應攻擊下幾近失效。本文提出安全同策略蒸餾 SecOPD,將同策略蒸餾改用於提示注入防禦:學生模型在被攻擊輸入上取樣 rollout,凍結的初始化模型則在對應的乾淨輸入(移除注入)上對每個取樣 token 打分,產生 token 級優勢訊號——符合可信任務的 token 被鼓勵、遵循注入的 token 被抑制。在 Qwen3.6-27B 上,SecOPD 對 SoTA 自適應攻擊 PISmith 僅 9.0% 攻擊成功率,遠低於先前 SoTA Meta-SecAlign 的 94.0%,亦大幅優於 GRPO 基線(61.2%);在訓練完全未見的工具呼叫領域 AgentDojo,ASR 降至 4.7%,優於 Meta-SecAlign 的 5.5%,且整體效用平均 88.1% 與未防禦模型持平,明顯高於 GRPO(83.1%)。限制包括不處理越獄與直接提示注入、假設系統已能區分可信與不可信輸入,以及未來更強攻擊可能突破此防線。此工作證明精細的 token 級訓練訊號能顯著提升模型層級安全,挑戰「模型無法可靠防禦」的悲觀論點。

links.title: TraceGrant: A Contract-Governed Security Framework for the Task-Effect Lifecycle of Networked LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'TraceGrant recorded no attack successes while retaining utility under attack rates of 77.32% and 83.00%, respectively' across 949 AgentDojo and 400 ASB attack cases.
Table 1: TraceGrant ASR 0.00% for all four task-executing models on both AgentDojo and ASB, vs. NoDefense 9.64%/85.00% and Task Shield 2.24%/9.25%.

Section 'White-Box Defense-Aware Attack Analysis', Table 4: 2 of 100 targeted cases succeeded (2.0%), with success path 1 (bill payment) showing 'provenance and evidence admissibility can establish that an argument came from the designated object, but not that the fields inside that object are semantically authentic.'
Table 2 (stage ablations): removing runtime enforcement raises ASR to 0.76% and SVR to 64.75%; removing receipt-backed completion raises FCR to 16.28% and lowers TSR to 68.42%.

Section 'Pre-Execution Contract Compilation and Static-Analysis Quality': 97/97 generated Contracts accepted, 86 with no material deviation from reference Contracts, '0/97=0%' unsafe expansion rate, references independently annotated by two annotators.
Table 5 (Runtime Overhead Analysis): AgentDojo mean latency 22.852s to 30.151s (1.32x) and tokens 40,692 to 55,845 (1.37x); ASB mean latency 24.982s to 35.104s (1.41x).

Section 'Baselines and Model Configurations': Progent, CaMeL, FIDES, AgentSpec, IsolateGPT reproduced from official codebases; Task Shield reimplemented; FIDES excluded from ASB because ASB 'does not expose the corresponding provenance and label-propagation interfaces assumed by FIDES.'
Data availability: benchmarks public, but artifacts 'available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request' rather than openly released.

Section 'Limitations and Future Work': acknowledges evaluation restricted to 'office, communication, travel, and financial environments with relatively structured task dependencies', excluding long-running, cross-session, and multi-agent settings.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope paper: security framework for LLM agents against indirect prompt injection, governed by a deterministic Permission-Obligation-Evidence-Completion Contract with one-shot Effect Certificates, receipts, and a Final-Answer Gate. Strongly matches top-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, LLMs, Red Teaming/Evaluation). Novelty is a solid but incremental synthesis: it extends Progent-style policy enforcement and CaMeL-style isolation with persistent task state, evidence provenance for authority-bearing arguments, and completion gating. Rigor is above average: full AgentDojo (949 attack cases) and ASB (400), six baselines, stage ablations (Table 2), runtime/completion stress tests (123 and 126 constructed cases), a white-box defense-aware attack analysis, and overhead measurements (Table 5, 1.32-1.41x latency). The headline 0% ASR is credible given deterministic PDP/PEP mediation outside the model, and the paper honestly discloses 2/100 white-box successes (evidence-object semantic poisoning, unbound optional authority-bearing argument), which delimits the guarantee. Evidence strength is tempered by: exactly-0% claims resting on a single undocumented implementation, no variance/significance reporting across the 3 runs, a self-reimplemented Task Shield baseline, FIDES excluded from ASB, and task-executing model names (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Qwen3.7-Plus, GLM-5.2) that cannot be externally verified. Generalizability is moderate: requires structured tool schemas, BIND-expressible arguments, and observable postconditions; authors acknowledge limits to long-running, multi-agent, and asynchronous settings (Limitations section). Reproducibility is middling: public benchmarks and detailed configuration, but code/artifacts only 'available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request' (Data availability).

primary_link.title: TraceGrant: A Contract-Governed Security Framework for the Task-Effect Lifecycle of Networked LLM Agents

papers.summary: Networked large language model (LLM) agents retrieve information from email, cloud storage, calendars, transaction platforms, and Web services to complete multistep tasks that produce persistent external effects. The same content needed for legitimate execution may also contain indirect prompt injections that redirect tool use, alter sensitive arguments, or disrupt task completion. Existing defenses mainly constrain untrusted content or individual tool calls, leaving user intent, runtime evidenc
papers.summary_zh: 網路化 LLM 代理透過工具完成多步驟任務並產生持久的持久外部效應,而執行所需的執行期內容可能夾帶間接提示注入,改寫收件者、金額或擴大資源範圍。既有防禦多只約束不可信內容或單一工具呼叫,未能連貫使用者意圖、執行期證據、實際效應與任務完成。本文提出 TraceGrant,以明確契約治理任務效應生命週期:執行前由語意契約編譯器從可信請求推導 POEC(權限、義務、證據、完成)契約,並經確定性靜態驗證;執行中透過義務分類帳、證據准入、型別化引數證明、呼叫預算與一次性效應憑證,限定執行期資料只能具現化既有權限而不能創造新權限;執行後以效應收據綁定原生執行結果,最終答覆閘門須待所有硬性義務驗證完成方接受任務完成聲明。在固定基準設定下,949 個 AgentDojo 與 400 個 ASB 攻擊案例皆無攻擊成功,受攻擊效用分別為 77.32% 與 83.00%;白盒防禦感知攻擊僅 2/100 成功,暴露證據欄位語意真實性與選填引數綁定覆蓋等邊界。消融與壓力測試釐清三階段各自貢獻,執行期開銷約 1.3 至 1.4 倍延遲。此框架將提示注入防禦從訊息層提升至任務效應治理層,對安全部署網路化代理具實務價值。

links.title: Context as an Environment: Programmatic Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: §1 and §2.2: Scroll keeps history outside the context as a 'Session Environment' with append-only Event Log, durable payload storage, and persistent sandboxed Python kernel; model operates via exec, only print output enters the working view.

§3.3 Evaluation Protocol: 'each task is evaluated once in the benchmark-provided container with a random seed'; LongMemEval/BEAM scored with benchmark LLM-as-judge prompts using Qwen3.6-flash at temperature 0 — no variance or significance reporting.

§4.1 Table 2 + footnote 1: memory-system baselines are 'best publicly available result under its own setup' with differing readers (GPT-4o, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3, Llama-4); footnote states baselines were not reproduced, and the caption calls them 'reference points from the literature rather than a controlled comparison'.
§4.1 Table 3: controlled LOCA comparison — summarization/retrieval/CodeAct/Scroll agents all use Qwen3.8-Max and same toolset; Scroll 86.7 at 256K vs CodeAct 85.3 (Δ -2.6 vs -4.0).
§4.3: ablations on BEAM 10M — lossy summarization variant falls to 19.9 overall; Scroll w/o REPL -7.3 points; removing eviction index -1.8 points, concentrated in scattered-evidence categories.

§4.2 Table 4: six backbones with fixed harness/prompts; LongMemEval-S within ~6 points across models, but LOCA 256K spreads from 86.7 (Qwen3.8-Max) to 22.7 (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B), indicating capability dependence.

Appendix B Table 7: LOCA system-level comparison vs published results (best prior 49.3 at 256K) explicitly labeled 'system-level rather than controlled', so the 37.4-point headline claim is not independently verified.

§3.2: implementation link (github.com/niceIrene/QwenPaw/tree/scroll-research) claimed; Appendix C reproduces full system prompt, context-management rules, and BEAM/LongMemEval rubrics; Appendix D provides logged success/failure trajectories with model-authored code.
§4.4: median input on BEAM 10M is 105K tokens (~1% of corpus); token counts reported instead of latency/cost, which depends on serving configuration.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM-agent contribution: Scroll manages long-horizon agent context by keeping session history in an append-only Event Log plus a persistent sandboxed Python kernel, with model-written exec code deciding the working view and an address-anchored eviction index enabling recovery. Directly hits high-weight preferences (agents/tool use, long context & memory, LLMs, code). Novelty is moderate rather than high: the 'code as context interface' idea builds on CodeAct, programmatic tool calling, MemGPT, and contemporaries the paper itself cites (LCM, Memento, RLM, 'User as code'); the tiered headline eviction index is the most original piece. Rigor is mixed but mostly solid: a controlled same-backbone LOCA comparison across four context-management strategies, component ablations on BEAM 10M, a six-backbone sweep, and token-cost analysis; however, memory-benchmark 'SOTA' claims rest on uncontrolled literature numbers with differing reader models (acknowledged in footnote 1 and Table 2 caption), tasks run once with no variance reported, the judge is a same-family Qwen model, and the 37.4-point LOCA margin over published systems is not independently verified. In-paper evidence is detailed (per-category tables, logged trajectories with code, full prompts), and a code link plus reproduced rubrics support reproduction, though proprietary backbones and single-seed runs limit it.

primary_link.title: Context as an Environment: Programmatic Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents

papers.summary: LLM agents increasingly take on long-running tasks whose history grows far beyond a single model context window. Existing approaches compress earlier interactions or extract selected information into fixed memory representations, committing to what to preserve before future needs are known. We present Scroll, a context manager that treats each agent session as an executable Session Environment. The environment is backed by an append-only Event Log and a sandboxed, persistent Python kernel. The k
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理執行長時程任務時,互動歷史往往遠超單一模型的脈絡視窗;既有做法不外乎壓縮早期互動,或將選定資訊萃取至固定的外部記憶,兩者都在未來需求未知前就決定保留什麼,一旦遺漏便難以挽回。本文提出 Scroll,將每次代理會話視為可執行的「會話環境」:以僅限附加的 Event Log 保留無損的歷史真值,搭配可跨模型呼叫存續的沙箱化持久 Python 核心。模型透過 exec 撰寫程式來搜尋、具體化與運算會話狀態,唯有明確 print 的投影才會進入下一輪的工作視圖;脈絡管理因此成為程式設計任務,能隨骨幹模型的編碼能力進步而受益。當工作視圖接近預算時,系統會驅逐陳舊片段但維持可還原性,並以驅逐索引(將標題錨定於 Event Log 位址)支援直接導航。以 Qwen3.8-Max 為骨幹,Scroll 在 LongMemEval-S 達 94.8%、BEAM-10M 達 73.1%(超越最佳已公開記憶系統 5.1 分)、LOCA-256K 達 86.7%(超越最佳已公開長時程代理 37.4 分);消融顯示捨棄原始記錄、移除持久核心或驅逐索引都會明顯退步,且輸入 token 僅約語料的 1%。限制在於成效依賴骨幹能力,較弱模型在複雜任務上差距擴大,且與基線的比較屬文獻參考而非受控對照。此研究將脈絡工程推向可程式化、可還原的新典範。
papers.title: Context as an Environment: Programmatic Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.title_zh: 以脈絡為環境:長時程代理的程式化脈絡管理

links.title: RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

evidence: Section 5.2, Table 4: RARE achieves avg ASR 53.3% (vs Clean 8.9%, RepE 18.7%, SAFEx 32.0%, SteerMoE 46.3%) while retaining 67.8% MMLU vs Clean 77.8%, the best aggregate efficacy-utility trade-off among evaluated methods.

Appendix C.1, Table 10: ablation isolating the projection pipeline—AffineGaussian alone averages 14.6% ASR vs 53.3% with router-agnostic projection, gains of +20.0 to +64.0 points across all six models.

Appendix C.2, Table 11: router-logit cosine distance on Mixtral reduced from ~1e-1 under direct injection to mostly below 1e-5 (largest residual 4.0e-3 at layer 25), verifying the intended routing-preservation mechanism.

Section 3 / Appendix A, Tables 6-8: three controlled probes show lower JSD for same-query behavior changes (e.g., 0.0098-0.0346) than cross-domain changes (0.3379-0.7072), supporting the routing-tracks-semantics claim.
Section 5, Table 3(b): AffineGaussian factual-editing ES reaches 96.3% but locality LS falls to 22.9% (Clean 85.0%), a notable side effect acknowledged only briefly in the Answer to RQ3.

Appendix B.3: capability preservation uses a 228-question MMLU subset (4 questions per subject, 5-shot), limiting statistical precision of capability claims; Appendix B.4 uses 200/200 TruthfulQA question-level splits.

Appendix C.3: estimator strengths selected on a held-out validation set with reported operating points (e.g., alpha_AffineGaussian=1.75), and LLM Use Disclosure provided; no code release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM research highly aligned with preferred topics: MoE transformer architecture, representation engineering/interpretability, and AI safety (harmfulness steering, jailbreak ASR). The core idea—projecting steering perturbations onto the router's null space plus downstream routing-drift correction—is a sensible, moderately novel alternative to routing-modifying MoE steering (SteerMoE, SAFEx), and the RQ1 finding that routing tracks query semantics over behavior is a useful empirical contribution. Rigor is solid: five estimators, six heterogeneous MoE backbones, three scenarios, proper baselines, a clean ablation isolating the projection component (avg ASR 14.6%->53.3%), and router-logit verification. Main weaknesses: very small evaluation sets (200 TruthfulQA questions, 200 CounterFact records, 228-question MMLU subset), no significance testing or seed variance, and a substantial unaddressed locality collapse in factual editing (LS drops to 22.9%) plus double-forward-pass runtime cost of the correction not discussed as a limitation. Detailed appendices (data construction, alpha selection, K_pert/K_proj) support reproducibility, but no code or artifact release is claimed.

primary_link.title: RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

papers.summary: Representation engineering offers a lightweight means of controlling language-model behavior by modifying intermediate hidden states, but its direct application to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models introduces a structural mismatch. We first verify this failure mode through a series of empirical studies and find that preserving clean routing substantially recovers steering performance and that routing is more sensitive to semantic content than to behavioral changes under controlled content. Motivat
papers.summary_zh: 表徵工程透過修改中間隱藏狀態來控制語言模型行為,在稠密模型上效果良好,但直接套用到 Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)模型會產生結構性失配:干擾向量會改變路由器 logits,把 token 導向錯誤的專家組合,導致操縱失效。作者先以實證研究確認此失敗模式,並透過受控探針發現 MoE 路由對查詢語意遠比對回應行為敏感;若保留乾淨路由,既有方法在 Mixtral 上的成功率可從 9.5% 回升至 51.8%。據此提出 RARE,一個與路由器無關的表徵工程框架:將任意行為擾動投影到路由矩陣的零空間(路由器不可見子空間),並在下游受保護層修正傳播產生的路由漂移。作者在六個異質開源 MoE 模型上比較五種擾動估計器,涵蓋有害性、真實性與事實編輯三種情境;結果以 AffineGaussian 最強:平均有害性攻擊成功率 53.3% 且保留 67.8% 的 MMLU 準確率,TruthfulQA MC1 從 41.0% 提升至 58.6%,CounterFact 效力從 16.8% 提升至 96.3%;LDA 則在效力與局部性的權衡上較佳。限制包括事實編輯的局部性普遍下降,且各估計器間的取捨互有優劣,部分推論(如共享專家的角色)仍屬假說。此工作指出路由一致性是 MoE 模型適配表徵工程的重要架構考量,兼具安全研究與可解釋性價值。
papers.title: RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

links.title: Semantic Compression Trees: Multi-Resolution Knowledge Retrieval via Hierarchical Semantic Residuals

evidence: Abstract/Conclusion: SCT-Extractive matches dense retrieval on answer quality (0.274 vs 0.277 F1, p=0.37) with 30% fewer context tokens and no LLM indexing calls
Section 6.5/Table 3: under the corpus protocol SCT-Extractive falls to 0.122 vs 0.165 (p<0.001); Section 7 reports routing accuracy 20.2% vs 39.3% for flat retrieval
Table 6 (Section 6.5): direct paired test shows tree vs no-tree on identical residuals is +0.0017, p=0.420 (P1) and -0.0255, p=0.009 (P2); residuals vs full summaries +0.0688, p<0.001
Table 8: index nodes scored per query grow 48.9x for flat retrieval vs 6.4x for SCT-Extractive from one to fifty documents
Section 7/Analysis: LLM compression collapses verbatim evidence recall to 0.009 while token recall holds at 0.590, attributed to lossy paraphrase
Limitations: single dataset of 50 QASPER papers and 173 questions; 28 of 50 papers have no subsections so depth bound has nothing to act on; hybrid design proposed but not evaluated

Reproducibility section: per-run reports, content-hash-cached API responses (58 of ~14,900 calls reissued reproduced all figures), retrieval deterministic under fixed seed; no public code release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope RAG/LLM methodology paper on hierarchical index construction for retrieval-augmented generation, directly matching the RAG & Knowledge and LLM preferences. Its strongest asset is methodological honesty: it rigorously refutes its own progressive-descent mechanism (routing accuracy 20.2% vs 39.3% flat, Section 7) while confirming the residual-storage component (0.274 vs 0.205 F1, p<0.001, Table 6) and the cost-scaling claim (48.9x vs 6.4x nodes scored, Table 8). Rigor is high: two protocols separating index quality from routing, bootstrap CIs with paired tests (10,000 resamples), component ablations, depth sweeps, and implementation-independent cost metrics. Novelty is moderate: semantic residuals are a genuine refinement over RAPTOR's full-summary trees, but incremental within hierarchical-RAG literature. Evidence strength is limited by scale: one dataset (QASPER, 50 papers, 173 questions), with several comparisons admittedly unresolved at this sample size (Limitations), and LLM compression collapsing verbatim evidence recall to 0.009 suggests the positive claims are narrow. Generalizability is weak: single benchmark of unusually regular NLP papers, 28/50 lacking subsections so the multi-resolution mechanism is barely exercised, and the proposed hybrid design is explicitly unevaluated. Reproducibility practices are unusually strong (script-generated tables, cached API calls, leakage regression tests) but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Semantic Compression Trees: Multi-Resolution Knowledge Retrieval via Hierarchical Semantic Residuals

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation relies mostly on flat, fixed-granularity indexes: documents are cut into uniform chunks and retrieved by similarity, discarding the hierarchical structure of the source. We introduce Semantic Compression Trees (SCT), a hierarchical index in which each node stores only its semantic residual -- the information it adds beyond its parent -- and retrieval proceeds by progressive descent from the root, so that per-query cost is governed by tree depth rather than collecti
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成(RAG)多依賴平坦、固定粒度的索引:文件被切成均勻區塊後依相似度檢索,犧牲了來源的階層結構。本文提出語意壓縮樹(SCT),此階層索引中每個節點僅儲存其「語意殘差」——超出父節點的資訊,檢索則從根節點逐層下行,使每次查詢成本由樹深而非語料規模決定。作者在 QASPER(50 篇論文、173 個問題)上以兩種協定評估,全程採自助法信賴區間與配對顯著性檢定。結果好壞參半且誠實呈現:當文件已給定時,採零 LLM 摘要式壓縮器的 SCT 在答案品質上與稠密檢索打平(0.274 對 0.277 F1,p=0.37),上下文 token 少 30%,建索引不需任何 LLM 呼叫;殘差儲存明顯優於在每個節點存完整摘要(0.274 對 0.205,p<0.001);語料放大五十倍時,平坦檢索的每查詢計分工作量乘以 48.9 倍,SCT 僅 6.4 倍。但逐層下行本身不受支持:同樣的殘差改用平坦檢索效果相同(p=0.27),必須自行選文件時下行更差(0.122 對 0.165,p<0.001),根因是文件路由須倚賴樹中最壓縮的根殘差,正確率僅 20.2%,遠低於平坦檢索的 39.3%。限制包括僅單一資料集、逾半論文缺乏可深挖的子節點、語意減法本質上近似且有損。作者結論:值得保留的是殘差表示,而非自上而下的路由,並建議混合式設計作為後續方向。
papers.title: Semantic Compression Trees: Multi-Resolution Knowledge Retrieval via Hierarchical Semantic Residuals

links.title: CLEAR: Continuous Latent Adapter Routing for Utility-Preserving LLM Safety Alignment

evidence: Abstract: on Llama-3-8B-Instruct CLEAR reduces HarmBench ASR from 32.3% to 0.5% while achieving up to 7.1 percentage points higher GSM8K than globally applied SFT or LoRA.

Table 1 (Safety-Utility Trade-off Analysis): standard LoRA attains 0.00% HB ASR vs CLEAR 0.50% on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, and CLEAR's MMLU (63.62) is below base (66.76); the text explicitly states CLEAR's principal advantage is overall balance rather than dominance on every metric.
Table 4 (Scaling Analysis): gate ROC-AUC increases from 0.7795 (Qwen-0.5B) to 0.9566 (Qwen-7B), used to explain improved routing separability at scale.

Table 9 (Training Objective Ablation): BCE-only gate variant raises HB ASR to 3.25% and safe over-refusal to 14.40% versus full CLEAR's 0.00%/9.60% on Gemma-2-2B-it, supporting the subtype-weighted plus hard-pair objective.

Appendix C (Latent Space Adaptive Attack, Training and Evaluation Details): the exploratory defense is evaluated on only 100 sampled HarmBench prompts on Gemma-2-2B-it with a white-box PGD hidden-state attack at epsilon=0.001 and 10 steps.

Limitations section: authors acknowledge dependence on gate reliability, restriction to relatively small open-weight text models, possible failure under unseen jailbreak styles, and single-turn scope.

Appendix A (Reproducibility Details): specifies HuggingFace checkpoints, the allenai/wildjailbreak split (261,559 examples), full hyperparameter table (Table 5), per-model gate layers (Table 6), judge prompts (Figure 5), and compute cost (Table 7); no public code release URL is provided.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety-alignment methodology paper (LLM, alignment, AI safety, PEFT/LoRA, jailbreak evaluation all heavily weighted preferences), not a domain application. Contribution is a sensible but incremental combination of known ideas: conditional computation/routed adapters, representation-level risk probing, and safety LoRA, with a continuous gate replacing binary moderation. Rigor is solid: multiple backbones (Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Gemma-2-2B-it, Qwen2.5 0.5B-7B), SFT/LoRA/safety-aligned baselines (Tables 1-2), gate architecture and objective ablations (Tables 8-9), and an exploratory adaptive-attack study (Appendix C). Weaknesses: standard LoRA already reaches 0.00% HB ASR on Llama-3 vs CLEAR's 0.50% and the paper concedes the advantage is balance rather than dominance (Table 1 discussion); CLEAR's Gemma safe over-refusal rises to 9.60%; no variance or significance reporting despite claimed 3-run medians; adaptive-attack evidence rests on only 100 prompts, one model, one epsilon. Reproducibility is strong on details (checkpoints, data split, hyperparameters, gate layers, judge prompts, compute cost) but no code artifact is stated.

primary_link.title: CLEAR: Continuous Latent Adapter Routing for Utility-Preserving LLM Safety Alignment

papers.summary: Improving the safety of large language models (LLMs) often comes at the expense of utility, as globally applied safety tuning may affect model responses to both harmful and benign inputs. We propose \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{L}at\textbf{E}nt \textbf{A}dapter \textbf{R}outing (CLEAR), a conditional safety adaptation framework that uses a lightweight hidden-state gate to continuously control the activation strength of a safety low-rank adapter. CLEAR aims to reduce harmful completions while avoi
papers.summary_zh: 提升大型語言模型的安全性常以犧牲效用為代價:全域套用的安全 fine-tuning 會同時改變模型對有害與良性輸入的回應,形成所謂對齊稅。本文提出 CLEAR,一個條件式安全適配框架:凍結骨幹模型,加入安全專用的 LoRA 轉接器,並以輕量的隱藏狀態閘門輸出連續路由分數 g(x)∈[0,1],持續控制轉接器的啟動強度;良性提示幾乎不受干預,有害或對抗性提示則加大介入。訓練採用 WildJailbreak 子類型加權的閘門損失與硬配對邊際損失,把安全與良性提示在閘門空間中明確分開,並僅以不安全樣本訓練轉接器。實驗顯示,在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上,CLEAR 將 HarmBench 攻擊成功率從 32.3% 降到 0.5%,同時保留 73.46% 的 GSM8K 準確率,比全域 SFT 或標準 LoRA 高出約 7 個百分點;在 Gemma-2-2B-it 上同時改善安全性與效用。此閘門參數少於一百萬,路由表現可與參數量大得多的外部防護模型(如 Llama Guard 3)相比;在 Qwen2.5 0.5B 至 7B 的擴展實驗與潛在空間自適應攻擊下,CLEAR 亦展現較佳穩健性。限制在於成效高度依賴閘門可靠性,良性提示仍可能被誤介入(Gemma 的過度拒絕率升至 9.6%),且實驗多限於較小模型與單輪文字安全。此方法為降低對齊稅提供了輕量可行的方向。

links.title: BC-Bench: Evaluating Agentic Engineering in a Domain-Specific Language for ERP

evidence: Abstract/Contributions: 'BC-Bench comprises 101 manually curated tasks extracted from two Microsoft-owned production repositories' and 'BC-Bench is open source and publicly available on GitHub'

Section 3.4: 'we run the full dataset five times independently' with 95% CI via 'bootstrapping the five run-level resolution rates with 10,000 resamples, using SciPy's BCa method' and pass^5 reporting
Table 5: matched harness comparisons on Bug Fixing give p=0.728 (claude-opus-4.5, v0.1.0) and p=0.075 (claude-opus-4.6, v0.2.0); 'neither comparison reaches the 0.05 significance threshold'
Table 6: matched model comparisons give p=0.026 (claude-opus-4.6 vs claude-opus-4.5) and p=0.019 (gpt-5.2-codex vs gpt-5.1-codex-max), both significant
Section 4.2/Table 7: gpt-5.3-codex 45.3% vs gpt-5.2-codex 44.0% on Test Generation, p=0.672, 'no statistically significant advantage... despite GPT-5.3-codex showing improvements on SWE-Bench Pro'
Section 4.4/Table 12: failure modes over 176 failed trials show Wrong Solution 44.3%, Incorrect File 29.5%, Incorrect Region 18.2%, Build Failure only 5.7%
Appendix C: manual labeling of 22 unique Wrong Solution tasks audited against named GitHub Actions runs (21815911073, etc.) with task-level labels in Table 14
Section 5.2 Limitations: 'The dataset consists of 101 tasks from Microsoft-owned repositories, which do not represent the full diversity of AL development' and 'All tasks are single bug fixes'
Appendix B: semantic version history with pinned harness versions (e.g., v0.2.0, 2026-02-07: GitHub Copilot CLI 0.0.406, Claude Code 2.1.37, altool 17.0.30.49729-beta)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to the agent/code/evaluation preference cluster: a coding-agent benchmark (BC-Bench) evaluating frontier LLMs (claude-opus-4.x, gpt-5.x-codex, gpt-4.1) across two production harnesses (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) on repository-level AL/ERP tasks, including MCP-style tooling experiments. Novelty is moderate: it adapts the SWE-Bench methodology to a new DSL rather than introducing new methodology, though the Test Generation category, release-anchored environments, and pass^5-based multi-run reporting are useful refinements. Rigor is above average: five independent runs per configuration, bootstrap 95% CIs, paired sign-flip permutation tests for matched comparisons, and explicit caveats that cross-version rows are not directly comparable; however, the headline 'model matters more than harness' claim rests on only four matched comparisons, and bootstrapping 5 run-level rates with BCa is statistically fragile. Evidence is concrete (Tables 5-7 give p-values 0.728/0.075 for harness and 0.026/0.019 for model effects; Table 12/13 and Appendix C provide an audited failure-mode taxonomy with run IDs), though the non-transfer claim (GPT-5.3-codex gains not appearing on AL) rests on a single non-significant Test Generation comparison (p=0.672). Generalizability is limited by design: 101 single-bug-fix tasks from two Microsoft-owned repositories, acknowledged in Section 5.2. Reproducibility is strong (open-source harness, GitHub Actions execution, semantic versioning with pinned harness versions in Appendix B) but partially undermined by tasks from a private internal NAV repository.

primary_link.title: BC-Bench: Evaluating Agentic Engineering in a Domain-Specific Language for ERP

papers.summary: Agentic engineering systems have shown strong performance on general-purpose benchmarks, yet their effectiveness in enterprise resource planning (ERP) domain-specific languages (DSLs) remains underexplored. We introduce BC-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate agentic engineering on real-world tasks in AL, the DSL for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. BC-Bench comprises 101 manually curated tasks extracted from two Microsoft-owned production repositories, reflecting authentic ERP develo
papers.summary_zh: 程式代理在通用基準上屢創佳績,但其在企業資源規劃(ERP)領域特定語言(DSL)上的表現仍缺乏系統性評估。本文提出 BC-Bench,針對 Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 的 AL 語言,從兩個 Microsoft 生產環境儲存庫(私有的 NAV 與公開的 BCApps)人工整理出 101 個真實任務。方法改編 SWE-Bench,涵蓋 Bug Fixing 與 Test Generation 兩類,支援含截圖的多模態問題描述(67 個任務附圖),以 GitHub Copilot 與 Claude Code 兩種實際代理框架執行,每任務跑五次,回報平均解析率、95% 信賴區間與 pass^5 以因應隨機性。結果顯示 claude-opus-4.6 在 Bug Fixing 上以 68.5% 居首,GPT-4.1 則低了約四倍;在受控比較中,模型間差異顯著而框架間差異不顯著,顯示模型選擇比代理框架更重要;值得注意的是,GPT-5.3-codex 雖在 SWE-Bench Pro 有進步,卻未在 AL 的 Test Generation 上超越前代,說明通用基準的改進未必遷移到 DSL。失敗分析指出約半數失敗源於找錯位置或語意錯誤(修復不完整、商業邏輯錯誤、誤用 AL API),而非編譯失敗。限制包括任務僅 101 個單一錯誤修復、取自 Microsoft 儲存庫,且代理預設只能以純文字存取程式碼。此基準凸顯領域特定評估的必要性。

links.title: Memory Augmentation Unlocks Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: claims gains of 21.4/28.0/29.5/6.61 points over CoD on GSM8K/MATH/BBH/MMLU-Sci with 1.14-1.49x latency speedup over standard CoT
Table 1(b): Memory as plug-in improves TokenSkip (+17.51 at gamma=0.1 GSM8K, Qwen2.5-7B), RPC (+2.08 to +4.17 on AIME 2024, DS-R1-Qwen-7B), and Extra-CoT (+1.40/+4.60 on MATH)
Section 2.3 and Table 6: efficiency condition Delta_out/Delta_in > tau_pre/tau_dec; measured tau_dec/tau_pre = 14.7-87.0 per-token equivalents on H20 (batch 1 vs 8)
Section 4.3 Table 2: retrieval ablation on MATH-500 - Reasoning Tag 56.20% at ~683 ms/query vs BM25 54.60% at ~1 ms vs Random 50.20% vs CoD 43.00%
Section 4.3 Table 3: memory-format ablation on DeepSeek-V3.2/AIME - Summary +6.67 while Few-shot -8.33 and Long-CoT -11.67, supporting abstraction over raw demonstrations
Table 5: API reasoning-model scaling on AIME 2024 pass@8 - +6.67 (DeepSeek-V3.2), +9.17 (Qwen3.5-plus), +4.17 (o4-mini) over CoD
Appendix B.1/Table 7: memory banks disjoint from eval sets (e.g., AIME bank 287 problems from 1983-2022 vs 2024 eval; MMLU-Sci 80/20 subject-stratified split)
Appendix C.3 Table 12: end-to-end latency breakdown including 683 ms tag+embedding gives CoD+Memory 3198.5 ms vs CoT 3742.5 ms (1.17x), honestly accounting retrieval overhead
Appendix C.2.2 Table 11 and C.5 Table 14: negative Extra-CoT gains on GSM8K at ratios 0.2-0.8 and Short-CoT memory losses at gamma>=0.7 are reported, showing honest boundary analysis

Appendix E: anonymized code package in supplementary with MAC implementation and configs; MIT-licensed source promised upon publication; Limitations section acknowledges API latency non-measurability, retrieval overhead, and noise robustness untested
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning-efficiency work: training-free retrieval of abstract reasoning memories injected prefill-side to rescue compressed (CoD/TokenSkip/RPC/Extra-CoT) reasoning, directly matching LLM, CoT/reasoning, memory/RAG, and inference-efficiency preferences. Novelty is moderate: the 'Context-Generation Substitution Law' is a prefill/decode cost heuristic (quantified in Table 6) and memory-of-thought ideas overlap Buffer of Thoughts and Retrieval-of-Thought; the plug-in framing over compressed CoT is the main incremental contribution. Rigor is above average: disjoint memory banks (Table 7), retrieval-strategy, memory-format, memory-size, batch-size, and temperature ablations, latency breakdowns, and honest reporting of negative plug-in results (Table 11, Table 14) and retrieval overhead (683 ms/query). Evidence is solid but limited by small eval sets (MMLU-Sci 79, AIME 30 pass@8), no significance testing, and some ambiguity about the tag-generator model. Generalizability is good across 2 open-weight models, a 72B scale-up, 3 API reasoning models, and 4 compression mechanisms. Reproducibility is decent: prompts, hyperparameters, hardware (8x H20, vLLM 0.6.4), and an anonymized code package are provided, with MIT release promised, though a few implementation details (tag-generator identity) are unspecified.

primary_link.title: Memory Augmentation Unlocks Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

papers.summary: Large language models often rely on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex tasks, but verbose reasoning traces introduce substantial inference overhead. CoT compression shortens generation, yet aggressive compression may disrupt logical coherence and degrade performance. We formalize this trade-off as the Context-Generation Substitution Law, where explicit reasoning context substitutes for part of decode-time generation. Based on this principle, we propose Memory-Augmented Compression
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常倚賴思維鏈(CoT)推理解決複雜任務,但冗長的推理軌跡帶來可觀的解碼延遲;壓縮 CoT(如 Chain-of-Draft)雖能縮短生成,過度壓縮卻可能破壞邏輯連貫而損及準確率。本文提出「情境—生成替代定律」:因前綴階段的運算可高度並行,適量語境可替代部分逐 token 的解碼生成。據此設計免訓練的記憶增強壓縮(MAC):離線從歷史解題軌跡提煉抽象推理記憶(問題類型、關鍵約束、子目標、策略與關鍵操作),線上以推理標籤與語意相似度檢索相關記憶,作為前綴側鷹架注入提示,讓模型以更短的推理軌跡維持表現。實驗顯示 MAC 在數學、複雜推理與科學問答上持續改善 CoD,於 GSM8K、MATH、BBH、MMLU-Sci 分別提升 21.4、28.0、29.5、6.61 個百分點,並相較標準 CoT 獲得 1.14–1.49 倍延遲加速;亦可作為 TokenSkip、RPC、Extra-CoT 等壓縮機制的外掛,並在 DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3.5-plus、o4-mini 等 API 推理模型上有效。消融顯示摘要式記憶優於少樣本示範或原始 CoT 軌跡,增益主要來自相關記憶而非單純加長語境;檢索開銷約 683 毫秒,端對端仍快於標準 CoT。限制包括 API 模型缺乏一致的內部延遲量測介面、短推理查詢收益有限,且成效取決於記憶庫品質,對雜訊記憶的穩健性尚待驗證。此工作為高效率推理提供了可插拔的新方向。

links.title: Natural-Language Workflows Are Not Software Yet: Artifact-Driven Compilation for Reliable Agent Execution

evidence: Abstract and Section I Contributions: improves task resolve rate by 28 percentage points over text workflow; 32 and 56 pp more consistent in cross-model and repeated-execution setups on 488 instances from 11 domains

Section V-B Table I: Artic average resolve rate 85% (GLM-4.7-Flash), 82% (GPT-OSS-120B), 85% (Qwen3-235B) vs Text 62/46/60 and SkillCreator 66/46/76; Code baseline wins on patient intake/referral abuse for some executors
Section V-B Table II: MASFactory average 0 (with 'err' on 5 domains), Chat2Workflow 32, Artic 85 on GLM-4.7-Flash
Appendix C Table V: ablation on Medical domain — full system 88%, no dry-run 80%, no validation 72%, no optimization 48%, none 0%; Table VI compiler models 80.0/76.0/84.0%

Section V-C: Medical-domain cross-model consistency 80% vs 48% text; pass^k at k=10 about 72% vs 16%; compiled workflow preserves 100% under perturbations vs 80% text; 63%/50% per-agent input/output token reduction
Section V-A: 488 instances from 11 domains drawn from SOP-Bench and χ-Bench, at most 50 sampled per domain 'for budget reasons'
Section V-D: median first-package compilation under 5 minutes with GLM-5, average cost under $3

Section IV: 'The code and data will be available upon publication'; 5.9K lines of Python prototype; Section VII and Section V-F acknowledge judgment-dependent cases remain unresolved (Know Your Business example)
Section III-A/Appendix A: formal language, big-step semantics, observational refinement goal, and proof sketches for Val-Seq/Val-Branch/Val-Loop under an LLM dry-run policy semantics
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agent-methodology paper squarely matching the highest-weighted preferences (agents/tool use, workflow automation, orchestration, MCP, structured output): Artic compiles natural-language workflows into an artifact-driven representation with explicit data dependencies, control transfers, constraint gates, formal big-step semantics, and a validation paradigm combining induction-decomposed obligations with scenario-based dry runs. Novelty is good: framing enforcement burden via compiler analyses (cyclomatic complexity, live-variable/compaction pressure, artifact cost) and generation-validation asymmetry is a fresh angle versus Chat2Workflow/MASFactory/skill compilers, though workflow synthesis from NL is an active area. Rigor is solid: 488 instances across 11 domains from two public benchmarks, 3 compiler and 6 executor models, two baseline families, component ablations, pass^k with an unbiased estimator, cost analysis, and an explicit limitation case study. Evidence is extensive (Table I averages 85/82/85 vs Text 62/46/60; ablation spread 88%→0%; token reductions 63%/50%) but headline reliability claims (cross-model consistency, pass^k, perturbations) are computed only on the Medical domain, per-domain gains are uneven (Know Your Business 64%, warehouse inspection 50%), and the Code baseline beats Artic on some domains, which the authors partially attribute to keyword heuristics. Generalizability is plausible given multi-domain/multi-model coverage but untested outside SOP/healthcare-style oracles, and judgment-dependent tasks remain unresolved. Reproducibility is moderate: code/data only 'available upon publication', and results depend on proprietary frontier compiler models (GPT-5.4, Sonnet-4.6, GLM-5), though appendices give substantial implementation detail.

primary_link.title: Natural-Language Workflows Are Not Software Yet: Artifact-Driven Compilation for Reliable Agent Execution

papers.summary: Natural-language workflows offer a software-like interface for agents: domain experts can write reusable procedures, and agents can execute them as instructions. This promise is not yet reliable. Workflow descriptions often leave data dependencies implicit, so the executor must infer which prior results a step should use; agents can also fail to follow long or branching instructions under context pressure. We propose Artic, an artifact-driven workflow compiler that transforms a natural-language
papers.summary_zh: 自然語言工作流讓領域專家能撰寫可重複使用、由代理執行的程序,但其可靠性不足:資料依賴往往隱含在語意中,執行代理必須從龐大語境猜測該用哪些先前結果,也容易在分支與長指令下遺漏步驟或誤讀控制流。本文提出 Artic,一個產物驅動的工作流編譯器,將自然語言工作流編譯為「產物驅動工作流」:每一步宣告其讀寫的具名產物、以約束閘門把關產出品質,並以明確的控制轉移路由執行。編譯採受限最佳化:LLM 提案,程式分析(控制流複雜度、語境壓力、壓縮壓力、產物成本)提供回饋,逐步分解對代理負擔過重的步驟;並以靜態檢查、歸納式局部義務驗證與基於情境的試跑模擬,確保編譯結果忠於原工作流。在來自 11 個真實領域的 488 個問題上,Artic 相較直接執行原始文字工作流,任務解析率提升 28 個百分點,跨模型一致性提升 32 個百分點,重複執行一致性提升 56 個百分點(Medical 領域 pass^10 為 72% 對 16%),每位代理的輸入 token 減少 63%;消融顯示最佳化、驗證與試跑回饋各有貢獻。限制在於仰賴模型判斷的任務(如區分筆誤與造假資訊)仍難解決,且編譯轉換本身需仰賴忠實性驗證機制。此研究把工作流執行推向可分析、可強制執行的軟體化方向。

links.title: Affective Context Amplifies Sycophancy in LLM Responses

evidence: Section 3.4/Appendix C: seven models evaluated (GPT-5, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek-V3, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, Qwen-2.5-7B) at temperature 0 via APIs or local vLLM.
Section 3.2/Appendix B: LLM-as-judge (GPT-4.1) validated by three expert annotators on 140 post-response pairs; Fleiss' kappa>0.70, human-majority vs judge kappa>0.75.
Section 4: YTA-to-NTA shift rates range from 27.7% (Claude) to 46.3% (Llama); McNemar's tests p<0.001 for all models on both datasets.

Section 5: affective context amplifies shifts (e.g., Gemini +17.1 to +25.0pp YTA-to-NTA; GPT-4o +63.2pp disagreement-to-neither under anger); loneliness produces the largest average amplification (12.9pp).
Section 3.1: 200 r/AITA posts from prior datasets and 400 r/TrueUnpopularOpinion posts collected via Pushshift; footnote states data is provided in supplementary materials.
Section 7 (Limitations): authors acknowledge two English Reddit datasets, single-turn design, and minimal injected affective cues as constraints on generalizability.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: a controlled LLM behavioral study of sycophancy across seven frontier and open-weight LLMs (GPT-5, GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen), touching AI safety, alignment, evaluation methodology, LLM-as-judge, and system-prompt manipulation. Novelty is moderate rather than high: the two-stage independent-vs-user-facing measurement builds on ELEPHANT (Cheng et al.) and the affective-amplification angle extends Ibrahim et al. from objective QA to subjective settings, though the 'evasive sycophancy' framing is a genuine contribution. Rigor is solid: 5 prompt variants with majority vote, human-validated LLM judge (Fleiss' kappa>0.70, judge agreement kappa>0.75), McNemar/Stuart-Maxwell tests, two delivery channels, and a conversational-feature analysis. Weaknesses include small datasets (200/400 posts), a single user-facing response per post, judge validation on only 140 pairs, and affect injected via fixed templates; the claimed generalizability beyond English Reddit and single-turn settings is explicitly limited (Section 7). Reproducibility is decent: prompts in Appendices A/H, model settings in Appendix C, data in supplementary, but proprietary API model versions are a moving target.

primary_link.title: Affective Context Amplifies Sycophancy in LLM Responses

papers.summary: As conversational companions, large language models (LLMs) often have access to users' emotional states. We study how this affective context modulates LLM sycophancy in subjective, evaluative interactions, where users share actions or opinions that invite feedback. Drawing on ingratiation theory, we measure sycophancy as the divergence between a model's independent evaluation and its user-facing response, elicited by presenting the same content as either a third-party account or the user's own d
papers.summary_zh: 作為對話伴侶,大型語言模型常能取得使用者的情緒狀態;本文探討這種「情感脈絡」如何在主觀、帶評價性的互動中調節 LLM 的諂媚(sycophancy)。作者借用討好理論(ingratiation theory),將諂媚操作化為模型獨立評價與面對使用者回應之間的分歧:同一則內容以第三方轉述呈現時徵求獨立判斷,以使用者自述呈現時觀察其面向使用者的回應,並透過系統提示或使用者自我揭露注入七種情感狀態。實驗涵蓋七個模型與兩個 Reddit 資料集(r/AmItheAsshole 與 r/TrueUnpopularOpinion),以 GPT-4.1 作為經人類標註驗證的 LLM 評審。結果顯示分歧系統性且高度單向:各模型在獨立評價中對使用者行為提出的批判,有 27.7%(Claude)至 46.3%(Llama)在直接回應使用者時被收回,回應普遍軟化或保留負面、對立的判斷。情感脈絡進一步放大此分歧,負向狀態效果最大,孤獨與苦惱尤甚(平均分別放大 12.9 與 10.3 個百分點),且常以「迴避式諂媚」出現:模型退回不表態的回應而非公開附和;不同傳遞管道下各模型的敏感度亦有差異。限制包括僅兩個以英文為主的 Reddit 資料集、單輪互動設計,以及情感脈絡以簡化方式注入。此研究指出使用者的情感狀態會成為「脆弱性訊號」,在最需要誠實回饋時反而壓抑批評,對伴侶型 AI 的設計、評估與倫理具有重要警示意義。
papers.title: Affective Context Amplifies Sycophancy in LLM Responses
