links.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection

evidence: Abstract: 'ARQ-refined queries detect substantially more true positives, by up to 119.8%, with a Precision of at least 98.0%' and fixes 'three unresolved GitHub issues ... open for as long as 27 months'
§4.1 Table 1: FormAI v2 TP 7009→15406 with Gemini3.5-ARQ (Precision 98.4); GPT5.4 regresses on Juliet (5110→4946, -3.2%), consistent with claimed worst-case behavior
§4.1 Metric: 'recall is not feasible to compute here' because 'CodeQL queries and CWE labels are not in a one-to-one relationship'; Precision-only reporting is an acknowledged limitation
§4.1 Baselines: comparison 'only against the original CodeQL queries, not against IRIS ... nor QLCoder', with reimplementation of Java-target systems deemed out of scope
§4.3 Table 2: baseline without Analyze/Oracle 'regresses below vanilla CodeQL in 5 of 6 model/dataset configurations', supporting necessity of execution grounding
§4.2: manually verified fixes for issues #21187, #20577, #16542 (all UseAfterFree.ql); two previously undiscovered bugs in zlib and libpng with linked code lines
§4.4 Table 3: 51+6, 49+0, 42+2 Success/No-Op out of 60 per model = 83.3%; iterations average 433–690 s
§3.3/§4: delegates Algorithm 1 to commercial agents (Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex) with thinking 'low or disabled'; no code or artifact release statement anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: a centrally LLM-driven agentic system (coding agents with tool use, MCP-based LSP access) for code/security tooling, matching Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLMs (2.5), and Code & Programming (2.0); it is a language-methodology paper, not a pure domain application. The execution-grounded refinement loop (sanitizer oracle + paired witness programs + regression rollback) is a meaningful but incremental advance over KNighter/MoCQ/IRIS, which the related-work section differentiates honestly. Rigor is solid: formal Algorithm 1, ablation removing Analyze/Oracle, efficiency accounting, and candid limitation discussion; but evaluation compares only against vanilla CodeQL (external baselines declared out of scope), uses 12 queries, reports Precision only (recall declared infeasible due to CWE/query label mismatch), and the TP-verification procedure is underspecified. Evidence is internally consistent (Table 1 gains check out: 7009→15406 = +119.8%; Table 2 baseline regresses below vanilla in 5 of 6 configs; Table 3 success/no-op = 150/180 = 83.3%) and includes real-world artifacts (3 fixed GitHub issues #21187/#20577/#16542; zlib/libpng bugs with code links), though TP labeling methodology and single-baseline design temper confidence. Generalizability is plausible (any analyzer with a runtime oracle; C#/Go mentioned) but demonstrated only on C/C++ CodeQL. Reproducibility is middling: public datasets and a fully specified algorithm, but no code/artifact release and dependence on commercial agent products with loosely specified configs. Not out-of-scope; calibrated weighted score ~0.74.

primary_link.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection

papers.summary: Static analyzers have been widely adopted for vulnerability detection in C/C++ programs. Query-based static analyzers (e.g., CodeQL) encode vulnerable code patterns in detection queries and match them against source code. However, existing queries still suffer from false positives (FPs, incorrectly flagging benign code as vulnerable) and false negatives (FNs, missing real vulnerabilities). We present ARQ, an agentic framework that automatically refines C/C++ CodeQL queries using execution-ground
papers.summary_zh: 靜態分析工具（如 CodeQL）以查詢比對原始碼中的漏洞模式，但查詢本身常有誤報（FP）與漏報（FN）。ARQ 提出一套代理人框架，以大型語言模型（LLM）自動精修 C/C++ 的 CodeQL 查詢，核心概念是：當合成程式的實際執行結果與查詢判定不一致時，即暴露查詢弱點。LLM 先生成一對極為相似的程式（如 tp.c 與 fn.c），再以編譯器 sanitizer（如 AddressSanitizer）作為 oracle 驗證漏洞真偽，避免模型幻覺；接著以成對的正反見證程式引導 LLM 修訂查詢，並對所有已驗證見證進行迴歸測試，防止修一處壞一處。整個流程不需標註資料集、提交紀錄或漏洞範本。實驗以 GPT-5.4、Claude-Sonnet-4.6 與 Gemini-3.5-flash 精修 12 個官方查詢，在 Juliet v1.3 與 FormAI v2 上真陽性最多提升 119.8%，Precision 全程不低於 98.0%，並修復 CodeQL 官方儲存庫三個懸置長達 27 個月的 GitHub issue，也在 libpng 與 zlib 找出兩個先前未知漏洞。限制方面，因資料集僅以 CWE 標註，無法計算召回率，故只報告 Precision；成效依賴底層模型，GPT-5.4 在 Juliet 上略有退化；也未與 IRIS、QLCoder 直接比較。消融實驗顯示，若移除 Analyze 與 Oracle，純 LLM 推理常低於原始查詢，證明以執行證據約束 LLM 是必要且實用的方向。
papers.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection
papers.title_zh: ARQ：以代理人框架自動精修 CodeQL 查詢偵測 C/C++ 漏洞

links.title: Certified Multi-Turn Robustness for LLM Safety via Compositional Bounds and Safety Persistence

evidence: Abstract: introduces MTCR with compositional certification via embedding-space mode decomposition, (alpha,beta)-safety persistence improving degradation from p^k to beta^k, and matching information-theoretic upper bounds.

Section 4.2, Table 1: certified lower bounds and empirical safety for six LLMs (LLaMA-2, Vicuna, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet); Gap column ranges +0.19 to +0.30, e.g., GPT-4o k=5 certified 0.55 vs Crescendo empirical 0.78.
Section 2 'Scope of certification': 'the formal certification covers only epsilon-bounded perturbations' while 'Real attacks such as Crescendo operate at the semantic level'.
Appendix H: Crescendo-style attack uses 'template-based escalation sequences rather than the original adaptive LLM-based variant, representing a weaker but reproducible adversary'.

Section 4.1: 'Safety is judged by a harmful-content detector combining refusal patterns and an unsafe-keyword list'; Appendix G describes regex plus keyword list as default and a BERT-based classifier comparison (Table 4).

Appendix E: full proofs of Proposition 2.1, Theorems 3.1, 3.5, 3.8, 3.10, 3.11; Lemma E.1 justifies the 1/kappa overlap penalty as a 'conservative' single multiplicative factor rather than a tight derivation.

Section 3.2 / Proposition 3.7: admits the sufficient conditions yield beta=0 (vacuous bound) 'in many practical settings', so persistence parameters are instead estimated empirically (Appendix F.1, N_p=100, Clopper-Pearson lower endpoint).

Appendix I: numerical verification on a parametric Bernoulli model, e.g., Table 5 shows compositional gain ratio <1 for small k or many transitions, and I.4 reports empirical 0.90-0.94 vs certified 0.67 in synthetic validation.
Section 5 'Tightness and Computation': 'Full certification of a single model at four horizons requires approximately 2.5 hours on a single A100 GPU'; targets offline certification only.
Limitations: binary detector-dependent safety predicate, heuristic k-means mode discovery that 'may not cover adversarial state-space regions', and no formal guarantee beyond the epsilon-ball.
Appendix J: fixed seeds (42,142,242,342,442), hyperparameter Table 6, AdvBench 150 prompts, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings; no code or data availability statement appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety research with strong preference alignment (LLM 2.5, AI Safety 2.0, Red Teaming 1.8): certified robustness against multi-turn jailbreaks evaluated on six production LLMs including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5. Novelty is solid but not breakthrough: the first formal multi-turn certification framework, though built by composing known tools (randomized smoothing, SA-MDP theory, compositional verification). Rigor is fairly high: full proofs (Appendix E), matching information-theoretic upper bounds, and an impossibility result, plus honest acknowledgment that Proposition 3.7's sufficient conditions yield vacuous beta=0 in practice and that the 1/kappa overlap penalty (Lemma E.1) is a conservative argument rather than an exact proof. Evidence strength is moderate: six models, 100 trials with Clopper-Pearson CIs, ablations (Tables 1-4), but the certified-vs-empirical gaps are large (+0.19 to +0.30), the Crescendo-style adversary is explicitly a weaker template-based surrogate (Appendix H), the default safety detector is crude regex/keyword matching (Section 4.1, Appendix G), and N=100 smoothing samples is small; the synthetic validation in Appendix I is partly circular since the Bernoulli model is constructed to match theoretical assumptions. Generalizability is limited by the formal guarantee covering only epsilon-bounded character-level perturbations while real attacks are semantic (Section 2 'Scope of certification', Limitations), and mode discovery from safe dialogues may miss adversarial regions (Section 5). Reproducibility is mixed: detailed hyperparameters, fixed seeds, and compute estimates (Appendix J, ~2.5h on one A100), but no code/data release and manually designed escalation templates are not published.

primary_link.title: Certified Multi-Turn Robustness for LLM Safety via Compositional Bounds and Safety Persistence

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to multi-turn jailbreak attacks that progressively manipulate conversation context. Existing certified robustness methods are limited to single-turn inputs; naive multi-turn composition yields bounds that degrade exponentially in the number of turns. We introduce Multi-Turn Certified Robustness (MTCR), a framework that models conversational safety via State-Adversarial MDPs and defines $k$-turn certified robustness as the worst-case safety probability
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型容易受到多輪越獄攻擊，但現有可驗證穩健性方法僅限單輪輸入；若將單輪下界直接相乘，k 輪保證會以 p^k 指數衰減而失去實用價值。本文提出 Multi-Turn Certified Robustness（MTCR），將多輪對話建模為 State-Adversarial MDP，定義 k 輪可驗證穩健性為面對自適應攻擊者時全程維持安全的最低機率。方法包含：(i) 於嵌入空間做模式分解，分別驗證模式內安全與模式間轉移，得到比單純相乘更緊的組合式下界；(ii) 定義 (α,β)-safety persistence，將衰減率由 p̄^k 改善為 β^k，並以 1−k(1−β) 的線性式估計可允許的對話長度；(iii) 以資訊論上界證明在無重疊分解下組合式界限是緊的，且缺乏結構假設時指數衰減不可避免。實驗評估六個模型（LLaMA-2、Vicuna、Llama-3.2、Qwen2.5、GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet），在 ε-bounded 與 Crescendo 式攻擊下，實際安全率一致高於認證下界，對齊較佳的模型衰減也較慢，驗證理論預測。限制包括：形式化保證僅涵蓋字元級 ε 擾動，語義攻擊僅有實證觀察；模式分解依賴 k-means 等啟發式分群，可能無法覆蓋對抗區域；安全謂詞為二元且依賴偵測器。此框架可作為部署前稽核工具，量化多輪最壞情況安全並定位安全瓶頸，對 LLM 安全工程具實務意義。
papers.title: Certified Multi-Turn Robustness for LLM Safety via Compositional Bounds and Safety Persistence
papers.title_zh: MTCR：以組合式界限與安全持續性實現 LLM 多輪對話的可驗證安全穩健性

links.title: Is Visual Prompting All You Need? Studying VLM Spatial Reasoning under Progressive Visual Scaffolds

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): scaffolds 'improve task accuracy over the original visual setting by up to 34.0 percentage points and further complement GRPO-based training, yielding up to 4.6 additional accuracy points'.

§4.2 (Page 5): 'Qwen 3.5 397B improves from 14.4% on the Original board to 48.4% with Text Symbols... Paired bootstrap intervals exclude zero for all three (Appendix E.1)'; floor models Gemma 3 27B and Mistral Small 3.2 show no resolvable gain.
Appendix E.1, Table 2 (Page 16): 95% bootstrap percentile intervals (B=200,000, seed 20260821) for every model-condition pair, plus Table 3 paired differences to best scaffold and text baseline.
§4.6 and Table 4 (Pages 8-9, 16): GRPO on Qwen 3 VL 4B/8B Thinking gives +3.8/+4.6 pp on Text Symbols versus near-zero on Original visual input (1.4%→0.8% and 0.2%→0.4%).

Appendix E.2, Table 5 (Pages 15, 17): ablation decomposing Axis Labels into grid lines only, blank gutter (which hurts, e.g., 14.4→4.4 for Qwen 3.5 397B), and printed labels (+2.4 to +7.6 pp recovery).

Limitations (Page 9): 'Our scaffolds are hand-designed... the improvements are partly by construction', 'We therefore restrict the empirical claims to this benchmark', quantization for Qwen 3.5 397B and GLM 4.6V acknowledged with within-model comparison argument.
Table 1 (Page 14): inference compute 1,367.1 A100-hours; Appendix E.3 (Page 15-16) reports ~1,500 A100-hours GRPO training budget.
§4.3/Figure 7 (Page 7): detection-task accuracy correlates with end-to-end planning accuracy (r=0.96, R²=0.92, p<0.001; weaker r=0.51 for average rule detection in E.5).
Footnote 1 (Page 2): 'Our code and data are available on GitHub.' Prompts fully listed in Appendix F (Pages 18-21).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled diagnostic study of how input-side visual scaffolding affects VLM spatial planning on SPaRC. It is in scope: methodology is language-model-centric (VLM/LLM evaluation, prompting-style input interventions, GRPO post-training), not pure computer vision. Strong preference alignment with LLMs, multimodal reasoning, prompting, and RL/alignment preferences. Novelty is moderate: visual scaffolds resemble Set-of-Mark prompting (acknowledged in §2.2), and the contribution is a systematic scaffold hierarchy plus perception-vs-reasoning disentanglement rather than a new method. Rigor is high: 7 open-weight models, 500-puzzle test split, 200,000-replicate bootstrap CIs and paired differences (Appendix E.1, Table 2/3), scaffold ablation (E.2 Table 5), degradation-recovery stress tests, honest limitations (scaffolds 'partly by construction', quantization confound, single benchmark). Evidence is solid but bound to one synthetic grid benchmark with absolute accuracies low (best model 48.4%), and GRPO gains (+3.8/+4.6 pp on Text Symbols) are small and from only two small models. Generalizability is explicitly restricted by the authors to SPaRC. Reproducibility is good (open weights, full prompts in Appendix F, seeds, compute budget in Table 1, GitHub code/data claim), though no direct URL is given.

primary_link.title: Is Visual Prompting All You Need? Studying VLM Spatial Reasoning under Progressive Visual Scaffolds

papers.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in multimodal reasoning, yet recent work shows that their failures often reflect an interaction between visual grounding and downstream reasoning. What remains less clear is how the visual presentation of a task shapes model performance and failure modes when the underlying reasoning problem is unchanged. We study this question in SPaRC, a benchmark for grid-based visual spatial planning, by introducing lightweight input-side scaffolds that pre
papers.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLM）的推理失敗常源自視覺定位與下游推理的交互作用，但既有研究多以文字取代影像或僅測子任務，難以釐清視覺呈現本身的影響。本文以 SPaRC（網格式視覺空間規劃基準）為測試平台，在棋盤布局、規則與解答不變的前提下，建構漸進式輸入端視覺鷹架：S/E 標記、座標軸標籤、格點座標，以及將規則符號改為文字的 Text Symbols。作者評估七個開源 VLM 的端對端解題準確率、物件偵測表現與路徑層級錯誤類型。零樣本下鷹架最高提升 34.0 個百分點：Qwen 3.5 397B 由 14.4% 升至 48.4%，最佳視覺輸入甚至超過文字基線；錯誤分析顯示增益主要來自端點定位與路徑連通等定位類錯誤的減少，規則滿足仍屬難題。視覺退化實驗顯示座標鷹架可部分抵禦低對比與低解析度，但旋轉仍是弱點。GRPO 後訓練實驗最為關鍵：在原始圖像上近乎學不到訊號，在 Text Symbols 上卻可再提升 4.6 個百分點，顯示感知輸入會限制 RL 可利用的訓練訊號。限制包括：鷹架依已知棋盤結構手工設計、結論僅限 SPaRC，且未涵蓋閉源前沿模型，最大模型使用 4-bit 量化。這凸顯基準分數同時量測感知與推理，輸入呈現方式本身即是不可忽略的實驗變因，對未來多模態基準設計深具參考價值。
papers.title: Is Visual Prompting All You Need? Studying VLM Spatial Reasoning under Progressive Visual Scaffolds
papers.title_zh: 視覺提示就夠了嗎？漸進式視覺鷹架下的 VLM 空間推理研究

links.title: When Trust Meets Truth: Trust-Truth Separability in LLM-as-Judge

evidence: Abstract: 'Source attribution shifts not only trust scores but also truth verdicts and logit-derived correct-side probabilities' — central claim of trust-truth non-separability.

Appendix B.3, Table 6: pooled matched-pair Human-minus-AI effects with item-cluster bootstrap 95% CIs — trust rating +0.57 pts [+0.54,+0.60], P(Correct) +3.92 pp [+3.29,+4.65], logit Correct-Judge confidence +5.35 pp [+4.93,+5.80]; domain-stratified effects all same direction.

Appendix A.2: human baseline is N=54 participants, each judging 8 fact-checking QA items (4 correct, 4 incorrect) with no source cues, described as a 'behavioral contrast, not a normative gold standard'.

Appendix A.1: incorrect answers generated by GPT-5.2, manually checked for plausibility/length (≤10% length difference), cue position fixed across conditions; per-domain QA item counts are not reported anywhere.

Appendix A.4: five judges (GPT-5.4, Claude-Sonnet-4.6 via APIs; GPT-OSS-120B, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, Qwen3.6-35B local) with JSON-only outputs; open-weight models used for logit-derived confidence (Appendix B.1).

Table 1 (Section 3): humans show trust-truth dissociation (trust 4.66 vs 4.14; truth accuracy 0.77 correct vs 0.88 incorrect) while LLMs show tighter coupling (trust 6.60 vs 6.10; accuracy 0.68 vs 0.63).
Limitations section: authors concede restricted domains/cues/models, absence of placebo variants for lexical framing, behavioral-only mechanism claim, and small human study.
Front-matter footnote: 'Materials for reproducibility: anonymous repository' plus full prompt templates in Appendix Tables 4-5 and public source datasets (MedQuAD, WebQuestions, ASQA).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant audit of LLM-as-Judge reliability: whether multi-field judge outputs (trust score vs. binary truth verdict) are separable, directly touching LLM, evaluation/benchmark, and AI-safety preferences. The controlled source-counterfactual design (content fixed, only Human/AI cue varied), separate stateless prompts, and matched-pair item-cluster bootstrap CIs are methodologically sound and results are directionally consistent across 5 judges and 3 domains. Novelty is moderate: source/label cue bias in LLM judges is well documented, and this extends the authors' own prior label-effects work to a separability framing. Rigor gaps: the human baseline is small (N=54, 8 fact-checking QA each, no cues), per-domain dataset sizes are unreported, incorrect answers are GPT-generated with subjective manual checks, and no placebo/lexical-framing controls. Evidence is quantitative with CIs but scope-limited; authors honestly bound claims in the Limitations section. Prompts (Tables 4-5), model versions, decoding setup, and an anonymous repository support reproduction, though 'default temperature' and missing dataset counts weaken it. Not a domain-application paper despite the HealthQA dataset; it is core LLM-evaluation methodology.

primary_link.title: When Trust Meets Truth: Trust-Truth Separability in LLM-as-Judge

papers.summary: LLM-as-Judge systems can produce multi-dimensional evaluations, such as trustworthiness, reliability, and factuality, and these outputs are often interpreted as independent evidence. We test this assumption for a common pair of judgments: trust scoring and binary truth classification. On correctness-controlled QA, LLM judges align trust scores with truth verdicts more tightly than human behavioral reference, suggesting weaker separations between trust and truth judgment. We then apply stress tes
papers.summary_zh: LLM-as-Judge 常同時輸出多維評估，如可信度評分與事實正確判斷，下游管線常將這些欄位視為相互獨立的證據。本文檢驗此假設：LLM 評審能否將連續信任評分與二元真相判斷分離？作者在 HealthQA、GeneralQA 與事實查核三個領域建立正確性受控的問答集，為每個答案製造 Human 與 AI 來源的反事實版本，內容完全不變，僅改變來源提示。以 54 位人類評審作為行為基線，並測試 GPT-5.4、Claude-Sonnet-4.6 等商業模型與 Llama-3.3-70B 等開源模型。結果顯示：人類對正確答案給予較高信任，但其真相判斷準確率反而較低，呈現部分分離；LLM 評審的信任與真相則緊密耦合。壓力測試中，Human 來源提示同時推高信任分數與判為 Correct 的機率（彙總 P(Correct) 提升 3.92 個百分點），對本應判錯的答案也會增加誤判接受；本地模型的 logit 分析更顯示正確判斷信心提升 5.35 個百分點，證明來源線索已滲入事實評估的內部訊號。限制包括僅涵蓋受測領域與模型、來源提示較真實情境單純、人類僅為行為基線而非黃金標準，且未探討內部機制。此研究的意義在於：多維評審輸出預設不該視為獨立證據，於基準測試或資料過濾管線使用前，應先進行盲審與標籤交換等可分離性稽核。
papers.title: When Trust Meets Truth: Trust-Truth Separability in LLM-as-Judge
papers.title_zh: 當信任遇上真相：LLM-as-Judge 中的信任—真相可分離性

links.title: K-Bench: measuring model performance on real scientific agent requests

evidence: Abstract: '1,602 completed agent runs... no model clears the line under all three judges' with pooled best mean 8.04 and 95% CI [7.80, 8.23] spanning the threshold.
Section 5.2: judge-dependent threshold crossing - qwen3.8-max and grok-4.5 each say two models reach the 8-anchor while gpt-5.6-sol says none (highest mean 7.90).
Section 5.4 and Table 22: calibration-adjusted self-preference of gpt-5.6-sol is +0.83, comparable to the first-second leaderboard gap; grok-4.5 shows +0.11.

Section 7 (Limitations): 'we never checked the instrument: no human scored any run', two of three judges are contestants, one harness/one-shot/one attempt, and private items limit external reproducibility.

Section 'Data, code and availability': 'The task prompts, attachments, transcripts and output artifacts are not released'; only de-identified score tables and rubric v1.0 (Appendix A.1) will be published.
Section 4.2 and Table 6: scientific accuracy 6.22 vs communication 7.33 on identical denominators, ordering within all nine models.
Section 4.4 and Table 9: 767 of 1,602 runs (47.9%) end with no output file; empty runs average 5.26 vs 6.68.
Section 3.4: HMAC blinding, read-only output trees hashed before/after judging, 4,806/4,806 schema-valid assessments eventually, 534 paired comparisons per model pair (Section 3.5).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent evaluation benchmark built from verbatim first-turn user traffic, scored by three blinded LLM judges with artifact inspection. Highly relevant to agent evaluation, tool use, and LLM-as-judge methodology. Strengths: unusually careful self-analysis of the judging panel (order reproduces, Kendall's W=0.955, while level is judge-dependent), quantified self-preference (+0.83 for gpt-5.6-sol), paired comparisons that cancel judge calibration, deterministic transcript-derived proxies (verification actions, empty-run rates), and full rubric disclosure. Weaknesses: no human validation of the absolute 8-anchor, two of three judges are contestants with the neutral-judge refit deferred, single run per model-task with no variance estimate, complete-case filtering (22 refusals dropped), uneven one-week domain sample, and the task set/transcripts are not released, so a benchmark cannot be reused externally. Novelty is moderate: traffic-derived open-ended judging follows WildBench/Arena-Hard/AstaBench/RealClawBench; the artifact-graded, no-verifier design and panel-as-object-of-study are the main new elements.

primary_link.title: K-Bench: measuring model performance on real scientific agent requests

papers.summary: Benchmarks for scientific artificial intelligence are mostly written to be scored: multiple-choice questions, curated agent tasks with reference solutions, or simulators with a known generative structure. Real scientific requests arrive differently. They are underspecified, they carry attachments, and lack ground truth. We report K-Bench 01, an evaluation built from first-turn requests sampled from live user traffic on K-Dense Web and run end to end by nine frontier models in identical sandboxes
papers.summary_zh: 科學AI基準多以可評分為設計前提，採選擇題或附參考解答的任務，但真實科學請求往往規格不完整、附帶檔案且缺乏標準答案。K-Bench 01 從 K-Dense Web 真實用戶流量抽取178則第一輪請求原文（含附件），在相同沙盒與固定 harness 下由九個前沿模型各執行一次，共1,602個運行，再由三位身分遮蔽的語言模型評審，依八維度量規檢視回答文字與磁碟上的產出檔案，合計4,806份評估與39,934項評分。結果顯示沒有任何模型在三位評審下同時越過「領域科學家願意小修後接受」的8分門檻：gpt-5.6-sol 平均8.04最高，但其95%信賴區間橫跨門檻，兩位評審改將 claude-opus-5 排第一，故榜首視為未定。47.6%的評分低於8分；科學準確度平均6.22落後溝通7.33，且方向在九個模型內部一致；最常見失敗標記為overclaiming（31.4%），47.9%的運行未在磁碟留下任何檔案。評審對排序高度一致（Kendall W 0.955）卻對分數水平系統性分歧，且兩位評審同為參賽者，gpt-5.6-sol 出現+0.83的校準調整後自評偏好。研究未做人類校準、題組不公開；其主張是可複現的是系統排序而非絕對分數，評估科學代理應報告交付內容、宣稱與產出檔案的聯合分布。
papers.title: K-Bench: measuring model performance on real scientific agent requests
papers.title_zh: K-Bench：衡量模型在真實科學代理請求上的表現

links.title: AID-Guard: Stateful Authorization for Delegated Agent Effects

evidence: Abstract: 'Thirteen live mutations produced no unauthorized provider effects... All 210 Stripe provider-contract trials matched their predeclared outcomes.'

Section VI-B: 'The D0 inventory records a disposition for all 39 items: 20 returned IN_SCOPE_PASS, 19 returned NOT_APPLICABLE_VALIDATED' - conformance evidence for a declared, not discovered, inventory.

Section VI-F (Table V): benign utility drop of '-43.8 percentage points [-66.7, -20.8] for DeepSeek' under the exact-manifest profile, honestly framed as 'a strict enforcement stress profile rather than a recommended default deployment policy'.
Section VI-F: 'Spotlighting matched AID-Guard's 0/144 unsafe-effect result while preserving 41/48 benign tasks versus 20/48' - a favorable baseline result the paper does not hide.
Section VII-B: 'The prototype uses synthetic credentials on a trusted host, one enumerable loopback domain, one controlled provider, and bounded Stripe and Resend schedules.'
Section VI-A Reproducibility: 'we will release it for artifact evaluation' - artifact promised but not yet available.

Appendix F (Table XIII): bounded model checking '199 reachable states; 1,375 transitions; depth 6' and '312 reachable states; 7,192 transitions; depth 8' support P1-P2 sketches, explicitly not unbounded proofs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems-security protocol paper squarely within preference scope: agent tool-use authorization (MCP, tool calls), agent misbehavior/recovery, and prompt-injection defense evaluated with LLMs-in-the-loop on AgentDojo. Novelty is moderate: the combination of commit-time revalidation, single reservation lineage, certified-no-effect recovery with delivery fencing, and one-successor transfer is a real contribution, but the paper itself catalogs many contemporaneous preprints (CapLease, CXI, Cordon, Commit-Time Authorization) covering much of the lifecycle. Rigor is strong: explicit threat model and TCB, conditional properties P1-P3 with proof sketches, bounded transition validation (Appendix F: 199/312-state models), predeclared outcomes, matched ambient controls, Wilson intervals and task-cluster bootstrap, and unusually honest confound handling (e.g., Section VI-F admits the natural AgentDojo slice is 'a model-behavior comparison rather than a guard-attribution result' and that Spotlighting matched 0/144 unsafe with far better utility). Evidence is solid but small-scale and synthetic: 13 mutations, 3 concurrent histories, 4 recovery traces, 210 Stripe test-mode trials, 44-attack proposer-compromise profile, all on one loopback domain; no mechanized proof and no-seed utility analysis is only descriptive. Generalizability is deliberately narrow: properties are conditional on a D0-complete declared domain and supported atomic/controlled-idempotent provider contracts, with high prototype latency (2.35x ambient median, Section VI-D) and severe utility cost (35.4-43.8 pp drop; 12-26/48 in the frontier rerun). Reproducibility intent is good (frozen pipeline, digests, versioned artifact) but the artifact is only promised ('we will release it for artifact evaluation', Section VI-A), not yet verifiable.

primary_link.title: AID-Guard: Stateful Authorization for Delegated Agent Effects

papers.summary: Tool-using AI agents turn delegated tasks into provider effects, yet authorization often ends at admission while provider state, delivery, retry, and recovery evolve. A request may change before commit, or response loss may cause a replacement to create a second effect from one approval. We present AID-Guard, a stateful authorization-to-effect closure protocol. It revalidates the approved request and provider state at commit, retains one reservation under ambiguity, and permits release or one su
papers.summary_zh: 使用工具的AI代理會把委派任務轉成對供應商的實際效應，但授權常止於准入：請求可能在提交前被竄改，或效應已發生而回應遺失，重試與替代授權可能讓一次批准產生兩次效應，形成授權—效應缺口。AID-Guard 是有狀態的授權到效應閉合協定，核心為三項規則：提交時重新驗證確切的已核准請求與當前供應商狀態（D2）；交付結果不明時保留同一配額保留，不得鑄造替代授權；僅在取得終端結果或經認證的無效應證據並安裝交付圍欄後，才允許釋放或轉移給唯一後繼者。協定以H1–H3三個強制檢查點綁定觀察、能力發行與效應邊界宣稱，並以角色分離的證據圖支援公開驗證與特權重播。作者以Python/SQLite原型在本機迴路MCP網域評估：13次現場變異未產生未授權效應；210組Stripe合約試驗全數符合預宣告結果；各類重試、競態與當機復原排程皆無重複效應；在提案者完全妥協下，44個攻擊全數被阻擋，44個對應合法提案全數放行。限制包括嚴格exact-manifest使良性效用下降35.4–43.8個百分點、原型延遲偏高（中位數約為環境的2.35倍），且仰賴可列舉的效應路徑與受信任主機。核心洞見是重試與復原本身就是授權轉移，需受持久邊界約束。
papers.title: AID-Guard: Stateful Authorization for Delegated Agent Effects
papers.title_zh: AID-Guard：針對委派代理效應的有狀態授權

links.title: No Judgment Without a Reason: Counterfactual Receipts for Versioned AI Evaluators

evidence: Abstract and §7.2 Table 2: direct receipt with Qwen3-1.7B reaches 98.41% exact receipt accuracy vs 96.99% for cube prediction; paired effect −1.42 pp [−2.87, −0.30], Holm-adjusted p=.002, rejecting the frozen cube-superiority claim.

§7.5 Table 6: source-order permutation consistency is only 54.77% (direct) and 49.18% (cube) despite ~98% locked accuracy; §7.3 reports wrong receipts in 1.66% of changed cases with both endpoints correct (direct).

§7.6 Table 7: post-hoc permutation augmentation raises order consistency from 55.85% to 96.61% (direct) at −0.32 pp locked cost, improves untouched language-shift rendering, but untargeted inverse consistency stays ~47% for both targets.
§7.8 Table 9: composition holdout — direct keeps 93.75% revised-verdict accuracy yet only 7.16% changed-case receipt accuracy; at greater depth changed-case receipts are 0% for both targets.

§6.3: protocol and analysis code frozen under SHA-256, explicitly described as an internal content-addressed freeze, not third-party preregistration; §5.4 reports an independent audit with zero label errors and two found-and-fixed aggregation errors.

§10 Scope and limitations: constructed deterministic adjudicators, one model family (1.7B primary, 0.6B replication, single LoRA config), six organizational locked clauses, templated RuleTaker-style logical worlds, and no human-validity or deployed-systems study.

§7.1 Table 1: majority baseline 53.8%/44.2% and character TF-IDF 90.0%/61.7% on revised-verdict/receipt accuracy, establishing that lexical signal alone does not explain the learned results but also does not establish reasoning.
§7.10 Table 11: compute-matched comparison (17.43M trainable params, ~53 min/seed) with generated-token counts, ruling out obvious target-length confounds.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong methodological paper on certifying explanations for versioned AI evaluators (LLM-as-judge governance), overlapping several high-weight preferences (LLMs via Qwen3 fine-tuning, AI safety/scalable oversight, interpretability, evaluation/benchmark design, reasoning-style rule worlds) but not Japanese NLP or core agent capabilities. Novelty is solid: judgment receipts as minimal sufficient explanations for version transitions, antichain/query lower bounds, and paired metamorphic consistency as an evaluation primitive, though built from known parts (prime-implicant sufficient reasons, metamorphic testing, selective prediction). Rigor and evidence are unusually strong for the scale: content-hash frozen protocol, five seeds, hierarchical bootstrap, Holm correction, independent label audit, surface/chance diagnostics, smaller-backbone replication, and a preserved preregistered negative result; residual limits are the internal (non-third-party) freeze, one backbone family, one LoRA config, and exploratory 3-seed post-hoc studies. Generalizability is capped by fully constructed executable adjudicators, templated logical worlds, and only six organizational locked clauses, which the authors honestly flag. Reproducibility is good on paper (pinned model revision, hyperparameters, SHA-256 freeze, datasheet/checksums referenced) but no explicit public code/data release is stated. Overall a high-quality, well-hedged contribution whose empirical findings are trustworthy within their narrow constructed scope.

primary_link.title: No Judgment Without a Reason: Counterfactual Receipts for Versioned AI Evaluators

papers.summary: Evaluators often produce correct labels via flawed reasoning, a critical failure for agentic systems gating actions, routing reviews, or supplying training feedback. Standard evaluation only verifies final label correctness, ignoring whether judgment changes stem from valid evidence, consistent rules, or proper rule applicability. We formalize evaluator reasoning accountability via three core sources: grounds, norms, and authority. Varying these sources yields an eight-cell counterfactual judgme
papers.summary_zh: AI評估器在實務中為代理動作把關、分流送審並回流訓練訊號，但多數評測只檢驗最終標籤，無法確認判決改變源自證據、規則或適用權限的何種變化。本文將評估器狀態表示為三類型來源：grounds（證據）、norms（決策規則）與authority（管轄範圍），以新舊版本來源替換構成八格反事實「判決立方體」；判決回執是能重現修訂判決的所有包含極小替換集合。模型輸出僅屬預測，唯有透過可信裁定器執行反事實才能認證。ReasonBench 在組織政策與邏輯規則世界提供可執行的新舊狀態、全部混合體與精確回執，共19,520個案例與7,200個配對控制。在預先以內容雜湊凍結的五種子實驗中，Qwen3-1.7B直接預測回執達98.41%精確率，預測完整立方體為96.99%，配對差異-1.42個百分點，否證了預先凍結的「立方體監督更有利」假設。更重要的是高準確率掩蓋的失敗：來源順序置換下一致性僅約50%；訓練於零或單一來源變更而測試於多重變更時，判決準確率維持93.75%，回執復原卻僅剩7.16%。事後置換增強可將順序一致性提升至96.6%而不損及凍結測試表現，但未針對的反向轉移關係依然失效。限制涵蓋裁定器皆為可執行建構、組織子集僅六條款與單一模型家族；核心主張是區分預測與認證，並在準確率之外報告語義保留轉換下的一致性。
papers.title: No Judgment Without a Reason: Counterfactual Receipts for Versioned AI Evaluators
papers.title_zh: 無理由即無判決：版本化AI評估器的反事實回執

links.title: Target-Aware Calibration Data Selection for Preserving Uncertainty in Quantized Language Models

evidence: Abstract: frames calibration-data selection as a 'target-dependent uncertainty-preservation problem' across '8 language models, 9 NLP benchmarks, and 22 comparison methods'
Section 5.3 / Table 2: DPQ-s128-r75 best boundary rank 6.20 with AccΔ 0.2125, RateΔ 0.1000, JSD 0.0158 vs GPTQ-WikiText AccΔ 0.4553, RateΔ 0.2271, JSD 0.0387
Section 5.4 / Table 4: broad MCQA target shifts leaders to confidence-only (rank 8.96) and TaskRandom (9.12) while DPQ-r75 falls to 11.88, supporting the target-dependence claim
Appendix A.4 / Table 10: AWQ transfer is mixed—WikiText is best on every reported metric for TruthfulQA, honestly reported as 'quantizer- and target-dependent rather than fixed at r75'
Appendix A.1 / Table 6: stability check removing Llama-3.2-1B keeps DPQ-s128-r75 first (rank 6.26, Agr. 0.9360)
Appendix C: Propositions 1-6 with proofs (boundary flip condition, TV mismatch bound, temperature scaling preserves argmax); mathematically elementary but correctly stated
Appendix D / Tables 16-18: seeds 4242/2027, public checkpoints, single RTX 5090 32GB, deterministic evaluation sizes, retained JSONL/CSV artifacts, code at github.com/xi-xiaoran/DPQ
Limitations section: scope restricted to option-scoring uncertainty and 4-bit GPTQ/AWQ; 'verbalized confidence and long-form generation' deferred to future work
References: future-dated citations with overlapping authorship (He et al. 2026 arXiv:2606.00144; Wu et al. 2026 arXiv:2605.08314; Shao et al. 2026) cited for motivation
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-efficiency work: calibration-data selection for 4-bit post-training quantization of LLMs (Qwen2.5, Llama-3.x, Mistral) evaluated on standard NLP/QA benchmarks, directly matching the Large Language Models, Scaling & Efficiency, and Inference & Serving preferences; not a domain-application or out-of-scope area. Novelty is moderate: the target-dependent uncertainty-preservation framing and the mixture-mismatch TV-bound argument are new, but the components (doubt/margin-based selection, calibration-data effects, post-hoc calibration) build on known prior work (Williams & Aletras 2024; Proskurina et al. 2024; Zhong et al. 2025). Rigor is strong for scope: formal propositions with proofs (Appendix C), 22 comparison methods, ratio/size/component ablations, negative controls (HighNLL-QA, LowDoubt-QA), a stability check removing the Llama-3.2-1B stress case (Table 6), and honest reporting of mixed AWQ transfer (Table 10); deductions for mathematically trivial propositions, equal-weight rank aggregation as the headline metric, and future-dated self-citations with overlapping authors (He et al. 2026, Wu et al. 2026, Shao et al. 2026) that slightly undermine citation hygiene. Evidence is concrete and multi-metric (Tables 1, 2, 4-15) but lacks statistical significance testing and full per-model breakdowns in the main text. Generalizability is bounded by the option-scoring operationalization, 4-bit PTQ focus, target-oriented candidate pool, and the authors' own admission that verbalized confidence and long-form generation are untested. Reproducibility is good: public code link, checkpoints, seeds, prompt formats, dataset sizes, and hardware documented in Appendix D.

primary_link.title: Target-Aware Calibration Data Selection for Preserving Uncertainty in Quantized Language Models

papers.summary: Quantization is widely used to deploy large language models, but its effect on uncertainty behavior, such as confidence, margins, and abstention, is rarely treated as a primary objective. We frame calibration-data selection for quantization as a target-dependent uncertainty-preservation problem. Different deployments emphasize different regions of the input distribution, yet prior work mainly optimizes accuracy-oriented compression metrics or adjusts scores after quantization. We formalize this
papers.summary_zh: 量化是部署大型語言模型的標準手段，但其對不確定性行為（信心、邊際與棄答）的影響很少被當成主要目標；當下游依賴分數做棄答、重排或安全過濾時，即使top-1答案不變，量化仍可能改變信心邊際與可答性判斷。本文將校準資料選取形式化為目標相依的不確定性保留問題，定義分布保留與邊界保留兩種風險，並以混合比例失配論證說明除非目標重合，否則單一配方無法同時適合所有目標。作者提出DPQ（Doubt-Preserving Quantization）輕量預量化配方家族：利用全精度模型的預測挑選高懷疑（低邊際）範例，混入WikiText或隨機QA錨點後執行未更動的GPTQ量化器。在8個模型、9個NLP基準與22種方法上，最佳配方隨目標而異：DPQ-r75 在 SQuAD2 可答性邊界保留上居首，將邊界準確度偏差自WikiText的0.4553降至0.2125；廣泛多選QA則由較溫和或單一訊號配方如DPQ-r50、confidence-only與entropy-only領先，沒有配方能在兩個目標上同時稱霸。消融顯示混合成分比校準預算更重要，r100過度集中反而變差；事後校準與預量化選取互補，溫度縮放無法修復決策翻轉；AWQ轉移具條件性。限制涵蓋僅操作化選項評分式不確定性、候選池以目標為導向，以及主要針對GPTQ。其意義在於部署應依所需保留的分數行為選擇校準資料，並審計量化後模型的分數行為而非只看準確率。
papers.title: Target-Aware Calibration Data Selection for Preserving Uncertainty in Quantized Language Models
papers.title_zh: 目標感知的校準資料選取：在量化語言模型中保留不確定性

links.title: Vis-Poison: Poisoning Visual Knowledge in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

evidence: Abstract: reports end-to-end attack success rate of 40.16% to 65.40% against 30k-entry multimodal knowledge bases in black-box settings; claims code and data at github.com/SWUFE-DB-Group/Vis-Poison
Section 3.2.2: attacker 'only injects...a single poisoned image' with 'no control over any associated text' and 'remains entirely oblivious to internal components'
Section 4.2 & Algorithm 1: Planner/Editor/Verifier multi-agent loop; 'successfully constructs poisoned images in over 73% of cases when R=1'
Section 5: defines Poison Override Rate (POR), Clean Help Rate (CHR), Poison Induction Rate (PIR) using closed-book responses as knowledge proxy
Section 6.4/Table 4: average POR 62.4% across six generators; average ASR-G rises from 63.3% (easy) to 76.4% (hard)
Section 6.6.1/Table 6: TruFor blocks 3.89% of poisoned images; text-side isValid blocks 22.78% of captions
Appendix C/Table 10: Cohen's κ of 0.73 (poison verification) to 0.90 (question-only knowledge) between automatic judgments and humans
Limitations: scope restricted to single-image queries and visual modality; construction pipeline not exhaustively varied across model choices
llm_evaluation.rationale: Security attack paper on multimodal RAG with MLLM generators: strong alignment with high-weight preferences (RAG & knowledge, AI safety, red teaming/evaluation, multimodal AI, partially agentic construction). Not pure CV—the payload pipeline is language-model-centric (Planner/Editor/Verifier LLM loop). Novelty is solid but incremental within a crowded poisoning-attack literature: image-only semantic editing for black-box transfer plus a knowledge-aware POR/CHR/PIR evaluation framing are the genuine contributions. Rigor is good: two pipelines, 3 retrievers, 9 captioners, 6 generators, 30k KBs, stratified easy/hard splits, human agreement (Cohen's κ 0.73–0.90, Appendix C/Table 10), and a limitations section; weaknesses include reuse of Gemma 4-31B as verifier/judge (mild circularity), k=1 retrieval favoring the attack, no variance/significance reporting, and a figure-only baseline comparison (Fig. 5). Evidence is quantitatively detailed (end-to-end ASR 40.16–65.40% at 30k, Table 3; POR avg 62.4%, Table 4; TruFor blocks only 3.89%, Table 6). Generalizability is limited to WebQA-derived single-image queries. Reproducibility benefits from released code/data, full prompts (Appendix A), and hardware detail, but depends on proprietary models.

primary_link.title: Vis-Poison: Poisoning Visual Knowledge in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

papers.summary: While multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly rely on images as external knowledge sources, the introduction of poisoned visual evidence can severely compromise multimodal large language model (MLLM) generation. Unlike prior attacks that rely on altering textual metadata, we introduce Vis-Poison, a novel visual knowledge poisoning attack where the poisoned image itself is the attacker-controlled payload, without manipulating captions, summaries, metadata, or other as
papers.summary_zh: 多模態檢索增強生成（RAG）系統日益依賴圖片作為外部知識來源，但既有投毒攻擊多仰賴竄改文字（如反事實字幕或指令）。本文提出 Vis-Poison，一種純視覺投毒攻擊：惡意載荷完全內嵌於圖片本身，不操縱任何關聯文字。攻擊者以自動化多代理流程建構毒圖——由 Planner 規劃編輯指令、Editor 執行局部修改、Verifier 驗證圖片是否支持目標錯誤答案。由於局部編輯保留圖片整體語意，毒圖在檢索階段仍與查詢高度相關，但生成階段的查詢會引導模型注意被操縱的區域，進而輸出攻擊者想要的答案。實驗在 COCO 與 Flickr30k 知識庫（規模至 3 萬筆）上，涵蓋兩種檢索管線、四種嵌入模型與六種生成模型，黑盒端到端攻擊成功率達 40.16% 至 65.40%。作者另提出知識感知評估框架，發現即使模型閉卷即可答對，毒圖仍以平均 62.4% 的覆寫率扭轉其參數化知識。現有防禦效果有限：TruFor 偽造偵測僅攔截 3.89% 毒圖，文字端檢查僅攔截 22.78% 字幕，top-3 檢索僅部分緩解。限制包括僅探討視覺模態、單圖查詢情境，且建構流程依賴大型模型。此研究顯示多模態 RAG 的安全邊界正從文字信任轉向視覺信任，突顯驗證視覺證據完整性的必要性。
papers.title: Vis-Poison: Poisoning Visual Knowledge in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: Vis-Poison：針對多模態檢索增強生成的視覺知識投毒攻擊

links.title: Asymmetric Capacity Allocation in Self-Refinement Pipelines

evidence: Abstract: claims 'the first stage-wise model size study of the self-refinement pipeline on 5 benchmarks from different domains using 6 model sizes of Qwen3 and 4 model sizes of Gemma 3'
Section 3.2: protocol varies exactly one stage (generator, critic, or refiner) while fixing the other two at the same model, e.g., P(0.6B,32B,32B)...P(32B,32B,32B)
Table 1 (Sec. 5): under Qwen3, refiner std 20.60 pts on PIE vs critic 1.63; Meeting Planning refiner 11.20 vs critic 3.10; supports asymmetric sensitivity findings
Section 5.2/Finding 2.2 and Table 3: Qwen3-0.6B critic over matched no-critique baseline yields +9.67/+10.34 pts on Meeting Planning and positive gains on all five benchmarks

Section 5.3/Finding 3.2: '12 of the 30 evaluated refiner pipelines (5 benchmarks x 6 refiner sizes) perform worse than the corresponding initial generation'; manual analysis of 50 degradation events from P(32B,32B,0.6B)
Section 5.2: manual five-point rubric evaluation of 50 critiques each from 0.6B and 32B critics; e.g., ZebraLogic non-misleading rates 70% (32B) vs 64% (0.6B)
Appendix A: greedy decoding, temperature 0.0, max 700 new tokens, NVIDIA H100 GPUs; Appendix B: evaluation subsets of 500/320 examples per benchmark
Appendices C, D, E, and Table 4: Gemma 3-27B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-8B configurations reproduce qualitative trends; degradation totals 12/30, 9/30, 8/30, 8/20
Limitations: single refinement iteration only; no retrieval, planning, tool use, or memory; two model families only
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core-LLM methodology paper: a controlled stage-wise model-size sweep of the generator-critic-refiner self-refinement pipeline, directly relevant to LLM agents, inference-time scaling/efficiency, and reasoning benchmarks; not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: the claim to be the first systematic stage-wise capacity study of self-refinement is plausible given the related-work positioning against routing/cascading (Sec. 2), but the conclusions (generator/refiner matter, critic size does not) are intuitive empirical findings with no new technique. Rigor is solid: one-stage-at-a-time protocol (Sec. 3.2), 2 model families, 3 anchor scales (32B/14B/8B), a matched no-critique baseline (Sec. 3.3), manual rubric evaluation of critique quality (Sec. 5.2), and manual analysis of 50 degradation events (Sec. 5.3); however, no statistical significance testing, no error bars, subsets of only 320-500 examples per benchmark (Appendix B), a single refinement iteration, and no cost/FLOP-normalized analysis despite efficiency claims. Evidence strength is decent: quantitative support in Table 1 (refiner std 20.60 vs critic 1.63 on PIE, Qwen3), Table 3 (+9.67/+10.34 pts on Meeting Planning from a 0.6B critic over no-critique), and Table 4 (12/30 degraded refiner pipelines), with claims matching the reported data; the GPT-4-judged CollaboSentGen metric and small subsets weaken confidence. Generalizability is limited to open-weight dense models <=32B and one critique-refine round (acknowledged in Limitations). Reproducibility is fair: open models, greedy decoding with temperature 0.0 and 700 max tokens (Appendix A), prompts in Appendix G, and subset specifications (Appendix B), but no code/data release or judge implementation details.

primary_link.title: Asymmetric Capacity Allocation in Self-Refinement Pipelines

papers.summary: Self-refinement, typically structured as generation, critique, and revision, is a widely adopted paradigm for improving LLM generation and serves as a core mechanism in many LLM agents. While the three stages involve different cognitive demands, most existing approaches conveniently treat the model size as an implementation detail rather than a subject of study, which may lead to a waste of resources. Little work has systematically examined how model size affects each stage or whether effective
papers.summary_zh: 自我精煉（生成—評論—修訂）已成為改善大型語言模型輸出的核心範式，並廣泛嵌入各類代理工作流，但既有方法多憑直覺或一致地縮放整條管線的模型規模，鮮有系統性檢視各階段對模型容量的敏感度差異。本文首次進行分階段模型規模研究：固定其他兩個階段、單獨變動生成器、評論者或修訂者的模型大小，在涵蓋規劃、摘要、邏輯推理、程式最佳化與故事補寫的五個基準上，以 Qwen3（0.6B 至 32B）與 Gemma 3（1B 至 27B）兩個模型家族進行控制實驗。結果顯示兩大發現：其一，管線效能對生成器與修訂者的規模高度敏感，擴大兩者普遍帶來改善，而容量不足的修訂者甚至會使輸出劣於未經精煉的初始生成（Qwen3-32B 設定下 30 個配置有 12 個退化）；其二，效能對評論者規模相當不敏感，0.6B 與 32B 評論者的評論品質差異有限，但即使是最小的評論者，也穩定優於完全省略評論的基線，顯示明確的外部回饋不可省略。作者進一步手動分析退化事件，發現小型修訂者常在套用評論時不必要地改動原本正確的內容。研究限制在於僅分析單輪精煉、兩個模型家族，未涵蓋檢索、工具使用等更複雜的代理系統。此發現為多階段語言模型系統提供務實設計準則：容量應非對稱配置，評論者可用小模型，修訂者則不可縮減。

links.title: Neuro-Formal Verification: Agentic Language-Agnostic Formal Program Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: 'NFV returns a Dafny proof of correctness or of a bug on 57% of the entries at 92% precision, and a CBMC counterexample for 63% of the buggy programs at 90% precision.'

Section 1.2/Contributions: 'A dataset of 206 Python (program, specification) pairs — 103 correct references and 103 buggy mutants'; 'the Dafny backend proves 70% of the correct programs and refutes 46% of the mutants at 94% and 89% precision'.

Section 4.2, Table 3: verification 93.5% precision / 69.9% recall (F1 0.80); refutation 88.7% / 45.6% (F1 0.60); pipeline 92.2% precision, 57.3% recall, F1 0.71 at 5 attempts x 10 repair rounds (Section 4.1).

Section 3.1.1: 'Provenance tags... Untagged code is rejected'; frozen artifacts 're-checked mechanically on every repair round'; translation repair loop 'sees no verifier goal' — goal-blind safeguards against task alteration.

Section 4.5: LLM-as-judge 'wrong on 58 of the 206 entries at 72% precision'; naive LLM+verifier 'proves 98% of the correct programs and 98% of the known-wrong ones: precision 50%' with 'code rewritten (57% of unsound proofs)'; Nagini proves 0-2% for lack of environment formalization.
Section 4.2.1, Table 5: all 11 wrong verdicts attributed to named causes (6 missing/strengthened preconditions, 1 library formalization, 1 label change) with the unstated assumption listed per entry.
Section 4.4, Table 6: gpt-5.6-sol verification F1 0.80 vs gpt-5-mini 0.57, claude-sonnet-4.6 0.53, claude-haiku-4.5 0.19; refutation F1 more resilient across models.
Section 2.2, Table 2: median 7 LOC, 55% with loops; 'no result here is evidence about scale'; Table 4 shows L3 tier worst (33% verify recall, 60% precision).

Footnote 2 (Section 2): 'The dataset, the pipeline and the scripts that produce every table and number reported here will be released shortly as open source' — availability promised, not yet delivered.
Section 2.1: filtering used claude-sonnet-4.5 to generate 100 diverse inputs per task; Appendix A.1 lists all 206 entries with postconditions and upstream identifiers to enable reconstruction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an agentic LLM pipeline that orchestrates formal verifiers (Dafny, CBMC) as tools to prove/refute Python program properties, squarely matching the highest-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, LLMs, Reasoning). Not out of scope. Novelty is moderate: LLM+verifier integration exists (AutoVerus, Baldur, Lemur cited), but the goal-blind staged discipline, provenance tags, frozen-artifact checks, and refutation-as-negated-proof with witness preconditions are genuine system contributions. Rigor is solid: clear precision/recall/F1 definitions, three baselines spanning neural-to-symbolic, tier ablation, 4-model comparison, and exhaustive attribution of all 11 wrong verdicts (Table 5); weakened by single runs, no variance reporting, and tiny programs. Evidence is internally consistent and quantified (pipeline 57.3% recall / 92.2% precision, F1 0.71; CBMC 63%/90%; LLM-judge 72% precision) but confined to a 206-entry HumanEval-derived benchmark of median-7-LOC programs, which the authors themselves flag as 'no result... evidence about scale'. Generalizability limited: language-agnostic claim tested only on Python, worst results on the import-heavy L3 tier. Reproducibility partially supported: full dataset enumerated with upstream identifiers and budgets specified (5 attempts x 10 rounds), but code 'will be released shortly', prompts are not shown, and one filtering step is non-deterministic.

papers.summary:
Formal verification offers the strongest assurance available for software, and verification-aware languages have made its automation real. Yet the benefits reach few mainstream developers, most of whose languages have no verification support. Besides, specifying properties and modeling the environment require expertise in formal methods. Proof is therefore reserved for a few celebrated artifacts, while the production code that ships is attested only through review and testing.

papers.summary_zh: 形式驗證是軟體正確性最強的保證，但過去僅惠及少數使用驗證感知語言的專家；主流開發者的語言缺乏驗證支援，撰寫規格與環境建模也需要形式方法專業。本文提出神經形式驗證（NFV）：由 AI 編碼代理將主流語言的程式、斷言與文件化環境翻譯至成熟驗證器（如 Dafny 或有界模型檢查器 CBMC），再由驗證器以機器檢查的方式裁決程式正確或存在錯誤，追求經驗準確度而非健全性保證。框架設有目標盲的分階段紀律：程式庫理論與前置條件在目標可見前即凍結、翻譯逐行標註來源標籤、修復迴圈不得改動凍結內容；反駁方向則機械化否定規格，將候選反例安裝為前置條件後加以證明。作者構建 206 個（程式、規格）配對，含 103 個正確參考實作與 103 個突變體。使用旗艦模型時，Dafny 以 94% 精確度證明 70% 的正確程式，以 89% 精確度反駁 46% 的突變體；CBMC 以 90% 精確度反駁 63% 的錯誤程式；合併管線在 57% 的條目上給出 92% 精確度的機器檢查結論，明顯優於總是作答的 LLM-as-a-judge 基線（72% 精確度）。分析顯示多數錯誤結論源自文件未言明的前置條件合成，且較弱模型的驗證能力急劇下降。限制在於以經驗準確度取代健全性、環境形式化未經測試佐證、程式規模偏小。此工作讓機器檢查的程式推理首次能以按鈕式流程服務主流開發者，對稽核 AI 生成的程式碼尤具價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, multi-agent frameworks, CoT reasoning, LLM-as-judge evaluation); not a pure domain application. Contribution is incremental within the crowded multi-agent debate space (Tree-of-Debate, ChatEval precedents), but the 'unstated limitation' task framing and dedicated benchmark are genuinely new. Rigor is above average: three baselines, three targeted ablations, paired bootstrap/Wilcoxon significance tests, and a hybrid human+LLM Likert panel with reported inter-rater agreement (Appendix I, Table 10). Key weaknesses temper confidence: gold labels in ToC-Bench are themselves produced by an LLM extraction pipeline (§4.2), the same model family serves as system backbone and LLM-judge, error taxonomies are self-classified by authors (Appendix M), and evaluation covers only 100 of 414 papers. primary_link.title: Tree-of-Concerns: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Debate for Unstated-Limitation Extraction in Scientific Critique

papers.summary: As scientific literature grows and papers increasingly under-report limitations, multi-agent LLMs offer a promising approach to systematically uncover these hidden failure modes. Here, we introduce Tree-of-Concerns, a multi-agent framework that deploys specialized skeptic personas, each operating through a category-specific analytical lens, as parallel debate trees to extract unstated limitations from scientific papers. Each persona conducts structured, evidence-grounded argumentation, while a P
papers.summary_zh: 科學論文普遍低估自身限制：近期分析發現 NeurIPS 2023 審稿人指出的弱點中，73% 未出現在作者的限制章節。既有自動化評論系統（如 DIAGPaper、MARG）著重模仿人類審稿風格，容易停留在作者已承認的表面問題；且標準多代理共識機制常有從眾性，導致過早同質化。本文提出 Tree-of-Concerns（ToC）：部署五個專業懷疑者角色（範疇、方法學、理論、可重現性、公平性）作為平行辯論樹，每個節點經歷四階段對抗辯論——提出證據支持的主張、論文倡導者反駁、修訂或撤回、調停者裁定並決定是否擴展子節點；隨後由 Panel Review 以單一模型呼叫同時從五種視角複審每個存活主張，執行背書、合併、降級、重分類或拒絕，解決跨分支冗餘與類別漂移。作者同步發布 ToC-Bench，首個針對未陳述限制的基準，含 414 篇論文與 1,905 條黃金限制，來源為 OpenReview 弱點與後續引用批評。在 100 篇保留測試集上，ToC+Panel 達 36.1% Coverage@10 與 40.3% 精確度，較最強基線分別提升約 11% 與 79%，混合 Likert 評估小組的效度、具體性與新穎性評分亦皆最高；消融證明專業化、擴展與小組調解各自貢獻顯著。限制包括僅涵蓋 ML/NLP/CV 領域、僅處理文字、單篇分析，且 43% 未被任何方法找回的黃金限制需要後續研究的知識。此框架可作為輔助同儕審查的工具，幫助系統性揭露論文未言明的失敗模式。

links.title: Personalized Privacy Control in LLMs via Attention Head Intervention

evidence: Section 1/Abstract: frames personalized privacy for agentic LLMs; reports policy ignorance ratios of 51.25% (Qwen2.5-7B) and 74.28% (Gemma3-4B) under prompt-based policies.
Section 3/Figure 3: high PIR across policies, Gemma-3-4B above 70% on all four, motivating representation-level control.
Section 4.1-4.3: method identifies top-k heads via logistic-regression AUROC probes, uses patching vectors for refusal states and L2-normalized steering direction for disclosure.

Section 5.2/Table 2: Repair lowers PED vs DP (e.g., 71.11 to 6.78 on Qwen2.5-3B Privacy-Max; 35.38 to 11.40 on Gemma3-4B), but on Qwen2.5-7B Privacy-Max CoT (22.72) and AdaSteer (21.96) beat Repair (32.97).
Section 5.1: calibration set N=100 examples per disclosure state from AirGapAgent-R training split, disjoint from test; hyperparameters k and alpha selected on calibration (Table 10).
Appendix C.1/Table 7: rule-based classifier vs Gemma-3-27B LLM judge agreement: match 97.09-99.57%, Cohen's kappa 0.778-0.962.
Section 5.3/Figure 7 and Table 3: robustness to random n in {4,8,16} field policies and AUROC-based selection outperforming random head selection across policies.
Appendix D.1-Table 14 and D.5-Table 12: attention heads beat residual/MLP under equal edited-dimensionality budget; State Acc 86.54-99.60% with Behavior Acc over 92%.
Limitations section: benchmark limited to structured PII fields and specific scenarios; unstructured personal disclosures left to future work.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM paper: personalized privacy control for agentic LLMs via attention-head probing, activation patching, and steering, plus a new benchmark (P3Bench) extending AirGapAgent-R with user-specific disclosure policies. Relevance is high (LLMs, safety/privacy, interpretability, agent framing), though the method adapts established intervention techniques (CAST, AdaSteer, RepE, activation patching) to a new task, making novelty solid but incremental. Rigor is good: three models, four policies, prompting/steering baselines, hyperparameters tuned on a calibration set disjoint from test, extensive ablations (module-level budget comparison, vector design, AUROC vs random head selection, policy-agnostic Repair-G), and bootstrap CIs; the rule-based evaluator is validated against an LLM judge (Cohen's kappa 0.778-0.962). Evidence is solid but slightly weakened by overclaim: 'Repair achieves the lowest PED' fails in one of twelve Table 2 cells (Qwen2.5-7B Privacy-Max: CoT 22.72 and AdaSteer 21.96 beat Repair 32.97), and Table 14 attn-head numbers diverge sharply from main results without full reconciliation. Generalizability is limited to three small open models, one derived benchmark, structured PII fields, and English; authors concede unstructured disclosures are out of scope. Reproducibility is moderate: prompts, policy JSONs, hyperparameters, and calibration details are provided, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Personalized Privacy Control in LLMs via Attention Head Intervention

papers.summary: The rise of agentic AI enables LLMs to access diverse user data, raising critical privacy concerns. Prior work on contextual privacy studies whether LLMs regulate information disclosure according to context-dependent norms. However, acceptable disclosure boundaries may vary across users even within the same context. To address this limitation, we introduce \textit{personalized privacy}, which incorporates user-specific disclosure preferences into privacy control. We further present P3Bench~(\tex
papers.summary_zh: 代理式 AI 使大型語言模型能存取多樣的使用者資料，帶來嚴峻的隱私疑慮。過往研究聚焦情境隱私，即模型是否依情境規範披露資訊；然而即使在同一情境下，可接受的揭露程度也因人而異。本文提出個人化隱私概念，並建立 P3Bench 基準，將情境隱私政策延伸為使用者專屬的揭露偏好，定義 Privacy-Max、Contact-Open、Health-Open、Preference-Open 四種設定。實驗顯示僅靠提示詞傳達政策並不可靠：Qwen2.5-7B 與 Gemma3-4B 的平均政策忽略率分別高達 51.25% 與 74.28%，且不同模型呈現相異的預設揭露先驗——有的過度拒答，有的過度分享。為此，作者提出 Repair，一種推論時的注意力頭介入方法：先以線性探針對各注意力頭進行揭露狀態 AUROC 評分，選出政策相關頭；再為拒絕狀態建構激活補丁向量、為揭露狀態建構引導方向；推論時以多數決預測揭露狀態，套用狀態自適應介入，全程無需重新訓練。結果顯示 Repair 在三個模型與四種政策上取得最低的政策誤差距離（PED），例如 Privacy-Max 下相較直接提示在 Qwen2.5-3B 降低 90.5%，且同時減少過度拒答與過度分享，不同於 CoT 常以一種錯誤換取另一種；政策無關變體 Repair-G 亦具競爭力。限制在於隱私欄位與情境覆蓋有限，且以結構化個人欄位為主。此工作揭示了模型內建的揭露先驗如何干擾政策遵循，並示範以內部表徵介入可靠實現個人化隱私控制。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM evaluation-methodology paper that operationalizes 'operationally unknown' person names as controlled prompt variables for factuality, privacy-leakage, bias, and abstention audits (Sections 1-2). Topical fit to the LLM/evaluation/safety preferences is solid, though the contribution is an evaluation resource and protocol rather than a new LLM capability method. Rigor is high: the protocol is fully specified (Section 4, Appendices A.2-A.4), validation yield is reported over 52,726 candidates down to 300 accepted names (Figure 4, Section 5.2), reruns quantify web-LLM instability (no_info only 31.6% stable across ten replicates, Section 7.1/Table 9), guardrail ablations isolate variant search as the largest search-side control (Table 1/12), and name-likeness is validated with LSTM BPC and 14-tokenizer fragmentation diagnostics (Section 7.3). The 204-participant human audit honestly reports that accepted names are rated plausible in only 63.0% of ratings versus 77.2% for rejected names, and that disagreement concentrates in ambiguous boundary cases (Section 7.4). Evidence is quantitatively consistent across tables. Generalizability is limited by the Latin-script two-component restriction and provider/locale/time dependence (Limitations). Reproducibility is strong: pipeline code, release files with manifests and validation-stack hashes, adjudicator prompts, and query inventories are released (Appendices A.5, A.3, A.4), though reliance on hosted gpt-4.1-mini/gpt-5.2 screening and commercial search injects irreducible nondeterminism the authors themselves document.

primary_link.title: No PUN Intended: Plausible Unknown Names for Person-Centred LLM Evaluation

papers.summary: Person names are widely used as prompt variables in LLM evaluations of factuality, privacy leakage, bias and abstention, but when a name's evidential status is uncontrolled, measurements may conflate memorisation, retrieval, name priors and wrong-person attribution. We operationalise an unknown name as one with plausible First-Last form, no indexed full-name evidence, and no ambiguity signals under a documented validation run, and introduce PUN (Plausible Unknown Names), a protocol for construct
papers.summary_zh: 人名常被當作提示詞變數，用於評估 LLM 的事實性、隱私洩漏、偏見與拒答行為；但若姓名的證據狀態未受控制，測量結果會混淆記憶、檢索、姓名先驗與張冠李戴等多種因素。本文提出 PUN（Plausible Unknown Names）協定，將「未知姓名」操作化為：具似真的「名字—姓氏」形式、在文件化的驗證執行中無索引公開全名證據、且無歧義訊號（如相似拼寫、變體、名人吸引子）。協定分三階段：自 Wikidata 人類實體抽取已證實的名字與姓氏元件並跨國配對取樣；本地格式檢查；再以可上網的 LLM 進行「Who is {name}?」篩查，最後以受控網頁搜尋（精確引號、倒序、ASCII 摺疊、母音與語音變體等查詢）做可稽核的再驗證。在一次展示執行中，52,726 個候選僅有 300 個（約 0.6%）被接受為操作上未知，顯示僅靠精確引號搜尋會誤收 815 個額外名字。LSTM 字元模型與斷詞診斷顯示接受名比名人擾動或隨機字串更像姓名（中位 BPC 3.16）。204 名參與者的人類研究發現，受試者僅在 3% 的案例中能找回人物證據，且 75.8% 的搜尋判斷支持「無資訊」結論。限制包括僅涵蓋拉丁字母雙元件姓名、結論依賴搜尋供應商與時間點，且姓名仍攜帶文化與社會關聯。此資源為隱私稽核、偏見研究與機器遺忘基準提供受控陰性對照，凸顯人名證據狀態本身即是應受控制的實驗變數。
papers.title: No PUN Intended: Plausible Unknown Names for Person-Centred LLM Evaluation
papers.title_zh: No PUN Intended：以似真未知姓名進行以人為本的 LLM 評估

primary_link.title: Don't Solve, Just Compare: Tiny Advisors for Runtime Intervention in LLM Agents

papers.summary: LLM agents are emerging as an important paradigm for real-world tasks that require reasoning, tool use, and sequential decision-making. As these agents operate over longer horizons, runtime intervention offers a way to improve reliability without retraining the underlying actor. Failure detection alone is insufficient. Effective intervention must also provide a useful direction for recovery. Existing approaches often rely on an expert solver or a critic that generates task-specific corrections,
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理在長時程互動任務中日益普及，執行期介入成為不需重新訓練即可提升可靠性的途徑。然而既有方法若非交由更強的專家模型接管，就是要求評論者具備足夠的任務解題能力來產生修正回饋，成本高昂。本文提出比較式微小顧問（COTA）：核心觀察是判斷動作好壞不需要絕對價值評估，只需比較——若代理的提案被多個普通可行替代動作反覆超越，即表示提案是弱選擇。系統在每個決策點取樣 K 個可執行替代動作，由僅 0.5B 的比較器預測同狀態下哪個動作在凍結演員延續下帶來更好的結果；重複兩兩比較以蒙地卡羅閘門估計提案被支配的比例，觸發時將勝出替代動作作為非約束建議回傳，由原演員重新規劃。比較器以同前綴反事實分支訓練：從相同環境狀態僅改變分支動作後交回同一演員，以兄弟軌跡結果構成成對監督。在 WebShop、ALFWorld 與 τ³-Retail 搭配 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 與 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的九個組合中，COTA 全面改善原演員效能並優於自我反思、AgentPRM 與 Asym-AC 基線，例如 Qwen3-8B 的 WebShop 報酬由 0.3960 升至 0.5630，ALFWorld 成功率由 82.84% 升至 90.30%；線上開銷平均僅 1.38 倍。消融顯示成對比較目標與建構式介入缺一不可，且候選機制能注入演員重複取樣難以觸及的動作多樣性。此研究證明輔助模型的角色可從解題窄化為比較，微小模型即可引導遠強於自身的代理。
papers.title: Don't Solve, Just Compare: Tiny Advisors for Runtime Intervention in LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 別急著解題，只要比較：以微小顧問實現 LLM 代理的執行期介入

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope and strongly preference-aligned: an LLM-centric multi-agent (LangGraph) workflow for code refactoring matching Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM preferences, evaluated across three LLM configurations with a matched direct-prompt baseline. Rigor is solid (stratified sampling, Wilcoxon/Holm, Cochran's Q, McNemar, Wilson CIs, effect sizes, explicit threats-to-validity), and claims are carefully scoped to static proxies. primary_link.title: REFINE: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach for Evidence-Guided Code Refactoring

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for automated code refactoring. However, generated changes must reduce targeted quality problems without introducing new issues or altering behaviour-relevant code structures. We introduce REFINE (Refactoring with Evidence-aware Flow for Integrated ageNtic Execution), a tool-agnostic, evidence-aware multi-agent approach for generating Java file-level refactoring candidates. REFINE combines static-analysis-guided smell identification, smell-inf
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在程式碼生成與轉換上展現強大能力，為自動化重構帶來新機會；然而重構不只是改寫程式碼，還需確實減少目標品質問題、避免引入新問題，並保留與行為相關的結構。本文提出 REFINE，一個與工具無關、證據感知的多代理工作流，針對 Java 檔案層級生成重構候選，結合靜態分析引導的壞味道識別（PMD）、壞味道導向的規劃、LLM 轉換、自動重新分析、保留性檢查與結構化報告，使每個候選可追溯到觸發它的證據與各項檢查的結果。實驗涵蓋 15 個開源系統的 450 個 Java 檔案，於 GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 與 Claude Opus 4.8 三種配置下產出 1,350 個模型輸出：偵測到的總壞味道分別減少 68.26%、72.79% 與 68.49%，其中重大壞味道減少 86.51% 至 91.60% 最為顯著；但更廣的品質指標改善並不均勻，循環複雜度與 LCOM 僅在 Gemini 3.1 明顯提升。保留性檢查揭露殘餘風險：關鍵 assert/fail 呼叫的保留率僅 57.1%，公開方法移除則是最具體的失敗診斷。在 150 檔案配對的直接提示基線比較中，REFINE 達到更高的中位總壞味道減少（100% 對 20.8%）、更小的編輯足跡與更少的公開方法移除，但直接提示反而更常保留 assert/fail 建構。研究限制在於檔案層級範圍，且靜態代理指標無法證明行為等價。此工作將 LLM 重構定位為可追溯的候選生成與風險過濾機制，產出仍需編譯、測試與人工審查，並顯示模型選擇實質上是重構策略決策。

Fit is strong; novelty is moderate-incremental, since the hybrid internalize/utilize framing, GRPO backbone, and teacher-student distillation are inherited from cited prior work (Skill0/Skill0.5/SkillRL), with the unified JSD operator (Appendix A.2-A.3) as the main new idea. They either keep skills outside the model, fully internalize them, or select among internalization and utilization objectives through noisy task-level success rates. Such designs fragment training and assign uniform importance to actions within t
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理在長時程互動任務中需要可重複使用的技能，但現有方法多將技能外置於模型、完全內化，或以含噪的任務層級成功率在內化與運用之間做硬性路由，忽略同一軌跡中不同動作對技能指引的反應各異。本文提出 AUSO，以 GRPO 為共同骨幹的漸進式強化學習框架：訓練初期以教師（附加通用技能）與學生（無技能）動作分布間的 JSD 作為資訊增益訊號，對無成功率訊號的任務群組進行動作感知的蒸餾內化；中期移除教師監督，改以純結果驅動的 GRPO 鞏固自主解題能力；後期比較同一狀態下有無技能條件化的動作分布，以 JSD 量化各動作的技能敏感度，結合 Bernoulli 變異數構成的不確定閘門對優勢函數加權，使有益於技能的動作獲得更強更新、有害者被抑制，且不改變原始優勢正負號。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 與 SearchQA 上，AUSO 超越 Skill0.5 等基準，OOD 泛化尤其顯著；消融實驗證實各階段與閘門皆不可或缺。限制在於超參數（如階段比例、閘門係數）需調校，且評估限於特定代理基準與 Qwen2.5-7B 骨幹。此工作把技能生命週期納入統一的動作層級最佳化，為代理技能學習提供更細緻的典範。

papers.summary_zh: 訓練代理所需環境多半圍繞預定義任務建構，難以擴展至反映真實且持續演化的商業工作流程。本文提出 AgentMercury，主張把「建構世界」視為代理系統中與策略模型、世界模型並列的 Planet 角色：先由高階商業情境實例化一個可執行世界，包含公司身分、服務圖、狀態架構、種子初始狀態與跨服務不變量，不變量以可執行的 SQL 驗證條件呈現而非寫死在轉移規則中，任務與軌跡再從同一世界衍生，並透過確定性評分器驗收。作者合成 4,783 個橫跨 14 個產業、50 個國家的環境，衍生 43,300 個任務，且與評測基準無關。以 GRPO 與 SAO 在這些世界訓練 Qwen3.5-4B，使 EnterpriseOps-GYM 由 12.3 升至 15.7，AIME26 由 45.9 升至 56.0，HMMT、LiveCodeBench、SciCode、BFCL 與 τ³ 等域外基準同步提升，顯示情境接地環境提供可遷移的學習訊號。此外，以建構軌跡微調 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，可將留出商業簡報的環境編寫成功率從 3.3% 提升至 83.3%，證明環境建構本身可成為可學習的能力。限制是目前尚未以學習型世界模型閉合「策略缺口→情境合成」的迴路，且 SAO 在 4B 模型上學習訊號不足。此研究把環境擴展從「堆更多任務」轉向「擴展世界多樣性」。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope structured survey squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: LLMs, agentic coding systems, code generation, RAG, and security/evaluation. Its conceptual contributions (the E1-E4 claim-evidence ladder in Section 2.4, the evaluation-configuration tuple and J@k joint functional-security metric in Section 4, the G0-G3 authority tiers, and the minimum reporting protocol in Table 5) are genuinely useful synthesizing artifacts, and the paper is unusually honest about non-comparability of SWE-bench numbers (Table 3) and its own validity threats (Section 8.6). Scores are capped because it is a self-described structured narrative/tertiary review (Section 2.1) with no new empirical results, no exhaustive search or dual-reviewer screening (Section 8.6), corpus coding admittedly not yet performed by humans (Section 2.2), and a claimed source package with no concrete availability link, limiting reproducibility. Individual observations (leakage, weak test oracles, dataset issues) are largely known from prior work; the value-add is the intersectional framing and evaluation governance framework.

primary_link.title: Large Language Models at the Intersection of Software Engineering and Software Security:An Evidence-Centered Structured Survey and Research Agenda

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are moving from code completion toward repository-scale agents that retrieve context, edit files, execute tools, and participate in security-sensitive workflows. The evidence for these systems, however, remains divided between software engineering evaluations centered on functional task completion and software security evaluations centered on vulnerability detection, secure generation, or exploit-oriented validation. This evidence-centered structured survey synthesiz
papers.summary_zh: LLM 已從程式碼補全走向會檢索脈絡、編輯檔案、執行工具並參與安全敏感流程的儲存庫規模代理，但相關證據分散於以功能完成為主的軟體工程評測與以漏洞偵測、安全生成為主的軟體安全評測之間。本文以 2026 年 5 月 31 日為截止的結構化敘事回顧，將軟體工程與安全視為同等支柱，提出涵蓋功能正確性、安全、營運可靠度、證據來源與代理權限的保證框架，並以評測組態 ⟨A,C,M,T,V,B,H⟩ 說明為何僅標示模型名稱不足以詮釋代理結果。作者定義聯合成功指標 J@k、E1 至 E4 的證據階梯與 G0 至 G3 的代理權限層級，並提出最低揭露報告協定。綜整顯示：執行回饋與儲存庫存取能明顯改善任務完成，但本身不構成安全保證；靜態分析標籤也很難證明可部署的正確性。文中歸納弱測試神諭、資料洩漏與時間洩漏、代理框架變動、僅以代理指標檢查安全、預算與人為介入低報等效度威脅，並據此提出聯合安全與功能基準、儲存庫規模威脅模型、可校準的人類監督、縱向可維護性證據與可重現代理評測的研究議程。限制在於此為非窮盡的敘事式回顧，結論的時間效度脆弱。核心訊息是模型能力應以符合威脅模型的保證案例衡量，而非單一排行榜分數。

Sec. 4.1 'Conformal Settings': alpha_APS=0.2, rho=0.25; ACI calibration set of 150 queries; APS calibration set of 239 queries built with DeepSeek-V3.2 decomposition and judging
Table 1: Ours (Qwen3-8B) average 0.464 vs Search-R2 0.446 and Search-R1 0.400; Ours (Qwen2.5-3B) 0.401 vs Search-R1 0.336
Table 3 (Sec. 4.3): full framework 0.401 vs -ACI 0.384 and -APS 0.389 on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct; per-dataset results in Table 8
Table 4: average retrieved documents 3.4 (alpha_APS=0.20), 2.4 (0.35), 4.8 (0.05)
Sec. 4.2 footnote 1: 'As Search-R2 is closed-source, we are unable to evaluate it on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct'
Sec. 7 Limitations: QA-only validation, reliance on a strong external teacher (DeepSeek-V3.2) for APS calibration, guarantees limited to outcome reliability
Appendix B: Theorems 1/3/5 and Lemma 4 restate coverage proofs from Angelopoulos & Bates (2022), Romano et al. (2020), and Gibbs & Candes (2021)
Appendix C: full implementation stack (VeRL, sglang v0.5.3rc0, flashinfer, faiss-gpu v1.8.0, e5-base-v2, 2018 Wikipedia dump, 4x RTX PRO 6000, lr 1e-6, G=5, 512 prompts/step)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agentic-RL paper: search agents trained with GRPO, APS-based adaptive retrieval truncation and ACI-based trajectory confidence weighting, evaluated on seven single/multi-hop QA benchmarks with two Qwen backbones (Table 1). Preference relevance is high (agents/tool use, RAG, RL fine-tuning, hallucination reduction). Novelty is moderate: APS, ACI, and GRPO are existing tools; the contribution is their combination, and the paper itself cites closely related CP-for-RAG (Chakraborty et al.) and CP-for-alignment (Chen et al.) work, weakening the 'first' claim. Rigor is mixed: component ablations (Table 3) and sensitivity analyses (Tables 3-4, Fig. 2) exist, but gains per component are small (~+0.01-0.02), no seed variance or significance testing is reported, Appendix B proofs largely restate Angelopoulos & Bates, Romano et al., and Gibbs & Candes, and the retrieval-side coverage guarantee rests on a 239-query calibration set labeled by DeepSeek-V3.2 as judge (Sec. 4.1), making the exchangeability/coverage argument fragile. Evidence strength is decent: per-dataset tables and ablation details are complete, but the headline efficiency claim ('drastically reducing redundant tool invocations') is supported only by figures, and the closed-source Search-R2 footnote (Sec. 4.2, fn.1) leaves unclear whether 8B numbers are reproduced or copied. Generalizability is limited by QA-only validation and teacher-model-dependent calibration (Sec. 7). Reproducibility is good: code link, detailed Appendix C (VeRL, sglang v0.5.3rc0, faiss-gpu, e5-base-v2, hardware), prompts in Appendix D, and calibration-set construction described, though seeds are unspecified.

primary_link.title: CAS: Conformalized Agentic Search via Adaptive Retrieval and Policy Weighting

papers.summary:
Search Agents face a severe reliability crisis during reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning. Heuristic Top-K retrieval often causes critical evidence loss or noise inclusion, while over-confidence induced by progressive RL leads to hallucinated answers and redundant searches.
  To build highly reliable agents, we introduce Conformal Prediction (CP) and propose Conformalized Agentic Search (CAS). This framework establishes reliability guarantees on both the retrieval and training sides: on the
papers.summary_zh: 以強化學習微調的搜尋代理面臨可靠度危機：固定的 Top-K 檢索在難題上遺漏關鍵證據、在簡單問題上引入雜訊，而 RL 過程誘發的過度自信又導致幻覺答案與冗餘搜尋。本文引入 Conformal Prediction（保形預測）提出 CAS 框架，在檢索與訓練兩端同時建立統計保證。檢索端採用 APS（Adaptive Prediction Set），將檢索分數以 softmax 轉為相關性機率，依校準閾值累積截斷文件集，在維持 1−α 邊際覆蓋的同時讓脈絡長度隨查詢難度自適應；訓練端採用 ACI（Adaptive Conformal Inference），以答案 token 的平均負對數概似作為非一致性分數，透過線上更新誤差率 α_t 動態建構預測集，並在 GRPO 目標中對落入低信心集合的軌跡施加折扣權重 η，同時抑制盲目過度自信與僥倖猜測。在 NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2Wiki、MuSiQue 與 Bamboogle 七個 QA 資料集上，CAS 於 Qwen3-8B 平均達 0.464，超越 Search-R2 的 0.446，且大幅減少平均搜尋次數；消融與敏感度分析證實兩模組互補，且 α_t 能穩定收斂至目標錯誤率。限制包括僅驗證於開放域 QA、APS 校準集依賴 DeepSeek-V3.2 等強大外部模型，且統計保證尚未延伸至中間推理過程。此工作為 RL 訓練的搜尋代理提供有理論依據的可靠度基礎。

links.title: SLICE: Specification-Level Isolation of Contract Enforcement

evidence: Abstract: 'Relative to the strongest evaluated baseline for each model, SLICE improves performance ... by an average of 6.58%'; code link https://github.com/suhanmen/SLICE
Section 4 (Datasets): ContractEval has 364 tasks; 'We excluded 24 tasks with inconsistent annotations, leaving an evaluation set of 340 tasks'; Appendix B details the two pre-registered filters
Section 5.1 / Table 1: SLICE achieves highest SSR on all four models (56.18%, 74.41%, 77.65%, 72.65%) with model-specific gains of 13.70%/7.65%/3.79%/1.16% over strongest baselines
Section 5.4 / Table 2: removing graph-based masking reduces SSR/pass@1 by averages of 6.39%/7.21%; removing candidate selection reduces them by 4.07%/4.36%

Section 6 (Limitations): 'Evaluation is limited to ContractEval ... Performance on classes, multi-function programs, and repository-level code therefore remains unverified'; seven generation passes per task
Appendix C: contract-only masking achieves 95.48% accuracy against GPT-5.4-mini reference labels; example extraction F1 94.29%
Appendix E / Table 4: diff-lp determines selection for 77.35%-97.65% of tasks; sampled candidates chosen in 42.94% of selections on average
Appendix A: implementation details include SFR-Embedding-2_R for semantic matching, temperature 0.7/top-p 0.95 sampling, 2,048-token caps, three RTX PRO 6000 GPUs
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM code-generation methodology: SLICE decomposes contract-satisfying code generation into specification graph structuring, multi-candidate body selection, and screened assertion insertion, directly hitting high-weight preferences (LLMs, Code & Programming, Reasoning/Prompting baselines, agent-guided CodeTree baseline). Novelty is moderate: the pipeline is sensible engineering (heuristic markers, cosine/lexical grounding thresholds 0.75/45%) and diff-lp tie-breaking is a modest new selection signal on top of ContractEval, the authors' own benchmark. Rigor is solid within scope: 4 LLMs, 6 baselines, two-component ablations (Table 2), fine-grained F/C error decomposition (Table 5), token-cost analysis, and pre-registered dataset filtering (Appendix B); but no significance testing or multi-seed variance, and gains over the strongest baseline are thin on Gemma-4 (1.16%). Evidence strength is good but bounded: all claims rest on a single 340-task benchmark with heuristics validated only against GPT-5.4-mini labels (95.48% masking accuracy, Appendix C). Generalizability is explicitly limited by the authors (Section 6): one benchmark, marker sets tuned to HumanEval/MBPP-style prose, no classes/repos. Reproducibility is strong: public code, full decoding settings, embedding model, and hardware in Appendix A. Weighted total ~0.72.

primary_link.title: SLICE: Specification-Level Isolation of Contract Enforcement

papers.summary: Programming problems commonly specify both the computation a function should perform and the conditions that its inputs must satisfy. Large language models are widely used to generate code from these problem specifications, and the generated function must implement the required computation while enforcing the stated input conditions. The stated input conditions collectively form an input contract. Enforcing this contract is difficult: incomplete enforcement accepts inputs that should be rejected
papers.summary_zh: 程式設計題通常同時描述函式應完成的計算與輸入必須滿足的條件；後者構成輸入合約，合約滿足的程式須對有效輸入回傳正確輸出，並主動拒絕違約輸入。但 HumanEval、MBPP 等基準只在有效輸入上評測，現有生成方法也缺乏同時辨識功能需求與輸入合約的流程。本文提出 SLICE，透過三階段把合約強制與功能實作分離：(1) 以確定性切分與規則標記建立規格圖，用語意相似度與詞彙接地將描述片段連結至抽出的合約條件，並移除僅含合約的片段形成功能視圖；(2) 功能主體生成結合貪婪與取樣解碼產生五個候選，以可執行範例的執行分數排序，並以僅計分差異區域的 diff-lp 對數機率解決平手；(3) 依抽出的條件生成輸入驗證斷言，先以有效範例篩除過度嚴格的斷言，再以 AST 轉換插入所選主體。在 ContractEval 的 340 個任務與四個 LLM（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-12B-it、GPT-5.4-nano）上，SLICE 於同時衡量功能正確與合約滿足的 SSR 上平均相對各模型最強基準提升 6.58%，最高達 13.70%，且耗用 token 遠低於 CodeTree 與 SpecFix；消融證實規格遮罩與候選選擇皆有效。限制包括同句混合功能與合約內容時無法完全分離、僅在 ContractEval 驗證，以及相較直接提示的推論成本較高。

Section 5.1, Table 4: empirical mentee-mentor r=0.71, slope 0.55, grounding audit full pass 0.988, decision agreement 0.981 explicitly equal to the always-treat baseline, with 0 of 34 do-not-treat cases recovered.
Section 3.2: concrete training configuration (rank-16 LoRA on top 16 blocks, s=20, dropout 0.05, ~13.6M trainable params, AdamW lr 5e-5, cosine decay, batch 2, 3,000 iterations, mlx-lm v0.31.3).

Section 5 deployment note: 'All source code and both deployment demonstrations are available at https://github.com/cgpan/distillLA'; Section 6 concedes limitations of five replications, one dataset, one treatment, one outcome.
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM-centric methodology paper (education domain, but language methodology is core, so the pure-domain cap does not apply): a two-stage pipeline LoRA-fine-tunes a small open-weight Gemma (E2B) to distill a black-box CATE estimator plus its ALE-fANOVA decomposition into a self-explaining local LLM, with a faithfulness audit gating training traces and scoring outputs. Preference relevance is solid: hits LLM, distillation/efficiency, interpretability, PEFT, reasoning-trace distillation, and local serving; the education application and single tabular task temper it. Novelty is good: the authors credibly position the gap against Explingo-style narration-only pipelines (Section 2.2), and distilling estimator+decomposition with an audit gate appears new, though each ingredient (TabLLM-style prediction, SHAP narration, LoRA distillation) exists. Rigor is above average: a 2x2 oracle-vs-X-learner simulation cleanly separates estimator loss from distillation loss (Section 4.2/4.3), with well-defined metrics (slope, AUC, FalseCite, closure, UnsafeTreat), plus a size/precision ablation (Appendix C); weaknesses are only 5 simulation replications, a single DGP, and empirical fidelity measurable only against the mentor. Evidence strength is decent and unusually honest: mentee r=0.925 under oracle vs 0.723 under X-learner, UnsafeTreat=1.000 in the severely imbalanced X-learner case, empirical decision agreement 0.981 equal to the always-treat baseline, and Appendix B transparently shows a sign-flipped interaction and inflated estimate. Generalizability is limited by one dataset, one treatment, one estimator, though the pipeline is described as estimator-agnostic. Reproducibility is strong: complete hyperparameters (rank-16 LoRA, AdamW 5e-5, 3000 iterations, mlx-lm v0.31.3), full prompt listings, DGP specification, cost notes, and a GitHub link.

primary_link.title: Distilling Black-Box Machine Learning into a Small, Self-Explaining Language Model for Learning Analytics

papers.summary: Learning analytics increasingly relies on flexible machine learning (ML), but the model opacity and the burden of deployment prevent these tools from reaching educational practice. We propose a two-stage fine-tuning pipeline that distills a fitted black-box estimator and its post hoc interpretation (the mentor) into a small, open-weight large language model (LLM; the mentee) that returns an individual-level estimate and explains in natural language. The design is estimator-agnostic and paired wi
papers.summary_zh: 學習分析日益依賴彈性的機器學習，但模型不透明與部署負擔使其難以走進教育現場。本文提出兩階段微調管線：導師階段先擬合任一黑箱估計器（案例中為估計異質處理效應的 X-learner），以 ALE-fANOVA 將個別預測分解為總均值、各協變項一階貢獻、一個資料驅動的成對交互作用與殘差，再由強大 LLM 撰寫結構化導師軌跡，並以驗證器作為接受閘門確保算術封閉與引用屬實；門生階段以 LoRA 微調約 20 億參數的 Gemma 4 E2B，使其僅憑學生協變項即可輸出效應估計、自然語言解釋與建議決策，全程離線運行於一般筆記型電腦，學生資料不出本機。模擬研究顯示，給予神諭訊號時蒸餾近乎無損（相關係數大於 0.90、真實調節變項排序 AUC 為 1.000 且不引用雜訊變項），剩餘誤差幾乎源自上游估計器；但在嚴重類別不平衡下，決策會塌縮向多數行動而建議有害處置。應用於具全國代表性的 HSLS:09 資料，管線重現「進階數學課程對最不可能升讀四年制大學的學生助益最大」的既有結論，98.8% 的敘述通過稽核且無捏造數值。限制包括幅度壓縮、敘述流暢不等於正確，以及單一資料與處理的驗證範圍。此工作展示預測與解釋可被蒸餾進單一小模型並可稽核。
