llm_evaluation.rationale: A core-LLM methodology paper on machine unlearning, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI safety, training/fine-tuning, datasets); not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: framing 'claim-level' unlearning with two disjoint paraphrased forget sets (F1/F2) to test transfer beyond surface suppression is a genuine contribution, but the evaluated algorithms (GD, NPO, NPO+RT, SimNPO) are standard and the negative finding (localized, superficial forgetting) is somewhat expected. Rigor is solid but not exceptional: careful task formalization (Eq. 1), per-method hyperparameters (Table 12), human-LLM agreement validation (Table 2), memorization checks (App. H), and MIA analysis (App. J) are strengths; however, no statistical significance testing, small benchmark (76-91 papers per subset, Table 3), per-method hyperparameter tuning that could bias comparisons, and a visible QA reference error (Table 11 fill-in-the-blank answer 'worse non-English performance' mismatched to a BERT/LSTM question) temper the assessment. Evidence for the central claim is strong: GD on F1 drops F1 R-F1 97.54->71.70 while F2 stays ~93.5 (Table 4), and App. H shows member NLL 0.24 vs 3.88 non-member plus 94.6%->47.5% answer-permutation accuracy after unlearning. Generalizability is limited to 7B-8B models on one pretraining corpus, as the authors concede in Limitations. Reproducibility benefits from released code/benchmark (Apache License, Sec. 1), published prompts, and hyperparameters, though reliance on proprietary GPT-5 API extraction reduces exact replication.

primary_link.title: Can Scientific Claims Be Removed from Large Language Models? A Systematic Evaluation of Claim-Level Unlearning

papers.summary: Language models (LMs) are trained on static scientific corpora, whereas scientific knowledge continuously evolves through correction and revision. Scientific claims encoded within these models may later become retracted, disproven, or updated by subsequent research, creating the risk of disseminating outdated information in scientific workflows. This creates a need for LMs to forget obsolete scientific claims. Machine unlearning offers a promising solution by enabling knowledge removal while mai
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型的預訓練語料靜態固定，但科學知識會透過更正與撤稿持續演化，已被撤回或推翻的主張可能持續被模型複述，形成認知慣性與安全疑慮。本文定義「科學主張遺忘」任務並提出 SciUnlearn 基準：從 Dolma 語料抽取電腦科學、醫學與真實撤稿論文的科學主張，為每個主張生成多選、真假、填空與斷言推理等 QA 對，並拆成語意等價的兩個遺忘集 F1、F2，另備內外部保留集，以「對 F1 遺忘後在 F2 上的表現」檢驗主張層級而非表面形式的遺忘。作者在 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 與 LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct 上評估 GD、NPO、NPO+RT、SimNPO 及其保留集變體的 LoRA 與全參數訓練。結果顯示遺忘大多侷限於被訓練的遺忘集，對改寫後的姊妹集遷移有限，顯示現有方法多為表面壓抑；具保留目標的方法較能守住非目標知識與通用基準，成員推斷分析亦顯示語意成員仍殘留成員訊號；引用網路的代理指標指出低被引論文較易發生跨集合外溢。限制包括僅涵蓋最佳化式方法、撤稿子集樣本小，且實驗限於 7B–8B 模型。此基準凸顯結構化知識移除需要超越實例層級的專門演算法與評估。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A multilingual long-context LLM benchmark (MGAL) evaluating 12 frontier and open-weight models across six UN languages, four granularity levels, and position-stratified evidence, which is squarely on-topic for LLM evaluation, long-context, and benchmarking preferences (though no Japanese content). Novelty is moderate: the granularity+position+multilingual combination is claimed as first-of-kind (Abstract; Table 2) and two new diagnostic framings (local semantic crowding, fluency-consistency gap) are introduced, but several findings (recency bias, option-order bias, lost-in-the-middle) confirm known phenomena. Rigor is decent—two-annotator verification (Appendix F.6, 720 human-hours), instruction-placement and option-order ablations (Section 4.4), and a no-context ablation (Appendix G.4: 0.73→0.31)—but the headline fine-vs-coarse claim compares non-comparable metrics (accuracy vs ROUGE-L; Appendix F.1 concedes this), no significance testing is reported, and several models score near-zero on translation (Table 3: Mistral 1.63, Gemma 1.95) without deep diagnosis. Evidence strength is supported by extensive per-language/per-position tables and LLM-judge/human agreement (Appendix F.5, r=0.871), though key claims like semantic crowding rest partly on LLM-judged error taxonomies and three qualitative cases (Section 5.1; Appendix G.2). Generalizability is limited to formal UN-report text despite broad language coverage (Appendix D notes all six are conventionally high-resource). Reproducibility is promising (prompts, pipeline details in Appendices E/F) but artifacts are only promised 'upon publication' (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: MGAL: A Multilingual Granularity-Aware Long-Context Benchmark

papers.summary: Evaluation of long-context Large Language Models (LLMs) has advanced rapidly. However, most existing benchmarks are limited to the document level and focus mainly on high-resource languages, leaving many fine-grained challenges insufficiently evaluated. To address this gap, we present MGAL, the first multilingual, granularity- and position-aware long-context benchmark. MGAL is constructed from United Nations (UN) reports spanning 8K to 128K tokens across the six official UN languages. It covers
papers.summary_zh: 長上下文 LLM 的評測多侷限於文件層級且偏重高資源語言，缺乏對細粒度理解與證據位置的系統性檢驗。本文提出 MGAL，首個多語言、粒度與位置感知的長上下文基準：以聯合國報告為來源，涵蓋六種官方語言，上下文長度 8K 至 128K tokens，包含字詞、句子、段落、文件四個粒度層級的七項任務（問答、完形填句、段落填補、摘要、翻譯），並於文件與段落層級對證據位置（開頭、中段、結尾）分層，每個項目均經人工雙重審核，同位置跨語言對齊語意以利公平比較。對 12 個長上下文模型的評測顯示：模型在字詞層級表現佳，粒度越粗表現越差；閉源模型在相對低資源語言上維持明顯優勢。作者並識別兩項新挑戰：局部語意擁擠下，模型傾向依賴連接詞與重複實體等表面線索，而非句子的語篇角色，造成位置錯誤；以及流暢度與一致性落差，輸出讀來通順卻漂離來源事實。研究另確認近因偏差與選項順序啟發式等既有模式，並透過指令位置與選項順序消融實驗佐證成因；移除上下文的對照實驗亦證明作答主要仰賴提供的長文本。限制包括自動指標與 LLM 評審的偏誤，以及任務表現難以與指令遵循完全解耦。MGAL 為多語言細粒度長文本理解提供嚴謹的診斷工具。

links.title: ForeDreamer: A Self-Evolving Dual-Agent Memory Architecture for Future Event Prediction

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: ForeDreamer separates factual memory (question-specific evidence) from experiential memory and uses a main agent plus memory-processing subagent with MemGuide/MemTool interface
Table 1 (Section 4.2): Prophet Arena average Brier 0.1471 for ForeDreamer vs 0.2059 Full Text and 0.1761 best baseline LightMem (Qwen3.5-Flash)
Table 2 (Section 4.2): FutureX accuracy 0.4108 vs best baseline A-MEM 0.3495 (Qwen3.5-Flash)

Appendix C.3: 'retain the top five candidates, evaluate them on the held-out test set, and report the best test performance among these candidates' — best-of-5 test-set selection, no significance/variance reporting
Table 3/Table 4 (Section 4.2): ablations show both evolution tracks and both procedural optimizations contribute (e.g., w/o both optimizations 0.1592 Brier vs 0.1471 full)
Section 3.2.2/Figure 4: 201 generated MemTools collapse into 98 clusters at token-Jaccard τ=0.5, motivating compositional tool reuse; Appendix E.1 adds normalized-sequence and AST views
Table 6 (Section 4.2): No-Information setting (0.2545 Brier / 0.3077 acc) plus GPT-5-Nano with earlier cutoff (Appendix D.1) support gains not explained by memorization
Limitations: authors acknowledge small resolved-feedback pool and that traditional agent-memory benchmarks are out of scope

Appendix C.4 and Appendix F: Tavily search, 4 results/query, 30K-char context, ≤2 turns, 60 evolution iterations, sandboxed tool execution, and full prompt templates provided; no explicit code release statement
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent paper squarely on-target for the stated preferences: self-evolving dual-agent memory (main agent + memory-processing subagent), tool-calling MemTools, web-search evidence processing, and RAG/memory baselines on live forecasting benchmarks. Novelty is moderate: separating factual vs. experiential memory and evolving procedural MemGuide/MemTool assets extends prior agent-memory and self-evolving-agent work (Mem0, A-MEM, MemSkill, self-improving coding agents) rather than introducing a fundamentally new mechanism, though the diagnostic-driven optimizations are concretely motivated. Rigor has real strengths (two benchmarks, three backbones, eight baselines, dual-track and optimization ablations, search-setting robustness, no-information leakage checks) but a serious selection flaw: Appendix C.3 reports 'the best test performance among' the top-five validation-ranked candidates, i.e., test-set cherry-picking without seeds, variance, or significance tests; compute overhead of the subagent pipeline versus cheaper baselines is also unaddressed. Evidence is internally consistent with large, uniform gains (e.g., Brier 0.1471 vs Full Text 0.2059; FutureX 0.4108 vs best baseline 0.3495), but unverifiable future-dated backbones (GPT-5.4-Nano, Qwen3.5-Flash) and a 2026 arXiv ID weaken external credibility. Generalizability is limited to open-web forecasting by the authors' own admission (Limitations). Reproducibility is aided by extensive prompt templates (Appendix F) and hyperparameters (Appendix C.4) but no explicit code release and dependence on live, cutoff-constrained web search.

primary_link.title: ForeDreamer: A Self-Evolving Dual-Agent Memory Architecture for Future Event Prediction

papers.summary: Open-web future event prediction requires agents to distill reliable signals from noisy, redundant, and incomplete evidence. Existing retrieval/memory mechanisms directly feed retrieved information to agents or rely on simple memory functions such as storing and reusing prior information for prediction, leaving them insufficient for open-web forecasting. We propose to transform raw web evidence into structured memory before prediction, enabling agents to reason over distilled, question-specific
papers.summary_zh: 開放網路環境下的未來事件預測,要求代理從嘈雜、冗餘且不完整的證據中提煉可靠訊號,但現有檢索與記憶機制多半把檢索結果直接塞進模型脈絡,或僅做簡單的儲存與重複使用,難以勝任此任務。ForeDreamer主張在預測前先將原始網路證據轉換為結構化記憶,並提出自演化雙代理框架:主代理負責搜尋規劃與最終預測;記憶處理子代理依據MemGuide工作流程,以可執行的MemTools將搜尋結果轉為針對該問題的事實記憶。框架區分「事實記憶」(當前問題的證據狀態)與「經驗記憶」(跨預測回合累積的持久經驗),並以雙軌機制演化:文字軌更新引導搜尋、證據整合與校準的Experience Bank;程序軌演化MemGuide樹與MemTools,並引入組合式工具重用與多樣性引導探索兩項最佳化,分別緩解工具重複生成與探索過度集中。在Prophet Arena與FutureX上,以Qwen3.5-Flash與GPT-5.4-Nano為骨幹,ForeDreamer的Brier分數與準確率皆優於Full Text、RAG及多種代理記憶系統;消融實驗證實兩條演化軌跡與兩項最佳化皆有貢獻,結果對互動輪數、搜尋提供者與檢索預算穩健,並以無資訊設定排除資料外洩疑慮。限制在於已解答的預測回饋稀少,演化僅仰賴小規模驗證池,有驗證集過擬合疑慮,且未涵蓋傳統代理記憶基準。此研究顯示,將記憶視為可演化的經驗而非靜態儲存,是開放網路預測的關鍵。

links.title: HIERA: Workload-Aware Planning Across Implementation Spaces for GPU Kernel Optimization

evidence: Abstract: HIERA 'constructs contract-augmented task specifications, selects an appropriate implementation space across PyTorch operators, CUDA libraries, and custom CUDA kernels, and uses profiling feedback and expert knowledge to guide structured iterative refinement'

Experimental Setup – Compared Methods and Experimental Variants: baselines 'KernelBench-Caesar, CUDAForge, and CUDA-L1' with 'three base LLMs: DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen3.6-Plus, and Gemini-3.6-Flash'; main protocol fixes 'sampling temperature of 0.3' and budget 'B=18 candidates per task'

Results – RQ1: 'HIERA reaches 92.4% fast_0 and 60.4% fast_1' at B=18, 'exceeding KernelBench (85.2%/29.6%) and CUDAForge (85.6%/44.8%)' (Figure 3); Table 2 reports 'best or tied-best result in 22 of 27 comparisons'

Ablation Study (Figure 5): without planning 'fast_0 decreases only from 99% to 96%, whereas fast_1 and fast_2 fall from 62/20% to 6/6%' on Level 2; without contracts Level 1 drops '97/68/18% to 86/40/0%'
RQ3 Case Study: stencil runtime decreases 'from 13.71 ms in the first iteration to 4.71 ms in the fifth iteration' vs cuDNN '7.23 ms', a '1.53× speedup' (Figure 6)
Scope and Limitations: 'All experiments are conducted on NVIDIA A100 GPUs... the stencil study only considers one operator and configuration and should therefore be viewed as evidence of feasibility'
Table 1: full environment (NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB, CUDA Toolkit 12.8, PyTorch 2.7.1+cu126, cuDNN 9.5.1); no code or artifact availability statement appears in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: A training-free LLM-agent framework (Search-Space Decision, Strategy Planning, and Optimization agents) for CUDA kernel generation with execution/NCU-feedback loops, squarely matching high-weight preferences: Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLMs; the framework is a language-methodology contribution, not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: framing implementation-space selection (PyTorch ops vs CUDA libraries vs custom CUDA) as an explicit planning decision is a fresh angle over fixed-space predecessors (CUDAForge, KernelBench-Caesar), but contract-augmented specifications and iterative execution-feedback refinement are incremental engineering of known ideas. Rigor is solid: three baselines, three base LLMs, budget-curve analysis (B=1..18), 90-task implementation-space comparison, and two ablations isolating contract vs planning effects; however, no significance testing, single stochastic runs, and ablations restricted to one LLM. Evidence strength is good—detailed tables (e.g., 97/68/18 fast_0/1/2 on Qwen3.6-Plus Level 1; ablation fast_1 drop 62%→6% without planning) and a concrete stencil case (13.71→4.71 ms vs 7.23 ms cuDNN, 1.53×)—but headline curves are figure-based and baseline numbers may reflect re-aligned budgets. Generalizability is limited to one GPU (A100), FP32 (FP64 stencil only), and one stencil config, which the authors themselves flag. Reproducibility is middling: thorough protocol and environment table, but no code, prompt-template, or expert-knowledge rubric release is stated anywhere in the document.

primary_link.title: HIERA: Workload-Aware Planning Across Implementation Spaces for GPU Kernel Optimization

papers.summary: High-performance GPU kernels underpin modern deep learning and scientific computing. As workloads become increasingly diverse and GPU hardware evolves rapidly, developing efficient methods for automated GPU kernel generation and optimization has become increasingly important. Existing LLM-based methods typically optimize within a fixed implementation space, limiting either optimization flexibility or search efficiency. We propose \textsc{HIERA}, a hierarchical search-space planning framework for
papers.summary_zh: 高效能GPU核心是深度學習與科學運算的基礎,但現有LLM核心生成與最佳化方法多半固定在單一實作空間:依賴高階運算子或最佳化程式庫會錯失需要客製融合與形狀特化的機會,直接探索自訂CUDA又因搜尋空間龐大而效率低落,且執行與profiling回饋無法判斷所選空間是否適合該工作負載。HIERA將實作空間選擇明確視為規劃問題:先以合約增強的任務規格固定介面、參數語意與編譯規則,使生成聚焦於效能關鍵決策;再由Search-Space Decision Agent在純CUDA、CUDA程式庫、CUDA加PyTorch運算子三個嵌套空間中選擇,並依profiling回饋與專家知識,從五類最佳化方向(控制流與邊界特化、執行緒與warp級平行、記憶體傳輸效率、資料重用與搬移管線化、Tensor Core利用)剪枝選向,由Strategy Planning Agent與Optimization Agent進行結構化迭代精煉。在KernelBench三個層級與三種基礎LLM(DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3.6-Plus、Gemini-3.6-Flash)上,HIERA在多數fast0/fast1/fast2指標領先免訓練方法KernelBench-Caesar與CUDAForge,小預算下樣本效率尤其突出,並可與強化學習方法CUDA-L1競爭;消融顯示合約規格主要保障實作有效性,階層規劃主要提升加速率。科學運算的2D stencil案例更達cuDNN的1.53倍加速。限制包括僅評測A100、以FP32為主,且stencil案例僅涵蓋單一算子與設定。此框架證明跨粒度的負載感知規劃能在異質工作負載下兼顧可靠與彈性。

links.title: Structured but Fragile: On the Limits of LLMs in Cybersecurity Decision-Making

evidence: Section 5, Table 1: over 108 evaluations per defender, Optimal scores 4.82 vs Gemini 4.63, Grok 4.56, ChatGPT 4.51, Claude 4.29, Poor 1.76.
Section 5.0.2, Table 2: per-graph Spearman correlations between formal risk and panel score range from -0.867 (G1, p=3.49e-4) to -0.266 (G7, p=9.03e-4).
Section 5.3.2, Table 7: relabeling the poor strategy as 'optimal defender' raises mean score by +1.68 (1.76 to 3.44); Table 8 Exp.3 reports 71% OM win rate over the true optimum.
Section 5.0.3, Table 3: Claude's mean rank gap rises from +0.108 (Graphs 1-4) to +2.188 (Graphs 5-7), showing evaluator fragility on complex graphs.
Section 5.5, Table 10: with control names anonymized and topology removed, Greedy becomes top scorer (5.42) while Optimal drops to 4.31, evidencing dependence on structural information.

Section 6.0.3: LLM solvers achieve optimal risk when completing, but Grok/Claude are ~8x slower than the baseline on large graphs; ChatGPT times out on one 70-node graph and Gemini on 7 graphs under a 1,500-second cap.

Section 7: authors explicitly state the optimisation baseline is a normative reference, not real-world ground truth, and rely on manual inspection only as sanity check; no code or data release is mentioned anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled LLM-capability study (not a pure domain application): frontier LLMs select defence portfolios over attack graphs against a Stackelberg MILP normative reference, with prompt-structure disclosures (Fig. 3/5), framing/naming perturbations, topology ablations, and LLM-generated solver evaluation. It hits high-weight preferences directly: LLMs, structured reasoning, prompting sensitivity, LLM-as-judge reliability, and code generation. Novelty is moderate: judge label bias, self-preference, and framing sensitivity have precedents; the fresh parts are the game-theoretic normative baseline, the topology-vs-semantics ablations, and the non-monotonic judge behaviour (Claude underrated on complex graphs, Sec 5.0.3). Rigor is solid but bounded: outcomes rest entirely on LLM-judge ordinal labels with no human ground truth (acknowledged in Sec 7), the H/M/L-to-numeric effectiveness mapping is ad hoc (defended only by citation to prior robustness work, Sec 5.0.6), no repeated sampling/variance or CIs are reported for judge scores, and the claimed '84' framing experiments (Sec 5.3.2) do not match the 27 graph-budget combinations x 3 conditions. Evidence is internally consistent and quantified (Table 1 scores, Table 2 Spearman correlations -0.867 to -0.266, Table 7 OM +1.68 delta, Table 8 Exp.3 71% OM win rate, Table 10 Greedy 5.42 under topology removal), and relative-comparison design mitigates judge-dependence. Generalizability is limited to one domain, seven hand-built graphs, and four closed frontier models; prompts are described in detail but no code/data release is stated, and future-dated model versions hinder exact replication.

primary_link.title: Structured but Fragile: On the Limits of LLMs in Cybersecurity Decision-Making

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in cybersecurity workflows, yet it remains unclear whether they can perform structured security reasoning or merely rely on superficial cues and prior knowledge. We study this question in the context of defence selection over attack graphs derived from real-world threat scenarios, including ransomware, supply-chain compromise, cloud abuse, Kubernetes attacks, POS malware, and ICS/OT intrusion. Given a budget constraint, LLMs must select security
papers.summary_zh: LLM正快速進入資安工作流程,但是否具備結構化安全推理、抑或僅依賴表面線索與既有知識,仍未釐清。本文以源自勒索軟體、供應鏈入侵、雲端濫用、Kubernetes、POS惡意程式與ICS/OT入侵等真實威脅的七個攻擊圖情境,檢驗LLM在預算限制下選擇安全控制組合的能力,並以Stackelberg賽局最佳化(化為混合整數線性規劃求解)作為規範性參照,再由四個前沿LLM組成評審團進行受控評估。結果顯示LLM具有條件式勝任力:當攻擊圖結構明確時,其策略常接近最佳解;但能力相當脆弱——對框架與命名高度敏感,把劣質策略標示為「optimal defender」可使平均評分提升1.68分,在部分實驗中甚至勝過真正的最佳解;形式風險與LLM判斷呈非單調關係,複雜圖上Claude的近最佳策略反遭低估;數值評分會放大偏差,領域知識(如POS情境的P2PE)可能凌駕明確的威脅結構;移除圖拓撲後,評估崩落為單純依效能標籤的Greedy策略。要求LLM自行產生求解器雖能得出正確的log空間混合整數規劃,但大型圖上執行時間約慢八倍且常逾時。作者據此建議避免暗示性標籤、採匿名化與類別式評分、使用多模型評審團、以形式化方法交叉驗證,並務必提供明確的結構化輸入。整體而言,LLM宜作為結構化流程中的輔助工具,而非獨立決策者。

links.title: Knowing but Not Saying: Preventing Factual Access Failures in LLM SFT via Recall-Anchored Distillation

evidence: Section 'Preliminary Studies, F1': benchmark-level comparison shows TriviaQA EM drops 65.03 to 43.95 after MedMCQA SFT while MMLU recognition remains stable, motivating the access-failure framing.
Section 'Preliminary Studies, F3': 300 Base-correct/SFT-wrong examples labeled with 97.3% LLM-judge agreement; format/verbosity mismatch accounts for 77.3%, and 4-shot prompting recovers 90.0%.

Section 'Experiments, Main Results (Q3)': Replay on identical anchor text reduces Llama-3.1-8B PopQA EM to 3.40 vs. 11.60 standard SFT and 15.20 RAD, isolating the soft base distribution as the preservation signal.

Section 'Experiments, Ablation Analysis': Table 2 shows forward KL (52.88 TriviaQA EM), symmetric KL, no-clipping, and tau variants all keep TriviaQA EM above 51 with MedMCQA near 60, indicating robustness; Figure 5 shows gains across all five epochs and non-monotonic alpha.
Section 'Experiments, Efficiency Analysis': memory footprint differences within 1 GB across three backbones; largest training-time increase about 1.4 hours due to the extra adapter-off forward pass.

References section: Wang (2024) 'Real-time object detection...' and Yang et al. (2024b) 'Optically mediated nonvolatile resistive memory device...' are cited in the Introduction for LLM fine-tuning claims, indicating citation-integrity problems.

Section 'Experiments, Training Setup': three backbones (Llama-3.1-8B base, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct) but only MedMCQA as target domain and only LoRA adaptation, limiting tested generality; no code or data availability claim appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper (SFT-induced forgetting, LoRA self-distillation, factuality evaluation) with strong relevance to LLM training/optimization and factual-hallucination preferences. The 'factual access failure' diagnosis (recognition vs. recall dissociation, 77.3% format/verbosity failures among 300 analyzed cases) is well executed but builds heavily on prior spurious-forgetting and hidden-knowledge work, and RAD is a competent but incremental combination of LwF-style self-distillation with KL anchoring on unlabeled OOD text. Experimental design is solid: replay control isolating the soft-distribution signal, KL-direction/clipping/alpha ablations, contamination filtering, and efficiency analysis. Weaknesses: recovery is only partial (e.g., Llama TriviaQA EM 51.62 vs. 65.03 base; Qwen2.5-3B 9.04 vs. 30.57 base), single target domain (MedMCQA) limits generalizability, LoRA-only adaptation untested for full fine-tuning, and the reference list contains clearly irrelevant citations (an object-detection paper and a resistive-memory device paper cited for LLM fine-tuning claims), a citation-integrity concern. No code/data release is stated.
topics: benchmark evaluation (TriviaQA, PopQA, MMLU, TruthfulQA, MedMCQA)

primary_link.title: Knowing but Not Saying: Preventing Factual Access Failures in LLM SFT via Recall-Anchored Distillation

papers.summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can degrade factual behavior outside the target domain. This degradation is often described as catastrophic forgetting, yet open-ended factual failures do not necessarily imply that the underlying facts have been erased. In this work, we identify a more specific phenomenon, factual access failure: after domain SFT, models can still recognize or rank the correct answer under constrained evaluation, while failing to produce it in closed-book generation. Through benchma
papers.summary_zh: 監督式微調雖能讓LLM適應特定領域,卻常在領域外造成事實行為退化,過去多歸因於災難性遺忘。本文指出更精確的現象是「事實存取失敗」:領域SFT後,模型在選擇題或約束式探測下仍能辨識或排序正確答案,卻在閉卷式開放生成中說不出來。作者以基準層級比較、同一事實的多選與生成配對探測及失敗模式分析證實:識別型表現大致穩定,開放式回憶卻大幅下滑(如Llama-3.1-8B在TriviaQA的EM由65.03降至43.95);在300個Base對、SFT錯的案例分析中,77.3%屬於格式或冗長等表達層失敗,而非真正遺忘,且簡單的4-shot提示可回復九成案例。據此提出Recall-Anchored Distillation(RAD):以LoRA開關在單一模型內實作師生角色——關閉adapter時,基礎模型在未標記OOD文字(維基百科式字首—續寫)上的軟性下一詞分布作為教師,開啟adapter的學生以裁剪反向KL對齊之,並與目標域SFT損失聯合最佳化;無需OOD金標答案、外部評審或標註資料,額外成本僅多一次前向傳遞。三個骨幹在MedMCQA上微調後,RAD將Llama-3.1-8B的TriviaQA EM回復至51.62、PopQA EM升至15.20,同時MedMCQA準確率為微調系統中最高;使用相同文字的replay基準反而更差(PopQA EM僅3.40),證明關鍵訊號是基礎模型的軟性分布而非額外文字曝露。限制為回復僅屬部分、錨定強度α呈非單調、訓練時間略增。此工作釐清SFT退化的本質,並提供低成本保存事實能力的方案。
papers.title: Knowing but Not Saying: Preventing Factual Access Failures in LLM SFT via Recall-Anchored Distillation

evidence: Sec. 5.2, Tables 1-2: at 30% column sparsity COEC lowers WikiText-2 perplexity on all six models under each of three selection criteria (e.g., Qwen2.5-32B 13.90 to 9.64 with Wanda-sp) and improves 7-task zero-shot accuracy in most settings

Sec. 5.4, Table 3: cumulative ablation over five development models attributes perplexity reduction to GCV rescale (10.06 to 9.81) and two-sided rotation (to 9.45) and zero-shot gain to reduced-Stiefel solve (51.5 to 52.7)
App. A, Table 1: FLAP bias compensation remains ahead on perplexity on five of six main-text models at 10% and 20% sparsity, an admitted limitation of the method in mild regimes
Sec. 5.5, Table 4: deployment benefit quantified only as params/memory/GFLOPs per token (23-29% reduction); realized wall-clock speedup explicitly not reported
App. B: hyperparameters, seeds, numerical safeguards and a three-seed PPL spread (median 0.08) are documented, but no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the paper

App. B, Compute environment: a same-configuration L40S cross-check reproduced perplexity to 0.001 but shifted zero-shot accuracy by 0.55 points, comparable to several accuracy deltas in Tables 2 and 4
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM efficiency work: training-free structured pruning compensation for Llama-3/3.1 and Qwen2.5 (7B-72B), matching the high-weight LLM and Scaling & Efficiency preferences. The method is a meaningful but incremental extension of RCPU: it generalizes one-sided orthogonal compensation to alternating two-sided rotations on a reduced Stiefel manifold, adds GCV-selected per-mode singular-value rescaling, Gram tempering, and an attention-alignment penalty; each ingredient is a classical tool and the novelty lies mainly in the combination (Sec. 2, 4). Rigor is solid: unified protocol across three selection criteria (Sec. 5.1-5.2), component-wise ablation (Sec. 5.4, Table 3), calibration-size study (Sec. 5.3), seed-variance and numerical-safeguard reporting (App. B), plus honest negative results (FLAP bias leads perplexity at 10-20% on five of six models, App. A; RCPU leads accuracy on Qwen2.5-14B). Evidence is weakened by evaluation limited to WikiText-2 perplexity and 7 zero-shot tasks, no wall-clock speedup (Sec. 5.5 reports only params/memory/FLOPs), and a cross-hardware zero-shot shift of 0.55 points (App. B) that is the same order as several reported accuracy gains. Reproducibility is helped by a very detailed implementation appendix (App. B) but no code release is stated. Generalizability is decent across families, scales, and selection criteria, though untested on MoE or non-LLM architectures.

primary_link.title: COEC: Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation for Structured Pruning of Large Language Models

papers.summary: Structured pruning reduces the size and inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by removing weight columns, but the resulting output error can degrade accuracy. Existing training-free compensation methods use an additive bias or a single orthogonal rotation on the output side of the retained weight. These corrections leave its input singular frame unchanged and therefore limit how the retained weight can adapt after column removal. We propose COEC (Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compen
papers.summary_zh: 本論文針對大型語言模型（LLM）的結構化剪枝問題。剪枝移除整欄權重可縮小模型並降低推論成本，但會產生輸出誤差、損害準確率；現有免訓練補償方法僅採用加法偏誤或單側正交旋轉，無法調整輸入奇異基底。作者提出COEC，一個免訓練的剪枝後補償框架：對保留權重交替施加左右正交旋轉，右旋轉於縮減Stiefel流形上求解，奇異值以廣義交叉驗證（GCV）逐層選取正規化強度做逐模態縮放；另引入Gram矩陣頻譜調和以降低高能量激活方向的主導性，並以錨定對齊懲罰維持相鄰注意力投影間的幾何關係。所有元件僅依賴128條校準序列的二階統計量，無需反向傳播或重訓，且與剪枝準則無關，可作為外掛套用於Wanda-sp、FLAP與RCPU的選取結果。實驗涵蓋Llama-3、Llama-3.1與Qwen2.5系列，在10%至30%結構化稀疏度下，COEC於所有模型改善WikiText-2困惑度，並在多數設定提升七項零樣本準確率，稀疏度越高增益越大，如Qwen2.5-32B困惑度由13.90降至9.64。消融實驗分離各元件貢獻；補償不改變模型形狀，部署成本僅取決於剪枝率，補償7至8B模型約需45至86 GPU分鐘。限制包括：低稀疏度下FLAP偏誤在困惑度上仍具競爭力，對齊懲罰無法消除子空間內的殘餘旋轉，右旋轉亦在困惑度與零樣本準確率間存在取捨。此研究顯示，剪枝後補償能在免重訓的前提下挽回部分因剪欄而損失的效能。
papers.title: COEC: Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation for Structured Pruning of Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: COEC：大型語言模型結構化剪枝的校準正交等價補償

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference LLM-agent security work (agents/tool-use, AI safety, red-teaming/evaluation, LLMs) with unusually high internal consistency: every headline number cross-checks against appendix counts (Table 8 reproduces all five protected ASR/TSR values; funnel 1,150/8,310=13.8% matches Table 11; ablation deltas 11.00/6.57 match Table 6). However, the main SkillsSafety raw baselines are quoted from a benchmark (Jin et al. 2026) whose author list overlaps almost entirely with this paper's, and §9's 'independently constructed' claim is made without disclosing that overlap; the only matched external baseline is a weak rule-hook (claude-guardrails, +1.19 ASR over raw), attacks are non-adaptive (acknowledged §9), locus D gets no isolated quantitative evaluation, clean-utility covers only four of five Work Agents, and all results depend on unverifiable 2026 proprietary model versions (GPT-5.4/5.5, gemini-3.5-flash, MiniMax-M2.7/M3, GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.5). primary_link.title: ClawSentry: A Progressive Multi-Tier Security Monitor for Safeguarding Autonomous LLM Agents

papers.summary: As large language model (LLM) agents move from conversation to executing code, reading local files, and orchestrating external tools, a single agent hijacked by a malicious third-party skill can cause data exfiltration, privilege escalation, or cascading compromise. We argue that agentic risk is progressive: it can enter at four loci of the agent control loop--skill admission, invocation-time intent, execution-time effect, and post-action consequence--while a denied dangerous objective can reapp
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討自主LLM代理執行程式碼、存取檔案與外部工具時的安全風險。作者主張代理風險是漸進的，可從控制迴路的四個位置入侵：技能包准入、呼叫時意圖、執行時效應與事後後果，且被拒絕的危險目標能以改寫參數或切換工具繞過；現有防禦多僅涵蓋單一環節。為此，團隊提出ClawSentry，一個開源、框架無關的安全監督閘道：(1) Agent Harness Protocol（AHP）以統一事件架構搭配同步UDS與非同步Webhook雙通道，讓同一策略套用於Codex、Claude Code、Kimi CLI與Gemini CLI；(2) 首次使用技能包審查（FSPR），以確定性證據底線加上有界唯讀代理審查，在使用前攔截惡意套件；(3) 三層漸進決策引擎：確定性L1、規則錨定的L2語意審查（含25條OWASP規則）與唯讀L3證據調查代理，僅對殘餘模糊事件投入情境審查；(4) 工作階段級防繞過機制，辨識能力等效的重試；(5) 事後非同步稽核。審查者僅具唯讀工具，政策權威保留於閘道。實驗顯示：在SkillInject上，Codex/GPT-5.4的情境攻擊成功率由39.55%降至2.61%；跨五個Work Agent，SkillsSafety攻擊成功率由33.5–49.7%壓至9.09–15.03%，乾淨技能的任務成功率維持98.7%；僅13.8%的L1事件需要模型審查。限制方面：基準中的攻擊非自適性，事後層只能報告無法追溯強制，中毒工作階段仍有6.7點任務成功率成本，FSPR對乾淨套件亦有5.7–7.5%誤封鎖率。本研究的啟示是：准入時審查主導防禦成效，能力強的審查模型應以唯讀外部監督者身分納入防禦迴路。
papers.title: ClawSentry: A Progressive Multi-Tier Security Monitor for Safeguarding Autonomous LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'Evaluating 13 models, including 11 VLMs, across 200 trials per model' — contradicted by Contributions bullet 2 and Conclusion which state 'Across 16 models and 200 trials per model'.
Section 3.4: TOCS defined as indicator-mean against condition-level ToM prediction (Eq. 2), with uncertainty rate (Eq. 3) and positional bias (Eq. 4) as auxiliary diagnostics.
Section 4.2.2: 'Under Comp-ToM0, its SSS reaches 0.90... Under Comp-ToM1, SSS inverts to -0.44, consistent with successful deception'; 'Among the evaluated VLMs, no model clears both bottlenecks.'

Appendix F.2.3: chi-square independence tests — 'only PCM-LLM shows significant reward-location-dependent choice across all four conditions (all p<0.01)', all other cells non-significant, supporting the positional-bias confound claim.
Appendix F.3 / Section 4.4: ablation numbers 'TAS: 0.04 to 0.56 under Coop-ToM0; GAS: 0.12 to 0.54' for internvl-8b under blank-image condition, supporting the visual-interference claim.

Appendix F.2.4, Table 5: Bonferroni-corrected Scheirer-Ray-Hare tests show significant Mode/ToM effects only for PCM-LLM on TAS/SSS/GAS; most VLMs show no significant effects, supporting the 'no reliable behavioral change under ToM constraints' claim.
Limitations section: 'No human participants were evaluated under the MOSAIC protocol'; model coverage restricted to open-source ≤15B; 'MOSAIC currently instantiates a single interaction scenario'.
Appendix C: unified inference config 'temperature = 0.7, top_p = 0.9'; reward location 'assigned independently and uniformly at random... without a fixed random seed'.
Footnote 1: 'Code available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MOSAIC-50EE'; Appendix D provides full prompt templates; Appendix E gives formal metric equations.

Editing defects: Section 4.1 contains the incomplete sentence 'Minicpm-8b deviates from this pattern despite sharing the same backbone; the source of minicpm-8b's divergence from this pattern.'; Appendix F.1 contains a duplicated clause ('characterized by exceptionally high uncertainty rates exceeding 0.').
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark paper (MOSAIC) evaluating whether VLM/LLM agents translate theory-of-mind inferences into coordinated verbal+nonverbal social action. Strong topical fit to the preference profile: it targets LLM/VLM agents (Agents 2.5), ToM/multi-step reasoning (Reasoning 2.5), strategic deception (AI Safety), multimodal models, and benchmark/evaluation methodology, with a text-only Llama-3.1-8b baseline alongside 11 VLMs. Novelty is solid: the joint requirement of active ToM deployment, multichannel signal generation (trajectory, gaze, facial expression), and receiver-side decoding measurement is credibly positioned (Table 1, Related Work) beyond passive ToM QA or language-only arenas like SOTOPIA, though the belief-vs-action gap is anticipated by cited SimpleToM. Rigor is above average: 200 trials/model, 4 controlled conditions, positional-bias and uncertainty diagnostics, reward-balance binomial tests, chi-square independence tests, Bonferroni-corrected Scheirer-Ray-Hare and Kruskal-Wallis analyses (Appendix F), plus ablations and failure analyses. Deductions: internal inconsistency between '13 models' (Abstract) and '16 models' (Contributions, Conclusion), a truncated sentence in Section 4.1 and duplicated text in Appendix F.1, no human baseline, no closed/frontier models (≤15B open-source only), and a single-scenario design that limits generalizability (acknowledged in Limitations). Evidence for headline claims is quantitative and mostly self-consistent (e.g., PCM-LLM SSS 0.90 Comp-ToM0 vs -0.44 Comp-ToM1 in 4.2.2; ablation TAS 0.04→0.56, GAS 0.12→0.54 in F.3), but key comparisons rely on figures, and the PCM-LLM 'reference architecture' from the same authors winning every condition is a somewhat self-referential contrast framed charitably as a feasibility reference. Reproducibility is decent: anonymous code link, full prompt templates (Appendix D), formal metric definitions (Appendix E), hardware/software details (Appendix C), though no fixed random seed and PCM-LLM details live in a separate preprint.

primary_link.title: Belief Without Behavior: Measuring the Translation of Theory of Mind into Coordinated Social Action in Vision-Language Models

papers.summary: Effective social interaction requires agents to translate mental state inferences into coordinated behavioral signals across verbal and nonverbal channels simultaneously. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate theory of mind (ToM) reasoning and embodied behavior in isolation, leaving unmeasured the gap between social inference and social action. We introduce MOSAIC (Multimodal Orchestration of Social Action, Inference, and Communication), a controlled benchmark in which two embodied agents interact ac
papers.summary_zh: 本研究探討視覺語言模型(VLM)能否將心智理論(Theory of Mind, ToM)的推論轉化為協調一致的社會行動。既有基準多將 ToM 推理與具身行為分開評估,社會推論與社會行動之間的落差始終未被測量。作者提出 MOSAIC 基準:在 Unity 虛擬環境中讓兩個具身代理互動,知情的主體端須依合作或競爭模式引導或誤導參與者,並整合語言、移動軌跡、注視方向與臉部表情等多重訊號,同時系統性操弄互動模式與 ToM 階層(ToM-0/ToM-1)。團隊評估 13 個模型,含 11 個 VLM、純文字 LLM 基線,以及具明確 ToM 模組的混合架構 PCM-LLM,每模型 200 次試驗。結果顯示 VLM 無法產生符合 ToM 約束的行為,且存在兩道連續瓶頸:多數模型造不出方向一致的非語言訊號;即使訊號存在,參與者端也無法解讀並回應。僅 PCM-LLM 全數過關,顯示明確的信念—行動耦合是此類任務的充分要件。微調實驗顯示動作層級的模仿學習無法習得跨通道協調;消融實驗則發現視覺輸入對部分模型反而是注意力干擾。限制包括場景單一、缺乏人類基線、模型規模限於 15B 以下。本研究的價值在於證明語言層次的社會推理未必落實為行為,為具身社會智慧的評估立下新標準。
papers.title: Belief Without Behavior: Measuring the Translation of Theory of Mind into Coordinated Social Action in Vision-Language Models

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic for LLM agent security: the threat model targets tool-call argument construction (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, red-team evaluation) across DeepSeek/Claude configurations. The access-vs-authorization framing is a genuine, if incremental, distinction from InjecAgent/AgentDojo/AirGapAgent, and the counterfactual influence test plus authorized control is a thoughtful methodological addition. Rigor is above average: formal violation predicate, Wilson intervals, assigned-vs-parsed counts, and honest scope limits (synthetic profiles, generation-only, no executed exfiltration). Weaknesses: one observation per pressure-policy cell, a single synthetic task/schema, small n (6 sessions per model-policy cell), exploratory lexical markers, and a defense evaluated only on 12 replayed deterministic sessions (Table 5) without inline runtime results. No code or artifact release is stated, and prompts are shown only abridged, limiting reproducibility. Results support feasibility of authority-pressure disclosure, not population rates or provider rankings, as the authors themselves concede.

primary_link.title: The Claws in Plain Sight: Unauthorized Context Disclosure through LLM Agent Tool Calls

papers.summary: LLM agents routinely construct tool-call arguments from user profiles, conversation history, retrieved documents, and prior tool results. However, legitimate access to contextual information does not imply authorization to transmit that information for every purpose or destination. We present Claw in Plain Sight, an authority- pressure attack in which task-adjacent content frames protected attributes as operationally or procedurally required, causing a model to include them in otherwise valid ge
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理以工具呼叫執行任務,其參數常由使用者設定檔、對話歷史與擷取文件等情境組成。本文指出「可存取」不等於「可傳送」:模型有權讀取某項資訊,並不代表可將它放進送往特定目的地的工具參數。作者提出 Claw in Plain Sight,一種權威壓力攻擊:以合規備忘錄、發布檢查清單等看似正當的任務相關內容,宣稱受保護屬性為流程所必需,誘使模型在原本合法的工具呼叫中夾帶年齡、性別、收入與職業等資料。評估採合成基準,交叉六個壓力層級與四個隱私政策層級,涵蓋五個 DeepSeek 與 Claude 模型組態,共 120 個工作階段。結果顯示各模型洩漏率介於 20.8% 至 75.0%,所有組態至少出現一次違規;更明確的政策指令雖可降低整體洩漏(S3 降至 26.7%),但效果因模型而異:DeepSeek 在 S3 完全止漏,Claude 仍有洩漏,且回應文字中的標記無法可靠偵測違規。對照實驗未發現非逐字的間接影響。作者另提出具來源感知的執行前參考監控器,依目的、目的地與欄位層級授權把關。限制在於僅使用合成資料、單一任務,且於本地擷取參數,並未證明真實外洩。本研究凸顯工具呼叫建構本身即是獨立的隱私邊界,需要執行期防護而非僅靠提示詞政策。
papers.title: The Claws in Plain Sight: Unauthorized Context Disclosure through LLM Agent Tool Calls
papers.title_zh: 明目張膽的利爪:透過 LLM 代理工具呼叫進行未經授權的情境揭露

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM sequence-modeling architecture paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, Transformer Architecture, Long Context, Scaling & Efficiency): a closed-form chunk-parallel TTT update preserving per-token LR/momentum/decay, validated from scratch up to 1.3B on 15B tokens. Novelty is solid but incremental—chunkwise parallelization via cumulative sums is well established (DeltaNet/GLA/Mamba2 line); the contribution is extending exact chunk-end equivalence to coupled per-token momentum+decay for nonlinear fast weights (Prop. 3.1, verified <2e-6 rel. L2, Sec 3.2). Rigor is above average: framework-matched ablations (Table 5: chunk-averaged collapses S-NIAH-1@8K from 95.4 to 6.8), coefficient-shuffle intervention (Table 12), throughput/inference measurements (Table 13), though the chunk-averaged 2K score of 25.2 vs LaCT's 100.0 at the same context is an unexplained anomaly. Evidence is strongest for length extrapolation (Table 14: 93.6% S-NIAH-1@16K vs <26% all baselines) but general-LM gains are small, retrieval remains below full attention (43.6 vs 53.3, Table 3), LongBench absolute scores are near-floor (14.1 vs 12.1), training scale is 15B tokens, and key baselines (Titans, E2E-TTT) are self-reimplementations—transparently disclosed. Limitations (scale, within-chunk blind spot) are honestly stated; code link and full hyperparameters (Table 7) aid reproduction. Not a pure-domain application; in scope.

primary_link.title: Rethinking Expressivity and Efficiency in Test-Time Training

papers.summary: Test-Time Training (TTT) enables long-context processing via continuous weight updates during inference, but current methods struggle to balance the expressivity of per-token update dynamics with the hardware efficiency of chunk-wise approximations. We propose E$^2$-TTT (Expressive and Efficient TTT) to bridge this gap. Under the standard approximation of taking gradients at the chunk-start weights, we derive a closed-form state transition that exactly reproduces the chunk-end fast-weight and mo
papers.summary_zh: 測試時訓練（TTT）在推論期間持續更新權重以處理長上下文，但現有方法難以兼顧逐 token 更新的表達力與 chunk 近似的硬體效率。E²-TTT 在梯度於 chunk 起始權重處計算的標準假設下，推導出封閉形式的狀態轉移，可精確重現逐 token 遞迴在 chunk 結束時的快權重與動量狀態。此方法僅依賴逐 token 純量因子，透過對數空間累積和以平行方式計算兩組核函數，再以兩次加權梯度聚合取代序列式遞迴，因此保有大型 chunk 的平行訓練效率。作者從頭訓練最多 1.3B 參數的模型，結果顯示其困惑度在 WikiText 與 LAMBADA 上皆為最低，情境內檢索超越 HQLT 與 LaCT 等基線；長度外推表現尤其突出，在 Needle in a Haystack 測試中，於訓練上下文 8 倍長度下仍保有超過 90% 準確率，同時訓練吞吐量與高效 chunk 方法相當。限制方面，chunk 級輸出仍存在 chunk 內盲區，需靠滑動視窗注意力補償，且實驗規模僅至 1.3B。此研究證明保留精確的時間動態是長上下文泛化的關鍵，為可擴展的測試時訓練指出明確方向。
papers.title: Rethinking Expressivity and Efficiency in Test-Time Training
papers.title_zh: E²-TTT：重新思考測試時訓練的表達力與效率

links.title: ReFrame: Evidence-Guided Test-Time Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: training-free test-time framework where two agents share a lightweight locally deployed MLLM to build risk/utility evidence and rewrite prompts before calling the unmodified downstream MLLM
Section 3.2: utility dominance and reasoning inertia findings are supported only by illustrative cases (Figures 2 and 7, Appendix A.1), not systematic measurements
Table 1: ReFrame reports overall 98.31/94.09 safety/utility on GPT-4.1 versus EchoSafe 91.03/78.74, with near-ceiling values across all three downstream models
Section 5.1: all safety/utility scores are produced by LLM-as-a-judge using gpt-4o-mini with author-written prompts (Appendix D); no human evaluation is reported
Section 5.4: Tables 3-4 show scalability across Qwen3VL-4B/8B and Qwen3.5-9B agent backbones and open-source downstream models (Qwen3.6-35B, Qwen3VL-235B)
Section 5.3 / Figure 4: ablation removes risk and utility cards on GPT-4.1; results described qualitatively without a numeric table
Limitations: no formal robustness guarantee against adaptive attacks, dependence on local MLLM card quality, and evaluation limited to static single-turn image-text inputs
Appendix B.3 and C: implementation on a single A800 80GB with temperature 0, OpenAI-compatible serving, plus complete agent and judge prompts supplied; no code repository stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference fit: test-time jailbreak defense, oversensitivity reduction, and LLM-as-judge evaluation for MLLMs sit squarely in AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Multimodal AI, and prompting/agent preferences. Novelty is moderate: test-time input rewriting defenses (ECSO, Self-Reminder, AMIA, EchoSafe) already exist; the dual risk/utility evidence cards plus image-routing decision are a sensible new combination rather than a fundamentally new mechanism, and the 'agents' are two prompted calls to the same local model. Rigor is decent but uneven: broad coverage (3 closed + 2 open downstream models, 3 agent backbones, 5 safety + 4 normal benchmarks, ablation, runtime), yet all core empirical findings (Section 3.2) rest on single case studies, safety/utility numbers come solely from a gpt-4o-mini judge with author-written rubrics, no human validation, no significance testing, and several eval sets are small (SIUO 167, MMMU subsets 60). Near-ceiling uniform scores (98-99.9 safety across all models in Table 1) suggest the judge may reward rewritten safe redirections, and Table 2 normal-task gains (37.28 to 45.95) are plausibly prompt-clarification effects, which the authors themselves concede. Generalizability is supported by design (black-box, model-agnostic) and Tables 3-4, though all agent backbones are Qwen-family and only static single-turn inputs are tested. Reproducibility is above average because full agent and judge prompts, decoding settings (temperature 0, A800 GPU), model names, and public dataset sources are provided, but no code release is stated. Limitations and ethics are candidly discussed.

primary_link.title: ReFrame: Evidence-Guided Test-Time Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models

papers.summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend model capabilities beyond text, they also make safety alignment increasingly challenging. Multimodal safety alignment methods must address cross-modal jailbreaks, safety-awareness failures, and over-sensitive refusals. However, existing methods often rely on retraining or internal-state inspection, limiting their applicability to deployed closed-source MLLMs and motivating test-time safety alignment. We analyze this setting and identify two k
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）帶來跨模態越獄、安全意識不足與過度拒答等安全對齊挑戰，而現有方法多需重新訓練或存取模型內部狀態，難以套用於已部署的封閉源模型。本文分析測試時設定中的兩大障礙：效用主導（表層任務壓抑安全知識的活化）與推理慣性（越獄框架誘導模型沿不安全軌跡生成），並提出 ReFrame——免訓練的多模態輸入重構框架。兩個代理共用一個輕量本地 MLLM：證據產生代理分別建構風險卡與效用卡，識別不安全核心並記錄可保留的良性脈絡；改寫與路由代理則將證據合成為安全代理提示詞與影像路由決策，在不修改下游模型、不存取內部資訊的前提下完成防護。實驗涵蓋 GPT-4.1、Gemini-3-Flash、Qwen3.5-Flash 與五個基準，ReFrame 在越獄防禦、安全意識與過敏性降低上均取得最佳的安全—效用平衡（GPT-4.1 上平均 98.31/94.09），並將正常任務準確率自 37.28 提升至 45.95，每樣本僅增加 0.84 秒。限制包括缺乏對自適應攻擊的形式化保證、依賴本地模型品質，且僅評估靜態單輪輸入。此方法讓黑箱安全對齊在實務部署上真正可行。
papers.title: ReFrame: Evidence-Guided Test-Time Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models

Table 3 (§5): SAGE leads SemBench average quality 0.908 vs Lotus 0.778, Palimpzest 0.780, Sema 0.829, at $0.159 total cost and 488.7s latency
Table 6 (§5 ablations): removing predicate-aware routing drops membership F1 0.850→0.720 at $0.563 cost and FewRel F1 0.902→0.039; mean-log-prob gate drops membership F1 to 0.634
§5 Cross-domain recovery: SAGE recovers 80.8% of target-trained ceiling vs 73.5% LOTUS and 60.1% FDJ across twelve directions without target labels
Appendix A Table 7: recipe-card compiler validates at 88.3% JSON-parseable, 99.7% semantic-correct-if-parseable under sample shift; A.1 shows card agreement converges by five probe pairs

§7 Limitations: coverage result is empirical; excludes recursive agents, training, side effects, multimodal conversion; scale results cover two membership joins; reference-free compiler and self-judged proxy may make correlated errors

Appendix I: full setup disclosed (96 configurations over tau_f in {0.05-0.20}, tau_e in {0.70-0.90}, reasoning on/off, T in {0,0.2,0.5}; K=3; probe n=min(50,N); shared OpenRouter/LiteLLM pricing), but no code or data release is claimed
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on LLM-backed semantic query processing: it compiles AI functions in SQL into three typed primitives (AI_SCALAR, AI_AGG, AI_JOIN) and executes them with confidence-gated small-to-large model cascades and per-query configuration racing. LLM relevance is strong (Granite-3.0-8B/gpt-oss-120b backends, model cascades, LLM-call cost reduction, retrieval-as-join-predicate, test-time configuration selection), giving solid preference relevance, though the contribution is primarily a database algebra rather than LLM methodology per se. Novelty is moderate: the unification is a clean synthesis, but cascades, TokenSAR confidence, iRace racing, and the AI-Join decomposition are adopted from prior work the paper itself acknowledges. Rigor is above average: multi-workload evaluation (SemBench Q1-Q10, Multi-XScience, FewRel, BRIGHT, three compound joins), mechanism ablations, route and compound-predicate interventions, a 160-query/96-configuration proposer replay, and explicit limitations (self-judged proxy error, mixed model stacks across columns, single-run diagnostics). Evidence is quantitatively detailed with repeated-run means and measured (not projected) 358x cost reduction, but the label-free proxy lags the gold oracle (0.843 vs 0.892) and coverage claims are empirical. Generalizability is constrained by the authors' own admission: two membership joins at scale, limited models, approximate aggregate compaction. Reproducibility benefits from full prompt templates, configuration grids, pricing schedules, and pseudocode, though no public code artifact is stated.
topics: LLM inference efficiency and model cascades
AI functions / semantic operators in SQL
retrieval and similarity as pair predicates

primary_link.title: SAGE: A Unified Algebra and Self-Adaptive Execution for AI Functions in SQL

papers.summary: SQL systems increasingly expose AI functions for tasks such as classification, extraction, filtering, ranking, retrieval, joining, and summarization. Despite their diverse APIs, these functions play only three relational roles: transforming individual rows, aggregating groups, or generating relationships between row pairs. We present SAGE (Self-Adaptive Generative Execution), a unified logical and physical framework that captures these roles with three typed primitives, AI_SCALAR, AI_AGG, and AI
papers.summary_zh: SQL 系統陸續暴露分類、擷取、檢索、彙總等 AI 函式，但其 API 繁雜且模型呼叫成本高。本文觀察到這些函式在關聯資料流中僅扮演三種角色，提出 SAGE 框架：以三個型別化原語 AI_SCALAR、AI_AGG 與 AI_JOIN 統一表達，並與標準關聯運算子自然組合。所有原語共用由答案相關 token 信心驅動的小到大模型級聯，物理層則依資料形狀各自最佳化：純量逐列平行、聚合提供近重複壓縮與合法分塊；連接最為關鍵，透過配方卡與小型無標籤探針判斷述詞能否分解，選擇成員、關聯或推理三種路由。每筆查詢再以探針競賽在品質、成本與延遲預算下凍結最佳組態。作者審計十一個公開系統共 78 個運算子，其中 63 個直接映射至三原語；在 SemBench 與 Multi-XScience 上取得最佳平均品質 0.908，代表性可分解連接將 16,256 次生成呼叫降至 128 次，實測成本降低 358 倍。限制包括不涵蓋遞迴代理、訓練與索引建構，且無標籤代理可能產生相關誤差。此工作為資料庫最佳化器建立最小模型呼叫核心，兼具語義正確性與執行效率。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: a single-practitioner case study of a five-seat LLM agent fleet (Claude-family models) governed by kernel-checked formal verification, spanning agentic orchestration, code generation (compiler, executive, Verilog RTL), and mathematical reasoning in Lean 4. The Salt method's contribution is a governance/economics methodology (kernel as referee, certificate layer, adversarial refuter passes, append-only ledgers) rather than a new algorithm, and it is an n=1 existence proof with explicitly disclaimed generalizability and several self-reported, self-extracted measurements. Rigor is unusually candid for the genre (pre-registered token meter, reported retraction, named SAT-only verification links, honest limitations), but there are no baselines, no controlled comparisons, and key instruments cover only a 4.86-day window. Artifacts are public and replayable, supporting partial reproducibility, though model versions are deferred and the expert human factor is not reproducible.

primary_link.title: AI with Authority, from Application to Silicon

papers.summary: For sixty years, machine verification has been a major cost overhead, affordable only for exceptional artifacts. Here we report that generative AI inverts this relationship: at AI speed, machine verification is not only economical but essential to productivity --- it is the incorruptible referee that lets one person safely direct autonomous machine work at scale. In five weeks, one researcher on consumer AI subscriptions directed a small fleet of AI agents from application code, through a verifi
papers.summary_zh: 六十年來機器驗證始終是昂貴的成本負擔，僅適用於少數里程碑產物。本文報告生成式 AI 反轉了這個關係：在 AI 速度下，機器驗證不僅經濟，更是生產力的必要條件——它是讓一個人能安全指揮自主機器工作的公正裁判。作者提出 Salt 方法，以 Lean 4 核心作為不可腐化的裁判：數學主張以核心檢驗的工件在代理間傳遞，人類注意力只保留給陳述、設計與裁決；每項任務交付實作、規格、機器檢驗證明、對抗性測試與簡化憑證五項工件，並輔以五個 AI 代理席位、僅限附加的錯誤帳本與預算機制。案例研究在五週內、僅靠消費級訂閱，由一人指揮小型代理艦隊，從應用程式碼、經過驗證的編譯器與執行器，到透過社群晶片航次完成下線的 RISC-V 處理器，全程無證明經人類審查、無人工撰寫 RTL。量化結果包括 37 天產出逾 32 萬行 Lean（約 mathlib 的 29.3%）、2,087 次提交且零錯誤證明入冊，錯誤帳本編號至 #256。限制為未觸及孿生質數猜想、硬體驗證鏈存在僅以 SAT 檢驗的環節，且屬單一專家案例。此研究證明機器驗證在 AI 時代反轉為生產力前提，深具指標意義。

links.title: SAC-Copula: Quality-Preserving Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models via Smooth Correlated Gumbel Fields

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology: watermarking for diffusion language models (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) matching LLM and AI Safety/detection preferences, not image diffusion. The contribution — replacing i.i.d. Gumbel perturbations with locally correlated Gumbel fields via a Gaussian copula, plus a covariance-aware matched-filter detector (FFR/GO-FFR) — is a genuine but incremental design-dimension extension of Bagchi-style DLM watermarking; the detector is standard ridge-regularized matched filtering. Rigor is above average: matched i.i.d. baseline (rho=0 endpoint of same tape family, Section 2), rho-sweep ablation, detector-readout and common-detector controls, calibration size/source/threshold-transfer tests, and honest failure analyses. However, the headline quality claim (upper-tail PPL stability) has weak statistical support (Appendix C.9 Table 18: collapse-rate difference -0.025, McNemar p=0.125; median-PPL difference CI includes 0; SAC lower-PPL win rate 0.485), the mechanism analysis is an honestly-labeled latent proxy, and eval sets are small (200). Detection evidence is strong (AUC 0.990, TPR@1%FPR 0.980; Table 1) and transfers to Dream-7B and C4-en (Table 2). Generalizability is limited to masked-diffusion text models; paraphrase robustness is explicitly out of scope. Reproducibility is good (code link in Section 4, full configs in Appendix C.2), with a few fields marked unavailable.

primary_link.title: SAC-Copula: Quality-Preserving Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models via Smooth Correlated Gumbel Fields

papers.summary: Watermarking diffusion language models (DLMs) requires mechanisms compatible with iterative parallel unmasking rather than autoregressive decoding. Existing sampling-based watermarking methods typically inject position-wise i.i.d. perturbations, which can be poorly aligned with DLM decoding dynamics and degrade generation quality. We propose SAC-Copula, a quality-preserving watermarking method for DLMs based on smooth, locally correlated Gumbel perturbation fields constructed via a Gaussian copu
papers.summary_zh: 擴散語言模型（DLM）以迭代平行去遮罩方式生成文字，現有浮水印多注入位置獨立的 i.i.d. 擾動，與解碼動態不契合而降低品質。本文提出 SAC-Copula，透過高斯 copula 建構平滑且局部相關的 Gumbel 擾動場：將鍵控白噪聲經高斯核加權、雙流混合後映射回標準 Gumbel 邊際，在保留單座標 Gumbel 分佈的同時引入可控的低延遲相依性。機制分析顯示局部正相關將潛在局部差異能量自 i.i.d. 的 2 降至 2(1−ρ²r₁)，呼應 DLM 對相鄰位置一致性的偏好。偵測端提出 SAC-aware 的 FFR 偵測器，結合協變異數感知濾波與原生樣本校準，另提供 GO-FFR 以全域偏移掃描處理插入與刪除編輯。在 LLaDA-8B 與 ELI5 上，SAC-Copula 達到 AUC 0.990 與 TPR@1%FPR 0.980，相較 i.i.d. 基線，PPL 99 百分位從 4256 大幅降至 99.65，嚴重尾部失敗由 3.5% 降至 1.0%；於 Dream-7B 與 C4-en 的轉移實驗亦驗證泛化能力。限制包括改寫式攻擊與累積同步漂移仍未解決，且部署需私有 tape 存取與代表性校準資料。此研究將擾動場的聯合幾何視為 DLM 浮水印的關鍵設計維度。
papers.title: SAC-Copula: Quality-Preserving Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models via Smooth Correlated Gumbel Fields
papers.title_zh: SAC-Copula：透過平滑相關 Gumbel 場為擴散語言模型提供品質保留浮水印

links.title: Generation of Web Apps with Agentic IDEs: An Empirical Assessment

evidence: Page 4, Section 3.3: '48 generated project instances overall: 5 projects × 3 Agentic IDEs × 3 repetitions plus 3 runs repeated for the Note Manager'; fixed stack (FastAPI backend, plain HTML/CSS/JS frontend, pytest) to control variability.

Pages 5-6, Section 3.4: six-dimension validation protocol (installation, frontend acceptance, backend API tests, persistence, AI-test execution, project structure) with structured corrective prompts capped at 10 iterations; Lighthouse and SonarQube for auditing.
Page 6, Table 1: average errors per project 1.67 (Copilot), 2.87 (Cursor), 1.93 (Windsurf); backend coverage 71.2%/77.7%/66.94%.
Page 8, Table 2: tests are the dominant error area (1.06 of 2.16 average errors, ≈49%, consistent with the abstract's 49.6% claim); persistence and project-structure errors are zero across IDEs.

Page 9, Section 4.4/Table 5: Claude Sonnet 4.5 rerun raises Note Manager backend coverage from 48-63% to 96-99%, cuts corrective iterations to 0-0.33 and eliminates regressions; some delta labels use inverted signs (e.g., '+84%' for an 84% time reduction), a presentation flaw.
Page 10, Section 4.5: authors acknowledge construct/external/conclusion threats — checklist-based error counting, single stack, five applications, descriptive analysis without statistical tests.
Page 12, Data Availability Statement: tools, scripts, and empirical data released at https://zenodo.org/records/19208143, supporting replication.
Page 2, Related Work: ref [9] ('refractive error management: A systematic review') is cited to support claims about LLM code-generation variability, indicating citation hygiene problems.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope and strongly preference-aligned: a controlled empirical study of LLM-based coding agents (Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf running Claude Sonnet 3.5/4.5) generating full-stack apps, hitting Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM preferences. However, it is an evaluation/benchmark paper with no methodological contribution; findings (strong on CRUD/auth, weak on test generation and distributed architectures) are plausible and partly expected, capping novelty. Rigor is solid but descriptive: 48 generated projects with a six-dimension validation protocol and a model-evolution arm, yet no statistical significance testing, no inter-rater reliability for manual checks, small task set (5 apps, single FastAPI/JS stack), and sloppy citation hygiene (e.g., ref [9] on refractive error management cited for LLM code-generation variability, p.2). Quantitative claims trace to tables (e.g., tests = 1.06/2.16 avg errors ≈ 49%, matching the 49.6% abstract claim), supporting evidence strength at a descriptive level only. Generalizability is explicitly narrow (authors concede this on p.10). Materials on Zenodo plus a detailed protocol aid replication, though manual validation and fast-moving IDE/model versions limit exact reproduction.

primary_link.title: Generation of Web Apps with Agentic IDEs: An Empirical Assessment

papers.summary: Agentic IDEs are among the most significant innovations in software engineering, aiming to accelerate application development through LLM-based agents that can assist developers during development. However, their evaluation in end-to-end development tasks involving the generation of complete applications remains limited. To fill this gap, we propose a rigorous comparative analysis of three popular agentic IDEs (Copilot, Cursor, and Windsurf) in the generation of five full-stack Web applications
papers.summary_zh: 代理式 IDE 被視為軟體工程的重要革新，但其在端對端完整應用生成上的能力評估仍然有限。本文對三個主流工具（GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Windsurf）進行嚴謹比較，要求它們從零生成五個複雜度遞增的全端 Web 應用：筆記管理、身分驗證、安全檔案託管、即時聊天與分散式任務佇列，共產出 48 個專案實例，並結合自動化驗證、Lighthouse 與 SonarQube 靜態分析及人工檢查，從有效性、迭代修正、效率與模型演進四個面向分析。結果顯示對 CRUD、驗證等成熟模式，代理式 IDE 已高度成熟，錯誤少且修正迭代平均介於 1.13 至 1.73 次；差異最集中於自動化測試生成，佔全部錯誤的 49.6%，複雜分散式架構（任務佇列）錯誤明顯較多。三種 IDE 差距不大：Copilot 錯誤最少、Cursor 生成最快且測試覆蓋率最高（77.7%）、Windsurf 後端品質最佳；從 Claude Sonnet 3.5 升級至 4.5 後，錯誤大幅下降、覆蓋率升至 95–99%。限制為應用與技術堆疊範圍有限，難以推及大型工業系統。研究指出代理式 IDE 正將開發者角色轉向以自然語言指揮、驗證與除錯為主的軟體編排。
papers.title: Generation of Web Apps with Agentic IDEs: An Empirical Assessment
papers.title_zh: 以代理式 IDE 生成 Web 應用程式：實證評估

links.title: Trustworthy RAG: An Evaluation Agent for Detecting Misinformation and Knowledge Poisoning in Generative AI Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'the agent reaches 91% accuracy and 100% precision, with 100% recall on instruction injection, while in-place edits, such as entity swaps, remain hard to detect'; ROC-AUC 0.73 to 0.81 across three LLMs.

Section IV Protocol: '100 samples per run... about 15 poisoned and 85 clean samples. A naive always-trust baseline... is therefore correct on 85 clean samples, i.e. ~85% accuracy; hence Delta and F1, not accuracy, are the informative metrics.'
Table I (Section V-A): per-strategy hierarchy with entity swap at 0% recall (CI 0 to 20.4%) and Delta=0.053, described as leaving 'no surface artifacts'.
Table II (Section V-B): NLI alone yields 0% recall; 'Full + Dampener' restores 91% accuracy / 57.1% F1, attributing recall to the poison pathway and dampener.
Section V-C / Table III: 'Qwen configurations underperform the naive baseline by 14 points (71%)' attributed to hedged generation style depressing NLI entailment.
Section V-F: 'On FEVER, the full 100-sample run reaches 73% accuracy and underperforms the 85% baseline by 12 points, with separation collapsing to Delta=0.035.'
Section V-E: 'The evaluation adds ~14.7 s per sample (~17x overhead over baseline RAG), dominated by up to 20 CPU NLI passes at K=5.'

Section VI Scope and validity: 'The poisoning strategies are rule-based... This study measures detection of poisoned context before generation, while measuring whether the LLM adopts injected misinformation... requires end-to-end evaluation.'
Abstract and Section VII: 'We release the proposed approach, attack generator, and experimental artifacts at https://github.com/GPT-Laboratory/TrustworthyRAG'.
Section II related work: closest defenses [22] certifiably robust RAG and [23] trust-aware retrieval filtering are positioned against but not empirically compared in the experiments.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: RAG security, LLM misinformation/knowledge poisoning detection, NLI verification, and an evaluation layer map directly onto RAG & Knowledge, AI Safety, LLM, and Red Teaming/Evaluation preferences, with a secondary secure-coding (Code & Programming) use case. Novelty is modest: the contribution is a heuristic fusion of existing signals (NLI entailment via bart-large-mnli, linguistic/structural rules, embedding outliers) into a weighted Trust Index with a hand-tuned dampener, positioned against existing online defenses (certifiably robust RAG, trust-aware filtering) that are discussed but never empirically compared. Rigor is above average for the venue: component ablation (Table II), 2x2 LLM-embedding factorial (Table III), run-to-run variance (Table V), per-LLM threshold calibration with ROC-AUC, Wilson/bootstrap CIs, weight-perturbation analysis, and honest negative results (FEVER below naive baseline; Qwen underperforming). Evidence is limited by scale: ~15 poisoned samples per run yielding wide recall CIs the authors themselves flag, rule-based synthetic attacks only, no attack-success-rate/end-to-end measurement, and no baseline defense comparison. Generalizability is explicitly bounded: style-dependent LLM sensitivity requiring per-model calibration, cross-dataset failure on FEVER, single curated 40-rule secure-coding KB. Reproducibility is decent: released code/attack generator/artifacts, fixed seed, detailed hyperparameters, though stochastic decoding and a specific Ollama endpoint temper this.

primary_link.title: Trustworthy RAG: An Evaluation Agent for Detecting Misinformation and Knowledge Poisoning in Generative AI Systems

papers.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in external knowledge, but RAG systems usually trust whatever they retrieve, creating a Security-Reliability Gap: high semantic relevance does not guarantee factual truth. Adversaries exploit this through knowledge poisoning, inserting malicious documents to cause targeted misinformation. We propose an Evaluation Agent, middleware that combines Natural Language Inference (NLI) factual verification, a five-signal pois
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）將 LLM 輸出錨定於外部知識，但系統通常照單全收檢索結果，形成安全—可靠性落差：高語義相關不等於事實正確，攻擊者可透過知識污染注入惡意文件。本文提出 Evaluation Agent 中介層，結合 NLI 事實驗證（bart-large-mnli）、含相關性加權聚合的五訊號毒化偵測器，以及信任指數 T=0.4F+0.35C+0.25(1−P)，並對高污染情境施加非線性衰減器。在 TruthfulQA 與 Llama 3.3 70B 上，代理達到 91% 準確率與 100% 精確率，對指令注入召回率達 100%，但原位編輯（如實體替換）近乎無法偵測。跨三個 LLM 的信任指數 ROC-AUC 介於 0.73 至 0.81，顯示生成風格的影響大於模型規模，且需逐模型校準閾值；FEVER 上較弱的結果劃定了跨資料集泛化的界線。在軟體工程應用中，基於 OWASP Top 10 與 CWE 的安全編碼助理可可靠阻擋注入的不安全建議（F1 92%），但矛盾與細微語義弱化仍具挑戰。限制包括每樣本約 17 秒的評估開銷、文件級真值的保守性，以及偵測範圍僅限表面訊號。此研究在推論迴圈內建立線上信任層，並明確量化此類偵測的成敗邊界。
papers.title: Trustworthy RAG: An Evaluation Agent for Detecting Misinformation and Knowledge Poisoning in Generative AI Systems
papers.title_zh: Trustworthy RAG：偵測生成式 AI 系統中錯誤資訊與知識污染的評估代理

links.title: SAEM: Stage-Aware Expert Management for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: 'SAEM achieves an average 1.33× throughput improvement over the strongest state-of-the-art caching and offloading baselines... rising to 1.54× when calibration data matches the workload'
Sec. III, Table I: sequence-level temporal coherence TC_seq averages 89.30% across Qwen3 and ERNIE-4.5 on MATH-500, AIME 2024, GPQA-Diamond, empirically supporting the core stage-locality hypothesis

Sec. V-B: speedups over strongest baseline of 1.60×/1.47× (MATH-500), 1.20×/1.21× (AIME 2024), 1.14×/1.34× (GPQA-Diamond); text acknowledges MATH-500 is the calibration set for both cache warm-up and transition-set pruning, i.e., the largest margin is calibration-matched

Sec. V-D, Table IV: ablation at 12.5% ECR on Qwen3 shows cache update only 1.39×, token repacker only 1.46×, in-situ CPU execution alone 0.79× at BS=1 (0.99-1.00× at BS=8), all components 1.77× — includes a candid negative isolation result

Sec. V-C, Table III: prediction-oracle fixed-sequence replay reports CHR efficiency 76.09–97.80% and TP efficiency 87.87–100.78%, bounding perfect-prediction benefit to 1.08–1.14× at BS=1; the 100.78% value is attributed to sub-1% measurement variation

Sec. VI-B: limitation — cue-based detection 'may become less precise' when explicit discourse cues are absent; Sec. IV-B1 states only alternative-path-exploration transitions are handled, with broader reasoning strategies 'left for future work'

Sec. V-A2/V-A3: single hardware configuration (A100 80GB, Xeon Gold 6326, PCIe 4.0 ×16); the only reported metric is end-to-end throughput in tokens/s — no accuracy or answer-quality comparison is given anywhere despite CPU-GPU numerical divergence being acknowledged in Sec. V-C

Reproducibility: Sec. V-A3 describes implementation atop Hugging Face Transformers with PyTorch backend, but no code, artifact, or data release is mentioned anywhere in the document; transition cue sets are only exemplified ('Alternatively,' 'Instead,'), not fully enumerated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference systems paper: MoE LLM inference efficiency exploiting CoT stage structure, matching LLM (2.5), Reasoning/CoT (2.5), MoE/Transformer (1.2), Scaling & Efficiency (1.3), and Inference & Serving (1.5) preferences. Novelty is moderate: stage-level cache management via discourse cues is a fresh angle, but token repacking and CPU in-situ execution closely follow Fiddler-style and standard kernel-optimization precedents. Evaluation is solid — two MoE models, three reasoning benchmarks, four baselines, a component ablation with an honest negative result (in-situ execution alone 0.79×), and a well-designed prediction-oracle replay bounding gains at 1.08–1.14× — yet only throughput is measured with no answer-accuracy verification, results live in figures without variance estimates, and a single hardware configuration is used. Generalizability is limited by reliance on explicit English discourse cues (only alternative-path-exploration handled, per the authors' own limitation section) and calibration-set overlap on the headline dataset. No code or artifact release is stated, capping reproducibility.

primary_link.title: SAEM: Stage-Aware Expert Management for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

papers.summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves LLM reasoning by decomposing complex problems into intermediate steps, but its sequential nature increases decoding latency and memory usage. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity through sparse expert activation, yet their full expert weights often exceed GPU memory and require costly GPU-CPU transfers. Existing runtimes treat all tokens uniformly, overlooking a key structural property of CoT traces: consecutive reasoning stages exhibit coheren
papers.summary_zh: 鏈式思考（CoT）提示透過分解問題提升 LLM 推理能力，但序列式解碼增加延遲與記憶體壓力；混合專家（MoE）模型的完整專家權重常超出 GPU 記憶體，且現有執行期將所有 token 一視同仁，忽略 CoT 軌跡中連續推理階段呈現一致且可預測的專家啟動模式。本文提出 SAEM，一個階段感知的 MoE 推理執行期：以輕量模式比對偵測「Alternatively」等話語轉換提示，即時切分推理階段；階段感知快取在邊界處以聚合的啟動統計更新專家駐留；專家對齊的 token 重打包將分散存取轉為連續批次以提升 kernel 效率；就地 CPU 執行搭配 NUMA 感知與延遲隱藏預取，避免不必要的 PCIe 傳輸。在 Qwen3-30B 與 ERNIE-4.5 上，於 MATH-500、AIME 2024 與 GPQA-Diamond 的實驗顯示，SAEM 相對最強的快取與卸載基線平均提升 1.33 倍吞吐量，校準資料匹配時可達 1.54 倍；批次 8 且 3.125% ECR 下較 Mixtral-Offloading 快 2.10 倍，預言者上限分析亦證實其接近理論最優。限制為階段偵測依賴明確文字提示，缺乏提示時效果下降，且更長上下文的擴展性尚待驗證。此系統證明利用語義結構可顯著改善資源受限環境下的 MoE 推理效率。
papers.title: SAEM: Stage-Aware Expert Management for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.title_zh: SAEM：鏈式思考推理中記憶體高效 MoE 推理的階段感知專家管理

links.title: Weighted Memory Tree: Remembering What Matters for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: WMT improves accuracy by an average of 9.97 percentage points while reducing prompt-token usage by 32.8% versus linear memory
Section 4.1: WMT outperforms the unweighted tree in all six model-benchmark combinations by 5.46-18.11 percentage points while processing fewer prompt tokens
Table 1 (Sec 4.1): GAIA-Text Qwen3-8B Full WMT 33.86% acc / 32.48M tokens vs Linear History 20.47% / 43.67M; verified arithmetic matches the 13.39pp and 25.6% claims
Section 3.1: prompt-token accounting includes all language-model calls, including base-agent reasoning, semantic memory selection, and branch summarization
Table 4 (Appendix A.3): Full WMT ASR 0.419, PRR 0.097, TSR 0.575 vs Linear Memory ASR 0.995, PRR 0.246, TSR 0.183 on 100 scenarios with 409 poisoned memories
Section 7 Limitations: evaluation limited to the GAIA benchmark family, small open-weight models only, and a new task tree per question so the cross-conversation global-memory mode is never evaluated
Section 7: retention scores estimate operational utility rather than factual correctness; a misleading memory recorded as a successful action starts at u_success=0.75 (worked example, Appendix A.4)

Appendix A.2: fixed coefficients (alpha,beta,gamma,delta)=(0.60,0.30,0.20,0.20) and tau_obs=0.10 disclosed, but Section 2.4's decay rate rho, rho_G, and max streak exponent M are never assigned values and no code release is mentioned
Section 5: MemGPT, Generative Agents, HiAgent, and Context-Folding are discussed as related work but none are run as baselines; comparison is restricted to linear history and internal ablations
Appendix A.5: retained benchmark artifacts lack per-execution wall-clock ledger, utilization traces, and power measurements; no GPU-hours or energy reported
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-fit paper on LLM-agent memory management: hierarchical task/action memory with dynamic retention scoring, lifecycle folding/suppression, and utility-aware prompt synthesis, evaluated on GAIA/GAIA-Text with three 8B-class models plus a memory-poisoning robustness study. Preference relevance is high (agents, memory/long-context, safety, efficiency all directly engaged). Novelty is moderate: the tree structure follows TME and folding follows Context-Folding (Sun et al. 2026); the contribution is the fixed hand-specified retention scores (event-based Eq. 2, selection-based decay Eq. 4-5), branch aggregation (Eq. 6), and suppression thresholding, which are sensible but incremental and not learned. Rigor is decent: four primary baselines plus component ablations (Tables 2-3), three models, careful token accounting that includes auxiliary selector/summarizer calls (Sec 3.1), and matched poisoning scenarios across configurations. However there are no significance tests or variance estimates on 127/165-question splits, no sensitivity analysis over fixed coefficients, and no comparison to external memory baselines (MemGPT, HiAgent, Generative Agents are cited but not run). Evidence strength is moderately strong: the headline 9.97pp/32.8% figures check out against Table 1, and A.5 is unusually transparent about what was not logged; yet the poisoning corpus is self-constructed, latency values (e.g., 0.022 ms) look unit-suspicious, and results rest on single runs. Generalizability is limited by GAIA-only evaluation, small models only, and one-shot-only memory trees, all honestly acknowledged in Sec 7. Reproducibility is partial: coefficients and thresholds are given in A.2, but the decay rate rho, global rate rho_G, and streak cap M are never instantiated, and no code or artifact release is stated; poisoning scenarios lack construction detail.

primary_link.title: Weighted Memory Tree: Remembering What Matters for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated the ability to solve multi-step tasks requiring planning, tool use, and external information access, yet growing execution histories increase inference cost and expose reasoning to outdated, irrelevant, or misleading information, potentially degrading reasoning quality. Existing memory approaches organize or compress execution histories but provide limited mechanisms for deciding which memories remain active. We introduce the, a hierarchical me
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理在執行長程任務時，互動歷史不斷累積，不僅推高推論成本，也讓推理暴露於過時或誤導性資訊。本文提出加權記憶樹（WMT），將執行歷程組織為任務、子任務與動作節點，並為每個記憶賦予動態保留分數：事件式更新依執行成敗設定初始分數，選擇式衰減則對多次落選的記憶逐步降權。記憶控制器據此摺疊已完成分支、壓制低優先度分支，並在恢復執行時重新開啟；提示合成器結合語意選擇與保留分數，建構精簡的工作脈絡。在 GAIA-Text 與 GAIA 上以 Qwen3-8B、Gemma 4 E4B、Llama-3.1-8B 評估，相較線性記憶基準，WMT 平均提升 9.97 個百分點準確率並減少 32.8% 提示詞元用量。記憶污染實驗顯示 WMT 降低攻擊成功率、毒化檢索率與波及範圍，同時維持最高的任務成功率。消融研究證明層級結構、生命週期管理與語意檢索缺一不可，僅有樹狀組織並不足夠。限制在於僅評估 GAIA 系列基準、使用 8B 級開源模型，且保留分數衡量的是操作效用而非事實正確性，可能壓制有用記憶或保留誤導內容。此研究指出長程代理記憶的關鍵不在儲存更多資訊，而在持續決定哪些資訊該保持活躍。
papers.title: Weighted Memory Tree: Remembering What Matters for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 加權記憶樹：為長程 LLM 代理記住真正重要的事

links.title: Mitigating Database Leakage in RAG Systems with Keyword-Grounded Fact Substitution

evidence: Abstract/Sec. 1: proposes KFS-RAG, replacing retrieved context with keyword-grounded facts via attention rollout plus causal perturbation, using an auxiliary LLM (DeepSeek-V3) for fact extraction.
Sec. 4.1: pipeline uses bge-large-en-v1.5 retriever, Llama3-8B-Instruct generator, GPT-2 AP backbone, k_cand=3 candidates and k_out=1 keyword; DeepSeek-V3 as fact extractor.

Table 1 (Sec. 4.2): KFS-RAG-Fact ODQA BLEU-1 0.096 vs Vanilla 0.083, but 2WikiMultiHopQA 0.335 vs Vanilla 0.408 and HealthcareMagic 0.135 vs SAGE 0.138, partially contradicting the 'consistently outperforming' utility claim.
Tables 2-4 (Sec. 4.3): under targeted attack on ODQA, KFS-RAG-Fact lowers CRR from 70.8% (Vanilla) to 21.03%, with leakage BLEU-1 0.039 vs 0.754.

Table 8 (Appendix A.4): 2WikiMultiHopQA targeted-attack leakage BLEU-1 0.372 with Llama-3 AP backbone vs 0.077 with GPT-2, despite Sec. 4.4 text claiming the privacy-utility pattern 'remains stable' across AP backbones.

Table 5 (Sec. 4.4): perturbation-only variant reaches higher utility (0.103/0.183) than full KFS-RAG-Fact (0.088/0.158) at 8.60s vs 6.67s latency; KFS-RAG-Fact utility values here differ from Table 1 (0.096/0.140).
Appendix A.3/Table 6: context-side adversarial instructions embedded in retrieved documents; KFS-RAG reduces ODQA untargeted CRR to 24.03% vs Vanilla 72.4%.
Appendix A.7/Table 9: additional baselines (LLM summarization, advanced RAG, prompt hardening) show a utility-leakage trade-off consistent with KFS-RAG's positioning.
Limitations section: method restricted to single-turn, unimodal text settings; no code or data release is mentioned anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A RAG-security defense paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, RAG & Knowledge, AI Safety, red-teaming/evaluation): it defends RAG pipelines against prompt-injection database leakage by substituting retrieved context with keyword-grounded facts identified via a two-stage attention-rollout + causal-perturbation mechanism, then LLM fact extraction. Preference relevance is high but the paper is a defense/system contribution rather than core LLM methodology. Novelty is moderate: it composes known techniques (attention rollout, loss-based perturbation importance, auxiliary-LLM extraction, in-context re-synthesis) into a new pipeline; the closest alternatives (SAGE synthesis, DP-RAG, TEE-based RemoteRAG) are positioned but the core idea is incremental. Rigor is reasonable: three dataset families, five baseline groups, targeted/untargeted plus context-side attacks, latency ablation, and model-sensitivity checks (Secs. 4.1-4.4, Appendix A.3-A.8). However, no statistical significance or variance reporting, BLEU/ROUGE against references is a weak utility metric for QA, and default k_out=1 keyword is restrictive. Evidence strength is undercut by internal inconsistencies and overstated claims: Table 1 shows KFS-RAG-Fact losing to Vanilla RAG on 2WikiMultiHopQA (0.335 vs 0.408 BLEU-1) and to SAGE on HealthcareMagic (0.135 vs 0.138) despite 'consistently outperforming' claims (Sec. 4.2); Appendix A.4/Table 8 leakage BLEU-1 jumps from 0.077 (GPT-2 AP) to 0.372 (Llama-3 AP) on 2WikiMultiHopQA while the text claims the privacy-utility pattern 'remains stable'; Table 5 utility values (0.088/0.158) disagree with Table 1 (0.096/0.140) for the same ODQA KFS-RAG-Fact setting. Generalizability is supported by two generators (Llama3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B) and multiple auxiliary models, but limited to English, single-turn, text-only (Limitations). Reproducibility: models, hyperparameters (k_cand=3, k_out=1), Algorithm 1, and metric definitions are given, but no code or data release is stated. No evidence of out-of-scope domain application, so the 0.20 cap does not apply.

primary_link.title: Mitigating Database Leakage in RAG Systems with Keyword-Grounded Fact Substitution

papers.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for combining large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge sources. However, RAG systems remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, which may mislead the retriever or generator to expose sensitive database contents. To address this issue, we propose KFS-RAG, a defense that mitigates information leakage by reformulating the retrieved context. Specifically, our method first identifies a small set of influential key
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）系統容易受到提示注入攻擊，攻擊者可誘導檢索器或生成器洩漏資料庫的敏感內容。既有防護如合成文件、差分隱私或加密隔離，各自面臨資訊粒度不足、依賴上下文冗餘或可用性受限等問題。本文提出 KFS-RAG，在檢索之後、生成之前介入：先以輕量的注意力—擾動機制辨識與查詢最相關的關鍵字，第一階段用 attention rollout 產生高召回候選詞，第二階段以遮蔽詞彙造成的損失變化做因果驗證；再由輔助 LLM 依關鍵字擷取精煉的事實集取代原始檢索上下文，並施加長度限制以縮小攻擊面；另提供選用的上下文再合成步驟，恢復文體與對話細節。在 ODQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 與 HealthcareMagic 三類任務上，KFS-RAG-Fact 在針對性與非針對性注入攻擊下，大幅降低 BLEU、ROUGE-L、語意相似度、編輯距離與區塊還原率等洩漏指標，同時答案效用與原始 RAG 相當甚至更佳。消融顯示關鍵字數量、AP 骨幹與事實擷取模型的選擇影響隱私—效用權衡，再合成步驟會略微增加洩漏風險。限制包括僅涵蓋單輪、純文字的設定，未處理多輪對話與多模態場景，是未來重要的延伸方向。
