evidence: Abstract: Across six model-task pairs ArrowRevelio recovers 99.92-100% of hidden vector correspondences; classification models achieve 94.39-99.54% victim agreement with at most 1.59 pp accuracy difference.

Section III-B: identifies three gaps in the LWE argument - reduction in the wrong direction, quantization producing A^T S ≈ Δ^2 W_obf H~^{-1} versus B-E ≈ Δ W_obf H~^{-1}, and A,E,S distributions derived from victim weights that do not match standard LWE.
Table II: permutation accuracy 99.95 (ViT-B/16/CIFAR-100), 100.00 (BERT/SST-2, GPT-2/SST-2), 99.92 (ViT/Kvasir-SEG), 100.00 (SD 2.1 Jewelry/Emoji) with mean true-match rank 1.00-1.31.
Table III: ViT/CIFAR-100 victim 92.37 vs recovered 90.78 accuracy with 94.39% agreement; Kvasir-SEG Dice 89.61 vs 87.58 with 98.35% output agreement.

Table VI: higher-rank masking on BERT-base/SST-2 keeps permutation accuracy 100% through r=256 and 99.98% at r=512 while victim agreement falls from 95.53% to 48.05%; Section VII-B estimates rank-512 TEE correction cost approaches the no-offloading baseline.
Section VI-E: end-to-end attack runtime 11.531 s at r=1 and 17.170 s at r=32 on BERT-base/SST-2 (EPYC 9115, RTX 6000).
Section VI-A: attack receives only W_pre and W_obf; ArrowCloak instantiated from its released implementation with secrets resampled per layer; victim weights and secrets used only for evaluation.

Appendix C Table VIII: automatic rank estimator returns true rank in 72/72 layers for all r in {2,...,512}; Table IX: exact GPT-2 reference scores 0.80472 vs 0.00921 for an independently pretrained checkpoint (perm. acc. 100.00% vs 0.09%).

Section V Propositions: rank-one spectral dominance gives δ/λ_mask=O(n^{-1/2}), sin^2θ ≤ 2δ/λ_mask, and projector error ≤ sqrt(2δ/λ_mask); Appendix B reports min r_v=0.56 and min c_v=0.33 with the caveat that finite-width checks do not prove the asymptotic conditions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed ML-security paper in the LLM deployment-protection niche: it audits ArrowCloak's LWE hardness claim (reduction direction, quantization mismatch with an extra Δ factor, joint-distribution mismatch, Section III-B) and introduces ArrowRevelio, a query-free SVD+Hungarian-matching attack exploiting the shared rank-r mask subspace. Preference relevance is moderate: the TEE-Shielded LLM Partitioning framing and BERT/GPT-2/SST-2 victims connect to LLMs and AI safety/attack themes, but the core methodology is linear-algebraic cryptanalysis of a weight-obfuscation scheme rather than LLM or language methodology. Rigor is strong: formal propositions with sound proofs (spectral dominance yielding δ/λ_mask=O(n^{-1/2}), sinθ=O(n^{-1/4})), complexity analysis, controlled Gaussian-E victim, rank-inference and reference-selection ablations, and honest reporting that rank-512 masking cuts victim agreement to 48.05% (Table VI). Evidence is detailed and quantitative (Tables II-IX) though confined to the authors' instantiation of one specific defense using its released implementation, with no stated release of the attack code. Generalizability is bounded by the strong threat-model assumption of the exact public initialization checkpoint and applicability mainly to shared low-rank-mask defenses. Not domain-application or pure-CV work, so no out-of-scope cap applies.

primary_link.title: Hiding Directions, Leaking Structure: Breaking ArrowCloak through Low-Rank Structure

papers.summary: TEE-shielded inference keeps sensitive state in a trusted execution environment (TEE) while offloading linear algebra to an untrusted accelerator. Wang et al., in Game of Arrows (USENIX Security 2025), showed that five widely adopted lightweight defenses preserve vector directions and introduced ArrowMatch to exploit this leakage. They then proposed ArrowCloak, which adds a different multiple of one shared mask direction to each vector and bases its weight-recovery hardness argument on Learning
papers.summary_zh: TEE 遮蔽式推論將敏感模型狀態留在可信執行環境，而把線性代數運算外包給不可信的加速器。ArrowCloak 透過對每個權重向量加上共享遮罩方向的倍數並重新排列，宣稱其權重還原難度可奠基於 Learning with Errors（LWE）。本文從密碼學與結構兩個角度重新檢視：其 LWE 映射的歸約方向錯誤、量化算術不符模數關係、聯合分佈也不符合標準 LWE，因此硬度論證不成立。更關鍵的是，重用單一遮罩方向使曝光矩陣殘留可還原的秩一結構。作者據此提出 ArrowRevelio，一種無需查詢的端對端攻擊：以 SVD 估計並移除共享遮罩子空間，用匈牙利演算法解一對一指派還原隱藏排列，再以最小平方法重建權重，且不需要轉換秘密、受害者查詢或微調資料。在 ViT-B/16、BERT-base、GPT-2、Kvasir-SEG 與 SD 2.1 等六組模型—任務組合上，排列還原率達 99.92–100%，分類模型與受害模型的一致率為 94.39–99.54%，準確率差距不超過 1.59 個百分點。提高遮罩秩至 512 雖將一致率降至 48.05%，但排列還原仍近乎完美，且 TEE 計算成本隨秩線性增加。此結果顯示輕量防護必須同時處理逐向量的幾何洩漏與跨向量的聯合結構洩漏。
papers.title: Hiding Directions, Leaking Structure: Breaking ArrowCloak through Low-Rank Structure
papers.title_zh: 隱藏方向、洩漏結構：以低秩結構破解 ArrowCloak

Appendix C: 'Every per-model Yes/No interval and every per-scale mean interval excludes zero', with five individual UCF-Crime pairs (e.g., Qwen3-VL-8B 0–9 float +0.99 [-0.92,+2.35]) honestly listed as exceptions

llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically excellent study of how VLM answers become anomaly scores, but its topic fit to the stated preferences is partial. The core insight—reading the full answer-token distribution instead of the decoded argmax, and the resulting 'rank compression'—is genuinely a language-model methodology finding, explicitly extending G-Eval/LLM-ranker results (Section 2) and matching Multimodal AI, Evaluation, and Prompting preferences; however, the demonstration domain is video anomaly detection on two surveillance benchmarks, with no Japanese NLP, agents, reasoning, code, or RAG content, and VLM-as-detector work sits near the CV/video periphery (though not 'pure CV' since the contribution is the language readout interface). Novelty is moderate: the Prob-over-Gen repair is acknowledged as established in LLM evaluation; the new value is the controlled characterization, the mechanism decomposition, and the domain-specific surprises (finer scales don't help Prob, AP tie sensitivity, smoothing conceals the loss). Rigor is exemplary: paired same-forward-pass comparisons, a measured verification of the greedy-decoder idealization (Appendix F), 10,000-replicate paired video bootstrap (Appendix C), oracle-threshold separation of threshold placement from compression (Table 11), cross-model transfer (Appendix M), model-size controls (Appendix L), and a candid limitations section. Evidence is strong and internally consistent (Table 1 means match Tables 3-4; decomposition in Table 10), with honest reporting of five bootstrap intervals including zero. Generalizability is limited by the authors' own admission (four fixed models, two benchmarks, one protocol; API models without logprobs cannot apply the remedy). Reproducibility is high-quality (exact HF checkpoints, verbatim prompts in Appendix D, estimator and bfloat16 accounting in Appendices O/T), but code is only promised ('will be released'), not yet available.
topics: AUROC and AP tie sensitivity and estimator choice

A VLM-based detector should therefore define an answer interface: the answer scale specifies the admissible answers, and the readout rule maps the model's output distribution to a score. Because this interface can change the evaluated ranking, it is part o
papers.summary_zh: 以視覺—語言模型進行免訓練影片異常偵測時，常見流程是讓模型對每個片段回答問題，再把答案轉成純量分數供 AUROC 與 AP 排序。本文指出這個答案介面——包含答案尺度與讀出規則——是偵測器的一部分，而非格式細節。生成式讀出只取最可能答案，使分佈不同但答案相同的片段被迫並列，作者稱之為生成答案排序壓縮；機率讀出則對可容許答案的完整分佈取期望值，保留答案內部的排序訊號。在四個 7–8B 開源 VLM、七種答案尺度、UCF-Crime 與 XD-Violence 兩個基準上，機率讀出在全部 28 個尺度—指標組合皆勝出，主指標平均增益於 UCF-Crime 為 7.66 AUROC、XD-Violence 為 10.97 AP。機制分析顯示，僅以機率打破生成分數的並列即可解釋 93–95% 的差距；即使浮點提示允許 91 個答案，生成讀出仍只產出 4–18 個相異分數，且 AP 對並列排序方式極為敏感，區間可超過 42 點。此優勢在各種解碼策略、提示改寫與平滑處理下皆成立，但先解碼解釋會壓縮答案分佈而縮小差距。限制包括模型集固定、指標僅反映未平滑的排序品質，且機率讀出需要能存取答案似然，閉源介面無法受益。

(i) Memory Challenge: a shopping session spans dozens of pages, yet existing agents either discard long-range observation histories, losing the evolving user state, or naively concatenate them, overwhelming the context window and
papers.summary_zh: 模擬真實的電商購物行為是離線評估與強化學習推薦系統的基礎，但既有模擬器面臨兩大挑戰：記憶問題——瀏覽歷程橫跨數十頁，捨棄歷史會失去長程依賴，拼接全部畫面又會撐爆上下文並降低品質；最佳化問題——逐步模仿監督無法察覺或矯正過度探索、過度被動等不真實的行為模式。本文提出 GUI 代理 RecVerse，以像素級截圖感知推薦頁面，並採認知科學啟發的三層記憶：工作記憶保存近期視覺脈絡、情節記憶記錄會話級事件、偏好記憶蒸餾高層使用者意圖；記憶更新被視為動作的一部分，與瀏覽行為一起透過強化學習學習何時記、記什麼。在最佳化上，RecVerse 以 GRPO 為基礎的軌跡級 RL 取代逐步模仿，結合對齊行為分佈的宏觀獎勵與意圖加權類別比對的微觀獎勵。作者同時釋出含 5,274 條真實軌跡、支援互動多輪強化學習的 USB 基準。實驗顯示 RecVerse-GUI 搭配 RL 在行為保真與意圖一致性上顯著優於 STA 等基準，人類評估中 92% 偏好 RecVerse 而非 STA；不過與真實使用者仍有 74% 偏好差距，指向更深入的個人化建模仍是未來課題。

links.title: DirEAG: Dirichlet Evidence Aggregation for Calibrating Verbalized Confidence in Mathematical Reasoning

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: paper targets black-box verbalized confidence calibration for LLM mathematical reasoning (GSM8K, SVAMP, GSM-Hard) with Qwen/Mistral/Gemma — strong overlap with top-weighted preferences (LLMs, Reasoning/CoT, Prompting); not an out-of-scope domain application.

Section 3: method = Platt-style per-level transforms + Dirichlet evidence over candidate answers plus null state + final binary Platt calibration; components are individually standard (Platt 1999, evidential Dirichlet priors, SteerConf steering from [20]), so novelty is an incremental recombination rather than a new mechanism.

Section 4.3 / Table 2: 'Count-only + Cal.' achieves ECE 0.0366 vs Full DirEAG 0.0280 (Qwen/GSM8K) and 0.0491 vs 0.0403 (Mistral/SVAMP); '+ Level Reliability' changes almost nothing — the paper itself concedes most calibration gain comes from the final binary calibrator, which weakens the core contribution's added value.

Section 4.2 / Table 1: no statistical significance tests, confidence intervals, or seed variance reported despite 3x3 model-dataset grid; several margins are very small (e.g., Mistral GSM8K ECE 0.0585 vs mean-confidence 0.0589), and self-consistency often beats DirEAG on accuracy (0.9265 vs 0.8908 on Qwen/GSM8K).

Section 4.4: base-rate diagnostic (Eq. 14) showing AUROC gains of ~0.229-0.362 over a constant predictor and null-state probability analysis (Fig. 3) is a genuinely informative addition supporting instance-level signal.
Limitations section: explicitly restricted to exact-match numerical reasoning and 7-9B open-weight models; no open-ended, multimodal, or frontier-model evaluation — generalizability is bounded.

Section 4.1 & Appendix: cross-fitting for SVAMP/GSM-Hard, evaluated examples excluded from fitting, aligned five-observation protocol across baselines, and released code with exact metric implementation (github.com/horacehsugithub/DirEAG) support reproducibility, though hyperparameters are deferred to the repo and cannot be verified from the text.

When the same problem is queried under multiple confidence-steering prompts, the resulting answer-confidence observations contain useful uncertainty information, yet their scales may shift across steering levels, models, and datasets. Existing black-box uncertainty methods often rely on answer agreement, sample consistency, or entro
papers.summary_zh: 在數學推理中使用大型語言模型時，可靠的信心估計至關重要，但黑盒設定下的言語化信心難以校準：同一題目在不同信心導引提示下產生的答案—信心觀測，其尺度會隨提示層級、模型與資料集漂移。既有黑盒不確定性方法多依賴答案一致性或熵，只描述輸出變異而未建模自報信心的數值意義；直接平均或啟發式聚合則無法學得提示與任務相關的偏差。本文提出 DirEAG，一種 Dirichlet 證據聚合方法：先以 Platt 式單調轉換校準每個自報信心，再將其轉為候選答案空間上的軟證據，並額外引入虛空狀態以表示所有生成答案皆錯的情況；模型在 held-out 校準集上學習各導引層級的可靠度權重，最後以第二次 Platt 校準將選中答案的後驗質量映射為經驗正確機率。在 GSM8K、SVAMP、GSM-Hard 上以 Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B 評估，DirEAG 在多數設定下相較直接平均與 SteerConf 式聚合取得更低的 ECE，答案選擇維持競爭力；消融顯示信心證據與最終二元校準分別作用於候選排序與機率尺度。逐題診斷顯示其 Brier 分數低於常數基率預測器，AUROC 增益 0.229–0.362。限制是僅涵蓋可精確比對數值的數學推理任務。

evidence: Abstract: routing introduces negligible accuracy change vs parameter-matched baselines; contextual gate achieves p<10^-10 faithfulness separation on both tasks without changing accuracy
Section V-A Table II: SEWN variants (68.85-69.20 BoolQ) fail to beat BERT-base (71.96) or a content-only ablation (69.68), and are statistically indistinguishable from a uniform 0.5 gate (68.76)
Section V-B: RoBERTa/BoolQ contextual gate fails faithfulness (p=0.177); swept prior size 0/100/259/269/839 plus 839 random ids with no condition passing and no trend (Fig. 3)

Section V-G Table X: SEWN-random-topk ablation yields non-significant faithfulness (p=0.45) with identical bottleneck, isolating learned ranking; Mixture-of-Depths passes top-vs-random (p=1.3e-6) but fails the strict top>random>bottom ordering
Section V-E Table VII: raw attention passes faithfulness at near-zero cost, matching SEWN's gate, a claim the authors explicitly retract; integrated gradients costs 46x inference

Section VII Limitations: no comparison against released PoWER-BERT/TR-BERT/Learned Token Pruning/ToMe implementations; n=200 faithfulness tests with no multiple-comparisons correction; PubMedQA uses non-standard pqa_artificial class-balanced subset not comparable to leaderboard

Appendix Reproducibility Notes: seeds {42,123,456}, fixed recipe, per-table JSON result files listed in an accompanying repository; exception that Table VII throughput columns were console-only with no saved artifact

Section V-F Table IX: efficiency/accuracy trade-off holds on binary QA and sentiment but collapses on RACE (SEWN-sparse 42.97 vs BERT-base 66.25), with DistilBERT also dropping 13.1 points, reported as a general compressed-model capacity limitation
llm_evaluation.rationale: Methodologically careful BERT-scale study of token routing that rigorously tests efficiency and interpretability claims, but targets mid-weight preferences (transformer efficiency, interpretability, evaluation) rather than the top-weighted LLM/agents/reasoning areas. Rigor is a standout: 3-seed protocol with std devs, parameter-matched ablations, a random-selection falsification control (Section V-G, p=0.45), a direct Mixture-of-Depths reimplementation, and an honest RoBERTa/BoolQ non-replication with a 0-839 prior-size/coverage/content confound sweep (Section V-B). Evidence is largely internally consistent and quantified, though faithfulness tests use n=200 without multiple-comparison correction and throughput for Table VII lacks a saved artifact. Generalizability is explicitly narrowed: BERT-base scale only, backbone-dependent faithfulness, and a RACE capacity collapse acknowledged (Sections VI-VII). Novelty is solid but methodological rather than architectural; the paper itself disclaims SOTA and builds on ERASER-style masking, Jain & Wallace, and MoD.
topics: interpretability and faithfulness of routing gates

primary_link.title: Sparse Token Routing in Efficient Transformers

papers.summary: Efficient-transformer research often motivates token pruning and adaptive computation with the claim that not all tokens require equal computational effort. We test this claim end to end using SEWN, a two-stream Transformer that routes tokens through either lightweight or full-capacity processing using a learned gate. Across our experiments, routing introduces negligible accuracy change relative to parameter-matched baselines, while the gate's token-importance signal depends critically on how it
papers.summary_zh: 高效能 Transformer 研究常主張並非所有詞元都需要同等計算量，但效率主張與可解釋性主張往往被捆綁在一起。本文以 SEWN——一個以可學習閘門將詞元路由至輕量或全容量雙流的 Transformer——端對端檢驗兩項主張。結果顯示，相對於參數匹配基準，路由帶來的準確率變化可忽略，而閘門的重要性訊號高度依賴學習方式：以功能詞詞典初始化的靜態先驗閘門在 BoolQ 的反事實遮罩測試中失敗，完全依賴上下文的閘門則在兩個任務上皆達 p<10⁻¹⁰ 的顯著分離。SEWN-sparse 在昂貴串流前執行硬性 top-k 選擇，相較 BERT-base 取得 5.2–8.7 倍吞吐量、相較 DistilBERT 為 2.6–4.4 倍，並在 2.7 萬例的 PubMedQA 上維持可接受的準確率折衷；與原始注意力、attention rollout、integrated gradients 的比較中，SEWN-sparse 提供最強的忠實性—效率權衡，而 integrated gradients 成本高達 46 倍。隨機選擇消融僅損失 2.6 點準確率卻消除忠實性（p=0.45），證明效果來自學得的詞元排序而非瓶頸本身；直接重實作的 Mixture-of-Depths 有訊號但未通過嚴格排序準則。作者亦誠實回報：靜態先驗結果無法在 RoBERTa/BoolQ 複現，且長篇章多選閱讀理解上所有壓縮模型都出現容量崩潰。

links.title: EviRank: Structured Relevance Evidence for Multimodal Image Re-ranking

evidence: Section 4.1: teacher = Gemini-3-flash/pro at temperature 0.15; online budget fixed at two MLLM calls per query; student = Qwen3-VL-2B-Thinking distilled on 20k queries
Section 4.2: EviRank-pro attains 95.61% R@1 on Flickr30k (BLIP-2 backbone), +6.32 over CoTMR; 69.53% R@1 on COCO (CLIP-ViT-L/14), +9.6 over CoTRR
Tables 6-7: ablations removing B0/Slots/Evidence/Required/Forbidden/Ignore with drops up to -13.5% on FashionIQ Toptee (w/o Evidence)
Table 9 and Appendix K: free-form augmentation gives +0.5 R@1 on COCO vs +6.5 for structured evidence; prompt-template rewrites vary <0.7 R@1
Section 4.5 / Appendix J: cross-teacher stability Kendall's tau >= 0.89, Top-1 agreement >= 91% across Gemini-3-pro, GPT-5.4, Claude-4.6-Opus/Sonnet, Gemini-3-flash
Appendix D.3 and Table 11: full distillation config (AdamW, lr 5e-5, 10 epochs, 8x H20), prompts fully specified in Appendix H; code link in abstract
Table 6 header vs Table 4: ablation claims CLIP-ViT-L/14 for I-to-I but CUB-200 EviRank-pro 99.4 R@4 matches DINOv2 main result 99.44, indicating a labeling inconsistency
Limitations section: English-only public benchmarks, still images only, offline metrics without human-facing user studies
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal re-ranking paper whose methodology is genuinely language-model-centric: an MLLM teacher (Gemini-3-flash/pro) parses queries via structured prompting into typed required/forbidden/ignorable evidence over six semantic slots, verification replaces free-form CoT, and the structured evidence is distilled into a Qwen3-VL-2B student (Section 3, Appendix D.3). This squarely engages the Reasoning/CoT, Prompting, Multimodal AI, and distillation preferences; it is not pure computer vision since the contribution is a language-grounded verification formulation, so it clears the out-of-scope bar. Novelty is solid but incremental: the decompose-then-verify principle is explicitly imported from NLP rubric/checklist evaluation (Section 2), with the delta being typed polarity over a fixed slot taxonomy, deterministic aggregation, and evidence-as-supervision (Table 1). Rigor is strong: five benchmarks across three paradigms, multiple backbones, component ablations (Tables 6-7), rubric-vs-listwise isolation (Table 8), prompt-perturbation and cross-teacher stability (Section 4.5, Appendix J), and a free-form-vs-structured control showing +6.5 vs +0.5 R@1 on COCO (Table 9/Appendix K). Weaknesses: no significance testing, dependence on closed-source teachers, a header/number inconsistency (Table 6 claims CLIP-ViT-L/14 for I-to-I but CUB-200 99.4 R@4 matches Table 4's DINOv2 results), and cross-backbone comparisons in Table 13. Quantitative claims are internally consistent and extensively tabulated (Tables 2-5, 13-16 cross-check), supporting solid evidence strength. Reproducibility is moderate: full prompts (Appendix H), hyperparameters (Table 11), and a code link are provided, but replication requires proprietary Gemini-3/GPT-5.4/Claude-4.6 APIs. Limitations (English-only, still images, no user studies) are honestly stated.

primary_link.title: EviRank: Structured Relevance Evidence for Multimodal Image Re-ranking

papers.summary: Real-world image search queries are multimodal and compositional: ``find this shirt in pink'' specifies an entity to retain, an attribute to modify, and context to ignore. Yet existing re-rankers either compress such multifaceted relevance into an opaque embedding or rely on free-form chain-of-thought that easily omits or hallucinates fine-grained constraints. Drawing on rubric- and checklist-based evaluation from NLP, we recast multimodal image re-ranking as a semantic constraint satisfaction p
papers.summary_zh: 真實世界的影像搜尋查詢往往是多模態且組合式的，例如「找出這件粉紅色的襯衫」同時指定要保留的實體、要修改的屬性與可忽略的脈絡。既有重新排序器不是把多面向相關性壓縮成不透明的嵌入，就是依賴容易遺漏或產生幻覺細節的自由形式思維鏈。本文借鑑 NLP 中以評分規則與檢核表進行評估的思路，將多模態影像重排重構為語意約束滿足問題，提出 EviRank：先由 MLLM 教師把任意形式的查詢解析成統一的證據封包——橫跨實體、屬性、動作、關係、場景與關鍵細節六個語意槽位，每條陳述標記為必需、禁止或可忽略；接著以證據條件化驗證重新排序，結合確定性評分規則與證據錨定的列表比較，全程免訓練。結構化證據進一步作為可分解的監督訊號，蒸餾出輕量的學生重排器。在涵蓋文字搜圖、以圖搜圖與組合式檢索的五個基準上，EviRank 達到 SOTA：BLIP-2 骨幹下 Flickr30k R@1 達 95.6%，超越 CoTMR 6.32 點；蒸餾學生保留教師九成以上能力且成本大幅降低。消融證明槽位分解、必需與禁止約束皆不可或缺，證據提取在不同教師與提示擾動下高度穩定。限制包括僅評估英文公開基準、聚焦靜態影像，且缺乏大規模上線的使用者研究。
papers.title: EviRank: Structured Relevance Evidence for Multimodal Image Re-ranking
papers.title_zh: EviRank：用於多模態影像重新排序的結構化相關性證據

links.title: Temporal Validity on Real Software Histories: Eliminating Stale-Fact Errors in Code-Assistant Memory over GitHub Fixes

evidence: Abstract: 'MemStrata reaches 0.91 answer accuracy versus RAG's 0.57–0.59' and forced RAG serves superseded value 36–38% of the time while MemStrata drives this to ≈0 at ~2.1s retrieval latency.
Section 5, Table 1: stale-fact-error forced naive_rag 0.361, advanced_rag 0.377, temporal_v6 ≈0.00; accuracy allowed 0.569/0.585/0.908; compression 48%; latency 2.16s vs 18.1s.

Section 3.2: yield '130 clean scenarios from 707 records (18.4%)'; scenarios kept only if 'the production triple extractor keys the state-A and state-B sentences identically' — selection via the method's own extractor.
Section 4, Paired-sample protocol: cached 130 scenarios with instance ids; allowed regime reproduced naive_rag 0.569 / advanced_rag 0.585 / temporal_v6 0.908 exactly from cache.
Section 5, Determinism: temporal forced stale-error read 0.015 vs 0.000 across runs ('a single answer flip on 130'); pipeline claimed bit-for-bit reproducible.

Section 6: product bug (case/punctuation-insensitive value comparison) found and fixed via strict_object_supersede; moat guardrail on synthetic code_mutation shows accuracy 1.000 and stale-fact-error 0.000 unchanged.
Section 7, Limitations: evaluates only '~18% of real fixes that are clean atomic transitions'; '130 real scenarios'; 'Single 7B local model on consumer hardware'.
Reproducibility Statement: eval/fetch_swebench.py (sha256-pinned), eval/swe_extract.py, eval/run_paper2.py, REPORT_PAPER2.md and REPORT_PAPER2_forced.md sources; no public repository URL supplied.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly preference-aligned: an LLM-agent memory paper targeting RAG's temporal-currency failure for code assistants, with SWE-bench-derived evaluation, local LLMs (Qwen2.5-Coder), and LLM reranking baselines — squarely matching Agents/RAG/Code/Memory preferences. Novelty is moderate: the deterministic supersession mechanism is inherited unchanged from 'Paper 1' (Section 3.1), so this paper's contribution is real-data validation plus a reranker negative result, on a narrow 130-scenario subset selected by the method's own production extractor (Section 3.2), which partially constrains the structural claim despite the RAG-fails-on-same-subset argument. Rigor is above average (paired cached regimes, temperature-0 determinism, forced/allowed matrix, disclosed single-answer run variance in Section 5, honest scope decoupling in Section 6/7) but judges are 3B models, n=130, no significance testing, and marker-free renderings make the task highly constrained. Evidence is self-reported by a single industry author with product-'moat' framing and no externally verifiable artifact link; tables are internally consistent (Table 1: forced stale-error 0.361/0.377 vs ≈0). Generalizability is explicitly limited to ~18% clean atomic transitions and one 7B local model (Section 7). Reproducibility is claimed strongly (sha256-pinned data, named scripts, cached scenarios, unit tests) but no public repository URL is provided.

primary_link.title: Temporal Validity on Real Software Histories: Eliminating Stale-Fact Errors in Code-Assistant Memory over GitHub Fixes

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has no model of time: when a fact changes across a coding session - a function is renamed, an endpoint moves, a dependency is bumped - RAG retrieves both the old and new value with near-identical similarity and cannot tell which is current, so it serves the superseded value. Paper 1 showed, on synthetic single-value benchmarks, that a deterministic (subject, relation, object) supersession memory eliminates this failure. Here we validate it end-to-end on real
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）缺乏時間概念：當工作階段內某個事實變動，例如函式改名或相依套件升版，RAG 會以相近相似度同時取回新舊值，無法判定何者為現行版本，因而回覆過時資訊。本文延續前作在合成基準的結果，將 MemStrata 的確定性取代式記憶端對端驗證於真實軟體史：從 SWE-bench 的 707 個真實 GitHub 議題中，萃取 130 筆乾淨的原子狀態轉移（修正前值到修正後值），並以無標記方式呈現，新舊語句僅在數值上有差異，唯一的時效訊號是順序。機制上，凡 (subject, relation) 鍵相符但物件不同的三元組即觸發取代，於雙時間軸帳本中關閉舊斷言、開啟新斷言。結果顯示 MemStrata 準確率達 0.91–0.99，RAG 僅 0.57–0.62；被迫作答時 RAG 有 36–38% 回覆被取代的舊值，LLM reranker 也無法改善，MemStrata 則趨近於零，且延遲與 RAG 相當（約 2.1 秒），並有約 48% 的記憶壓縮。限制在於僅約 18% 的真實修正屬乾淨原子轉移，擴大萃取涵蓋率是後續課題；樣本僅 130 筆、使用單一 7B 本地模型，研究中也發現並修復一個大小寫與標點不敏感比較的產品錯誤，並驗證安全性質未受損。此研究證明：對程式助理而言，記憶的關鍵難題是時效性而非召回率，確定性機制能在真實資料上消除此結構性失誤。

links.title: RAG Deserves an Index: Why Ingest-Time Compilation Beats Query-Time Interpretation

evidence: Abstract: compiled claims win 'every one of 32 budget-by-model cells' with 85.2% at ~2.2k reader tokens vs 72.5% at ~16.3k for the best chunk configuration; contextualized stack ties at ~21x tokens.

Sec 3.2: all 24 facts-vs-chunk comparisons survive Holm correction (p <= 4.9e-6) under McNemar's test; contextualized stack comparison pre-registered, tie at p=0.202 (2,048 budget) and p=0.076 (16,384), with dev-vs-held-out sign reversal explicitly reported.

Sec 3.2 fn 2: 'the grader is also Kimi K2.6, so extraction and judgment share a model; human calibration and a re-judgment under a different model family are in progress' — authors label the read-path result 'strong preliminary evidence'.

Sec 3.1: maintenance proof is a synthetic pilot (3,000 to 9,000 documents, 50 update events; 33.7x cheaper incremental updates, principal-angle drift < 1e-11), acknowledged as 'synthetic and its incremental update idealized... best-case bounds'.
Sec 2.1: validation gate admitted 69,746 byte-exactly-quoted claims and rejected 29 of 2,724 candidates (1.1%) in a 20-document replay.
Sec 4 item 7 (Honest boundaries): 'when a tool-using agent mediated retrieval, the compiled-payload advantage did not automatically survive the agent layer.'
References (15): full protocol appears in a companion report listed as 'Manuscript in preparation, 2026'; no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the paper.
Appendix A: break-even R* ~ 580 reads for a 500-document corpus, computed from a 20-document replay extrapolation; token-count equivalence caveat footnoted in Sec 3.2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core RAG/LLM systems methodology, squarely on-preference: proposes ingest-time semantic compilation (validated atomic claims as retrieval payload plus incrementally maintained embeddings) with a database-style cost model, directly targeting RAG quality, provenance, and inference cost. Not a domain application. The read-path study is unusually disciplined for a systems-position paper: held-out 500-transcript/499-question split, pre-registered contextualized-stack baseline, Holm-corrected McNemar tests, honest reporting of a sign reversal between dev and held-out (Sec 3.2), and an explicit agentic-layer failure case (Sec 4, item 7). Novelty is a competent synthesis: payload compilation (Mem0/Zep), pointer compilation (doc expansion, Dense X, contextual chunking) and incremental index maintenance (authors' own prior work, ref 14) all exist; the validated-provenance gate and contract framing are the main new pieces. Rigor and evidence are capped by self-acknowledged gaps: the maintenance proof is a synthetic, idealized pilot (3k-9k vectors, Sec 3.1); the QA judge shares a model with the extractor (Kimi K2.6) with human calibration 'in progress' (Sec 3.2 fn2); evidence is a single dialogue corpus (MediaSum-derived); and the full protocol lives in an unavailable 'manuscript in preparation' (ref 15). Reproducibility is weak: schema-level PostgreSQL description and a public dataset, but no code/artifact release, proprietary hosted models, and an unpublished companion protocol.

primary_link.title: RAG Deserves an Index: Why Ingest-Time Compilation Beats Query-Time Interpretation

papers.summary: Nearly every retrieval-augmented question-answering system in production ships with a hidden interpreter: on each query a language model re-derives the meaning of raw corpus text and then throws that work away. Cheaper models do not close the gap: per-token prices have fallen by orders of magnitude while inference spend has risen, because context volume grows faster than prices fall. This is the modern equivalent of the full-table scan, and the remedy is the one databases found fifty years ago:
papers.summary_zh: 生產環境的 RAG 系統普遍內建一個隱形直譯器：每次查詢都讓語言模型重新推導原始文本的語意——解析指涉、歸屬主張、重建結構——用完即棄。作者稱此典範為查詢時語意重建（QSR），並借鑑資料庫五十年的教訓：讀取模式已知的語料，應在寫入時就編譯成索引。他們提出 ingest-time semantic compilation（ISC），把語料編譯成具兩層的語意基板：幾何層為增量維護的向量嵌入；符號層為原子化主張，每筆主張附逐字來源片段、作者與位置，並經精確引文驗證閘門檢核，未達門檻即拒絕入庫，如同外鍵約束。基板另配備維護、遷移合約與成本模型，並導出損益兩平讀取次數 R*。兩項存在證明：合成實驗中，增量低秩更新的成本約為完整重建的 1/33.7，且精度達浮點等級；在 500 份廣播訪談逐字稿的保留測試集上，編譯主張作為檢索載荷，於 32 個預算×模型組合全數勝出，以約 2.2k 讀取 token 達 85.2% 正確率，遠優於最佳分塊設定的 72.5%（約 16.3k token）；唯一打平的情境化分塊堆疊需耗約 21 倍 token，作者論證其實已部分走向編譯。限制包括：維護實驗屬合成且理想化、萃取與評分共用同一模型家族（人工校準仍在進行）、代理式檢索情境下優勢未必延續。本文的意義在於把 RAG 重構為資料庫問題：將昂貴工作移到寫入時，以完整性約束與成本模型治理衍生的語意結構。

§6 Limitations: single same-family LLM judge, no human scoring, gap-classifier circularity (no policy-divergence label returned), sequential runs varying more than one factor, n=1 editor and n=1 procurement for post-editing.
§3.9: intended lexical corroboration failed — best lexical counts (2/44 modal openings) coincided with worst judged verdict (14/40), demonstrating metric relocation rather than improvement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A deployment study of a 43-role multi-agent LLM pipeline for tender authoring, squarely within core preferences: multi-agent orchestration, prompting/structural conditioning, LLM-as-judge evaluation, error cascades, and context compaction. The central finding — structural markup improving three reading tasks (routing 61%→97.8%, slot counts 404/280/340→310/310/310) but reversing on instruction conditioning (74%→48%, n=31 paired) — is a genuinely interesting and well-scoped empirical claim, complemented by a novel variance-amplification mechanism (deterministic windowing over stochastic annotation: 54 vs 56 slots → 68→51 questions) and an honest gap-classification evaluation methodology (68% of 70 judge gaps unavailable in sources, bracketing 73%/89%). Rigor is mixed: the paired conditioning comparison and three-run reproducibility hold one factor, and the blind ground-truth protocol is carefully verified, but the primary metric is a single same-model-family LLM judge with no human scoring, the gap classifier is acknowledged circular (policy-divergence category never returned), most comparisons confound multiple factors due to sequential development runs, and no significance testing is attempted. Evidence is internally consistent and specific but rests on 1–4 withheld commercial procurements, an unnamed sub-200B open-weights model, and n=1 for the post-edit study. Generalizability is limited by domain (tenders), single model class, and the authors' own admission that the constraint-scaffolding result may invert on frontier models (§3.6). Reproducibility is poor: no code, no named model, withheld data, default-temperature nondeterminism, though protocol descriptions in Appendices A–B support conceptual replication. Solid, unusually self-aware industrial research whose findings are suggestive rather than established.

papers.summary: Multi-agent pipelines that author formal documents must both read a requester's forms and write against them. We report a deployed tender-response system, running an open-weights model under sovereignty constraints, and evaluate it against human-written bids the same organisation actually submitted. On a blind comparison where the system had no worked example available, an LLM judge rated its answers at least as good as the human-submitted answer on $40$ of $55$ ground-truth sections, better on
papers.summary_zh: 本文評估一套已部署、在資料主權限制下運行開放權重模型的多代理投標回應系統，並與同機構實際提交的人類標書比較。系統由 43 個單次代理角色與一個多輪撰寫者組成，分六階段執行，設三道人工審核閘門。在無任何範例可用的盲測標案（T3）中，LLM 評審認為系統答案在 55 個基準區段中有 40 個（73%）不遜於人類版本、4 個更佳、無一遺漏，僅標記一項無根據主張；將 70 項缺失逐一歸因後，68% 源於系統來源中根本不存在的資訊，僅 21% 屬可得而未用，資訊可控分數升至 89%。另一標案（T4）由人類編輯從機器草稿修訂而成，最終文字有 20.5% 源自系統草稿。核心發現是條件化的不對稱性：把文件渲染成結構化標記改善了所有三個閱讀任務（標註路由覆蓋率從 61% 升至 97.8%、工作簿槽位三輪完全重現、過往標書分割六次逐位一致），但把指令素材由散文改為巢狀 XML，卻使答案品質從 74% 跌至 48%，機制在於結構改變了顯著性，使招標方成為最易取用的主詞。此外，明確點名禁忌句式會使殘餘缺陷集中在被點名的形式（96%）；把隨機標註耦合到確定性視窗函式則會放大變異，使相同檔案的問題數從 68 變為 51。限制包括單一 LLM 評審且與作者同模型家族、單一標案、部分比較未隔離單一因子。本文指出：結構屬於模型閱讀之處，寫作宜用散文與自我檢核，而評估應區分資訊可得性與寫作品質。

evidence: Abstract: CertKV is 'top-two in seven of nine LongBench-v2 settings, remains in the leading compressed tier on 128K RULER, and realizes a ten-fold cache budget in a packed Llama prototype' - the paper's own framing of its strongest empirical claims.

Section 4.2: 'After Holm correction across 36 paired comparisons, the only decisive difference is Llama at 2x versus PyramidKV: +8.75 points, 95% paired CI [3.58,13.92], exact McNemar p_Holm=0.0407. We therefore read the grid as evidence for a competitive operating point, not a universal method ranking.'

Section 3.1, Theorem 3.6 with proof in Appendix B.2: coverage budget is length-independent when log-rank gap slope exceeds one and grows polynomially below it; the proof is a p-series/integral tail test, confirming the elementary nature of the mathematics.

Section 3.2, Theorem 3.7: 'The identities follow by splitting kept and omitted terms' - the fixed-row tail factorization is exact algebra, and the minimality claim (Theorem C.2) is scoped to linear sketches recovering every sub-budget.

Section 5.2: honest negative result that 'the exact-top-k accuracy difference does not change sign as the model predicts' on downstream tasks, i.e., the controlled task law does not transfer as a calibrated decision rule.

Appendix D.3, Table 5: all four component interventions fail the pre-specified 10% practical-effect gate; the charged tail summary is 'slightly worse than assigning the same physical slot to one additional real token' (Delta=1.494e-4, p_Holm=9.180e-3).

Appendix D.1, Figure 3: cross-modal two-phase gate fails on SigLIP2/Whisper (Cohen's d=0.66/1.23 vs positive control d=7.1), explicitly limiting the empirical phase-structure claim to language models.

Appendix D.2/D.6: inference seed 42, bootstrap seed 0 with B=5000, 'Table generators and configurations are identified by SHA-256; the anonymous code release will also include the complete environment export' with a one-command validation entry point; 205.70 GPU-hours on RTX PRO 6000 disclosed.

Appendix D.2: evaluation uses all 503 LongBench-v2 examples per setting across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, Mistral-7B and full RULER at 16K-128K, establishing the LLM long-context scope of the empirical work.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Theory-plus-empirics study of KV-cache compression in transformer LLMs: strong match to LLM, Transformer Architecture, Long Context, Scaling/Efficiency, and Inference/Serving preferences, but no coverage of the highest-weight agent/reasoning/Japanese topics. The three separations (count vs coverage, output fidelity, task utility) are a useful conceptual contribution, but the underlying results are elementary: Theorem 3.6 is a p-series summability argument, Theorem 3.7 is exact sum-splitting algebra, and Theorem 3.8 uses standard Gaussian extreme-value reasoning; CertKV is an incremental combination of SnapKV scoring, Ada-KV-style budget allocation, and one synthetic tail slot. Rigor is unusually high: pre-specified grids, Holm/BH correction, disclosed seeds, and repeated explicit scoping of what the theorems do not prove (future queries, multi-layer, nonlinear summaries). Evidence strength is capped because the headline method claim is weak: only one decisive paired difference after Holm correction (Section 4.2), wide task-bootstrap uncertainty on RULER, ablation components below the pre-specified 10% practical gate, and the tail-summary component slightly worse than one extra real token for fidelity (Appendix D.3). Generalizability is moderate (5-6 model families, 4K-128K, but cross-modal phase-structure gate fails in Appendix D.1 and future-query/multi-layer theory is open). Reproducibility is strong on paper (checksums, seeds, environment export, one-command validation) though no runnable artifact is verifiable from the document.

Global score gaps -- not threshold counts -- determine how many tokens are needed to retain a target mass. For a realized row, the weighted sum of omitted values is the exact missing statistic. A controlled retrieval--aggregation
papers.summary_zh: KV 快取壓縮常以注意力圖中少數大權重作為正當性，但本文指出此論證並不完整：大權重未必涵蓋多數機率質量、被省略的值可能相互抵銷，且保留注意力輸出未必保留任務效用。作者嚴格區分四個層次——計數稀疏、覆蓋稀疏、輸出保真與任務效用——並證明其間三個推論皆不成立。理論結果包括：全域分數間隙包絡決定達成目標質量所需的 token 數，log-rank 斜率大於一時預算與長度無關，小於一時預算隨上下文成長；初始尺度的高斯 logits 雖有對數級的大權重計數，90% 覆蓋卻需約 0.61 比例，僅 1.6 倍壓縮；對固定的查詢列，被省略值的加權總和是唯一的加法修正量；在植入 token 模型中，重新正規化的 top-k 可在檢索型目標上勝過精確注意力，聚合型任務則否。據此提出免訓練壓縮器 CertKV：每個 KV head 保留一個尾端摘要槽，其餘槽位依值離散度分配，並嚴格遵守實體槽位預算。實驗上，在 LongBench-v2 的 503 題、三種骨幹與三種壓縮比下，九項設定有七項位居前二；128K RULER 上與 Ada-KV 同屬領先層；Llama 64K 打包原型實現 10 倍快取（持續 KV 由 8.59 降至 0.86 GB）。限制包括缺乏對未來查詢的無條件保證、跨層穩定性定理闕如、控制實驗的任務定律無法直接遷移到真實任務，跨模態普適性也未獲支持。本文的價值在於釐清「注意力稀疏」究竟授權了什麼：看似稀疏的權重是線索，而非保證。

links.title: EnSI-RAG: Entity-Structure-Indexed Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long-Document Question Answering

evidence: Experimental Setup: 'Because our Loong evaluation subset may differ from that used for the published baselines, its baseline scores are included as reference rather than as controlled head-to-head comparisons.'
Main Results, Table 2: EnSI-RAG achieves Oolong 71.84 / Loong 84.64 / Avg 78.24 vs SLIDERS 64.67 / 78.57 / 71.62; Oolong uses the same deterministic slice while Loong may not.
Appendix B, Number of Runs: 'Each reported EnSI-RAG result is obtained from one complete run... we therefore do not report across-run standard deviations or statistical significance tests.'

Method, Passage Construction: EnSI-RAG 'instantiates passage design on the fly during corpus preprocessing according to the requirements of the task and the structural organization of the documents,' implying domain-specific pipelines per dataset.
Appendix A, Table A1: 'All Oolong results reported in the main paper are evaluated exclusively on Oolong-Synth; we do not evaluate on Oolong-Real.'
Ablation Study, Table 4: Row-level 100.00 vs Table-level 91.50 accuracy on English Financial Loong questions only; retrieval-depth ablation also restricted to this subset.
Efficiency, Table 3: amortized offline cost 157,031 input tokens / 468.51s / 32.35 LLM calls per query; online stages only 656 + 5,460 tokens and ~26s.

Appendix B and Appendix C: seed-42 Loong sampling with reconstructable source_row_index, strict Oolong slice checks, released question identifiers, and verbatim prompt templates; code link stated in the Abstract.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely matching top-weighted preferences (RAG & knowledge, long context, LLMs, multi-hop reasoning). The entity-structure index used only as retrieval handles while generating from original passages is a clean, defensible middle ground between chunk-RAG and fully structured systems, but it is incremental over GraphRAG, HippoRAG, StructRAG, DocETL, and SLIDERS. Rigor is weakened by the authors' own admission that Loong baseline scores are cross-paper references on possibly different subsets, single-run results with no variance or significance testing, and ablations confined largely to a small English Financial subset. Evidence is strongest for the deterministic, verified Oolong slice (+7.17 over SLIDERS); Loong gains are not controlled. Generalizability is limited by explicitly domain-specific passage construction and Oolong-Synth-only evaluation. Reproducibility is comparatively strong: code release, deterministic slice verification with seeds, and verbatim prompts.

primary_link.title: EnSI-RAG: Entity-Structure-Indexed Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long-Document Question Answering

radar.summary: Question answering (QA) over long, connected documents remains challenging because relevant evidence may span multiple entities and their relationships. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods typically index documents as raw chunks and retrieve them through embedding similarity. Their performance degrades when chunk boundaries separate entities from supporting evidence or when a question requires multi-hop reasoning across the corpus. We propose EnSI-RAG (Entity-Structure-Indexed
radar.summary_zh: 長文件問答中，相關證據常分散於多個實體及其關係，而現有檢索增強生成（RAG）多以固定長度區塊索引文件並靠嵌入相似度檢索，當區塊邊界切斷實體與佐證，或問題需多跳推理時效能下降。本文提出 EnSI-RAG，建構與查詢無關的實體中心索引：離線先將文件轉為語義自足的實體中心段落，抽取〈實體、類型、語義欄位、值〉結構化記錄，建立形如 [實體][類型][屬性|關係|層面:值]→{段落識別碼} 的索引並保留指向原始段落的連結；線上由 LLM 規劃多跳檢索計畫，以索引定位佐證段落，再由 LLM 從原文合成答案，將證據定位與答案生成分離。在 Loong 與 Oolong 基準上平均準確率 78.24，較參考基線高 6.62 分（Oolong 71.84、Loong 84.64），優於 SLIDERS 等強基線。消融實驗顯示財務表格以列級段落最佳（100.00 對 91.50），屬性標籤粒度應依領域調整，Top-5 檢索已達最佳。限制包括 Loong 子集與已發表基線未必相同、每個結果僅單次執行、離線前處理成本高（每查詢攤提約 16 萬輸入 token）。本研究的價值在於展示以結構化索引輔助證據定位、保留原文作為生成依據，是區塊式 RAG 與全結構化系統之間的有效折衷，對金融、法律、學術等異質文件問答具實務參考價值。

links.title: Evaluating Large Language Model Performance on International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code Compliance

evidence: Section 4.2/4.3: DGEval comprises 1,678 questions across four sections (MCQ, open-ended with gemini-2.5-flash LLM-as-judge, DGL lookup, regulatory recall) with expert danger-criticality weighting; composite is equal-weighted average of section scores.

Section 4.4: human baseline corrected from raw 88.4% to 83.8% via first-attempt filtering and a left-truncated Beta mixture model (alpha=8.91, beta=1.93); authors explicitly call it an approximate, model-dependent upper bound with caveats about recency effects.
Section 4.5: 'Each question was evaluated once per model configuration; ... the reported scores are single-run point estimates and do not capture run-to-run variance.'
Section 4.1: DGL-derived question correctness was confirmed by in-house experts on 'a random subsample of 22 questions', a small validation of the 9,443-question generation pipeline.

Appendix D: judge validation reports JAR 74.00%/71.00% and EUI 73%/78% for two experts, quadratic-weighted kappa 0.7932 for score validity but only 0.1228 (slight) for explanation quality, on 100 human-reviewed records; Section 4.3 admits the judge shares a provider with the top model and family-specific favoritism was not directly tested.
Section 5.5/Table 5: web search averages +25.0 pp on Section 3; GPT-5.4 Mini rises 32.2%->81.9% (+49.6 pp) at 45x cost, while Claude Sonnet 4.6 gains only 5.6 pp at a 538x cost multiplier.

Section 5.1/Table 2: Gemini 3.1 Pro High leads all sections (95.8/86.0/89.6/36.8); Section 4 mean is 14.2% and stowage/segregation subsections average ~49-50% (Section 5.2), supporting the sub-domain failure claim.

Section 6.4: Claude Sonnet/Opus refused four questions (pathogens, inhalation toxicity, dibromomethane) and GPT-5.5 refused dibromomethane and nitroglycerin, scored zero, identified as a systematic bias on safety-critical topics.
Appendix E: benchmark questions and answer key are withheld by design and the submission-based evaluation server is only 'planned', limiting external reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is LLM evaluation methodology, not a pure domain application: a new 1,678-question benchmark (DGEval) probing LLM knowledge of IMDG dangerous-goods regulation, with multi-provider model comparison, thinking-level ablations, web-search (retrieval) ablations, LLM-as-judge validation, and cost/latency analysis. This aligns well with LLM, evaluation/benchmark, reasoning/CoT, safety, and RAG preferences, though the maritime-DG domain is narrow and no Japanese/NLP, agent, or code interests are served. Novelty is moderate: the domain gap is real (no prior DG benchmark; LLaMarine is a model, not a benchmark) and the truncated-Beta-corrected human baseline is a nice touch, but the construction and API-evaluation pipeline are standard. Rigor is solid but not airtight: 13 models and 35 configurations with expert weighting and judge meta-evaluation, yet single-run point estimates with no variance capture (Section 4.5), a same-family judge whose self-preference bias is acknowledged but not directly tested, DGL correctness verified on only a 22-question subsample (Section 4.1), and moderate judge agreement (JAR ~71-74%, explanation-quality kappa 0.12). Evidence strength is good: detailed tables back the headline claims (Gemini 3.1 Pro High 95.8/86.0/89.6/36.8 across Sections 1-4; +25.0 pp average web-search gain on DGL lookup; GPT-5.4 Mini +49.6 pp on Section 3), and speculative claims (Google training-data advantage) are flagged as undeterminable. Generalizability is moderate: lessons about composite scores masking safety-critical sub-domain failures, retrieval-task gains from search, overthinking penalties, and refusal biases transfer to other regulatory domains, but the benchmark itself is domain-locked. Reproducibility is weak: questions and answer key are deliberately withheld and the evaluation server is only 'planned' (Appendix E), with proprietary e-learning and DGL sources.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Large Language Model Performance on International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code Compliance

radar.summary: The transport of dangerous goods by sea is a high-consequence activity governed by the International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, a complex regulatory framework where errors in classification, packaging, stowage, or segregation can result in fire, explosion, toxic release, or loss of life or vessel. Correct compliance requires accurately interpreting hundreds of pages of interacting provisions, updated on a two-year amendment cycle. Practitioners increasingly use Large Language Models (
radar.summary_zh: 海運危險品運輸受國際海運危險品準則（IMDG Code）規範，分類、包裝、積載與隔離的錯誤可能釀成火災、爆炸或人命損失。實務者已普遍以 LLM 作為決策輔助，卻缺乏系統性評估。本文提出首個以 IMDG 修正案 42-24 為依據的 DGEval 基準，結合 NCB Hazcheck 電子學習平台專家撰寫題目與危險品清單（DGL）結構化查詢，共 1,678 題，涵蓋選擇題、開放式問答、DGL 查詢與法規條文識別四節，採專家加權評分，並以左截斷 Beta 分配校正人類從業基線為 83.8%。研究評估六家廠商 13 個模型、多種 thinking 設定共 35 個組態，並測試網路搜尋影響。結果顯示 Gemini 3.1 Pro 全面領先，第一節達 95.8%，大幅超越人類基線（GPT-5.5 為唯一另一個）；但所有模型在積載、隔離與法規回憶等安全關鍵領域最弱，第四節平均僅 14.2%。網路搜尋使 DGL 查詢平均提升 25 個百分點，GPT-5.4 Mini 進步近 50 分，惟成本效益差異極大。海事微調模型 LLaMarine 表現與基礎 Llama 3.3 相當。限制包括題庫與答案不公開、僅涵蓋 IMDG、知識截止日效應難以量化。研究強調複合分數不足以作為部署依據，LLM 應定位為治理流程中的決策輔助工具，人類監督與權威來源驗證在安全關鍵情境仍不可省略。

links.title: Automating Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via TRIAD: From Context Extraction to Validated Dataset Generation

evidence: Abstract: claims generated datasets show 'similar performance trends across different RAG setups' and 'exceeding 90% in both answerability and correctness'
Section 5.1, Table 2: human validation reports answerability 0.90 (HotpotQA) / 0.93 (MuSiQue) and correctness 0.92 / 0.98, multi-hop 0.91 / 0.85
Section 5.1: validator acceptance rates 68% (HotpotQA, 703 generated) and 66% (MuSiQue, 723 generated); true rejection rate verified on only 40 sampled decisions (85-90%)

Section 5.2 / Appendix A Table 5: embedding-model ordering (Embedding-002 > Embedding-001 > MiniLM) holds on both generated and static datasets; generated data shows inflated absolute recall (e.g., 0.910 vs 0.194 on HotpotQA)
Section 5.2, Table 3: LLM faithfulness trends inconsistent across benchmarks - Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite best on MuSiQue, GPT-5-nano best on HotpotQA
Section 4.2: manual evaluation of 200 questions; no annotator count, protocol, or inter-annotator agreement reported
Section 4.4/4.5: GPT-5-nano is both a tested generator and the RAGAS judge for correctness/faithfulness; potential bias not discussed

Section 8 Limitations: experiments restricted to 'relatively clean corpora and mostly general-knowledge data'; LLM non-determinism means exact replication may not be possible despite released code/data (Section 1, GitHub link)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/NLP methodology paper: LLM-driven generation of multi-hop RAG evaluation datasets, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, RAG & Knowledge, Red Teaming & Evaluation, multi-step reasoning, datasets). Novelty is moderate: it combines known ingredients (LLM question generation, LLM-as-judge validation with a sufficient-context check, feedback loop) into a preprocessing-free pipeline built on the RAG system's own vector store, plus a retrieval-pattern question taxonomy and simulated unanswerable questions; closest prior work (Filice et al. 2025, Lee et al. 2025, Liu et al. 2026) overlaps substantially. Rigor is decent but incomplete: human validation of 200 questions on four metrics and a 7-setup RAG comparison vs HotpotQA/MuSiQue are well designed, yet no inter-annotator agreement or annotator count is reported (Section 4.2), validator accuracy rests on only 40 sampled decisions, no significance testing or variance is given, and the LLM judge (GPT-5-nano) is also one of the tested generators, an unaddressed circularity risk. Evidence strength is solid for the quality claims (Table 2: >90% answerability/correctness; Table 5 trends for embeddings/chunk counts) but weaker for LLM faithfulness, where the paper itself concedes inconsistent trends across benchmarks (Section 5.2, Table 3). Generalizability is limited: validation uses only clean Wikipedia-derived corpora, not the proprietary domains the method targets (Section 8). Reproducibility is aided by released code, data, and all prompts (Appendix D), but proprietary API models and acknowledged non-determinism block exact replication.

primary_link.title: Automating Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via TRIAD: From Context Extraction to Validated Dataset Generation

Existing datasets, such as HotpotQA, challenge current RAG systems on Wikipedia-based knowledge, but they cannot be transferred directly to domain-specific settings. A comprehensive evaluation of RAG system quality requires both multi-hop queries and unanswerable questions. This paper introduces TRIAD, a three-st
radar.summary_zh: RAG 系統普及後，企業需要能評估其於專有知識庫表現的領域問答資料集，但 HotpotQA、MuSiQue 等基準受限於特定知識來源，多數自動生成框架僅處理單跳問題、需繁重前置處理，或忽略不可回答問題。本文提出 TRIAD，以三階段自動生成多跳問答資料集：生成階段從 RAG 向量資料庫選取初始文件並檢索相似文件，由 LLM 找出橋接主題後，依比較、交集、組合三種多跳類型（另含二元、時間性與不可回答類別）產生問題與答案，對應平行與循序兩種檢索模式；驗證階段以 LLM 評審檢查問題品質、正確性與充分脈絡，確保單一文件不足以作答，未通過者進入回饋修正迴圈；抽取階段為每題附加相關與不相關脈絡並標註，據以導出檢索難度，並以僅提供不相關脈絡模擬不可回答情境。以 HotpotQA 與 MuSiQue 語料各生成 600 題（約 480 題通過驗證），人工驗證顯示可回答性逾 90%、正確性逾 92%、多跳要求逾 85%、明確性逾 92%，誤拒率約 10-15%。跨七種 RAG 設定比較，生成資料集呈現與既有基準相似的效能趨勢。限制為生成問題檢索較易、絕對分數偏高，且實驗限於較乾淨的通用語料。其價值在於讓企業能低成本為專有語料建立可比較的 RAG 評估並量測幻覺率，其中 GPT-5-nano 偵測不可回答問題的表現最差。
radar.title: Automating Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via TRIAD: From Context Extraction to Validated Dataset Generation
radar.title_zh: 以 TRIAD 自動化多跳 RAG 評估：從脈絡抽取到已驗證資料集生成

links.title: Retrieval Needs Multivectors: An Exponential Separation

evidence: Theorem 1 (Section 4): relevance matrix PM(N,n,MP_{m,L}) requires d=2^Ω(m) single-vector dimension for retrieval ordering, while a multi-vector representation of size O(m^6) with margin Θ(m^{-2}) suffices.

Theorem 2 (Section 5.3): the NAND_n pattern matrix from [8] admits a unit-norm single-vector ordering representation of size Θ(N) with gap 2/√(nN), showing prior score-approximation hardness does not transfer to ordering.
Lemma 1 (Section 3): sign-rank lower bound 2^Ω(m) imported from Razborov-Sherstov [15]; Section 5.1 builds the sign-rank witness T = G - γ̃1^T with rank ≤ d+1.

Section 7.2.3 and Table 3: jointly fine-tuned Jina v4 multi-vector head gains 104.8%/83.8%/61.5% over the fine-tuned single-vector head at Recall@2/@10/@100, presented as the strongest controlled evidence.

Section 8 (Discussion and Limitations): ANDOR 'is not the pattern-matrix instance used in our proof'; with exactly two positives per query, [16] guarantees an existential 5-dimensional single-vector realization, bounding the theoretical claim's application to the benchmark.

Section 7.1 / Appendix B: fine-tuning protocol fully specified (6,250 steps, effective batch 32, 32 candidates/query with 18/6/3 hard-negative tiers, AdamW, per-run temperature and LR in Tables 11–12).
Section 6: 'The dataset and the official code will be released shortly' — no verified artifact availability at publication.
Section 6 / Appendix A: 50,000-document corpus, 20 categories × 20 attributes, nested width suites 3.5–11.5, deterministic SHA-256 quality score, collision-repair procedure described in detail.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strong theoretical-plus-benchmark paper on dense retrieval, not LLM methodology. It proves (Theorem 1, Sec. 4) an explicit exponential separation for the retrieval ordering problem: single-vector embeddings need d=2^Ω(m) while a polynomial O(m^6) multi-vector Chamfer construction suffices, and shows (Theorem 2, Sec. 5.3) that Jayaram's score-approximation hard instance admits a Θ(N) single-vector ordering representation, correctly scoping its novelty against prior sign-rank work. Preference alignment is moderate: the core is embedding/dense retrieval (RAG & Knowledge keywords: embedding, dense retrieval, semantic search, vector database) plus fine-tuning and a new benchmark, but there is no LLM, Japanese NLP, prompting, or agent methodology; the 'Boolean reasoning' framing is representational, not CoT. Experiments are unusually thorough (7 models, 45 train–test combinations, Recall/nDCG/MRR, zero-shot + fine-tuned, joint vs. separate Jina SV/MV training as a controlled ablation, Table 3 relative gains 105/84/62%), and the paper candidly discloses limitations (Sec. 8: ANDOR is a semantic instantiation, not the pattern-matrix instance; the 2-positives-per-query structure admits an existential 5-dim single-vector solution, so benchmark results evidence learnability gaps, not raw expressiveness on that matrix). Reproducibility is helped by very detailed construction and hyperparameters (Appendices A–B) but code/data are only promised 'shortly' (Sec. 6), so availability is unverified. Generalizability is limited by a synthetic e-commerce domain and worst-case theory.

primary_link.title: Retrieval Needs Multivectors: An Exponential Separation

radar.summary: Recent works have highlighted the expressive limitations of embedding based retrieval models through both theoretical analyses and challenging benchmarks such as LIMIT. While multi-vector embeddings consistently outperform single-vector embeddings, the precise representational gap between them remains poorly understood. In this work, following Jayaram's work, we provide the first explicit family of query and document sets, together with their relevance matrices, for which single-vector embedding
radar.summary_zh: 單向量嵌入與多向量（late-interaction，如 ColBERT）檢索之間的表達能力差距長期缺乏精確刻劃。本文首次給出明確的查詢與文件集及其相關矩陣：若要求單向量嵌入將所有相關文件排在所有不相關文件之上（檢索排序問題），需指數級維度 2^Ω(m)，而多向量表示僅需多項式大小 O(m^6)。理論建構基於 Minsky-Papert 函數的模式矩陣與 sign-rank 下界，利用 Chamfer 分數使相關與不相關文件間產生 Θ(m^-2) 的分離間隙。作者另證明先前工作的 NAND 模式矩陣雖在逐點分數近似上困難，卻存在 Θ(N) 維的單向量排序表示，兩結果互補。受理論啟發，作者提出 ANDOR 電商檢索基準：查詢為產品屬性類別上「析取的合取」（AND-of-OR）語義，語料含 50,000 件商品與僅違反少數類別的困難負例。實驗顯示七個先進模型中，多向量模型零樣本領先單向量 2-10 倍，微調後仍保持約 2 倍優勢，Recall@2 相對增益最高達 153%；即使 Jina v4 以同一骨幹聯合訓練單、多向量頭，差距依舊，證明為表示能力的根本限制而非訓練因素。限制包括每查詢僅兩個正例，理論上存在低維精確解但不具可學習性；測試寬度增大時所有方法效能遞減。此研究為檢索架構選型提供理論與實證依據，凸顯組合式多面向查詢情境下 late-interaction 架構的重要性。
radar.title: Retrieval Needs Multivectors: An Exponential Separation
radar.title_zh: 檢索需要多向量：一個指數級分離

links.title: Can LLMs Truly Forget? Revealing Unlearning Gaps Through Adversarial Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: fine-tuning-based methods reach Forget Quality above 0.91 yet ASRs of 72.8%-84.3%, close to the 87.5% ASR of the unprotected base model

Section 3.2: adversarial pipeline follows REBEL (cited ref 13), using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct hacker model and eight attack suites (roleplay, authority, system injection, direct, hypothetical, multiple choice, structured CoT, completion)
Section 5.3/Table 4: per-suite ASR results on the 1% forget split only; prompt-injection category averages ~86.6%; multiple choice lowest at 45.0%-70.0%

Section 5.4/Table 5: judge leakage scores vs ROUGE-L Pearson r=0.924 across 1,280 responses with 27 divergence cases; Appendix A/Table 7: manual audit of 10 purposively selected examples by one annotator, 7/10 binary agreement with two false-positive and one false-negative judge errors

Section 5.5/Table 6: multilingual probing of 7 languages yields 2.95% leak rate (33/1116) with back-translation mean similarity 0.886, but ROUGE-L>0.3 threshold was not calibrated against human judgment (Section 7)

Section 7 Limitations: single model family (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct), synthetic TOFU only, adversarial evaluation restricted to 1% split, 10-example single-annotator audit, no multi-turn or gradient-based attacks

Section 4.3: PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, PEFT, W&B on UMass Unity GPUs; no code or artifact release is stated and method hyperparameters (e.g., learning rates, epochs, QLoRA settings) are not reported
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solidly in-scope LLM safety/evaluation work: unlearning of Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct on TOFU, adversarial prompt recovery, and LLM-as-judge ASR align well with LLM, AI safety, red-teaming/evaluation, and prompting preferences. However, the headline finding (apparent forgetting is defeated by adversarial prompting) largely replicates REBEL, which the paper itself cites as the basis of its attack pipeline; the incremental contributions are a unified cross-paradigm comparison under OpenUnlearning and the ASR threshold metric. Rigor is reasonable (shared checkpoint, three forget splits, judge validation via r=0.924 ROUGE-L correlation, honest 7/10 audit agreement, explicit limitations section) but weakened by a single model family, synthetic TOFU-only data, adversarial testing restricted to the 1% split (2 authors, 40 QA pairs), a 10-example single-annotator audit, an uncalibrated 0.2 threshold, and no variance/significance reporting. No code release or hyperparameter detail is provided, limiting reproducibility; generalizability is explicitly constrained by the authors (Section 7).

primary_link.title: Can LLMs Truly Forget? Revealing Unlearning Gaps Through Adversarial Evaluation

radar.summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of targeted training data from a model while preserving its remaining capabilities, but evaluating whether such information has truly become inaccessible remains challenging. Existing benchmarks primarily assess unlearning under clean, non-adversarial queries, leaving open whether information that appears forgotten can still be recovered through strategic prompting. We address this gap through a unified evaluation of prompt-based and fine-tuning-ba
radar.summary_zh: 機器遺忘的目標是從模型中移除特定訓練資料的影響，但現有基準多以乾淨、非對抗性的查詢評估遺忘效果，無法確認資訊是否真的無法透過策略性提示取回。本文以 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 在 TOFU 資料集上，於 OpenUnlearning 統一框架比較提示式與微調式兩類遺忘方法，並對表現最佳的微調式方法進行對抗性壓力測試。作者提出 Attack Success Rate（ASR），以 LLM-as-judge 衡量洩漏分數超過 0.2 的對抗回應比例，涵蓋角色扮演、權威框架、系統注入、改寫、知識路由等八大攻擊套件，並另測七種語言的乾淨查詢。結果顯示 NPO、SimNPO 等方法雖在 Forget Quality 上達 0.91 以上，平均 ASR 仍介於 72.8% 至 84.3%，接近未防護基礎模型的 87.5%；而乾淨的多語言探測僅造成 2.95% 洩漏。評審分數與 ROUGE-L 相關係數達 0.924，十例人工稽核有七例與自動判定一致。限制包括僅使用單一模型家族、TOFU 為合成資料、對抗評估限於 1% 切分，且稽核樣本與門檻校準不足。本文說明標準指標表現優異並不代表穩健，主張將對抗性壓力測試納入遺忘評估，對隱私與合規部署具重要意義。
radar.title: Can LLMs Truly Forget? Revealing Unlearning Gaps Through Adversarial Evaluation
radar.title_zh: LLM 真的能遺忘嗎？以對抗性評估揭露機器遺忘的缺口

links.title: TreeWY: Speculative Verification for Gated DeltaNet Hybrids

evidence: Section 3, Eq. (2)-(3): core method is a tree-structured WY/UT transform of the gated delta rule (one triangular solve, O(N*dv) pseudo-value matrix instead of per-node states); Section 4 reports closed form matching the recurrence to ~1e-15 (fp64) and ~1e-7 (fp32).

Section 2, 'Existing approaches': acknowledges ReplaySSM 'solves the same triangular system we do' inside the verify window, and concurrent Bole (arXiv:2608.01651) reporting 82-99x transient-memory reduction and 3.4-7.7x faster tree verification, with no head-to-head 'since Bole's paper does not link to a code implementation'.

Section 5, Table 1 and Correctness: 175 matched points with acceptance length mean |delta|=0.039 (max 0.33); throughput 0.94-1.40x (35B) and KV reduction 2.0-2.5x, with wins explicitly conditional on memory pressure (Fig. 3: 31/105 points memory-bound at 35B).

Appendix D, Table 6: head-to-head shows ReplaySSM leads throughput at every load (1.38 vs 1.19 at 256 concurrency) and per-token cost at every load; the paper calls its scheduling explanation 'an attribution, not a validated claim'.

Section 6 and Section 4: trees are reported as 'enabled and correct, not as a speedup' (piecewise capture, non-graph-capturable kernel); evaluation covers only Qwen3.5 35B/397B from one family, and the implementation is a vLLM fork 'not yet upstreamed as of this writing' with no code release link, though models, workloads, and ~85 GPU-hours (Appendix F) are documented.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid LLM-inference systems paper: it removes per-node recurrent-state snapshots in speculative decoding for Gated DeltaNet hybrids via a tree-structured WY/UT transform, implemented in vLLM and evaluated on two Qwen3.5 scales. Preference relevance is moderate-high (LLM serving, linear attention/SSM hybrids, efficiency, KV cache), though it touches none of the highest-weighted topics (reasoning, agents, Japanese LLM). Novelty is genuinely incremental: the WY transform is inherited from DeltaNet (ref [13]), STree already did tree verification for Mamba2, and the paper itself flags near-identical concurrent work (ReplaySSM shares the same triangular solve; Bole reports 82-99x memory reduction for tree verification) with no head-to-head against Bole. Rigor and evidence are strong for a systems paper: fp64/fp32 correctness checks, 175 matched points with acceptance-length parity (mean |delta|=0.039, Section 5), memory-pressure and admission-vs-cost decompositions (Appendix C), and an honest ReplaySSM comparison that shows TreeWY losing on chain throughput (Appendix D, Table 6) with the gap explicitly labeled an unvalidated attribution. Wins are correctly scoped as conditional on memory pressure (up to 1.49x throughput, ~40x p99 TTFT), and tree width is 'enabled and correct, not as a speedup' (Section 6). Generalizability is limited by testing a single model family and one serving stack; reproducibility is hurt by the implementation being a fork 'not yet upstreamed' with no code link, despite public models, datasets, and detailed compute reporting (Appendix F).

primary_link.title: TreeWY: Speculative Verification for Gated DeltaNet Hybrids

radar.summary: Modern open models are hybrids: most layers are linear-attention (Gated DeltaNet, GDN) layers carrying a small fixed-size recurrent state instead of a growing key-value (KV) cache. This makes ordinary decoding memory-efficient, but hurts speculative decoding. To verify a batch of draft tokens and then roll back the rejected ones, today's systems snapshot the full recurrent state at every draft position for GDN layers, and those snapshots cannot be shared across branches of a draft tree, so a wid
radar.summary_zh: 現代混合式模型多數層採用線性注意力（如 Gated DeltaNet），以固定大小的循環狀態取代持續成長的 KV cache，雖利於一般解碼的記憶效率，卻傷害投機解碼：驗證草稿 token 時，現有系統需在每個草稿位置快照完整循環狀態，且快照無法在草稿樹分支間共用，使寬樹在記憶體上不可行。TreeWY 透過閘控 delta 規則的樹狀 WY 轉換，以單一次三角矩陣求解計算每個草稿節點的輸出，並在提交時僅重建被接受的那一個狀態，改存小型偽值矩陣以取代每節點狀態。作者在 vLLM 上實作，於 Qwen3.5 35B 與 397B 混合模型進行服務基準測試。結果顯示在相同接受長度下，投機循環狀態記憶與 KV cache 壓力大幅降低：記憶體受限時吞吐量最高提升 1.49 倍、p99 TTFT 可降低約 40 倍；記憶體充裕時則付出幾個百分點的代價。寬樹在此機制下變得可負擔，接受長度隨寬度上升，但因樹驗證核心無法與 CUDA graph 捕獲整合，尚未轉為吞吐量優勢；與 ReplaySSM 比較，後者在鏈模式吞吐量仍領先。此方法僅依賴閘控 delta 規則本身，對提升混合模型的推論效率具實務價值。
radar.title: TreeWY: Speculative Verification for Gated DeltaNet Hybrids
radar.title_zh: TreeWY：Gated DeltaNet 混合模型的投機驗證

links.title: Llama-Mobile: Efficient 2.7-Bit Quantization of VLMs

evidence: Abstract: compresses Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct to 3.7 GB with 8-bit activations, preserving performance on standard VQA tasks
Section 4, Table 1: S3D8 at 2.68 bpp scores 0.661 avg vs INT 0.347, student-t 0.565, lloyd-max 0.436 at similar sizes; bfloat16 baseline 0.744
Section 4.1: with GPTQ at ~2.7 bpp, S3D8 reaches 0.340 avg vs 0.018 for rate-matched INT, isolating format effect
Section 4.3, Table 2: S3D8 achieves 1031 GMAC/s vs 461 for INT8 on Graviton4 for (1,4096,14336) shape
Section 4.4: median 3.8 tokens/s on Pixel 8a with S3D8 from a 3.73 GB model file; INT8 model does not fit in memory
Section 5 Limitations: experiments restricted to a single model, CPU execution, Arm-optimized 64-entry table-lookup decoder, and a small VQA benchmark set
Section 3.3 and Appendix A.1: QAT data uses ImageNet images with teacher-generated responses; no downstream benchmark images or benchmark-specific prompts used
Appendix A.2: batch size 128, 2048 QAT steps, AdamW (beta1=0.9, beta2=0.95), LR 2^-(b+14) heuristic from [31]
Contributions: full quantization pipeline and inference implementation released at graphcore-research/llama-mobile-vlm
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-efficiency work: sub-3-bit quantization-aware distillation of Llama 3.2 11B Vision with a novel S3D8 packed vector format for Arm CPU inference. Matches preferences on LLMs, scaling/efficiency, inference/serving, and training/optimization, though it sits on the multimodal/systems side rather than core language methodology. Novelty is moderate: the format co-design and multimodal self-generated-data QAT are new combinations, but the paper itself cites close prior art (LLM-QAT data-free distillation, sign-factorized codebooks, llama.cpp Arm kernels). Rigor and evidence are solid: size-matched format comparisons under identical QAT (Table 1: S3D8 0.661 avg vs INT 0.347), GPTQ and direct-cast baselines, prompt-sampling ablation, and concrete runtime benchmarks; weakened by a single model, 1024-example eval subsets, and a self-implemented relative benchmark. Generalizability is limited and honestly acknowledged (one model, CPU-only, Arm 64-entry LUT decoder). Reproducibility is strong with released code and detailed hyperparameters/data-generation probabilities.

primary_link.title: Llama-Mobile: Efficient 2.7-Bit Quantization of VLMs

radar.summary: Deploying vision-language models (VLMs) on mobile devices is challenging due to their significant memory and compute requirements. We present a framework for quantizing VLMs for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. Our approach combines a quantization pipeline that uses the model itself to generate training data and does not require access to the training setup, with a novel 2.7-bit-per-parameter format supporting efficient execution on Arm CPUs. We validate our approach by comp
radar.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型的記憶體與運算需求龐大，難以部署於行動裝置；且在無法取得原始訓練資料的前提下，進行低於 3-bit 的權重量化更具挑戰。本文提出 Llama-Mobile 框架，包含兩項核心：一是 S3D8 格式，將三個帶號權重壓縮進一個位元組（每參數約 2.7 bit），以共享 5-bit 質心索引加上三個符號位元表示，可透過 Arm CPU 的查找表與邏輯運算快速解碼為 INT8；二是模型自身的合成資料管線，以 ImageNet 影像搭配隨機取樣的提示詞，由原模型生成回應作為知識蒸餾目標，進行量化感知訓練。應用於 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct，模型壓縮至 3.7 GB、啟用 8-bit 啟動值，在 VQAv2、ChartQA、DocVQA、AI2D 四項視覺問答任務上，平均效能僅下降 0.083，明顯優於同尺寸的 INT、student-t 與 lloyd-max 格式，也優於 GPTQ 等後訓練量化基準。部署驗證顯示 Pixel 8a 達 3.8 tokens/s、Graviton4 伺服器 CPU 達 36.8 tokens/s。限制包括僅驗證單一模型與 CPU 平台、S3D8 解碼器針對 Arm 最佳化、評估任務範圍有限。本工作證明次 3-bit 的 VLM 壓縮在資源受限裝置上確實可行。
radar.title: Llama-Mobile: Efficient 2.7-Bit Quantization of VLMs
radar.title_zh: Llama-Mobile：視覺語言模型的高效 2.7-bit 量化

links.title: Perturb the Thought, Not the Pixels: Latent-Space Rollout Diversification for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language Models

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: NC-GRPO sigma_0=0.5 reaches OOD avg 53.5 vs vanilla GRPO 52.0 with pooled McNemar p<10^-4; individually significant only on MathVerse (p=0.0006) and WeMath (p=0.005).
Section 4.2, Seed variance: two-seed OOD averages 51.9±0.1 (vanilla), 52.8±0.2 (NC-GRPO), 50.3±0.2 (antithetic), N=2 described as 'variance indicators, not distributions'.

Section 4.3, Table 4: antithetic pairing degrades pooled OOD to 50.1 (p=0.006 vs vanilla) and SPSA steering fails to recover (p=0.38 vs antithetic), supporting 'independent randomness is the active ingredient'.
Section 4.4, Table 3: NoisyRollout image noise achieves OOD avg 56.2 vs NC-GRPO's 53.5, margin carried by WeMath (+15.2), while NC-GRPO wins POPE (p=0.007) and in-domain Geo3K (53.9 vs 52.9).
Section 4.5, Table 6: Qwen2.5-VL-3B null — pooled OOD p=0.81, characterized as 'harmless but not beneficial below a capacity threshold', with sigma_0 transferred rather than re-tuned.
Section 4.5: 'All results in this paper are on Qwen-family models, and we make no cross-family claim'; cross-family sweeps reported as pending.
Section 5 Limitations: only three configurations have two seeds, ~15 uncorrected p-values, headline results survive Bonferroni, hallucination/general-capability batteries are single-seed.

Appendix A: algebraic content of Propositions 1-2 and Lemma 1 machine-verified in Lean 4 with Mathlib, 'included in the released artifact'; Gaussian moments and Taylor remainder remain pencil-and-paper.
Section 4.1: 'Per-question records, training code, and the injection hook will be made publicly available' — promised, not yet verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope RL-training methodology for LLM/VLM reasoning: NC-GRPO injects norm-calibrated Gaussian noise into the last hidden layer of the prefill pass for half of each GRPO rollout group, converting branch-point sensitivity into policy-gradient signal (Sections 3.1, 3.2). Strong matches to the Reasoning (mathematical reasoning, 2.5), Alignment/RLHF-RL (GRPO/RLVR, 2.0/1.5), Training (1.5) and Multimodal (1.8) preferences, though no text-only LLM validation and no coverage of agents, code, RAG, or safety clusters. Novelty is moderate: it relocates NoisyCoconut's latent branching (Sec 2.2) into the RLVR loop, a controlled variation of NoisyRollout rather than a new paradigm. Rigor is unusually strong: Lean 4 machine-verified algebra for Props 1-2 and Lemma 1 (Appendix A), paired per-question McNemar tests, two-seed replication of load-bearing configurations, transparent reporting of uncorrected p-values and a 3B null (Section 5, Table 6). Evidence strength is tempered by small effect sizes (+1.0 to +1.5 pp OOD; Table 1), the acknowledged competing baseline-gradient reading of the antithetic result (Section 4.3), the missing first-token temperature control (Section 5), and the fact that image-space NoisyRollout still posts a larger OOD average (56.2 vs 53.5, Table 3), leaving latent noise the winner only on hallucination robustness and in-domain. Generalizability is limited: Qwen-family only, explicit cross-family non-claim (Section 4.5), capacity floor at 3B (Table 6). Reproducibility: detailed hyperparameters, algorithm, and a promised release of per-question records, training code, and the hook (Section 4.1), but availability is stated as future intent.

primary_link.title: Perturb the Thought, Not the Pixels: Latent-Space Rollout Diversification for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language Models

radar.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs), and diversifying the rollouts within each optimization group amplifies its gains. Existing approaches diversify through decoding temperature or pixel-space image distortion; we ask whether the perturbation belongs in the model's latent space instead. We introduce Noise-Contrastive GRPO (NC-GRPO), which injects scale-calibrated Gaussian noise into the last hidden layer of the pro
radar.summary_zh: 以可驗證獎勵進行強化學習（RLVR）能提升視覺語言模型的推理能力，而增加每組 rollout 的多樣性可放大其效益。現有做法透過解碼溫度或像素空間影像失真來增加多樣性，本文則問：擾動是否應放在模型的潛在空間？作者提出 NC-GRPO，對每個 rollout 群組中一半的提示編碼前向傳播，於最後一層隱藏層注入尺度校準的高斯雜訊，使這些分支從位移後的出發點生成；儘管位移仍能答對的分支會相對被強化，將分支點的敏感度轉為策略梯度訊號。方法僅需約 50 行程式碼修改推論引擎，且不改動目標函數、獎勵與推論協定，設計上與模態無關。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 訓練於 Geometry3K 的實驗中，NC-GRPO 在五項域外數學基準顯著優於原始 GRPO（合併 McNemar p≤0.001），同時改善域內準確率與幻覺穩健性，後者是影像雜訊反而退步的軸線。機制消融顯示獨立隨機多樣性才是關鍵，而非雜訊預算或方向；雜訊尺度如同特化旋鈕，σ0=0.2 可在無一般能力損失下提升推理。限制包括多數結果為單一種子、僅驗證 Qwen 家族、p 值未校正，且 3B 模型未見效益，顯示存在能力門檻。
radar.title: Perturb the Thought, Not the Pixels: Latent-Space Rollout Diversification for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language Models
radar.title_zh: 擾動思維而非像素：視覺語言模型強化學習的潛在空間 Rollout 多樣化

Title-page footnote and Appendix F: code and data at https://github.com/kimsan1120/ECoG with de-identified datasets, prompts, parser code, per-fold breakdowns, and training scripts
llm_evaluation.rationale: Domain-anchored but methodologically substantive LLM paper: decoder SLMs (HCX 0.5B/1.5B, Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B) with evidence-span supervision plus a training-only rationale-label consistency auxiliary loss, evaluated under a scenario-level OOD holdout for Korean SMS/voice phishing. Strong alignment with LLM, NLP, interpretability/faithfulness, and evaluation preferences; weaker on the highest-weight topics (no Japanese NLP, rationales rather than true chain-of-thought reasoning, phishing-focused safety). Novelty is moderate: scenario holdout (cf. misinfo-general), evidence/rationale supervision (ERASER, e-SNLI, WT5, SCOTT) and consistency objectives are established; the contribution is their combination as a single-stage parameter-level regularizer. Rigor is solid: six baseline families including proprietary LLMs (Table 2), mechanism/pooling/target-order ablations and a λ sweep across four backbones (Table 4, Fig. 2), annotated-data audits (Appendix A), and a parser-human consistency audit (Appendix D), with candid treatment of teacher-forcing leakage and the non-causal nature of consistency. Main evidence weaknesses: single training run per configuration (Appendix C admits no seeds/error bars), LLM-generated supervision labels, and heterogeneous gains (Qwen3-0.6B nearly flat in Table 5; some negative per-scenario reductions in Fig. 4). Generalizability is limited by Korean-only, phishing-only evaluation, though the protocol and regularizer could transfer. Reproducibility is good: public code/data link and detailed supplementary artifacts, minus non-reproducible GPT-5.4/Gemini baselines.

primary_link.title: Evidence-Consistent Generative Detection under Scenario-Level Distribution Shift

radar.summary: Conventional in-distribution evaluation can overestimate robustness when training and test data share recurring task-specific patterns or surface cues. This risk is especially relevant in social-engineering fraud detection, where attackers can preserve malicious intent while changing the scenario, impersonated entity, or wording. We study this problem as scenario-level out-of-distribution (SL-OOD) detection for SMS and voice phishing, where entire attack scenarios are held out from training whil
radar.summary_zh: 當訓練與測試資料共用重複的情境模式或表面線索時，傳統同分布評估會高估模型穩健性。本文以韓國簡訊與語音詐騙偵測為對象，提出情境層級分布偏移（SL-OOD）評估：將完整攻擊情境自訓練集保留，標籤空間不變，測試模型能否運用決策相關證據而非熟悉的情境專屬線索進行泛化。實驗發現，無論特徵式、編碼器或解碼器基準，同分布高分都無法可靠預測保留情境下的表現，作者將此失敗模式稱為情境記憶化。為此提出 ECoG，一個解碼器生成式偵測框架，於單階段 fine-tuning 中結合證據片段監督與推理–標籤一致性正則化，推論時僅用原生 LM 頭解碼。在 0.5B 解碼器上，相較無一致性正則化的同一骨幹，ECoG 在 OOD 困難實例上提升 Macro-F1 3.22 點，降低生成理由支持相反標籤的比例 4.22 點，並增加與參考證據片段的 token 級重疊 8.38 點；四種解碼器骨幹的一致性改善方向一致。限制包括僅評估韓文資料、語音情境依賴 ASR 轉錄、解釋指標無法證立因果忠實性。本研究顯示隨機切分評估會誤導部署選型，證據一致性訓練對小型生成式偵測器在社會工程偏移下具實用價值。
radar.title: Evidence-Consistent Generative Detection under Scenario-Level Distribution Shift
radar.title_zh: 情境層級分布偏移下的證據一致性生成式偵測

links.title: Move by Move: Measuring and Steering How LLMs Conduct Psychotherapy

evidence: §3.1 Human Validation: five PhD/PsyD licensed psychologists independently multi-label every therapist turn; mean pairwise Krippendorff's α under Jaccard distance is 0.627, judge mean 0.592 (Table 2).
§4.1: therapist panel is GLM 5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT 5.6 Terra; moves are exposed as tools with guidance on when/how to perform each move.
§5.1: models over-use Inquiry at up to three times the human rate and consistently neglect Psychoeducation even with move tools; GPT 5.6 Terra Inquiry reduction exceeds 30 p.p.
§5.1.1: pass@4 is 62% with moves vs 53% without under majority reference, 72% vs 65% under union reference, a 7–9 p.p. turn-level alignment gain at fixed sampling budget.
Table 5 (Appendix B): mean absolute deviation from human move distribution averages 4.46% with moves vs 7.04% without across the three model families.

§5.2 and Limitations: fully synthetic model-led transcripts show context anchoring (skill building <1% of turns when model-led); limitations include modality mismatch, simulated patient, and only moderate inter-annotator agreement.
Ethical Considerations: human transcripts accessed under institutional license and 'we do not redistribute transcript text'; no code or data release is stated anywhere in the document.
§3.1 Judge Classifier: the move classifier is a GLM 5.2 judge with 5-sample majority vote, the same model family as one of the evaluated therapist models, with no discussion of this potential bias.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Language-centric LLM behavioral study (not a capped pure-domain application): it builds a MULTI-60-grounded ontology of ten therapeutic moves, validates it with five licensed psychologists, and uses it both to measure and to steer frontier LLMs by exposing moves as function-calling tools. Strongly aligned with LLM (w2.5) and Agents & Tool Use (w2.5) preferences, with secondary AI Safety and dialogue/NLP relevance. Novelty is moderate: behavioral coding of LLM therapists exists (Chiu et al. 2024, Kang et al. 2024, acknowledged in §6), and the paper's distinct contributions are the expert-validated compact ontology, temporal/transition analysis, and tool-framed steering. Rigor is solid but incomplete: careful multi-label annotation (mean Krippendorff's α 0.627, Table 2), judge validation on three corpora (Table 4), a synthetic-transcript control for context confounds (§4.2, §5.2), and pass@k sensitivity under two reference rules (§5.1.1); however, no significance tests or confidence intervals are reported, the judge is GLM 5.2-based—the same family as one tested therapist model (§3.1, §4.1)—a circularity risk not discussed, and the With-Moves condition bundles a mandatory tool-call constraint with the ontology guidance. Evidence is quantitative (MAD 4.46% vs 7.04%, Table 5; pass@4 62% vs 53% majority / 72% vs 65% union) but rests on a moderately reliable coding instrument and unquantified uncertainty. Generalizability is limited to CBT-adjacent English therapy and three proprietary models, acknowledged in the Conclusion. Reproducibility is hampered by licensed transcript data that cannot be redistributed (Ethical Considerations) and no stated code/data release, though prompts, tool definitions, and the full coding manual are provided (Appendices E–G).
topics: tool use / function calling for steering

primary_link.title: Move by Move: Measuring and Steering How LLMs Conduct Psychotherapy

radar.summary: Users increasingly turn to large language models for emotional support, yet little is known about how these models actually conduct a psychotherapy interaction. We introduce an ontology of ten therapeutic moves: compact, function-based categories grounded in the MULTI-60 inventory, validated through an annotation campaign with five licensed psychologists, and scaled with a judge-based approach that matches expert agreement. Applying it to real counseling transcripts and model-led sessions, we co
radar.summary_zh: 越來越多使用者向大型語言模型尋求情緒支持，但我們對模型如何實際進行心理治療互動所知有限。本文提出十種治療移動的編碼本體，奠基於 MULTI-60 清單，經五位持照心理學家標註驗證，並以與專家一致性相當的 LLM 評審擴大規模。研究者將本體應用於真實諮商逐字稿與模型主導的療程，比較人類治療師與多個前沿模型的移動分布，並利用代理式訓練特性，把每種移動包裝成工具暴露給模型以引導其行為。結果發現模型持續過度使用提問，比例高達人類的三倍；忽略心理教育；且高度受情境錨定：會延續人類治療師開啟的策略，卻在自主主導療程時極少主動發起。將本體以工具形式提供後，模型與人類移動分布的平均偏差約減半，且在固定取樣預算下，與人類治療師回合層級的對齊提升 7–9 個百分點，全程無需 fine-tuning。限制包括人類資料為口語逐字稿而模型為純文字的模態落差、以模型扮演個案的天真性，以及標註者間僅達中等一致性。本體為臨床人員與開發者提供可稽核的共享詞彙，有助於界定與評估 LLM 的治療行為，但作者強調貼近人類分布並不等同臨床勝任。
radar.title: Move by Move: Measuring and Steering How LLMs Conduct Psychotherapy
