links.title: SPICE: Speculative Prefetching with Low-Rank Expert Surrogates and Heterogeneous Orchestration for MoE Inference Acceleration

evidence: Abstract: 'SPICE achieves up to 3.12x speedup in Time Per Output Token (TPOT) with minimal quality loss' on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen2-57B-A14B.
Section 5.1: hardware includes NVIDIA 5090, RTX 4060, and A800; models are DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen2-57B-A14B; baselines are MoE-On-Demand (Naive), AdapMoE, and CG-MoE.
Section 5.2 and Table 1: 'SPICE incurs only a 3.0-3.5 percentage-point accuracy drop on GSM8K and a 2.3-3.9 point Pass@1 drop on HumanEval' (e.g., DeepSeek-V2-Lite GSM8K 70.8 -> 67.5).
Table 2: SPICE fallback 3.0%, H2D 54.7 GB, 3.48 J/token vs AdapMoE 6.1%, 75.7 GB, 3.78 J/token; evaluated with Top-K=8 and 512-slot expert cache.
Section 5.4/Figure 9: 'The full system achieves 172.5 ms, a 23.9% reduction over the best ablation' under the exact-residual setting.

Section 4.1/Eq. 4-5 and Algorithm 1: adaptive lookahead uses H_min from measured bandwidth and confidence halting at threshold tau, but the values of tau, LoRE rank r, and H_min/H_max are never given.
Section 5.1 lists MT-Bench and LongBench among evaluation datasets, but Section 5.2 reports quality results only for GSM8K and HumanEval.

Section 4.2: LoRE surrogate is a low-rank residual on the always-resident shared expert (Eq. 7-11), fit offline on calibration traces; the approach requires architectures 'that provide a native shared expert in each MoE layer'.
Availability claim: 'Our code will be available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPICE' - promised, not verified as released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on MoE LLM inference acceleration (prefetching, offloading, CPU-GPU orchestration), squarely matching the LLM, MoE/transformer, and inference-and-serving preferences, though not the highest-weight reasoning/agent topics. The three-part design (confidence-aware adaptive lookahead, LoRE shared-expert+low-rank surrogates, cost-based fetch-vs-CPU split) is a sensible but incremental combination of ideas adjacent to AdapMoE and CG-MoE; the surrogate substitution is the freshest element. Rigor is moderate: two models, three GPUs, two precisions, four baselines, an energy protocol, and a 4-variant ablation are present, but key hyperparameters (tau, LoRE rank r, H_min/H_max) are unspecified and MT-Bench/LongBench are listed as evaluation datasets yet never reported. Evidence is quantitative (speedups, accuracy deltas, energy/traffic tables, PCIe utilization) but headline numbers lean on figures and the 'up to 3.12x' best-case framing. Generalizability is decent across shared-expert MoE LLMs but the method explicitly requires a native shared expert. Code is only promised ('will be available'), and missing tuning details limit reproducibility.

primary_link.title: SPICE: Speculative Prefetching with Low-Rank Expert Surrogates and Heterogeneous Orchestration for MoE Inference Acceleration

radar.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are increasingly used in LLMs because sparse activation decouples model capacity from compute cost. However, the large expert parameter footprint often exceeds GPU memory capacity, making inference latency dominated by the host-to-device PCIe transfers for expert loading. To address these challenges, this paper presents SPICE, a speculative prefetching framework for MoE offloading that combines lightweight expert prediction with confidence-aware CPU-GPU orchestrat
radar.summary_zh: 混合專家模型因稀疏啟用而將模型容量與運算成本解耦，但龐大的專家參數常超出 GPU 記憶體，使推論延遲由主機到裝置的 PCIe 權重傳輸主導，成為 I/O 密集問題。本文提出 SPICE，一個結合輕量專家預測與信心感知 CPU–GPU 異質調度的投機預取框架。其一，SPICE 以與目標 MoE 架構對齊的輕量草稿模型預測未來層的專家路由，依硬體重疊需求與預測信心自適應調整前瞻深度，提前預取高信心專家，且不改变目標路由與輸出。其二，當投機預測失誤時，對低信心失誤以常駐共享專家加上低秩專家代理（LoRE）近似，避免關鍵路徑上的同步重載；需精確恢復的失誤則由成本感知調度器決定將權重取回 GPU 執行，或在 CPU 上以主機端權重精確計算，並與 GPU 運算非同步並行。在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 與 Qwen2-57B-A14B 及多種 GPU 平台上，SPICE 相對 AdapMoE 達 2.04–3.12 倍 TPOT 加速，GSM8K 準確率僅下降 3.0–3.5 點、HumanEval Pass@1 下降 2.3–3.9 點，且 fallback 率最低（3.0%）、單位 token 能耗 3.48 J。結論指出 MoE 卸載不僅需要預測未來專家，更需決定哪些失誤值得近似、哪些必須精確恢復，以及精確殘餘運算應在何處執行。
radar.title: SPICE: Speculative Prefetching with Low-Rank Expert Surrogates and Heterogeneous Orchestration for MoE Inference Acceleration
radar.title_zh: SPICE：以低秩專家代理與異質調度實現 MoE 推論加速的投機預取

links.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs

llm_evaluation.rationale:
Preference relevance (0.90): Strongly on-topic LLM methodology paper. It concerns serving compressed, 4-bit large language models (Abstract: 'Serving large language models cheaply increasingly means shipping models that are both structurally compressed... and quantized to 4 bits'), with direct hits on LLM (weight 2.5), quantization/distillation/compression under Scaling & Efficiency, fine-tuning/training under Training & Optimization, serving/memory under Inference & Serving, and long-context healing (§3.4: 16k-32k context training; AA-LCR long-context benchmark in §4). Not a pure domain application; in scope.

Novelty (0.45): The paper self-describes as 'an experience-and-recipe paper rather than a claim of a new algorithmic primitive' (§1), combining 'well-understood ingredients (knowledge distillation and fake-quantized training)'. QAD already exists (NVIDIA 2026, cited §1/§2), and distillation+quantization dates to Polino et al. 2018 (§2). The incremental contribution is the teacher choice in the compound-compression regime (§1: 'our contribution is the choice of teacher in the compress-then-quantize setting') plus the observation that the quantization stage is 'a second opportunity to apply teacher supervision' (§5.1) and the backend-gap deployment lesson (§6). Modest but real practitioner novelty.

Rigor (0.50): Controls are limited. The central claim — distilling from the original model beats distilling from the recovered bfloat16 checkpoint — was never tested head-to-head: §7 admits 'we did not run the head-to-head experiment (QAH vs. QAD-from-M_BF16 at matched configuration)'. All results are single runs with no seed variance or confidence intervals (§7: 'Every number is a single run'), and AIME 2025 has only 30 problems. Positive rigor signals: matched QAT baseline (§3.3, §5.2), an eleven-configuration QAT sweep with full table (Appendix A, Table 2), freezing ablation noted (§6: unfrozen layer norms/embeddings 'produced checkpoints worse than the unhealed MXFP4 model'), and candid limitations. The masking-schedule claim 'loss-mask-only training consistently underperformed' (§3.4) lacks supporting numbers.

Evidence strength (0.55): Quantitative results are concrete and internally consistent: 7-of-9 benchmark wins over the bf16 source with named deltas (§5.1: +7.4 AA-LCR 42.7 vs 35.3, +5.6 AIME 76.3 vs 70.7), teacher-parity figures (LiveCodeBench 66.5 vs 66.0, GPQA within 1.6, §5.1), QAH vs QAT convergence curves (54.9 peak at ~100 steps vs 54.6 at ~700, QAT loses ~19 points by step 1200, Figure 3/§5.2), and the backend sweep (DeepSpeed GPQA plateau 65.15 vs FSDP2 73.74, Table 1 and Appendix A Table 2). However, evidence rests on single runs, small-n benchmarks, one model family, and one format (§7), and key benchmark comparisons appear only via figure descriptions without full numeric tables (Figure 2).

Generalizability (0.40): Confined to GPT-OSS MoE transformers (120B→60B, 20B→9B), MXFP4 only, one data mixture (§7: 'One model family, one format, one data mixture'). The compression operator is proprietary, so transfer to layer pruning, SliceGPT, or low-rank decomposition is 'not verified' (§7), though QAH itself is claimed to need only logit access to the teacher (§7).

Reproducibility (0.40): Hyperparameters and data are specified (§4: MXFP4 stage, 32k context, global batch 64, lr 5e-6, 400 steps; Nemotron + SmolTalk mixture), and the chunked-KL kernel is delegated to a cited companion work (§3.4, Ryskulov et al. 2026). The open-weight Hypernova-60B release is linked (Abstract), but the paper notes the public release 'incorporates further training beyond the pipeline evaluated in this paper' (§1), the compression operator is proprietary (§7), and the 9B client deployment details are 'withheld' (§5.2) — so the evaluated pipeline cannot be fully reproduced.

Weighted score: 0.9*0.40 + 0.45*0.15 + 0.50*0.15 + 0.55*0.15 + 0.40*0.10 + 0.40*0.05 = 0.645 ≈ 0.65.

primary_link.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs

radar.summary: Serving large language models cheaply increasingly means shipping models that are both structurally compressed to a fraction of their parameters and quantized to 4 bits. Together these steps degrade reasoning, mathematics, coding, and long-context behavior enough to require a recovery, or healing, stage before deployment. The default recipe, quantization-aware training (QAT), re-fits the compressed, quantized model to hard labels; in our pipeline it converged slowly and collapsed past its peak.
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的部署常將結構壓縮與 4-bit 量化串聯使用，兩者相加足以重創推理、數學、程式與長情境能力，需要恢復階段。預設做法量化感知訓練以硬標籤重新擬合，作者在實務中發現其收斂緩慢且過峰後崩潰；而量化感知蒸餾預設存在全精度對應模型，在結構壓縮後並不成立——壓縮模型的 bfloat16 檢查點只是蒸餾恢復的近似，會封頂學生模型的準確率。因此作者提出量化感知癒合，直接以 KL 散度從原始未壓縮模型蒸餾 4-bit 學生，搭配 fake quantizer 與離線快取的教師 logits。在 GPT-OSS 120B→60B→MXFP4 管線中，QAH 學生在九項基準中有七項追平或超越自身 bfloat16 來源，於 LiveCodeBench 達到 120B 教師水準，權重記憶體約省 4 倍；相較匹配的 QAT 基準，約以 7 倍速度達到相近峰值，且持續訓練不崩潰，無需手調 early stopping。文中亦分享部署教訓：FSDP2 與 DeepSpeed 之間存在大幅且可重現的品質落差、必須凍結量化敏感子模組，以及以 chunked-KL 使 32k 長情境癒合可行。限制包括未執行直接 QAD 對照實驗、單一種子且部分基準樣本小、僅驗證單一模型家族與格式。此配方已產出開放權重的 Hypernova-60B。
radar.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs
radar.title_zh: 量化感知癒合：恢復壓縮 4-bit LLM 的實用配方

links.title: A Reproducible, License-Aware Distillation Recipe for CPUDeployable Safety Classification

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): students match teachers on adversarial text within overlapping confidence intervals; smallest generative student reaches 3.8% benign FPR vs 4.8% for the 8B teacher; encoder classifies in ~24 ms per request on CPU.

Section 5 (Page 7): teacher selected by shootout—Llama Guard 3 8B obtained macro-F1 0.517 and benign FPR 0.068; 'Distillation labeling touched the training buckets only. The gold benchmark was labeled independently... no teacher ever ran over it.'

Section 6 (Pages 9-10): gold benchmark of 6,361 scorable rows over four slices (dev/headline/stress/benign); fixed 0.5 threshold for all models; 95% percentile bootstrap CIs with B=1000 resamples under fixed seed.

Section 7, Table 5 (Page 10): DistilBERT stress macro-F1 0.618 [.594,.641] vs teacher 0.588 [.566,.610] (overlapping intervals); Qwen2.5-0.5B LoRA benign FPR 0.038 [.023,.053] vs 0.115 [.090,.140] for Llama Guard 3 1B.

Section 7, Table 8 (Page 14): removing per-class rebalancing costs −0.171 headline macro-F1 and −0.377 C4 F1 on TextCNN; ablations from a single seed on the cheapest architecture, with override and data-bucket deltas reported as directions only.
Section 8, Table 9 (Pages 14-15): DistilBERT 24.49 ms (desktop) / 27.96 ms (two vCPU); 0.5B generative student 8-bit quantized 127.52/178.56 ms; teachers not benchmarked on CPU.

Section 9, Limitations (Pages 16-18): gold mapping fidelity unmeasured; monolingual English only; no head-to-head vs ShieldGemma/Granite Guardian due to taxonomy mismatch; multi-label interface undemonstrated (13 of 25,997 unsafe labels carry two codes).

Appendix A (Page 23): per-source license audit table (Table A1), corpus regenerable from public sources, per-row predictions materialized so all tables recompute without rerunning models; labeled corpus 'released as a dataset' though no repository URL is given in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM safety contribution: distilling an LLM guard (Llama Guard 3 8B) into a CPU-deployable student fleet, evaluated on AI Safety/evaluation grounds. Preference relevance is solid but mid-tier: it centers LLM guard models, distillation, quantization, and safety benchmarking, yet touches no Japanese NLP, agents, reasoning, or RAG themes. Novelty is moderate—the paper itself frames the work as a resource/benchmark contribution; the individual techniques (distillation, LoRA, TF-IDF/encoder baselines) are standard, with the license-partitioned corpus and measurable license boundary being the freshest framing. Rigor and evidence are the paper's strengths: an independent 6,361-row gold benchmark never seen by the teacher, fixed 0.5 threshold across models, bootstrap CIs (B=1000) with claims deliberately limited to interval-supported statements, one-factor ablations, and honest reporting of ~25% harmful-prompt leakage and mapping-fidelity gaps. Generalizability is limited by English-only data, a single teacher, and taxonomy-specific conclusions. Reproducibility posture is strong (regenerable corpus, materialized predictions, pinned builds, license audit) but the document names no concrete code/model repository URL. Weighted score 0.63 reflects a careful, honest engineering/resource paper with modest headline numbers (macro-F1 ~0.50) rather than a methodological advance.

primary_link.title: A Reproducible, License-Aware Distillation Recipe for CPUDeployable Safety Classification

radar.summary: Deploying a safety layer for large language models on commodity hardware is constrained by the guards available to do it: current open guard models hold between 1 and 9 billion parameters, are oriented toward the graphics processing unit, and answer in seconds per request on a central processing unit. This paper presents a reproducible, license-aware knowledge-distillation recipe addressing that constraint. A strong open guard labels a corpus of roughly 97,000 prompts, drawn from 24 public datas
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的防護層通常依賴 1B 至 9B 參數的開源 guard 模型，此類模型以 GPU 為導向，在 CPU 上每個請求需時數秒，難以部署於一般硬體。本文提出一套可重現且具授權意識的知識蒸餾配方：以 Llama Guard 3 8B 作為教師，為取自 24 個公開資料集、約 97,000 則提示詞標註七類安全類別，類別對齊 MLCommons AILuminate v1.0 危害分類；再訓練涵蓋詞彙基線、TextCNN、BiLSTM、MiniLM-L6、DistilBERT 與 Qwen2.5-0.5B+LoRA 的小型學生模型艦隊。語料以授權邊界切分為商用與非商用兩桶，使可部署模型與研究模型的差異可被量化。所有模型在 6,361 列、含 600 則無害提示詞的獨立 gold 基準上評估。結果顯示學生模型在對抗性文本上與教師相符（信賴區間重疊），生成式學生將無害提示詞誤報率降至 3.8%，優於 8B 教師的 4.8% 與 1B 教師的 11.5%；DistilBERT 於 CPU 上約 24 毫秒完成分類。消融實驗指出逐類別重新平衡是唯一關鍵要素，而授權限制幾乎無成本。教師在乾淨參考切片上仍領先，論文亦坦承多標籤僅是介面、gold 映射忠實度未量測等限制。此資源使安全分類得以毫秒級延遲運行於一般 CPU，深具部署價值。

links.title: Benchmarking Patent Drafting from Inventor-Style Disclosures

evidence: Abstract & Sec. 1: introduces Dis2Pat (~9.4K disclosure-to-patent pairs) and Patent-MAF; claims consistent superiority over evaluated open-source models and competitiveness with closed-source LLMs.
Table 3 (Sec. 6.1): specification overall quality 85.4 for Patent-MAF vs 85.1 GPT-5 and 81.8 Qwen3-VL-72B; ablations w/o manager and w/o vision both drop to 83.4.
Table 4 (Sec. 6.2): claim overall 86.7 vs GPT-5 91.1; Patent-MAF BERTScore 88.3 vs GPT-5 83.8; w/o polisher largest drop 86.7 to 80.1.
Sec. 3.2 & Table 2: 100-sample human validation (Hallucination 9.8, Contradiction 10.0, De-legalization 9.7); ROUGE-L F1 0.08 vs source patents to show non-copying.
Sec. 5.2/6.3 & Figure 2: pairwise expert evaluation on only 60 samples against four baselines; GPT-5 preferred on completeness, clarity, legality, tie-ish on consistency.
Appendix D: DeepSeek-V3 with CoT as LLM judge; GLM-5.2 robustness re-check agrees on ~85% (spec) / 82% (claims); human-judge agreement 62-82% across dimensions.
Appendix E: only two annotators (one licensed attorney, one trainee), weighted kappa 0.65-0.79; attorney judgments used as primary decisions.
Appendix F.2/F.3: paired t-tests p<0.05 without multiple-comparison correction; ~2.5x token overhead vs single-shot.
Appendix C: LoRA rank 16, alpha 8, dropout 0.05, lr 5e-5, temperature 0.3, 16,384 max tokens, ~700 A100 GPU-hours.
Limitations section: pseudo-disclosures from granted patents may not capture real disclosure diversity/incompleteness; evaluation restricted to English-language patents.
Footnote 1 & Ethics Statement: code at github.com/scylj1/Patent-MAF; dataset to be released under CC-BY-SA-4.0.
Table 3 anomaly: GPT-4o scores BLEU 0.1 / R-1 12.3 on specifications, far below peers, with no analysis of the cause (likely formatting mismatch).
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM-centric agentic benchmarking paper (Dis2Pat dataset + Patent-MAF multi-agent framework) squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: LLMs, agents/multi-agent orchestration, NLP text generation, multimodal LLM inputs, and LLM-as-judge evaluation; patent drafting is a niche legal domain but the methodology (role decomposition, LoRA fine-tuning, prompting, judge-based evaluation) is language-methodology-rich, so it is not a 'pure domain application'. Novelty is moderate: the disclosure-to-patent task framing and figure-inclusive inputs are a genuine increment over Draft2Patent/Pap2Pat, but the manager/drafter/polisher decomposition closely mirrors existing agentic patent systems (AutoPatent, AutoSpec) and generic orchestration patterns. Rigor is solid but not exceptional: dataset filtering, 100-sample human validation with ROUGE-L divergence checks, ablations (manager/vision/finetuning/polisher), IAA (kappa 0.65-0.79), judge-robustness re-check with GLM-5.2, and paired t-tests; weakened by reliance on LLM-judge scores as primary quality evidence, an unexplained GPT-4o collapse (R-1 12.3 vs ~30 for peers), only 60-sample human evaluation with two annotators, and no confidence intervals or correction for multiple comparisons. Evidence supports 'best open-source baseline' claims (Table 3: 85.4 vs 81.8 Qwen3-VL-72B; Table 4: 86.7 claims) but the GPT-5 competitiveness claim is mixed (91.1 vs 86.7 on claims), and automatic metrics disagree in ways the paper only partially reconciles. Generalizability is limited: English-only, US-centric legal conventions, pseudo-disclosures that may not match authentic inventor notes (acknowledged in Limitations), though a Llama-backbone replication (Appendix F.1, Table 6) adds some cross-model validity. Reproducibility is good: public code, CC-BY-SA-4.0 data license, full prompts (Tables 5, 7, 8), LoRA/hyperparameter details, and ~700 A100 GPU-hours reported.

primary_link.title: Benchmarking Patent Drafting from Inventor-Style Disclosures

radar.summary: While recent large language models (LLMs) have achieved promising results on individual patent drafting tasks, they fundamentally fail to investigate the core challenge of real-world patent drafting: generating a complete and legally coherent patent application directly from early-stage invention materials. Prior work predominantly assumes later-stage, highly structured, or already legalistic inputs. However, real patenting workflows begin with informal, de-legalized disclosures authored by inve
radar.summary_zh: 專利撰寫實務始於發明人提出的非正式、去法律化揭露文件，但現有 LLM 評測多假設後期、高度結構化或已具法律格式的輸入。本文提出 Dis2Pat，首個揭露文件到專利申請的資料集，約 9.4K 筆樣本（8,490 訓練、943 測試），由已授權專利透過 GPT-5-mini 改寫成七段發明導向的擬似揭露，保留附圖並移除法律語言；專業人員評估其幻覺、細節、矛盾與去法律化分數皆達 9.7 以上（滿分 10）。作者並提出 Patent-MAF，一個為本地部署設計的多代理框架以因應專利保密需求：manager 代理以 Qwen3-32B 結構化揭露並分派任務，說明書 drafter 以 Qwen3-VL-32B 整合文字與圖像，請求項 drafter 以 LoRA 微調的 Qwen3-32B 產生請求項，polisher 代理統一術語並檢查跨段落一致性。實驗顯示 Patent-MAF 說明書整體品質達 85.4，超越 GPT-5 的 85.1；請求項整體 86.7，雖低於 GPT-5 的 91.1，但 BERTScore 88.3 高於 GPT-5 的 83.8。消融顯示移除 polisher 使請求項下降 6.6 分，移除微調降 5.1 分；視覺輸入有助說明書但對請求項無益。限制包括擬似揭露無法完全反映真實揭露的不完整性、僅涵蓋英文專利，且 token 用量約為單次生成的 2.5 倍。此基準填補真實專利工作流程的評測缺口，證明開源本地模型可逼近閉源水準。

links.title: ArtiMo: Agent-Driven Articulated Mesh Animation

llm_evaluation.rationale: Agentic LLM/VLM orchestration paper (perceiver-planner-executor with critic-actor self-refinement, CoT-style prompts, structured JSON outputs) applied to articulated 3D mesh animation. Genuine overlap with high-weight agent/reasoning/LLM topics and not pure CV, but the task domain is graphics/4D animation and the agent pattern (Self-Refine-style critique loops) is well-established; novelty comes mainly from the new task formulation and URDF grounding. Rigor is decent: ablations (Direct VLM 0.703 vs Full 0.985 P_gIoU), injected-failure critic tests (93.5% over 168 injections), per-type breakdowns, and 3-run variance are reported. However, evaluation rests on a self-constructed benchmark with self-defined metrics, near-ceiling scores, and mismatched baselines; oracle-URDF dependence is exposed by the Particulate setting dropping to 0.450. Closed-source API models and no explicit code release limit reproducibility.

primary_link.title: ArtiMo: Agent-Driven Articulated Mesh Animation

radar.summary: Animating articulated 3D meshes via text requires satisfying strict kinematic constraints, modeling causal interactions between parts, and achieving instruction fidelity. Due to the absence of task-specific training data and explicit articulation supervision, existing data-driven mesh animation methods are largely inapplicable to this setting. To address this, we propose ArtiMo, a novel agent-driven framework for text-guided articulated mesh animation. Operating in a zero-shot manner, ArtiMo dev
radar.summary_zh: 以文字驅動可關節化 3D 網格動畫，必須同時滿足 URDF 運動學約束、零件間因果互動與指令忠實度，但既有資料驅動方法缺乏任務資料與關節化監督。本文提出 ArtiMo，一個零樣本代理式框架：先將 URDF 資產轉為代理可讀表徵（多視角渲染、彩色零件疊圖、關節摘要與尺度資訊），由 VLM（Gemini 3.1 Pro）進行零件語意定位並推斷因果關係，LLM（ChatGPT 5.4）規劃含時序與狀態轉移的關節層級軌跡，再由 Blender 執行並輸出 GLTF 動畫。系統另設 critic–actor 自我改良迴圈：將動畫渲染成含運動軌跡與平移、旋轉提示的關鍵影格，供 VLM 評審診斷方向、幅度與復位錯誤，並回傳有限修復提示。作者貢獻橫跨 21 類物件、225 段動作的專家標註基準，並設計零件感知的 3D 與 2D 評測指標。結果顯示完整系統 P_gIoU 達 0.985、P_OccF1 0.899，即使使用 Particulate 預測的 URDF 亦有 0.450，遠優於 AnimateAnyMesh 的 0.019 與 Animate3D 的 -0.130；消融證實結構化規劃與迭代視覺修正缺一不可，critic 對注入錯誤的偵測率為 93.5%。論文另示範將運動計畫重定向至機器手臂，如先轉門把再開門、按鈕觸發壺蓋開啟。限制在於依賴輸入關節結構品質、難以處理微小或被遮蔽零件，且彈簧與阻尼等物理參數僅為近似。

links.title: Scaling Unsupervised Word Alignment to Documents via Structural Constraints

evidence: Abstract: 'Averaged over three models, CTFAlign reduces word alignment error rate from 0.412 to 0.326.'
Sec. 5 'LLM prompting does not scale': GPT-5.4-mini document-level AER collapses to near-1.0 across all six pairs (Table 1, e.g., en-fr 0.995).
Sec. 5: 'CTFAlign+Argmax ... brings down average AER from 0.341 to 0.248 with LaBSE' and with Qwen closes the sentence-document gap (0.294 vs 0.295).
Sec. 5 limitation of MDPAlign: 'on en-ja, MDPAlign falls under the unconstrained baseline (Qwen+MDPAlign 0.752/0.728 vs. SimAlign 0.602)'.
Sec. 6.1, Table 2: document-level DiffAlign CTF+Argmax improves ROC AUC over baseline (ja-zh omissions 0.788 vs 0.733; en-de additions 0.863 vs 0.843).
Sec. 6.2, Table 3: CTF+Argmax gains Spearman rho over DiffAlign on SwissGov-RSD (+0.044 en-de, +0.033 en-fr, +0.035 en-it).
Limitations: 'the en–fr and la–gr test sets each consist of only a single document pair' and reconstructed datasets are largely monotonic.
Footnote 1 and Appendix A: package at github.com/ZurichNLP/CTFAlign, experimental code and HuggingFace data released, plus reference implementation of CTFAlign.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid, training-free multilingual NLP methodology paper on document-level word alignment using structural constraints (diagonal prior, coarse-to-fine refinement) over embedding similarity matrices. Preference relevance is moderate: core contribution is classic word-alignment NLP rather than LLM/agent/reasoning science; LLM and foundation-model involvement is as tools (Qwen3-Embedding, mmBERT, LaBSE encoders; GPT-5.4-mini only as a failing 1-shot baseline), and Japanese content (en-ja, ja-zh) is one of several pairs. Novelty is incremental: both structural priors adapt known ideas (IBM Model 2/FastAlign positional priors, VecAlign coarse-to-fine) to token-level document matrices, clearly positioned against prior work in Sec. 2. Rigor is strong: six language pairs, three encoders, dev/test split discipline with hyperparameter search (App. E.2), sentence-level upper bounds, strict-vs-fuzzy ablation, and honest failure analysis (MDPAlign underperforms baseline on en-ja; mmBERT+CTFAlign failure case in App. H). Evidence is credible but bounded: headline AER drop 0.412→0.326 (Abstract) and downstream gains are modest and unaccompanied by significance tests, and several test sets collapse to a single document pair (Limitations). Generalizability is good given model-agnostic design and transfer to two downstream tasks, with the caveat that MDPAlign is structure-dependent and results hinge on encoder quality. Reproducibility is excellent: released Python package, experiment code, HF data, reference implementation (App. A), prompts (App. D), and full P/R/F1/AER tables.

primary_link.title: Scaling Unsupervised Word Alignment to Documents via Structural Constraints

radar.summary: Word alignment has traditionally been studied between sentences, but many cross-lingual tasks increasingly require correspondences across full documents. While recent multilingual embedding models can encode long inputs, we show that applying algorithms designed for sentences directly to documents leads to performance degradation. To address this, we introduce CTFAlign, a lightweight, training-free approach for document-level word alignment. CTFAlign applies a coarse-to-fine refinement strategy
radar.summary_zh: 詞對齊長期在句對層級研究，但幻覺偵測、標籤投影等跨語言任務日益需要文件級對應。本文展示為句子設計的嵌入對齊演算法直接套用於整份文件時，相似度矩陣變大且雜訊增多，效能明顯退化。作者提出兩種免訓練、模型無關的結構約束：MDPAlign 以主對角線先驗（嚴格帶狀遮罩或高斯衰減）限制搜尋空間；CTFAlign 採由粗到細策略，從 2×2 區塊網格遞迴細化，僅保留語意相似區域並附緩衝與復原機制。兩者皆直接作用於完整文件的 token 相似度矩陣，不需斷句或句對齊。評估涵蓋英法、英羅馬尼亞、英日、英中、英捷克與拉丁—希臘六個語言對，搭配 Qwen3-Embedding-4B、mmBERT-base 與 LaBSE。結果顯示 CTFAlign 將三模型平均 AER 由 0.412 降至 0.326，其中 CTFAlign+Argmax 最穩健，於 LaBSE 上平均 AER 為 0.248，並在多個設定追平甚至超越句級上限；以 GPT-5.4-mini 進行 1-shot 提示在文件級則崩壞至接近 1.0 的 AER。MDPAlign 僅在對齊貼近對角線時有效，於英日語對會失效。下游任務方面，結構約束提升 WMT24 翻譯覆蓋評估（遺漏與添加偵測）的 ROC AUC，並在 SwissGov-RSD 語意差異辨識上創下新紀錄。限制包括 gold 資料由句級標註重組、文件結構近乎單調，且效能依賴編碼器表徵，粗層錯誤可能遞迴傳播。

links.title: AI-to-AI Code Reviews of GitHub Pull Requests

llm_evaluation.rationale: Topic relevance (0.65): Direct hit on high-weight preferences Agents & Tool Use (AI coding agents, agent-author/agent-reviewer pairings) and Code & Programming (code review, GitHub PRs), with secondary LLM-as-a-judge/self-preference framing in Section 8; however, it is an empirical mining study that develops no language-model methodology itself, so not a core LLM/reasoning paper. Novelty (0.65): Section 2 and Section 3.4 claim the first product-resolved AI-author–AI-reviewer pairing characterization at scale (248,641 AI-reviewed agent-authored PRs; 45,269 cross-product), going beyond prior bot-attribution work (BIMAN, BoDeGHa) and agent-PR studies; contribution is a new dataset/characterization, not a method. Rigor (0.60): Careful two-tier signature framework ('Section 3.2: S1 body signatures, S2 vendor logins; branch-name prefixes never sufficient alone'), explicit quarantine ('Section 3.3: 38.0% of 4,563,819 candidates quarantined, 96.9% branch_only'), appropriate statistics ('Section 5.1: Cramér's V=0.150, χ²=3177.5; Wald CI [23.1,25.9]' and Table 4 Mann–Whitney U with Cliff's δ 0.02–0.27), and a candid threats section ('Section 7: 79.2% vs 31.9% timestamp retention'); but attribution has no external validation ('Section 3.3: internal consistency check rather than external validation'), no matched human baseline, and comment categories are self-declared and unvalidated. Evidence (0.60): Large-scale, internally consistent numbers (Table 2 sums match 45,269/208,145; Table 4 supports the 58–65% claim), yet all counts are self-admitted lower bounds and RQ2 measures are reviewer-output composition, not quality. Generalizability (0.50): 'Section 7 External validity: public GitHub only, 2024-01-01 to 2026-04-15, conditioned on signature attribution and integration adoption'; findings are period- and platform-bound, though the measurement method is reusable. Reproducibility (0.85): 'Section 3.5/Data Availability: replication package (scripts, signature registry, classifier rules) on GitHub; CodAGE on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0', with rule set and quarantine reasons released. Overall a solid emerging-results empirical characterization with honest caveats but descriptive-only evidence and no methodological or validated-quality contribution.

primary_link.title: AI-to-AI Code Reviews of GitHub Pull Requests

radar.summary: AI coding agents are increasingly integrated into software development workflows, operating on both sides of the pull-request (PR) process: AI authoring agents create or modify PRs, while AI reviewers evaluate them. This creates a closed loop in which one AI coding agent reviews a contribution attributed to another. We construct a large-scale dataset of AI-to-AI code review by linking AI-attributed PRs with AI-attributed review events from CodAGE, a public dataset of coding-agent-generated GitHu
radar.summary_zh: 本文探討「封閉迴圈」(closed-loop)AI 審查現象:AI 編碼代理(agent)撰寫的 GitHub pull request(PR)由另一個 AI 審查工具評審。作者將 CodAGE 資料集中的 AI 撰寫 PR 與 AI 歸因的審查事件連結,以兩層簽章歸因法(正文簽章與廠商控制帳號)建立大規模資料集,涵蓋 248,641 個至少收到一次 AI 審查的 PR,其中 45,269 個為跨產品審查、208,145 個為同產品審查。結果顯示:跨產品審查僅佔可歸因代理撰寫 PR 的約 1.6%,但絕對數量可觀,且自 2025 年第一季至第三季成長逾兩個數量級;Copilot 為最主要審查者,典型組合為 Codex 撰寫、Copilot 審查。審查行為方面,CodeRabbit 對 Claude Code 撰寫 PR 給出的 refactor 類意見佔 35.0%,遠高於 Copilot 撰寫 PR 的 10.5%;三個審查機器人對同產品 PR 的平均意見數高出 58–65%,但效應量小且集中於長尾;跨產品首審延遲中位數(1.2 分鐘)反而低於同產品(4.7 分鐘),主要反映審查者組成與時間戳完整性差異。限制:簽章歸因可能漏計,計數為下界;歸因屬產品層級而非模型層級;延遲比較受限於時間戳可得性;且未分析人類對照組。此研究提醒實證軟體工程:GitHub 資料不能再假定全為人類貢獻,而審查內容的正確性仍需人工驗證。
radar.title: AI-to-AI Code Reviews of GitHub Pull Requests
radar.title_zh: AI 對 AI 的 GitHub Pull Request 程式碼審查

links.title: ExploreAI: Agentic Exploration Knowledge Bases for Reproducible Observable-Regression Testing of Black-Box VR and 3D Applications

evidence: Abstract and Section I: ExploreAI is described as an 'LLM-driven agentic framework' where the LLM handles planning, evidence recording, capture-policy, and verification decisions while perception/navigation are delegated to specialized modules.

Section IV-B: six LLM configurations with exact API strings (gpt-5.4, gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, claude-opus-4-8, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) across six scenes in Unity, AI2-THOR, and BeamNG.

Section IV-C: frozen manifests built by two annotator passes with Cohen's kappa 0.86 and object-id Jaccard 0.89, with 5-63 targets per scene; Section V-A Table II reports 0.979 object / 0.971 view completeness macro averages.

Section V-B Table V: ablation on Urban Cabin shows removing LLM planning drops object/view completeness to 0.323/0.209 and removing self-verification yields aggregate 0.666; ablations are trace replays, acknowledged in Section VI External Validity.

Section V-C Table III text: all six configurations reach identical completeness with 'zero variance (SD=0)'; authors state the benchmark 'saturates rather than separating model families' and model choice trades cost, not completeness (Table IV: $0.001-$0.293 per run).

Section V-C Table VII: automated reproduction with EKB reaches 0.98/0.97 vs 0.58/0.46 without, but the reproducer is ExploreAI itself and automated Time is decision latency only; human study is a six-participant pilot.

Section V-C Table VIII: DiffEKBs detects 35/36 injected changes with 0 false positives (only a wrong-object FN); authors label it 'a controlled-injection proof of concept' with real version changes left as future work.

Section VI External Validity: authors admit six scenes are a small sample, dynamic/transparent/multiplayer behaviors are unhandled, and both reproduction studies are pilots rather than statistically powered studies.
Data Availability and Table I: replication package at figshare link; prompts and EKB schema 'released in artifact'; run configuration (YOLO thresholds, orbit policy, score weights) fully specified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agentic software-testing paper that strongly matches the high-weight LLM and Agents & Tool Use preferences: an LLM-driven agent performs planning, evidence recording, capture policy, and self-verification for black-box VR/3D regression testing, with a reusable EKB artifact and DiffEKBs cross-version diffing. It is in scope because language-model methodology is central (six LLM configurations with exact API strings), not pure CV/robotics. Evaluation is unusually transparent and internally consistent: 0.979/0.971 completeness against frozen two-annotator manifests (kappa 0.86, Jaccard 0.89), ablation aggregates recompute correctly (e.g., Urban Cabin no-planning 0.323/0.209 -> 0.633 aggregate), and a candid threats-to-validity section. Weaknesses cap the score: the six-scene benchmark saturates (SD=0 across all six LLMs, so it does not separate models), ablations are trace replays rather than end-to-end reruns, the automated reproducer is ExploreAI itself (circularity only partly mitigated), the human reproduction study has n=6, DiffEKBs is validated only on 36 injected changes, and the contribution is incremental over the authors' prior LLM-VR-testing case study (ref [19]). Artifact availability (figshare package, released prompts, schemas, manifests, logs) supports reproducibility.

primary_link.title: ExploreAI: Agentic Exploration Knowledge Bases for Reproducible Observable-Regression Testing of Black-Box VR and 3D Applications

radar.summary: Black-box VR and 3D applications are difficult to regression test because observable failures depend on where a tester moves, what objects are visible, and which views are captured. Manual exploratory testing can find such failures, but its evidence is time-consuming to reproduce; systematic sweeps are reproducible, but they lack semantic guidance and spend exploration budget on low-value viewpoints. We observe that an LLM can make the high-level decisions a human tester makes during exploration
radar.summary_zh: 黑箱 VR 與 3D 應用難以迴歸測試:可觀察的失敗取決於測試者移動位置、物件可見性與擷取的視角;人工探索式測試的證據難以重現,固定掃描又缺乏語意引導。本文提出 ExploreAI,一個 LLM 驅動的代理式框架,建構「探索知識庫」(Exploration Knowledge Base, EKB):為每個偵測到的物件結構化記錄掃描證據、目標選取理由、導航路徑、多視角擷取與自我驗證結果,成為可重用、可比對的測試工件。LLM 負責高層規劃、證據記錄、擷取政策與驗證決策,YOLO 感知與確定性模組處理高頻導航與擷取以控制成本。在 Unity、AI2-THOR 與 BeamNG 的六個室內外場景中,完整探索達 0.979 物件完整度與 0.971 視角完整度,目標探索完成所有查詢相關目標;消融實驗顯示移除 LLM 規劃使 Urban Cabin 完整度由 0.871/0.825 驟降至 0.323/0.209,移除自我驗證亦降至 0.666。重現試驗(六位人類受試者與自動化代理)顯示 EKB 情境能更完整、更快速重現物件—視角證據;DiffEKBs 比對偵測出 36 個注入變更中的 35 個且零誤報。限制:場景僅六個且能力基準已飽和、無法區分模型家族;人類試驗規模小;完整度仰賴人工凍結清單;成本依硬體與定價而定。此工作將探索結果轉為可重現證據,對跨版本可觀察迴歸檢測深具價值。
radar.title: ExploreAI: Agentic Exploration Knowledge Bases for Reproducible Observable-Regression Testing of Black-Box VR and 3D Applications
radar.title_zh: ExploreAI:以代理式探索知識庫實現黑箱 VR 與 3D 應用之可重現可觀察迴歸測試

links.title: Vibe Coding and Web Application Security: A Twin-Prompt Study

evidence: Abstract, p.1: 'The security-aware variant produced fewer confirmed findings in every application (24 versus 51) and contained no Critical or High issues; the most severe finding was detected only by manual testing.'

Section 3.2, p.3: 'Each variant was produced in a single, non-iterative interaction: one prompt, one response, no self-critique, no judge model, no security feedback loop and no repair step' — weakest intervention architecture chosen deliberately to isolate prompt effect.
Section 3.1, p.3: corpus of six applications is bespoke — 'The applications were not drawn from an existing benchmark' — limiting cross-study comparability, acknowledged as first future-work item.

Table 5, p.5: per-application A vs B confirmed findings (e.g., APP1 10 vs 4; APP6 11 vs 5; total 51 vs 24), with container/header classes shown to contribute equally to both variants and thus not drive the difference.
Section 4.3 / Table 6, p.6: 28 SAST-only, 24 DAST-only, 11 manual-only, 12 multi-method of 75 confirmed findings; Critical hard-coded-JWT-secret forgery in APP2 missed by all automated scanners.

Section 6, p.7: 'Each variant was generated exactly once and LLM output is non-deterministic, so part of any A–B difference may be run-to-run variation... no causal claim is made'; labelling by one author without second rater or agreement measure.

Section 7, p.7: 'The application corpus, prompts, raw tool reports, consolidated datasets, statistics tables, figures, processing scripts and command log are available... in the public repository (https://github.com/dandrocec/vibe_coding_security)'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope empirical study of LLM code generation security: Claude Code/Opus 4.8 as subject, a prompt-only intervention (security-aware variant), and multi-method vulnerability evaluation. Strong topical alignment with LLM, code/security-evaluation, prompting, and agent-tool preferences; not a domain-application or out-of-scope paper. Methodological care is real (pre-registered OWASP surface mapping, byte-identical Dockerfile control, frozen code, de-duplication pipeline, honest threats-to-validity section, no inferential overreach), but the design is very small: six bespoke applications, one generation run per cell, one analyst assigning severity/labels, confounded language comparison. Evidence is internally consistent (B<A in all six pairs, no Critical/High in B) yet purely descriptive and indistinguishable from run-to-run noise by the author's own admission. Generalizability is limited to one model, one assistant, and author-written tasks; the cross-benchmark contrast (vs Zhao et al., Tony et al.) is suggestive only. Reproducibility is aided by a claimed public repository with raw reports, prompts, tool versions, and a command log, though LLM generation itself is non-deterministic. A modest, transparently scoped preliminary contribution.

primary_link.title: Vibe Coding and Web Application Security: A Twin-Prompt Study

radar.summary: Large language models increasingly generate complete web applications from natural-language prompts, raising the question of whether explicitly requesting security best practice improves the result. We study six functionally distinct web applications, each generated in two prompt variants that are identical except for an appended security-requirements section: a baseline (A) and a security-aware (B) variant. All twelve programs were produced by the same agentic coding assistant and the same mode
radar.summary_zh: 「vibe coding」指以自然語言提示讓大型語言模型直接生成完整可執行的網頁應用,但也把認證、輸入處理與存取控制等安全決策交給模型。本文採雙提示(twin-prompt)設計:六個功能各異、橫跨三種框架與兩種語言的網頁應用,分別以基準提示(A)與附加安全需求章節的提示(B),由同一 Claude Code 代理與 Claude Opus 4.8 模型單輪生成,共十二個程式;再以靜態分析(Bandit、Semgrep、ESLint)、依賴審計(pip-audit、npm audit)、動態掃描(OWASP ZAP、Nikto)與人工測試交叉檢驗,85 個候選發現確認 75 個並標註 OWASP 類別。結果:安全感知變體在每個應用的確認發現皆較少(24 對 51,平均 4.0 對 8.5),且無 Critical 或 High 問題;兩個 Critical 與十一個 High 全在基準變體,發現以 A05 安全設定不當(48/75)為大宗。偵測方法高度互補:28 個僅由 SAST、24 個僅由 DAST、11 個僅由人工測試發現;最嚴重的問題——以硬編碼金鑰簽署 JWT、可偽造任意使用者 token——僅由人工測試發現,掃描器亦出現誤報。限制:語料小、每變體僅生成一次、單人標註、僅描述性統計而無檢定,無法分離提示效果與執行間變異。此初步研究提示完整的安全需求段落有助消除最嚴重弱點,但例行強化仍賴部署設定,並待多模型重複實驗驗證。
radar.title: Vibe Coding and Web Application Security: A Twin-Prompt Study
radar.title_zh: Vibe Coding 與網頁應用程式安全:雙提示研究

links.title: Calibrating Criterion Revision in LLM Agents: Failure Modes and a Trace-Anchored Protocol

evidence: §3.2: operationalizes criterion metabolism as CM = D ∧ E ∧ P ∧ C ∧ V, five non-compensatory conditions with explicit construct boundary ('one localizable layer of operative criterion change').

§6 Table 3: seven deterministic mechanism fixtures × 12 cases = 84 scorer trials; all four prespecified checks pass, but text explicitly notes this 'validates scorer behavior on designed mechanisms, not the construct itself'.
§8.2 Table 6: CM = 0 across all 192 model–case–arm trials; Qwen 2.5 passes P=12/12 and V=12/12 in every arm yet C=0, since the deleted condition reuses the stateless call.

§8.3: Qwen answers 12/12 loophole items with no revision state, 'establishing that current-item competence is sufficient to erase the intended deletion contrast' — a genuine zero-state reconstruction finding.
§7.2 and §11: four quantized artifacts, one deterministic seed, twelve cases with single loophole items; no significance tests; shared revision calls create dependent observations.

Reproducibility section: 'the manuscript source omits the raw response archive, its aggregates are author-verified but not independently recomputable from this archive alone'; §7.1 preserves the erroneous frozen_at timestamp, so the run was not independently preregistered.
Appendix C: explicit claim boundary — no capability-absence claim, no model ranking, CMB-0.4 is 'a protocol contribution rather than an empirical result'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant agent-evaluation paper: defines 'criterion revision' as a five-condition non-compensatory construct (D,E,P,C,V) for attributing persistent state in LLM agents, directly matching agent/memory/benchmark preferences. Methodological self-scrutiny is unusually strong (deterministic fixture validation, hash-bound artifacts, explicit claim boundaries, preserved preregistration error), but the empirical core is deliberately a calibration pilot: 4 small quantized models, one seed, 12 cases, confounded deletion/conflict interventions, and a universal zero result that supports only instrument diagnosis. The CMB-0.4 protocol is prospective with no results, so evidence strength and generalizability are inherently limited; reproducibility is undercut by the missing raw-response archive.

primary_link.title: Calibrating Criterion Revision in LLM Agents: Failure Modes and a Trace-Anchored Protocol

radar.summary: Language-model agents can improve after failure or carry text across episodes without revising what counts as success. We study the narrower attribution problem of criterion revision: when criterion K0 accepts an outcome violating a broader commitment B, what observations justify saying that the system formed and persistently used K1? We require five non-compensatory conditions: criterion-failure detection, a model-emitted proposal, new-episode transfer, intervention sensitivity on the claimed c
radar.summary_zh: LLM 代理失敗後可能改進,但改進是否代表系統真的修訂了「何謂成功」的準則(criterion revision)?本文將此歸因問題操作化為五個不可補償的證據條件:準則失敗偵測、模型自行提出修訂、清除上下文後在狀態完好下將修訂轉移到新情境、對所宣稱狀態載體的介入敏感性,以及保留正當判斷。作者建構 CMB-0.1 儀器:十二個跨領域案例、四種實驗臂(無狀態、僅附加歷史、系統生成但由 harness 提交的準則狀態、評估者預寫的 oracle 狀態),先以七個機制夾具完成 84 次確定性評分器驗證,再對 Llama 3.2、Gemma 3、Qwen 2.5 與 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 四個本地量化模型執行 96 次呼叫、192 個試驗校準。結果:沒有任何試驗同時滿足五條件,但此零值不能證明能力不存在——輸出契約失敗、評估承諾洩漏目標區分、harness 自動代為提交、刪除條件沿用無狀態呼叫、衝突提示同時改變多重因素等混淆都會壓低分數;Qwen 2.5-7B 更在無修訂狀態下答對全部轉移與保留題目,暴露「零狀態重建」問題。據此提出前瞻性 CMB-0.4 協定:隱藏式轉移、明確 WRITE/NO-WRITE/ESCALATE 動作與獨立執行紀錄、匹配介入與凍結的可執行 oracle。限制:僅四個量化模型、單一種子、案例數少,CMB-0.4 仍屬設計而非實證結果。此研究對提升 LLM 基準的建構效度極具示範價值。
radar.title: Calibrating Criterion Revision in LLM Agents: Failure Modes and a Trace-Anchored Protocol
radar.title_zh: 校準 LLM 代理的準則修訂:失敗模式與軌跡錨定協定

links.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies

evidence: Abstract: 'Using Qwen3-8B as a hybrid model that can be decoded with or without chain-of-thought reasoning, we compare direct decision policies, reasoning policies, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning' and identifies a capability-auditability tradeoff.

Table 1 (Results): Token-SFT classifier no-think F1 0.620 vs 0.367 in think mode; base Qwen3-8B think 0.536 vs no-think 0.096; RL-accuracy 0.520 and RL-faithfulness 0.549 fail to exceed base think policy.
Results, 'Decision Formation During Reasoning': post-CoT decision probe AUROC 0.976±0.045 vs pre-CoT 0.664±0.034 and TF-IDF text baseline 0.631±0.053; direct classifier decodable pre-CoT at 0.997.
Appendix E, Table 12-13: neutral filler flips 0.403 vs partial reasoning 0.277; filler-controlled base dependence gap +0.126 with McNemar p=7.0e-8, showing raw truncation overstates dependence.
Appendix G, Tables 17-18: dependence gap for accuracy objective changes sign across seeds (+0.046, -0.070, +0.110); between-run variability exceeds differences between reward objectives.
Appendix C.3-C.4: pushed RL run (temperature 1.0, group size 16, 250 iterations) reduced zero-variance groups from ~15/16 to ~3/16 yet held-out macro-F1 plateaued unchanged, ruling out undertraining.
Appendix D: probe validation includes within-family evaluation (D.3), TF-IDF text-only baselines (D.4), nested cross-validation layer selection (D.5), and register-transfer failures (D.6).
Appendix F.2: GPT-5 stated-type classifier validated on n=120 human-labelled traces (kappa 0.42 and 0.53) with inter-annotator kappa only 0.21, honestly reported as taxonomy ambiguity.

Limitations section: 'The experiments focus on a single intervention-timing benchmark composed of synthetic conversations... complete probe and reinforcement-learning analyses are limited to Qwen3-8B.'

Reproducibility Statement: LoRA rank 16 alpha=32, GRPO hyperparameters in Appendix A.6, single 24 GB GPU, three seeds per RL objective, and commitment to open-source code, adapters, prompts, and evaluation scripts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM paper spanning multiple weighted preferences: chain-of-thought faithfulness in abstaining action policies (Qwen3-8B think/no-think, GPT-4o, GPT-5.1), agent oversight, GRPO/alignment, and interpretability via activation probes. Novel contribution is framing faithfulness beyond QA for action/abstention policies with class imbalance and asymmetric costs, identifying a capability-auditability tradeoff, and introducing filler-controlled CoT ablations plus seed-variance controls for RL comparisons. Rigor is strong: text-only TF-IDF baselines, shuffled-label controls, nested cross-validation for layer selection, within-family probe evaluation, McNemar tests, three RL seeds, a prior-shift ablation, an increased-gradient RL run (zero-variance groups 15/16 to 3/16), and human validation of the LLM classifier (kappa 0.42/0.53 vs inter-annotator 0.21). Evidence is quantitative and honestly caveated, though some evaluations are small (n=400 matched, n=196 trajectory probes, 60-item RL held-out), non-matching 200-item slices for secondary models, and reliance on a synthetic benchmark from concurrent unpublished work. Generalizability is moderate: the tradeoff replicates across scale and family, but full probe/RL analyses are Qwen3-8B only. Reproducibility is strong with full hyperparameters, compute details (single 24GB GPU), and an open-source commitment. No instructions inside the paper were followed.

primary_link.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies

top5.summary: Many agentic systems must repeatedly choose between acting and abstaining, making faithful reasoning important for oversight: an explanation is useful only if it reflects the computation that produced the action. We study this problem through intervention timing in multi-party conversation, where an assistant must decide whether to speak or remain silent. This setting exposes class imbalance, asymmetric action costs, and the possibility that exposing reasoning changes the policy being audited. U
top5.summary_zh: 本文探討具棄權能力的行動政策之忠實推理：代理系統不僅要決定說什麼，還要決定是否該出手，而解釋唯有反映真正產生行動的計算才有價值。作者以多方對話中的干預時機為受控測試平台，利用 Qwen3-8B 可切換 think 與 no-think 解碼模式的特性，比較直接決策分類器、推理政策、LoRA 監督式微調與 GRPO 強化學習。結果呈現一致的能力—可稽核性權衡：決策 token 微調分類器達到最佳 macro-F1（0.620）卻不留任何推理可供檢視；推理政策可稽核但效能較低，漏失干預的比率明顯偏高。監督式微調會壓抑推理，保留推理的遮罩目標只在模型本已答對的案例上訓練，無法改善困難案例；GRPO 在所有取樣 rollout 一致行動（含自信犯錯）時缺乏學習訊號，加入行為忠實獎勵也因推理格式效應主導而失效，近似 Goodhart 定律。探針與行為消融顯示干預決策多在推理過程中才形成，但原始截斷測試會高估推理依賴，必須以長度相符的中性填充內容控制格式效應；論文另警示類別不平衡下的探針準確率、探針位置、機率貢獻指標飽和等陷阱，並主張強化學習比較應以獨立訓練 run 為統計單位。限制包括僅使用單一合成對話基準、深入分析限於 Qwen3-8B，且代表性分析仍屬相關性證據。本文顯示揭露推理本身會改變代理的行為政策，QA 式忠實性評估無法直接套用於可行動或棄權的代理系統。

links.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation

evidence: Abstract: 'static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens ... restores a 2.0-point gain over that baseline'

Section 3.2/Table 20: 'OneShot scores 56.2, below the S-only floor of 58.7 by more than twice the pooled standard deviation ... OracleSwap@16 lifts the score to 60.7, 4.5 above OneShot and 2.0 above the floor' with OracleSwap-mis@16 showing no repair
Section 5.2/Table 8: 'MP closes 52.2% of that gap on macro average, ahead of T2T at 26.9%, LoRA at 17.5%, and C2C at 10.9%'; per-dataset scores with mean +/- sd over three seeds
Table 1 (Section 5.3): row 2 'No refresh (R to inf)' drops mean recovery by -41.9; row 3 shows refresh without WRT recovers little; row 7 gates-zeroed reproduces S-only 'bit for bit'
Appendix C.5: 'The three trainable objects (C2C fuser, LoRA adapters, MentorPulse bridge) use the same training set fuse_v3, the same step budget, and the same learning-rate search'
Appendix A.4: 'any difference below 2*sigma_ab is described as comparable rather than better or worse; every claim of significance in the paper passes this threshold'
Appendix H.6: 'billing a resident, dedicated mentor for the full request duration instead of active compute seconds reverses the direction of the cost conclusion ... we report this reversal as is'
Section 5.4/Table 18: 'Recovery tracks V64 (Spearman rho=0.78, p=0.004); ... Three limits apply: eleven pairs are observational evidence'

Section 6/Appendix E.1: limits stated - 'The gains require long outputs (short outputs never refresh ...), basic student capability, and a pair close enough for selective reading'; 'cross-tokenizer pairs are future work'
Appendix A.3: 'Code, evaluation configurations, the data pipeline, per-seed outputs, and the scripts that derive every table in this appendix will be released' (promise, not yet available)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on cross-model latent guidance between frozen large/small LLMs (Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, Ministral), squarely in scope. Novel contribution: identifies 'guidance staleness' as a failure mode of one-shot cross-model guidance in long-form generation and introduces prefix-conditioned refresh via versioned slot memory, incremental mentor prefill, and Windowed Refresh Training, cleanly differentiated from LLM-to-SLM, C2C, LGR, RefreshKV, and disaggregated serving (Section 2, Table 6). Exceptional experimental discipline: 13 datasets, 11 mentor-student pairs across 3 families, 3 seeds with a 2x-pooled-SD significance rule (Appendix A.4), bit-exact degeneracy checks via zeroed gates (Appendix E.2), matched parameter budgets for LoRA and shared training data/budget for C2C (Appendix C), a disjoint diagnostic suite, and hard-verified identity constraints (Appendix G.5). The causal staleness diagnosis (probe readability decaying 0.79 to 0.47 while fresh stays 0.76-0.80; OracleSwap@16 lifting Multi-IF from 56.2 to 60.7 vs an S-only floor of 58.7, Section 3.2/Table 20) is a strong intervention-based design. Main result (52.2% gap closure vs 26.9% T2T, 17.5% LoRA, 10.9% C2C, Section 5.2/Table 8) and ablations (removing refresh costs -41.9 mean recovery, Table 1) are quantitatively supported. Honest cost accounting includes a sensitivity that reverses its own conclusion (resident mentor billing, Appendix H.6) and acknowledged limits: gains require long outputs and student capability, cross-tokenizer pairs untested, V64 predictor observational (n=11, Section 5.4). Reproducibility is strong on protocol detail (seeds, vLLM 0.19.1, lm-eval-harness 0.4.9, judge GPT-4.1, training pipeline stats) but code and artifacts are only promised for release, and LLM-judged metrics depend on a proprietary judge.

primary_link.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation

top5.summary: Cross-model latent guidance lets a frozen large mentor encode an input once and a frozen small student generate from the resulting signal. Existing methods keep this signal fixed, assuming it stays useful as the output grows; we show this fails in long-form generation. On multi-turn instruction following, static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens changes only the memory content and restores a 2
top5.summary_zh: 跨模型潛在引導讓凍結的大型 mentor 模型編碼輸入一次,凍結的小型 student 模型據此生成,但既有方法在解碼前算好引導訊號後便固定不變。本文指出此設計在長文本生成中失效:隨著已生成前綴增長,僅依輸入的靜態引導會過時,使 4B student 在多輪指令遵循任務的約束滿足率比無引導基準低 2.5 分。免訓練診斷證實,每 16 個 token 依前綴重建並替換記憶,即可在不改動 student 權重與 KV cache 的情況下恢復高出基準 2.0 分的增益,顯示問題源自引導「新鮮度」而非能力不足。MentorPulse 據此提出可部署機制:Slot Memory Constructor 將 mentor 狀態壓縮為數量有上限的槽位記憶;student 透過 gated cross-attention 橋接讀取;每 R 個 token 進行增量式 prefill,只處理新 token 並直接替換記憶,不會使 student 的 KV cache 失效;Windowed Refresh Training 則讓橋接學會消化生成中途的記憶更新。在十三個資料集上,MentorPulse 於主配對 Qwen3.5-27B→4B 平均縮小 52.2% 的 mentor–student 差距,優於 T2T、C2C 與同參數量 LoRA,並在三個模型家族共十一組配對全面領先;增益集中於長輸出任務,靜態潛在引導 C2C 在此反而低於 student 基線。預設 R=16 兼顧品質與成本,V64 讀取分佈變異數可在部署前預測配對增益。限制包括:短輸出從不觸發刷新、student 需具備基本能力、能力差距過大的配對增益收窄;學習式刷新觸發與跨 tokenizer 配對仍屬未來工作。整體而言,本文將「引導新鮮度」確立為設計軸線,使大小模型協作在長文本生成中最能發揮價值。

links.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

evidence: Section 6.2 / Table 3: 1.2% poison (360 memories, n=120 questions) drops LongMemEval accuracy 0.850→0.300; write-time screening 'refused 0 of 360 poisoned memories'; poisoned memory ranked #1 for every question.

Section 6.3: shipped weights (wt=0.15) give margin 0.175 vs poison's 0.32 similarity gain; McNemar p=0.80 vs no defense; corrected wt=0.35 imposes 0.245 absolute penalty against 0.45 max semantic term, characterized as 'a hard exclusion filter wearing the costume of a soft one.'

Table 6 (Section 6.3): Corpus M (94% benign untrusted band) accuracy 0.3167→0.7000 (p=1.17e-10) but authors flag windfall from removing distractors; Corpus N (untrusted evidence) accuracy 0.8583→0.0417 with evidence recall 99.17%→0.00% (p=6.31e-30).

Section 6.4 / Table 4: full pipeline reaches 0.832 recall on InjecAgent indirect injection with 0.035 FPR on NotInject vs 42.8% for DeBERTa-based detectors; Table 5 ablation shows Stage 3 injection rules contribute zero on indirect injection (Stage 2 secrets detector fires on credential-shaped exfiltration strings).

Section 7: adaptive-attack sweep pre-registered but 'not complete[d] in time'; single retriever/embedding model/reader; remedy (occupancy gate) 'not implemented or evaluated'; trust labels assumed un-malleable per threat model in Section 2.3.

Appendix A: repo revision 6d2863083361f7a5c8e12b4512346c94cb453c2c, LongMemEval_S revision 2ec2a557 with SHA-256, seed 42 throughout, sha256-keyed completion caching with temperature folded into key, measured $11.22 mixed-provenance arm cost, per-corpus dataset revisions in Table 1.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agent-security paper squarely within preference scope: LLM agent persistent-memory poisoning, write-time injection screening, and provenance-weighted retrieval, with strong alignment to Agents & Tool Use (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), and Red Teaming & Evaluation (1.8). Rigor is high: paired exact McNemar tests across identical question sets, a mixed-provenance design that explicitly removes the trust-label-as-answer-key confound (Corpus M/N, Section 6.3), per-stage ablation of the screening pipeline (Table 5), bootstrap CIs, and a three-line margin derivation (Equation 2) that explains both the inert shipped default (p=0.80) and the over-correction at wt=0.35. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative (0.850→0.300 at 1.2% poison, 0/360 screening refusals, Corpus N evidence recall 99.17%→0.00%). Notable honesty: negative result on the authors' own shipped product, limitations ordered by threat, and explicit refusal to claim the proposed occupancy-constraint remedy. Novelty is good but bounded: memory poisoning itself is established (PoisonedRAG, AgentPoison, MINJA, concurrent MPBench); the contributions are the utility-retained metric, the screening-boundary demonstration, and the additive-margin analysis rather than a new attack or defense. Generalizability is the weakest component: one memory system, one retriever/embedder/reader, LongMemEval-S only, non-adaptive attacker, and the authors acknowledge empirical generalization is by argument, not replication (Section 7). Reproducibility is excellent: pinned repo revision, frozen JSON inputs, seeds, completion caching, dataset revisions, and measured $11.22 API cost (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

top5.summary: Persistent memory makes false information durable: once a false statement is stored, it can be retrieved into future sessions that match it. We measure the cost of this failure mode using plainly worded false assertions generated in a single pass, with no instruction, trigger, or retriever optimization. Poisoning 1.2% of a LongMemEval corpus reduces accuracy from 0.850 to 0.300. A four-stage write-time screening pipeline that reaches 0.832 recall on indirect prompt injection while flagging 1.5%
top5.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 代理程式持久記憶遭投毒攻擊時的效用損失,以及寫入與讀取兩道防線的極限。作者刻意採用最弱攻擊:單次生成、不含指令或觸發詞、也未針對檢索器最佳化的白話錯誤陳述,藉此污染 LongMemEval 語料。僅佔語料 1.2% 的 360 筆毒化記憶,便使準確率從 0.850 跌至 0.300,失去約三分之二的記憶價值。寫入端的四階段內容篩選管線雖在間接提示注入偵測上達 0.832 召回率、誤報率僅 1.5%,卻對 360 筆毒化記憶全部放行;作者論證這是內容篩選類方法的結構性邊界,因為辨識陳述真偽需要文字以外的外部依據。防禦因此落在讀取端的來源加權排序,但結果並不理想:原廠預設權重統計上與無防禦無異(p=0.80);提高權重雖將效用恢復至 56%,卻是靠完全排除而非偏好——其對不可信內容的絕對懲罰超過語意相似度可用範圍的一半。混合來源實驗顯示,當不可信內容多為良性時防禦仍有效(0.3167 升至 0.7000);但當承載答案的證據本身來自不可信通道時,120 題的證據召回全數歸零,準確率跌至 0.0417。作者據此主張,此種加法計分形式下來源項沒有可用設定,應改採有界佔用配額。主要限制包括:攻擊者未做自適應最佳化、僅測單一系統與嵌入模型,且信任標籤可能遭洗白竄改。本文以「保留效用」取代攻擊成功率作為核心指標,並揭露防禦在無攻擊時的代價,對代理記憶安全評估極具參考價值。
top5.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking
top5.title_zh: 受攻擊下的效用:代理記憶投毒與內容篩選、來源加權排序的極限

links.title: In-Cell Learning: Deployed Language Models Can Learn New Knowledge Without Changing a Single Stored Bit

evidence: Abstract and §3.1: CellFill parametrization W = Ŵ + M ⊙ tanh(sBAᵀ) with B=0 at init, so |W_ij − Ŵ_ij| < M_ij for every weight regardless of optimizer; invariance is a property of the parametrization, not the training run.

§2 Prop. 1 and Appendix A: bitwise invariance holds only against frozen (a,s); a two-weight counterexample (executed as a unit test) shows re-running a quantizer with recomputed absmax scales silently reassigns untouched weights.

§5.1 Table 1: CellFill r=64 recovers 66.7±8.6% of synthetic facts with LAMBADA 42.33±1.99 under exact invariance asserted over 1.409×10⁹ constrained weights with zero violations; unconstrained dense pays 74.83 LAMBADA for 59.3±8.7%.

§5.5 Table 4: at the lr CellFill uses (1e-3), LoRA collapses (WikiText 796.48, 61.7% of weights clipped, 0.0% recall) while CellFill reaches 94.3±2.2% bit-identically; LoRA needs 2e-4 to work and still must be clipped (8.5%).

§5.5 Tables 2–3: MEMIT destroys the model under sequential application (WikiText 20,348 archived) and GRACE under its honest condition scores 2.0% (the untouched model's rate), while CellFill's honest condition reaches 95.7% on the 507 real probes.

§5.7 Table 7: on the PopQA tail, the fill answers 81.8–89.8% of unknowns at 75 tokens/question versus 90–1,008 tokens for retrieval arms, and is unaffected by the chunked index that drops retrieval to 41–74%.

§5.13 Table 10: at 10⁴ facts the knee is the tanh link's dead gradient (78.4% saturation), not the cells; gradient-preserving links raise absorption 22–24% to 36–39%, and stored bits (3–5×10⁻⁵/cell) are far below parametrization capacity.

§5.17: four sequential tasks each verified with zero violations; mean-room ratios 0.8271/0.8254/0.8238 give β=0.825±0.002, and the naive identity β=1−E|t| is shown false by logged fills (0.44–0.52 vs implied 0.17).

§5.16 Table 13: mechanism verified on published NF4/QAT releases (Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B at 94.3–97.6%, Gemma-4 at 82.9%) and a 27B gated-linear-attention model with 2.435×10¹⁰ weights bit-identical, though the 27B run is single-seed with a different recipe.

§9 Limitations: one model family/quantizer for most claims, n=1 for the entire 27B result and seven partitions, in-domain perplexity contaminated by rehearsal everywhere, diagonal-Fisher budget underestimates drift 15.9×–383×, and the headline capacity number and its cross-domain price come from different runs.

§10 Reproducibility: archived JSON configs trace every number, tables generated by scripts/make_tables.py, 25 CPU unit tests, exact commands per experiment, code at github.com/sumsliu/cellfill; §9 reports vendor byte-identity verification (bitsandbytes returns the release's 7.05×10⁸ packed bytes identically).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology work: continual learning on deployed 4-bit LLMs with bitwise artifact invariance, positioned at the intersection of quantization/efficiency, LoRA-style fine-tuning, knowledge injection vs RAG, and deployment/serving. The reframing of the dequantization gap as writable storage, the tanh-bounded CellFill parametrization with invariance by construction, the plasticity decay law (Prop. 6), and nested refinement bits are genuinely novel relative to QLoRA/LoftQ/QA-LoRA, PEQA/AlphaTuning, BitDelta, and editing methods. Rigor is unusually high: formal propositions with proofs and unit tests, exhaustive integer-domain verification on every merge, matched controls (unmerged adapter, unconstrained dense), LoRA/MEMIT/GRACE/retrieval baselines, and a candid limitations section that walks back earlier overclaims (rehearsal free-lunch artifact, Fisher budget not a certificate). Evidence is broad and archived but many key comparisons are n=1 or n=2 with seed spreads comparable to effects; capacity exponents come from two points; the capacity headline and its cross-domain price come from different runs. Generalizability is limited: facts only (no skills), one quantizer stack for most results, no GPTQ/AWQ measurements despite the argument that cell arithmetic applies, single sequential sequence on one model, and the 27B point uses a different recipe and path. Reproducibility is excellent: released code, archived JSON results generating all tables via scripts, exact commands, hyperparameter appendix, and vendor byte-identity verification.

primary_link.title: In-Cell Learning: Deployed Language Models Can Learn New Knowledge Without Changing a Single Stored Bit

top5.summary: A deployed language model is a file that many things depend on - a benchmark report, a certification, a fleet of devices - and every way of teaching it something new produces a different file. We show that this is not necessary. A 4-bit release stores each weight as an integer code and a shared scale, and leaves between the stored values an interval the quantizer discards; we call in-cell learning the paradigm in which new knowledge is written only into that interval, so that re-quantizing the s
top5.summary_zh: 已部署的 4-bit 量化模型是一份被基準報告、認證與裝置依賴的檔案,而任何教它新知識的方法(全參數 fine-tuning、adapter 合併、知識編輯)都會產生不同的檔案,迫使整套認證重來。本文提出 in-cell learning 典範:4-bit 權重以整數碼加共享縮放因子儲存,量化器丟棄的細胞內區間可作為可寫入空間;更新只寫進該區間,重新量化後可逐位元重現原始釋出版本。CellFill 以 W=Ŵ+M⊙tanh(sBAᵀ) 的有界低秩參數化實作,並直接在供應商自己的 4-bit 釋出版上訓練;更新是獨立、可撤銷的 fill 檔案,漂移由訓練前固定的半徑界定。在 NF4、QAT 與 GPTQ 式網格、Qwen3 與 Gemma(1.7B 至 31B)上,CellFill 寫入 83–97% 模型確實不知道的真實事實,於高達 2.4×10^10 個受限權重上零違規;同學習率的 LoRA 則會發散。寫入的知識確實可用:藥物與成分能以模型自身的兩跳上限組合;對 PopQA 長尾,fill 以每題 75 tokens 回答 82–90% 釋出模型答不了的問題,且不受區塊索引影響。多位寫入者可共用一次釋出,順序更新的可寫空間以 β≈0.82 幾何衰減,遺忘被測量而非消除。限制包括:僅示範事實而非技能、種子數少、NF4 以外的網格多為論證而非實測、Fisher 預算並非可用的數值憑證。此方法將模型更新從整份替換變成可稽核、可回滾的增量,對認證成本高於算力成本的部署場景極具價值。
top5.title: In-Cell Learning: Deployed Language Models Can Learn New Knowledge Without Changing a Single Stored Bit

links.title: Level-k Distinguishable Mechanisms for Evaluating Bounded Rationality in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: models 'maintain accurate strategic depth under recursive reasoning' and 'errors arise from using the wrong number of iterated depth of reasoning steps, not from computing best responses incorrectly'.

Definition 1 (Methodology): formalizes level-K distinguishability as injectivity of k -> a(k) on {0,...,Kmax}; motivating counterexample shows depth-0 and depth-2 proposals coincide in the negotiation game of Zhang et al. (2025).

Table 2 (Experiment and Results): recursive-condition accuracy 83.5-92.5% for three models but Sonnet 4.6 49.0 (99.0 within-one) in 11-20 Mod.; inductive accuracy collapses to 0.5-2.5% in Nash Demand, showing uneven degradation.
Appendix A.4: 'Ring 11-20 separates them' - extrapolating the constant -3 step diverges from the IDR sequence at k=4, giving an extrapolation check the three arithmetic games lack.
Appendix A.3: exclusion of Ring 11-20 k_target=10 trials is quantified - retaining ambiguous 20 submissions would raise pooled accuracy from 31.9% (n=12,467) to 32.9% (n=12,787).
Appendix B.3 Table 7: models called via OpenRouter slugs, temperature 0.2, max_tokens 8192, 4 games x 10 levels x conditions x 20 reps = 3200 trials per model; no-action trials scored as incorrect.
Appendix D.4: Wilson intervals plus cluster bootstrap with B=2000; clustered intervals are a median 4.1x wider per model and 7.6x pooled.
Conclusions: limitations - 'we only tested up to a depth of 10' and 'a single LLM judge (Claude Opus 4.8) to read and score every chain of thought'.
Appendix D.1: judge is same family as one evaluated model; extraction-only design with mandatory verbatim quotes mitigates but 'does not eliminate that possibility'.
Appendix B.2: confound acknowledged - wording change between k_target=4 and 5 means 'the design as run cannot separate the effect of the wording from the effect of the depth'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-methodology paper: evaluates four LLMs' strategic reasoning depth via level-k game instruments, with chain-of-thought consistency analysis and a tool-calling inductive condition, matching multiple high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, agents/tool use, evaluation, theory of mind). Novelty is substantive: the level-k distinguishability condition (Definition 1) directly addresses an identifiability gap in prior LLM game benchmarks, and the novel Ring 11-20 game plus non-monotone IDR sequence separates iteration from extrapolation (Appendix A.4). Rigor is high: closed-form best-response maps, a pigeonhole bound on Kmax (Lemma 1), blinded extraction-only judge with quote grounding, Wilson and cluster-bootstrap intervals (Appendix D.4), and an honest confound disclosure that wording change and depth boundary are inseparable at k=4/5. Evidence is quantitatively supported (Table 2 per-game accuracies, Figure 4 chain-length analysis, Table 3 mentalizing splits), though the mentalizing-accuracy link is correlational and the judge shares a model family with one evaluated model (acknowledged in D.1). Generalizability is limited to depth 10, four games, four models, and a single judge, as the Conclusions state. Reproducibility is strong: verbatim prompts (B.2), model slugs and decoding (Table 7), sampling formula for histories (C.1), released logs/code including lambda_sweep.csv, and provider-pinning guidance.

primary_link.title: Level-k Distinguishable Mechanisms for Evaluating Bounded Rationality in LLMs

top5.summary: Strategic depth of reasoning is essential for human interaction of Large Language Models (LLMs) operating in boundedly rational environments. However, existing evaluations are primarily based on canonical games prevalent in pretraining corpora, making it difficult to disentangle true strategic reasoning from memorisation. To address this, we formalise a necessary level-K distinguishability condition for strategic depth inference and construct a suite of novel game structures that meet this stand
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對現有LLM策略推理評估的效度缺口提出解方。過去研究多以預訓練語料中常見的經典賽局測試策略深度，難以區分真實推理與背誦，且缺乏不同推理深度對應到不同行動的保證，無法從行為辨識真實推理層級。作者形式化level-k可區分性條件，要求疊代最佳反應序列一一對應到不同行動，並建構新穎的五人環狀賽局Ring 11–20，同時改寫11–20金錢請求、All-Pay Auction與Nash Demand三個經典賽局。實驗涵蓋Gemma 4 31B、Qwen 3.6 27B、Claude Sonnet 4.6與DeepSeek v4 Pro四個模型，對手涵蓋L0至L9，並比較遞迴條件化（以語言描述對手層級）與歸納條件化（僅提供30筆對手歷史行動）。遞迴條件下各模型準確率高，思考鏈陳述的信念與實際行動內部一致；錯誤主要源自疊代步數算錯而非最佳反應計算錯誤，如Sonnet 4.6在深度4後固定少一層，Gemma 4在深度9、10失能。歸納條件下準確率劇烈且不均地下滑，於Nash Demand幾近歸零；思考鏈含明確策略性心智化的試次表現明顯較佳。限制包括僅測至深度10、依賴單一LLM評審Claude Opus 4.8，且對手描述措辭在深度4與5間改變，難以分離兩者效果。此研究對AI安全（低層級代理可能遭剝削）與以LLM模擬人類策略行為的基準設計深具意義。
